chinese_text: [那自己找找嘛。]
english_text: [Then just find opportunities yourself.]

chinese_text: [就把钱挣上了。]
english_text: [And they just make the money.]

chinese_text: [那你们做演员就不能越过经纪人吗？]
english_text: [So as actors, can't you bypass the agents?]

chinese_text: [行，哎呀。]
english_text: [Alright, jeez.]

chinese_text: [那你要这样的话是不是，有的演员也像跟你现在说的话也一样，这样吗？]
english_text: [If that's the case, do some actors also say things like what you're saying now?]

chinese_text: [往那一呆，那一整天我的妈呀，完了就那那点儿钱，你让我呆一天？中间又不爽了，有那演员直接说我走了，那经纪说啊有本事你走。]
english_text: [Just standing there all day, oh my god, and for that little money? You expect me to stay all day? Then when things go wrong, some actors just say 'I'm leaving,' and the agent says 'Go ahead, leave if you dare.']

chinese_text: [就他是我们的甲方爸爸，所以人家这边选不选你是人家的这边。就是人一一句不高兴直接跟他的甲方爸爸说，啊这个演员没空。]
english_text: [He's our client, so it's up to them whether they choose you or not. The moment they're unhappy, they can just tell their client, 'This actor isn't available.']

chinese_text: [慢慢慢来吧，主要是这经纪真难。]
english_text: [Take it slow, mainly because dealing with agents is really difficult.]

chinese_text: [那钱全让人中间经纪给挣了。]
english_text: [Then all the money is taken by the middleman agents.]

chinese_text: [就我们还得啊，还得捧着人家，哼凭啥呀真是。]
english_text: [And we still have to suck up to them, hmph, on what grounds, really.]

chinese_text: [你要这么说有可能。]
english_text: [If you put it that way, it's possible.]

chinese_text: [啊，人家至少挣你一半一般这种情况。然后人家挣钱了，完了你这我就做演员跟牛马似的，把你搞到剧组骗那了，骗那了让你耗一天，跟你说戏少戏少。]
english_text: [Well, they usually take at least half of your pay in these situations. Then they make their money, and here you are working like a beast, getting dragged to film sets, deceived, made to waste a whole day, being told there are only a few scenes.]

chinese_text: [嗯哼，你是以为我们特别挣钱。]
english_text: [Mhm, you think we make a lot of money.]

chinese_text: [哎你就待一会儿，哎没多少钱，然后就待一会儿帮算帮个忙吧。然后结果呢，他帮帮完一会儿你会发现啊大太阳底下。]
english_text: [Hey, just stay for a little while, it's not much money, just stay for a bit and help out as a favor. And then what happens? After you've helped for a bit, you find yourself under the hot sun.]

chinese_text: [刚哥，你知不知道我们现在做演员这行儿真不好做。]
english_text: [Brother Gang, do you know how difficult it is to be an actor these days?]

chinese_text: [想啊，那那没有经纪我们也没活呀。]
english_text: [I know, but without agents, we wouldn't get any work either.]

chinese_text: [人家一走那经纪完了又说，哎呀，你快回来吧快回来吧，哎我的错。你说这种人那两两两边倒这边挣着钱这边还那啥。这是我真无语了，就就这钱真不好挣。]
english_text: [Once they leave, the agent then says, 'Oh, please come back, please come back, it's my fault.' You see this kind of person, playing both sides, making money from both ends. I'm truly speechless, this money is really hard to earn.]

chinese_text: [真的，林子大了什么鸟都有，所以说啊出门在外啊，你说不定能遇见什么人。]
english_text: [Really, in a big forest, you'll find all kinds of birds, so when you're out in the world, you never know who you might meet.]

chinese_text: [啊，你像我经常出差啊。]
english_text: [Well, take me for example, I travel for business often.]

chinese_text: [就是没素质啊，公共场所儿就不注意形象。]
english_text: [They just have no class, not caring about their image in public places.]

chinese_text: [像这种人啊。]
english_text: [People like that.]

chinese_text: [那你静下心来，要不就别看了，一会儿到了。]
english_text: [Then calm down, or just stop looking, we'll be there soon.]

chinese_text: [没素质。]
english_text: [So rude.]

chinese_text: [见多了见怪不怪了，什么样的人都有，那还有上次，哎，我坐高铁。]
english_text: [I've seen so much that nothing surprises me anymore. There are all kinds of people. Like last time, sigh, I was on the high-speed train.]

chinese_text: [行了行了，你静下心来看你的书，你搭理他干啥呀？]
english_text: [Alright, alright, calm down and read your book. Why are you even bothering with him?]

chinese_text: [哇，我的妈你你诶抹得那脸上白呀，我的哎放屁。]
english_text: [Wow, my god, your face is so white with makeup. Oh my, fart.]

chinese_text: [没完没啊不，哪能没完没了。那拉裤子里了，那怎么的呀，就是一会儿当儿一会儿当。]
english_text: [It's not endless, no, how could it be endless. What if someone poops their pants, then what? It's just for a little while, for a moment.]

chinese_text: [那你现在看也看不心里去呀。]
english_text: [You can't focus on reading now anyway.]

chinese_text: [哎烦死了真是。]
english_text: [Sigh, so annoying, really.]

chinese_text: [哎，放屁，我的妈你说你个妇女，你这么大年龄了，哎她就在在旁边就坐坐我旁边儿。]
english_text: [Sigh, farting. My god, you're a woman, and at your age, sigh, she's sitting right there next to me.]

chinese_text: [[over]嫌[over]弃死我了，你你说她是个妇女，我一一个大男人我也没法儿说她呀。]
english_text: [I'm so disgusted. You say she's a woman, and I'm a grown man, so I can't really say anything to her.]

chinese_text: [烦死了，哎我真是吵死了。]
english_text: [So annoying, sigh, it's really so noisy.]

chinese_text: [我就看，烦死了也没完了这个人，真没素质。]
english_text: [I'll just watch. So annoying, this person never stops, really no manners.]

chinese_text: [烦死了，不是那那你看看，那腿颠儿的，颠的我书文字我都看不清了都快。]
english_text: [So annoying. No, then you look, the legs are shaking so much that I can barely see the words in my book.]

chinese_text: [我眼睛都让他给瞅瞎了都近视了现在。]
english_text: [My eyes are going blind from staring, and now I'm nearsighted.]

chinese_text: [没完了？]
english_text: [Not done yet?]

chinese_text: [咋那么没素质呢？咱下次坐一等座吧？这二等座真是坐得烦死了，每天都遇到这种人，哇哇哇哇还没完。]
english_text: [How can someone be so rude? Let's sit in first class next time? This second class is so annoying to sit in, I encounter people like this every day, wow, wow, wow, and it's still not over.]

chinese_text: [她是不是没完没了地放了？]
english_text: [Is she endlessly farting?]

chinese_text: [下次我不坐了，真是真是受不了了。]
english_text: [I'm not taking this next time, really, really can't stand it anymore.]

chinese_text: [鞋脱了，闻到味儿了吗？]
english_text: [Took off shoes, can you smell the odor?]

chinese_text: [没完了？]
english_text: [Not done yet?]

chinese_text: [哎我真真恶心，我真服了，这公共场合他脱啥鞋呢？臭死了。]
english_text: [Sigh, I'm really disgusted, I give up. Why take off shoes in a public place? It stinks so bad.]

chinese_text: [我这，真是我真心我受不了。]
english_text: [Me, really, I truly can't stand it.]

chinese_text: [我能看吗？你你你看看我那书颠的，嘚嘚嘚嘚嘚那儿颠的。]
english_text: [How can I read? Look, look, look at my book shaking, rattling over there.]

chinese_text: [你你看你看这，还往我身边儿靠，挤过去咱咱俩一二三挤，烦人。]
english_text: [You, look, look at this, still leaning toward me, squeeze over, let's squeeze together, one, two, three, so annoying.]

chinese_text: [我想看会儿书都看不了，你看看一直在那打电话，没完啦。]
english_text: [I can't even read for a bit, look, they keep talking on the phone endlessly.]

chinese_text: [爸你每次都是这句话，每一次都这样。]
english_text: [Dad, you always say the same thing, every single time.]

chinese_text: [我很小时候妈妈就走了，就剩你一个了，没有人再陪我过生日了，为什么你就不能陪陪我呢？每一年都这样。]
english_text: [Mom left when I was very young, leaving only you. There's no one else to celebrate my birthday with me anymore, so why can't you spend time with me? It's like this every year.]

chinese_text: [你闺女我的生日！]
english_text: [Your daughter's birthday! Mine!]

chinese_text: [你还是不记得，你都不知道什么日子。]
english_text: [You still don't remember, you don't even know what day it is.]

chinese_text: [每一次都把饭给我做好让我一个人吃，可是你每次之前都说要跟我一起吃。可是你记得今天是什么生什么日子吗？]
english_text: [Every time you make a meal for me to eat alone, but you always say before that you'll eat with me. But do you remember what special day today is?]

chinese_text: [哎爸不是，爸你你怎么不不吃饭了呢？]
english_text: [No, Dad. Dad, why... why aren't you eating?]

chinese_text: [爸你，你一年能陪我吃几次饭啊？]
english_text: [Dad, how many times a year can you eat with me?]

chinese_text: [不是，爸我不要你再回来给我捎蛋糕，我只想让你现在跟我在一块儿。]
english_text: [No, Dad. I don't want you to bring back a cake for me later. I just want you to be with me right now.]

chinese_text: [哎呀女儿，爸是一名消防员，有任务在身。那饭爸给你留好了，你自己吃啊。]
english_text: [Oh, daughter, Dad is a firefighter and has a mission. I've left the food for you, so eat it yourself.]

chinese_text: [蓉蓉！那个，饭桌儿上的饭我给你留好了啊，爸有任务我先走了啊。]
english_text: [Rongrong! Hey, I've left the food on the table for you. Dad has a mission, so I'm leaving now.]

chinese_text: [行了不说了，爸走了。]
english_text: [Alright, that's enough. Dad is leaving.]

chinese_text: [好了，来不及了蓉蓉，爸要先走了。]
english_text: [Okay, there's no time, Rongrong. Dad has to go now.]

chinese_text: [女儿，爸真有有任务在身，好吗？听话，乖，等爸出完任务回来，爸给你捎个蛋糕回来好吗？]
english_text: [Daughter, Dad really does have a mission, okay? Be good, listen. When Dad comes back from the mission, I'll bring you a cake, okay?]

chinese_text: [哎呀，怎么了？]
english_text: [Oh, what's wrong?]

chinese_text: [不是，不是。爸，哎不是不是不是，师傅，你看我都现在觉得，你都快快跟我爸一样了，比我爸还冲，你知道吗？]
english_text: [No, no. Dad, no, no, no. Master, look, I feel like you're becoming just like my dad, even more impulsive than him, you know?]

chinese_text: [没有师父。]
english_text: [No, Master.]

chinese_text: [但卖的好呀，你挣钱了呀！房租都交不起了，你不让我刻。]
english_text: [But it sells well, you're making money! We can't even afford the rent, yet you won't let me carve.]

chinese_text: [他们真要看我的面子，就会买您的雕画，为什么要买我的呢？因为他们能拿我这个去送人，你那个送不出去。]
english_text: [If they really respected me, they would buy your carvings. Why would they buy mine? Because they can give mine as gifts, but yours can't be given away.]

chinese_text: [为我这手艺一直在学，那你没发现，咱卖不出去了吗？卖不出去那说明啥，就没钱挣，没钱挣那我刻了个啥？我刻刻这个，我现在开始刻点创新的东西，你现在又说我不对。]
english_text: [I've been learning this craft all this time, but haven't you noticed we can't sell anything anymore? If we can't sell, what does that mean? No money. If there's no money, what am I carving for? I'm carving this, I'm starting to carve something innovative now, and you're saying I'm wrong.]

chinese_text: [不是师父，你咋看见我没有好好学呀？我这不雕着，你不是还夸我了之前。]
english_text: [No, Master. How can you say I'm not learning properly? I'm carving right here, and you even praised me before.]

chinese_text: [可是人家顾客就觉得我这个创新东西，挺好的。]
english_text: [But the customers think my innovative works are quite good.]

chinese_text: [不是，师父。不是，我问你，你这老思想，你现在雕画，能卖出几个，你告诉我？你一个月卖出一个了吗？你你雕那些卖出去了吗？是不是这个月，我雕了十个，卖出九个？]
english_text: [No, Master. No, let me ask you, with your old-fashioned thinking, how many of your carvings can you sell now? Tell me. Have you sold even one in a month? Have you sold any of those carvings you made? Didn't I carve ten this month and sell nine of them?]

chinese_text: [对不起师父，我道歉啦！]
english_text: [I'm sorry, Master. I apologize!]

chinese_text: [我我现在在干啥呀，师父？]
english_text: [What am I doing now, Master?]

chinese_text: [你现在还这个老思想，你就不变通一下吗？我能卖出钱，说明咱这个创新是有用的。我这个雕画是有有意义的，有意义他们想买，想买，咱这个店就能做大一[over]点儿[over]。]
english_text: [You're still stuck with this old thinking, can't you be a bit more flexible? The fact that I can make money from selling shows that our innovation is useful. My carvings have meaning, and because they have meaning, people want to buy them. If they want to buy them, our shop can grow a little bigger.]

chinese_text: [啊，你说我这雕的好，然后你教的是。]
english_text: [Oh, you say my carving is good, and then you're the one teaching?]

chinese_text: [学着呢呀。]
english_text: [I'm learning, aren't I?]

chinese_text: [学了吗？啊？]
english_text: [Have you learned it? Huh?]

chinese_text: [你说你每天拿着个破手机，按巴什么呢？这个雕刻技术你学没学啊？]
english_text: [You say you're holding that broken phone all day, what are you fiddling with? Have you learned this carving technique or not?]

chinese_text: [啊，做你的少爷去，我不收你这个徒弟！]
english_text: [Oh, go be your young master, I won't take you as my apprentice!]

chinese_text: [我告诉你啊，你这么年轻，我所有教给你的，都是我年轻时候。我年轻的时候，好多人找着我去刻东西。]
english_text: [Let me tell you, you're so young, everything I teach you is from when I was young. When I was young, many people asked me to carve things for them.]

chinese_text: [你年纪轻轻的，天天就玩儿手机。教给你的手艺，你有没有用心去学啊，有没有？]
english_text: [You're so young, yet you play on your phone all day. The craftsmanship I taught you, did you learn it with dedication, did you or did you not?]

chinese_text: [好，明天回家当你的少爷，我不收你这个徒弟了。]
english_text: [Fine, go home tomorrow and be your young master, I won't take you as my apprentice anymore.]

chinese_text: [你卖出去的，那都是你的同学啊，好朋友，是看你面子，知道吗？你自己看看，你真正刻的是什么玩意儿？]
english_text: [The ones you sold to, they're all your classmates, good friends who are doing you a favor, you know? Take a look yourself, what kind of crap are you actually carving?]

chinese_text: [我夸你，那是我夸你？]
english_text: [When I praise you, is that really me praising you?]

chinese_text: [你觉得你现在翅膀硬了，是吗？]
english_text: [You think you've grown strong wings now, is that it?]

chinese_text: [你是来给我学手艺啊，还是来当大爷呢？]
english_text: [Did you come here to learn craftsmanship from me, or to act like a master?]

chinese_text: [我就是这样教你的吗？我是这样教你的吗？]
english_text: [Is this how I taught you? Is this how I taught you?]

chinese_text: [是不是想飞？]
english_text: [Want to fly, is that it?]

chinese_text: [你现在你是坐着跟大爷似的，啊？]
english_text: [Now you're sitting there like a master, huh?]

chinese_text: [敢给师父大吼大叫了。啊，你刚学会了走路，现在想飞啊？]
english_text: [Daring to shout at your master now. Oh, you just learned to walk, and now you want to fly?]

chinese_text: [我告诉你啊，我就是看你爸，我们俩是好朋友我教你。你要是再这样下去，回家，做你的少爷去。]
english_text: [Let me tell you, I'm only teaching you because your father and I are good friends. If you keep this up, go home and be your young master.]

chinese_text: [什么？断绝父女关系。]
english_text: [What? Severing father-daughter relationship.]

chinese_text: [不是，你就不能给爸点笑容吗你？]
english_text: [Come on, can't you give your dad a smile?]

chinese_text: [就我准备给给你兰兰阿姨，这个行给你谈一下，让你允许我们俩，啊。]
english_text: [I was preparing to talk to you about Aunt Lanlan, to discuss this matter with you, to let you allow the two of us, you know.]

chinese_text: [[over]我[over]跟兰兰我们怎，我跟兰兰怎么了？我跟兰兰我现在我们俩，已经发展了一年多了，怎么了？]
english_text: [What about me and Lanlan? What's wrong with me and Lanlan? Lanlan and I have been together for over a year now, what's wrong with that?]

chinese_text: [那我，我跟你兰兰，兰兰阿姨你以后叫阿姨，啊，叫[over]阿姨[over]。]
english_text: [Then, me and your Lanlan, you'll call her Aunt Lanlan from now on, yes, call her Aunt.]

chinese_text: [不是啊，我跟你说女儿啊，这个，你也知道跟你妈分开之后啊，爸也一直就是自己一个人儿。]
english_text: [No, let me tell you, daughter, you know that after I separated from your mom, Dad has been living all by himself.]

chinese_text: [女儿，这个，给你商量个事儿。]
english_text: [Daughter, I need to discuss something with you.]

chinese_text: [不是，我是不是你爸呀！]
english_text: [Come on, am I not your father!]

chinese_text: [啊，你你这事儿。]
english_text: [Ah, this thing you've done.]

chinese_text: [行，爸，你要是让她进咱家一天门儿，我就跟你断绝父女关系。]
english_text: [Fine, Dad, if you let her into our home even for one day, I'll sever my father-daughter relationship with you.]

chinese_text: [我好像知道啥事儿了。]
english_text: [I think I know what's going on now.]

chinese_text: [那你一个人儿你，你一个人儿，你找其他人，你为啥要找兰兰呢？我就不明白兰兰是怎么，她。]
english_text: [Then why her? You could find someone else, why did you have to find Lanlan? I just don't understand what's with Lanlan, her...]

chinese_text: [兰兰阿姨？兰兰以前是我闺蜜，你让我现在叫她阿姨？是不是你们俩要结婚，我就叫她妈了，你啥意思呀？爸，啊，你还有没有我这个女儿了。]
english_text: [Auntie Lanlan? Lanlan used to be my best friend, and now you want me to call her auntie? Are you two getting married, so I should call her mom? What do you mean by this? Dad, do you even still consider me your daughter?]

chinese_text: [[over]你直接说[over]吧，别别别跟我这含糊了。]
english_text: [Just say it directly, stop being vague with me.]

chinese_text: [我算是看清她了。爸，你啥也别说了，这个兰兰现在心眼不好，你赶紧让她走。哪天她要是真进咱家门儿，我跟你说财产我一分没有。]
english_text: [I've seen her true colors now. Dad, don't say anything more. This Lanlan has bad intentions now, you need to make her leave quickly. If she really enters our home one day, let me tell you, I won't leave a single penny of the inheritance.]

chinese_text: [[over]不是[over]，爸，我也就半年前叫她。你你的意思是，你们俩之前就在一块啦，我不知道，哇行。]
english_text: [No, Dad, I only called her half a year ago. You mean you two were already together before, and I didn't know? Wow, fine.]

chinese_text: [不是那个兰兰到底给你是不是洗脑了，就来咱家一天，啊，你就看上她啦。]
english_text: [Did that Lanlan brainwash you or something? She comes to our home for one day, and you're already smitten with her?]

chinese_text: [嗯，你看着办吧，爸。反正现在就是这样有她没我，有我没她，你自己想吧。]
english_text: [Hmm, you figure it out, Dad. Anyway, it's come to this: if she's here, I'm not; if I'm here, she's not. Think about it yourself.]

chinese_text: [我就说她为啥说那天非要到我家，就这个意思呀，就看你现在挣点儿钱，她就没完了，是吗？往上贴。]
english_text: [No wonder she insisted on coming to our home that day, so this is what it's about. She sees you're making some money now and won't leave you alone, right? Sucking up to you.]

chinese_text: [一年多了爸！]
english_text: [It's been over a year, Dad!]

chinese_text: [咋了？你想想，是是是被你朋友骗了还是说，现现在有好多骗子诈骗手段太多了。]
english_text: [What's wrong? Think about it, were you deceived by your friend or what? There are so many scammers these days with too many fraudulent methods.]

english_text: [Go ahead and look, I'm waiting for you.]

english_text: [You're not a cleaner, then don't look.]

english_text: [Then I'll just leave it there, what about it?]

chinese_text: [咋的呢？进来坐会儿？]
english_text: [What's wrong? Want to come in and sit for a while?]

chinese_text: [[over]我这不是今天[over]不没下楼的吗？哎你要看不顺眼，你帮着扔了不就完了吗？搁这找什么事儿你？]

chinese_text: [我就放到那一会儿，怎么就有味儿了？一会我下去，我就扔了。]

english_text: [What's the matter?]

chinese_text: [有事儿吗？]

chinese_text: [那走廊也不是垃圾箱，也不是垃圾桶呀！]

chinese_text: [对啊，那那那咱们这么说好不好？对，您在里面是没问题。但是您为什么老老把什么垃圾啊，然后老老把这个鞋，放在走廊上呢啊？]

english_text: [It's fine.]

english_text: [I can not look, but I can still smell the odor! You don't know how strong the smell of your garbage bag is, do you? And then your shoes.]

chinese_text: [我是保洁？大哥。]
english_text: [Am I a cleaner? Brother.]

chinese_text: [你看我，就天天的从你们家路过呀什么的，万一就是您那，嗯嗯没穿衣服呀啥的。虽然对您在您自己家，但是我就特。]
english_text: [Look, I pass by your place every day, and what if, you know, you're not dressed or something. Even though it's your own home, I would just feel really...]

chinese_text: [大家都是成年人，对不对？大家这个垃圾都会有有自己处理的能力吧，对不对？而且这个走廊是。]
english_text: [We're all adults, right? Everyone should be able to handle their own trash, right? And this hallway is...]

chinese_text: [就是我每次我要坐电梯，我都得经过你们家门口，这很尴尬，你知道吗？]

english_text: [What do you mean 'in a little while'? When I came up last night, the trash was there, and the shoes were there too. Then when I went out this afternoon, the trash and shoes were still there. [over]In a little while[over].]

chinese_text: [不是我，我好害怕呀！我现在就是就是真的是我一个人在家里，我我什么都做不了我。]
english_text: [It's not me, I'm so scared! I'm really all alone at home right now, I can't do anything.]

chinese_text: [对呀，我也不知道是为什么，所以我现在该怎么办？我我完全看不见我就是，就是。]
english_text: [Yeah, I don't know why either, so what should I do now? I can't see anything at all, I just, I just...]

chinese_text: [不是，我突然间就是家里没电了，然后就一片漆黑现在。]
english_text: [No, suddenly the power went out in my home, and now it's completely dark.]

chinese_text: [别人家有啊。]
english_text: [Other people have electricity.]

chinese_text: [嗯嗯嗯。]
english_text: [Mmm hmm.]

chinese_text: [不是，关关键是，我我都摸不到门在哪儿，我都我都不知道我是待在那儿了，我。]
english_text: [No, the key thing is, I can't even find where the door is, I don't even know where I am right now.]

chinese_text: [好的好的好的。]
english_text: [Okay, okay, okay.]

chinese_text: [啊等一下等一下，有人敲门。]
english_text: [Ah, wait a minute, wait a minute, someone's knocking on the door.]

chinese_text: [反锁了反锁了。]
english_text: [It's bolted, it's bolted.]

english_text: [Should I go back to the bedroom?]

english_text: [Mmm hmm.]

english_text: [Hey, dear, what's wrong?]

english_text: [Phone. The phone's flashlight, quick!]

chinese_text: [怎么啦？]
english_text: [What's wrong?]

chinese_text: [然后然后我跟你说，你回卧室。]
english_text: [And then, and then I'm telling you, go back to the bedroom.]

chinese_text: [反锁了就好，反锁了就好，没事儿没事儿的啊，什么事都没有啊。别担心，我马上就回来了啊。]
english_text: [It's good that it's bolted, it's good that it's bolted, it's okay, it's okay, nothing's wrong. Don't worry, I'll be right back.]

chinese_text: [门反锁，嘘别吵吵，你听的门外有没有人？有吗？]
english_text: [The door is bolted, shush, be quiet, can you hear if there's anyone outside the door? Is there?]

chinese_text: [啊？别人家有电就咱家没有电？]

chinese_text: [对，你把卧室的门也锁上。]

chinese_text: [用被把自己蒙上，对，你躺进床，被子里面。]
english_text: [Cover yourself with the blanket, yes, you lie in bed, under the blanket.]

chinese_text: [好像有？]
english_text: [Is there someone?]

english_text: [Is someone knocking on the door?]

chinese_text: [我陪着你，我陪你聊天啊。]
english_text: [I'll stay with you, I'll chat with you.]

chinese_text: [把门反锁，抵住，千万不出千万不要出去。]
english_text: [Lock the door from the inside, block it, and whatever you do, don't go out.]

chinese_text: [就把门反锁。]
english_text: [Just lock the door from the inside.]

chinese_text: [别担心，别害怕，你用手机的手电筒你看看，别人家有没有电？]
english_text: [Don't worry, don't be scared. Use your phone's flashlight to see if the other apartments have electricity.]

chinese_text: [啊你上床上床。]
english_text: [Get on the bed, get on the bed.]

chinese_text: [你别别答理他，你不是不是已经反锁了？]
english_text: [Don't pay attention to him, haven't you already locked the door?]

chinese_text: [没事，我我我我现在就往回走，我现[over]在就往回走，我不挂电话啊。我不挂电话我现在就往回走。]
english_text: [It's okay, I'm heading back right now, I'm heading back right now, I won't hang up. I won't hang up, I'm heading back right now.]

chinese_text: [怎么啦？]
english_text: [What's wrong?]

english_text: [I can smell cigarette smoke every day.]

chinese_text: [有理啦！]
english_text: [You think you're so right!]

english_text: [Seriously, why are you being so dramatic, young lady? How does my smoking affect you? Did I spend your money or use your lighter?]

chinese_text: [不要坐电梯呀！走楼梯啊！楼梯里没有烟你走楼梯去啊！]
english_text: [Don't take the elevator! Take the stairs! There's no smoke in the stairs, go take the stairs!]

chinese_text: [没看见，爱坐不坐。]
english_text: [I don't see it, take it or leave it.]

chinese_text: [我抽我的烟怎么就把你捧上道德至高点了是吗？]
english_text: [How does my smoking put you on some moral high ground?]

chinese_text: [不是，我抽我地烟碍着你什么事儿，你花钱给我买的烟吗？]
english_text: [Seriously, how does my smoking affect you? Did you pay for my cigarettes?]

chinese_text: [呸，多管闲事儿。]
english_text: [Pfft, mind your own business.]

chinese_text: [我天天都看着呢，我天天都抽怎么啦？]
english_text: [I see it every day, I smoke every day, so what?]

chinese_text: [这不是道德至高点，不高德制高点的问题，这你就是不对的。]
english_text: [This isn't about moral high ground, you're just wrong.]

chinese_text: [那你不是明知故故犯吗？]
english_text: [Then aren't you knowingly doing something wrong?]

chinese_text: [只会给空气带来非常多的烟雾，那么这样子你自己出门去抽，你在大自然之间去抽好不好？]
english_text: [It just brings so much smoke into the air, so why don't you go outside to smoke, smoke in nature, okay?]

chinese_text: [不是，你天天都能闻到，那那你为什么还要在电梯里面抽烟呢？]
english_text: [Seriously, if you can smell it every day, then why do you still smoke in the elevator?]

chinese_text: [怎么你抽烟你还有理了是不是？]
english_text: [How can you be so self-righteous about smoking?]

chinese_text: [不是，你没看见墙上的字儿吗？电梯里面禁止抽烟！]
english_text: [No, didn't you see the sign on the wall? No smoking in the elevator!]

chinese_text: [什么叫矫情啊！这个明令禁止是不能抽烟。哦，您抽烟OK，那您出电梯之后你忍忍不行吗？不会在家里面。]
english_text: [What do you mean by being dramatic? It's explicitly forbidden to smoke here. Oh, it's OK for you to smoke, but can't you wait until after you get out of the elevator? Can't you just smoke at home?]

chinese_text: [大哥啊，你有闻到这个整个电梯都是烟味吗？]
english_text: [Brother, can you smell how the entire elevator reeks of cigarette smoke?]

chinese_text: [你没看到这个是公共场合公共场合吗？你公共场合如果都是你这样的人的话这个这社，社会怎么办？]
english_text: [Don't you see this is a public place? If everyone in public places were like you, what would happen to society?]

chinese_text: [我就感觉啊，那个你你那看你看你，你那个抽完烟就走了，然后我们全吸你的二手烟，那我们这个肺里面[over]全是烟了[over]。]
english_text: [I feel like, look at you, you just finish smoking and leave, and then we all inhale your secondhand smoke, so our lungs are filled with smoke.]

chinese_text: [那好OK，爱坐不坐是吧？那么请你现在现在下电梯好不好？你你这样只会给人家带来不便利。]

english_text: [The key point is this is a public place. It's OK for you to smoke, but after you leave, the elevator is full of cigarette smoke. What happens when children or elderly people come in? Are they supposed to inhale your secondhand smoke too?]

chinese_text: [然后我把它训练的，然后我俩一起玩儿，我我指到这里它就能跳到这椅子上。然后呢，我扔个拖鞋，它就能把拖鞋叼回来。]
english_text: [Then I trained it, and we played together. When I pointed here, it could jump onto this chair. Then, if I threw a slipper, it would bring the slipper back in its mouth.]

english_text: [Then later, I worked away from home for many years. Then one day, my father told me that Huahua was gone, um, that it had died of old age.]

chinese_text: [就，我小时候，就懵懵懂懂刚会走路，刚会说话，刚懂点事的时候，奶奶家里有个大狗，嗯，就是那种德牧黑背那种大狗那种，但我小时候，它就已经是老狗了。]
english_text: [When I was little, just starting to walk, just learning to talk, just beginning to understand things, there was a big dog at my grandmother's house, um, the kind of big German Shepherd, but when I was little, it was already an old dog.]

chinese_text: [但是，嗯虽然这件事情过去了十多年，在我心里面就是，想起来我就是那种感觉，就是哎呀我当初应该多给它一些好吃的。]
english_text: [But, um, although this happened more than ten years ago, in my heart, whenever I think about it, I have this feeling, like, I should have given it more tasty food back then.]

chinese_text: [每天我们睡醒的时候，就把手放在下面，它它就过来跳起来顶我手，跳起来顶我手，然后呢就相当于闹钟一样把我叫醒。]
english_text: [Every day when we woke up, I would put my hand down, and it would come over and jump up to push my hand, jump up and push my hand, and then it was like an alarm clock waking me up.]

chinese_text: [然后呢多陪它玩一玩，这样的话，它可能在它的生命当中就会少一些遗憾吧，就这样吧。]
english_text: [And then spend more time playing with it, that way, it might have had fewer regrets in its life, I guess.]

chinese_text: [然后当我知道这个事的时候呢，就心里面儿真的是，那种伤心就嗯就涌向心头了。]
english_text: [And when I found out about this, my heart was truly filled with that kind of sadness, um, it just welled up in my heart.]

chinese_text: [嗯，我让它出去它就能出去，它能听懂人话，就很有灵性。那后来，因为我要去上学嘛，然后就，就只有寒假暑假才能回来陪它玩儿了。]
english_text: [Um, when I told it to go out, it would go out, it could understand human speech, it was very spiritual. Then later, because I had to go to school, I could only come back to play with it during winter and summer vacations.]

chinese_text: [嗯，那时候我小啊就不懂啊，就嗷嗷哭嗷嗷哭，后面儿长大了以后呢，就是家里面又养了一个狗，叫花花。它是一个嗯京巴和一个别的串着的小狗。]
english_text: [Um, I was young then and didn't understand, I just cried and cried. After I grew up, my family got another dog, named Huahua. It was a mixed breed between a Pekingese and some other kind of dog.]

chinese_text: [然后，我就成天骑着它后背玩儿，然后我就，因为农村嘛，就前院子后院子，跟它玩儿。然后有一天我就问我奶奶，我说奶奶咱家狗呢？大黄呢？嗯？没回来。]
english_text: [Then, I would ride on its back all day to play, and because we were in the countryside, I would play with it in the front yard and back yard. Then one day I asked my grandmother, I said, 'Grandma, where's our dog? Where's Dahuang?' Hmm? It didn't come back.]

english_text: [Good, very good.]

chinese_text: [唉，来了来都来了，还行吧。]

english_text: [Well, it's good that no renovation is needed. They just want to add a few more parking spaces so they can charge random fees and collect money from others.]

english_text: [Otherwise, they'll be completely lawless.]

english_text: [Then they just collect fees without doing anything at all.]

chinese_text: [这还好啊！]

english_text: [Oh, right at my doorstep! We originally had a concrete ground at our entrance, which was fine for going out. Now they've laid these huge stone slabs, each one like a small mountain. chinese_text: [刚哥，我最近快烦死了。]

chinese_text: [就该有人管管他们。]

chinese_text: [唉，你就我小区啊。]
english_text: [Sigh, it's just my residential community.]

chinese_text: [他就说啥呢，哎你那什么，我交了物业，天天那我那个楼道里面老是有垃圾，为什么没人打扫？]
english_text: [What can they say? Hey, I've paid the property fees, but there's always garbage in my building's hallway every day, why doesn't anyone clean it?]

chinese_text: [又烦啥？]
english_text: [What else is bothering you?]

chinese_text: [对啊，所以说有好多居民啊，然后就一起就找物业嘛，然后后来被处理了啊。]
english_text: [Right, so many residents got together and went to the property management, and then the issue was addressed.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，你们这小区的物业还好点。]
english_text: [Oh, your community's property management is actually a bit better.]

chinese_text: [哎不打扫卫生，没有安排人，人人家有借口啊，能说啥？]
english_text: [Well, they don't clean, they don't arrange staff, they always have excuses, what can you say?]

chinese_text: [哎呀，我这不是腿伤了吗？又就坐在这儿，那没事儿那不就吃吗？呃送来好多补品，我一一筐一筐吃，我腿好可快了。]
english_text: [Oh, I hurt my leg, didn't I? So I'm just sitting here, and when there's nothing else to do, I eat, right? Uh, so many supplements were sent to me, I'm eating them basket by basket, my leg will heal much faster.]

chinese_text: [哎可以可以，我拿过来我补补钙。]
english_text: [Oh, sure, sure, I'll take them to supplement my calcium.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，你多陪陪嫂子呗。啊还值得你，我这小伤还值得你过来看一趟？]
english_text: [Oh, you should spend more time with your sister-in-law. Is my minor injury really worth you making a special trip to see me?]

chinese_text: [回头我拄拐去看嫂子。]
english_text: [Later I'll visit my sister-in-law on crutches.]

chinese_text: [谁知道它旁边有个大坑儿啊！这这次真不怪我啊，哎，嗯嫂子最近快生了吧？我算这月份差不多了。]
english_text: [Who knew there was a big pit next to it! This time it's really not my fault. Hey, isn't your sister-in-law about to give birth soon? I calculated the month, it should be about time.]

chinese_text: [哎，刚哥！你怎么来了呀？]
english_text: [Hey, Brother Gang! Why did you come?]

chinese_text: [住个院住胖了!我也没办法，我嘴里也闲不下来。]
english_text: [I gained weight during my hospital stay! I can't help it, my mouth can't stay idle.]

chinese_text: [哎呦我这小事儿！医生说了两个月，最多两个月能跑能跳了。就崴着了，踩空了，唉没事儿。]
english_text: [Oh, this little thing of mine! The doctor said in two months, at most two months, I'll be able to run and jump again. I just sprained it, missed a step, ah, it's nothing.]

chinese_text: [我就你这么一个宝贝妹妹啊，以后干什么事儿多加小心，明白吗？]
english_text: [You're my only precious sister, you need to be more careful in whatever you do from now on, understand?]

chinese_text: [我还要回去陪你嫂子呢。]
english_text: [I still need to go back and keep your sister-in-law company.]

chinese_text: [这很快，这不是你哥要当爸爸了吗？]
english_text: [This is fast, isn't your brother about to become a father?]

chinese_text: [一筐一筐吃啊？]
english_text: [Eating basket after basket?]

chinese_text: [哎等会儿，但是啊，记住一定要少吃，你看你吃的这脸蛋儿尽肉了!]
english_text: [Hey wait, but remember, you must eat less. Look at your face, it's all chubby from eating!]

chinese_text: [你属骆驼的啊？]
english_text: [Are you a camel or something?]

chinese_text: [好好养伤啊!]
english_text: [Take good care of your injury!]

chinese_text: [行了，别贫嘴了啊！我给你带了好吃的，你最喜欢的汉堡包。]
english_text: [Alright, stop being sarcastic! I brought you something delicious, your favorite hamburgers.]

chinese_text: [我就你这一个妹妹，我当哥的我不来看你？]
english_text: [You're my only sister, as your brother, how could I not come visit you?]

chinese_text: [从小就调皮，小的时候骑自行车，骑一次摔一次，骑一次摔一次。这次走路，过个台阶就能摔成这样？]
english_text: [You've been mischievous since childhood. When you were little, you rode a bike, fell once every time you rode, fell once every time you rode. This time, just walking over a step and you managed to fall like this?]

chinese_text: [跟别人打感情牌。然后说哦，这小狗可怜，没地方去，说让它缓缓，一缓缓半个月。]
english_text: [Playing the emotional card with others. Then saying oh, this poor puppy has nowhere to go, saying let it stay for a while, and that while becomes half a month.]

chinese_text: [找了，老师不想管事儿，你知道吗？唉。]
english_text: [I looked for them, the teacher doesn't want to deal with it, you know? Sigh.]

chinese_text: [现在在宿舍里待着，我真待不下去。在。]
english_text: [Now staying in the dormitory, I really can't stand it anymore. In.]

chinese_text: [肯定不允许啊，那宿。]
english_text: [It's definitely not allowed, that dorm.]

chinese_text: [她说哎呀，她说你这不打扫呀？你这个床位下面怎么一股屎味啊？屎味儿从哪来的？她知道屎味从哪来的，不是他狗拉的吗？]
english_text: [She said oh, she said aren't you going to clean? How come there's a smell of poop under your bed? Where did the poop smell come from? She knows where the poop smell came from, didn't her dog poop?]

chinese_text: [我找了。然后她她跟别人搞关系，她说哦我回头就，过两天就把它送走，过两天就把它送走。]
english_text: [I did. Then she, she plays nice with others, she says oh I'll, I'll send it away in a couple of days, send it away in a couple of days.]

chinese_text: [都不知道该怎么办了？]
english_text: [I don't even know what to do anymore?]

chinese_text: [就我那同学，她看学姐在宿舍里面养了只狗。你知道宿舍吧？十平，十平大小的地方，她在里面养狗。]
english_text: [That classmate of mine, she saw a senior student raising a dog in the dormitory. You know the dormitory, right? A ten-square-meter place, and she's raising a dog in there.]

chinese_text: [那里面是不不允许养狗的。结果有的时候，她的狗被宿管发现了，她还连累我一起跟她挨骂。]
english_text: [Dogs are not allowed in there. As a result, sometimes when her dog was discovered by the dorm supervisor, she even got me in trouble and scolded along with her.]

chinese_text: [她偷偷养，那狗都不能出门儿，天天在宿舍里面拉屎。她，然后那个狗在她那边拉屎，她打它，我我我人好，我不打那只狗，那狗就在我这拉。]
english_text: [She secretly raises it, that dog can't even go outside, it poops in the dormitory every day. She, then when the dog poops on her side, she hits it. I, I, I'm a good person, I don't hit that dog, so the dog poops on my side.]

chinese_text: [她就找我事儿。哎，这种情况应该是我找她事儿吧？我都没找她事儿，她敢找我事儿？]
english_text: [She picks a fight with me. Hey, in this situation, shouldn't I be the one picking a fight with her? I haven't even picked a fight with her, and she dares to pick a fight with me?]

chinese_text: [你知道吗？一天不知道在我这桌子下面拉多少屎？我清理都清理不干净，结果你猜晚上的时候她路过我的桌子，她说什么吗？]
english_text: [You know? I don't know how much poop it poops under my desk in a day? I can't even clean it all up, and then guess what she says when she passes my desk at night?]

chinese_text: [那你给校方，找校方了吗？]
english_text: [So have you reported it to the school authorities?]

chinese_text: [那她这不是找你事吗这是？]
english_text: [Then isn't she just picking a fight with you?]

chinese_text: [那你学校里面允许有狗啊？]
english_text: [So your school allows dogs?]

chinese_text: [哎呀哎呀呀，小王小王我真的，第十遍了第十遍了，你能不能干好？]
english_text: [Oh my god, Xiao Wang, Xiao Wang, really, this is the tenth time, the tenth time! Can you do this properly?]

chinese_text: [我见你也挺努力的，我也不知道努努力到哪个点儿上了？笔笔笔不带，跟别人借。]
english_text: [I see you're trying hard, but I don't know where your effort is going? You don't even bring a pen, pen, pen, and have to borrow from others.]

chinese_text: [你搞的真是，真是你让我带你出去，你就光长那张脸了真是。光那个门面还好，这一干实事儿，屁屁屁干不成，啥啥啥干不成。]
english_text: [What you've done is really, really... I take you out, and all you have is that face. The appearance is fine, but when it comes to actually doing something, you can't do shit, you can't do anything.]

chinese_text: [你脑子是锈的，你知道吗？根本听不懂我说话。就每次我给你发那信息啊，你你回复的是啥？你，牛唇不对马嘴。]
english_text: [Your brain is rusty, you know? You can't understand what I'm saying at all. Every time I send you a message, what do you reply? You're completely off-topic.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，你你赶赶紧去吧去吧去吧，行行，别跟我说话了，真是。]
english_text: [Oh, just go, go, go quickly, fine, fine, don't talk to me anymore, really.]

chinese_text: [都有问题，我说了八百次了，八百次了。]
english_text: [Everything has problems, I've said it eight hundred times, eight hundred times.]

chinese_text: [改改改改改改，赶紧拿拿拿回去，改改改改改改改改。]
english_text: [Revise, revise, revise, quickly take it back, revise, revise, revise, revise, revise.]

chinese_text: [你来公司实习期快，马上就到了，我就真不知道你每天是干啥吃的？]
english_text: [Your internship period at the company is almost up, and I really don't know what you're doing every day.]

chinese_text: [我说的这几个大点，你一条儿都没给我改。我真的不知道每天听啥，我就纳闷儿了，你脑子往哪儿想呢？你还想不想转正了？]
english_text: [Of these main points I mentioned, you haven't revised a single one for me. I really don't know what you're listening to every day, I'm puzzled, where is your mind? Do you still want to be hired permanently?]

chinese_text: [我真没话跟你说了，你现在已经完全不在我这个思维逻辑里。]
english_text: [I really have nothing to say to you, you're now completely outside my way of thinking.]

chinese_text: [完了，你还把那个笔笔芯儿给人弄床上了。人家客户咋说，啊？人好意思说吗？人看我面子上的。]
english_text: [Great, you even got the pen refill on the client's bed. What will the client say, huh? Would they dare to say anything? They're only being polite because of me.]

chinese_text: [语音你好好听，语音听不成，你给我翻译成文字。你翻译好了，一条儿一条儿的告诉我，你应该改哪儿？]
english_text: [Listen to the voice message carefully. If you can't understand the voice message, transcribe it to text for me. After you've transcribed it, tell me point by point what you should change.]

chinese_text: [嗯，我这个报告出来了。]
english_text: [Well, my report is ready.]

chinese_text: [行行行，那就按你的要求再改一下儿。我下回改之前，先给你看一下。]
english_text: [Fine, fine, fine, I'll revise it according to your requirements then. Next time before I revise, I'll show it to you first.]

chinese_text: [呃那个笔那个是我的问题，我确实没没没把把它注意好。但是这个，我写这个报告，你觉得哪哪里有问题吗？]
english_text: [Uh, that pen, that was my problem, I really didn't pay attention to it. But this, regarding the report I wrote, where do you think there are problems?]

chinese_text: [但实际上，我开始根本，根本就没有注意到这个男的，就是他是真的跟着我，我只是觉得，后面儿有一个人在走路。]
english_text: [But actually, at first I didn't notice at all that this man was really following me, I just felt that there was someone walking behind me.]

chinese_text: [但是我唯一当时求救的一个点就是，特别大声喊了一句妈！]
english_text: [But the only way I called for help at that moment was by shouting 'Mom!' really loudly.]

chinese_text: [因为当时我家住六层，还没有没有电梯，就是上楼的那一种。我就很开心很开心的就回家，我就要上楼。]
english_text: [Because at that time my home was on the sixth floor, and there was no elevator, the kind where you have to climb stairs. I was very happy to go home, and I was about to go upstairs.]

chinese_text: [我以为他也是住这栋楼，或者是他是这个楼里边某个，某一家的朋友还是什么的，因为我没有见过他。]
english_text: [I thought he also lived in this building, or he was a friend of someone in the building or something, because I had never seen him before.]

chinese_text: [看不见是因为他掐着我脖子，二是我特别紧张。结果这个男的，突然听到我说妈，就松开了，松开了以后，他就跑下去了。]
english_text: [I couldn't see because he was choking my neck, and secondly, I was very nervous. As a result, when this man suddenly heard me say 'Mom,' he let go, and after letting go, he ran downstairs.]

chinese_text: [我根本就没有那个意识，一直等到我上楼梯的时候，我从一楼正走往上走的时候，他就加速往前跟上来了。]
english_text: [I had no awareness at all, not until I started climbing the stairs, when I was walking up from the first floor, he sped up and followed me.]

chinese_text: [我一直都感觉，我后边跟着一个穿粉色粉色衣服的一个男的，一直在我后面跟着。]
english_text: [I kept feeling that a man in pink clothes was following behind me, following me all the time.]

chinese_text: [我就在一层半的时候，就停住了。我停住的原因是，我想让他先上，因为他跟的特别的紧。]
english_text: [I stopped at the halfway point between the first and second floors. The reason I stopped was that I wanted to let him go up first, because he was following very closely.]

chinese_text: [然后到那个时候，我还没有发发现我的危险，就我没有觉得，这是一个非常危险的事情。]
english_text: [And at that time, I still hadn't realized my danger, I didn't feel that this was a very dangerous situation.]

chinese_text: [她是真的听见啦，是后来我知道是听见了。因为当时我第一个呼救的就是那声妈，但我眼睛已经看不见了。]
english_text: [She really did hear it, I only found out later that she heard me. Because at that time, the first thing I cried out for help was 'Mom', but I couldn't see anything.]

chinese_text: [她当她她说开完门儿以后，我就上去了。你知道，我在那么紧张的情绪下，而且我腿都是抖的，我就超级速度从一楼跑到了六楼。]
english_text: [After she opened the door, I went up. You know, in such a nervous state, and my legs were shaking, I ran from the first floor to the sixth floor at super speed.]

chinese_text: [我们家在六楼，我在一楼半喊的，我妈竟然听见了，你能信吗？是真的听见啦！]
english_text: [Our home is on the sixth floor, I shouted from between the first and second floor, and my mom actually heard me, can you believe it? She really did hear it!]

chinese_text: [我当时拿着墨盒和笔，我都没松是为什么。我紧张到，我真的紧张到我，我已经眼睛发白，就看不清。]
english_text: [At that time, I was holding the ink box and pen, and I didn't let go. I was so nervous, really so nervous that my eyes were rolling back and I couldn't see clearly.]

chinese_text: [就相当于我妈后来跟我怎么说。我上楼的那个速度有多快，她在厨房听到我的呼救的声音，她不知道是呼救，她只听到一个妈字儿。]
english_text: [It's like what my mom told me later. How fast I was running upstairs, she heard my cry for help in the kitchen, she didn't know it was a cry for help, she only heard the word 'Mom'.]

chinese_text: [结果，当我停在那一刻的时候，那个男的真的三步两步，咵你知道吗？上手就掐我脖子，真的就上手就掐我脖子。]
english_text: [Then, when I stopped at that moment, the man really took just a few steps, you know? And immediately started choking my neck, he really just went straight for my neck.]

chinese_text: [我打开那一瞬间，你知道我妈，正好刚做饭。真的，我我眼睛里边儿是带着泪花儿哭不出来，但我又是，但我声音又是抖的。]
english_text: [The moment I opened it, you know, my mom had just finished cooking. Really, my eyes were filled with tears but I couldn't cry, and yet my voice was trembling.]

chinese_text: [抖的，我就一直跟我妈说这个事儿。我我我我妈就说，我妈当时就说谁啊？拿着铲子就跟我下去了。]
english_text: [Trembling, I kept telling my mom about this. My mom then said, my mom said at that time, 'Who is it?' and came down with me holding a spatula.]

chinese_text: [我给你讲个，我小时候特别，怎么说呢，就是让我到现在非常有阴影的事儿。]
english_text: [Let me tell you something, something from my childhood that was, how should I put it, something that still traumatizes me to this day.]

chinese_text: [呃我现在这个减肥呢，成效之后我就接到了通告，接到了通告以后呢，嗯我现在就挣了一笔大钱。]
english_text: [Uh, after my weight loss showed results, I received a job offer, and after receiving the offer, well, I've now earned a big sum of money.]

chinese_text: [没事儿，你想吃什么我请客。]
english_text: [It's nothing, whatever you want to eat, it's my treat.]

chinese_text: [所以呢，今天必须请你吃一顿，来庆祝我这个美丽的身材。]
english_text: [So, today I must treat you to a meal to celebrate my beautiful figure.]

chinese_text: [真是太好吃了，我真的饿死我了。]
english_text: [This is really delicious, I'm starving to death.]

chinese_text: [我今天在海底捞我得点那个牛肉，羊肉，鸡肉，这都不不不在话下。还得点那个鱼肉，还有什么虾滑呀，还有鱼丸儿啊。]
english_text: [Today at Haidilao, I have to order beef, lamb, chicken, that's a given. I also need to order fish, and also shrimp paste, and fish balls.]

chinese_text: [怎么不叫我呀当时？真是。]
english_text: [Why didn't you call me back then? Really.]

chinese_text: [嗯，你说的有道理，那我这样，我给你个选择啊。反正我想想我挣得这笔钱吧够你吃火锅？日料？还有那个呃海鲜？]
english_text: [Hmm, you have a point, then how about this, I'll give you a choice. Anyway, let me think if the money I earned is enough for you to have hot pot? Japanese food? And also, uh, seafood?]

chinese_text: [还有那个，哎你你你吃过那个没？就是虾滑，就是他们海底捞有一个做的一个特色，就是把虾滑放进那个面筋球里。]
english_text: [And also, hey, have you have you have you tried that? It's the shrimp paste, they have a specialty at Haidilao where they put shrimp paste inside gluten balls.]

chinese_text: [还有让我再想想啊，还有什么那个烩菜？呃各种菜，就是。]
english_text: [And let me think again, what else is there? That stewed dish? Uh, various dishes, you know.]

chinese_text: [行行行，就海底捞了。嗯多大点儿啊，多大点儿钱呀没关系。]
english_text: [Okay, okay, okay, let's go to Haidilao then. Hmm, how much could it be? It's just a little money, no problem.]

chinese_text: [今天大吃特吃，我跟你说，我真的半个月我都没见肉了，真的半个月没见肉了。]
english_text: [Today we're going to eat a lot, I'm telling you, I really haven't had meat for half a month, really no meat for half a month.]

chinese_text: [那必须的，我都已经减肥半个月，是不是很有成效？我真的是饿出来的。所以所以呢，但我跟你说我这个饿吧。]
english_text: [Of course, I've been dieting for half a month, hasn't it been very effective? I really achieved it through hunger. So, so, but let me tell you about this hunger of mine.]

chinese_text: [今天我不减了，就为了请你吃顿饭呢，一定得找一家非常好吃的地方。我大吃特吃一定给它补回来把这半个月。]
english_text: [Today I'm not dieting, just to treat you to a meal, we must find a really delicious place. I'm going to eat a lot to make up for these past two weeks.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，那年的生日可别提了，真的尬的要死。每次我就听他们当什么，跟所有的烦恼说拜拜[laughing]。]
english_text: [Oh, don't even mention that birthday, it was so embarrassing. Every time I hear them sing whatever, 'say goodbye to all troubles' [laughing].]

chinese_text: [哎，我感觉好久没见你，好像瘦了点儿？]
english_text: [Hey, I feel like I haven't seen you in a long time, have you lost a little weight?]

chinese_text: [你不要经常吃就行，咱们今天就好好吃，吃火锅吧。]
english_text: [As long as you don't eat it often, let's just eat well today, let's have hot pot.]

chinese_text: [那我们今天就吃这个，你说的我都馋了，我没有吃过这个。]
english_text: [Then let's eat this today. You've made me crave it with what you said, I've never had this before.]

chinese_text: [你知道吗？我上回过生日的时候就在海里捞，那么多人都看着然后让我跳舞，我我天哪！我当时脸都红死了都。]

english_text: [It's quite awkward. You see, if you come back in the morning—no, not 'come back in the morning.' If you come back early in the evening, you might still be able to grab a spot, but if you come back late, you basically can't get one.]

chinese_text: [你给打个电话，好容易找着电话了，找他下来你说你给挪挪个车吧？费劲巴列的嗯，也不上班儿怎么怎么地。我说你堵着别人路了，是不是？]
english_text: [You make a call, and after finally finding the phone number, you ask them to come down and move their car. It's such a hassle, and they make all sorts of excuses like not having to work or whatever. I tell them, 'You're blocking someone's way, aren't you?']

chinese_text: [打架的都有。]
english_text: [There have even been fights.]

chinese_text: [对对对，有的时候你像车多的时候我还碰过这种事儿。你像他们，嗯，早上你着急出门儿。]
english_text: [Yes, yes, yes. Sometimes when there are many cars, I've encountered this situation. Like them, well, in the morning when you're in a hurry to leave.]

chinese_text: [嗯，就有这种缺德的。]
english_text: [Well, there are just those kinds of inconsiderate people.]

chinese_text: [还行吧，就有的时候车多，就感觉它停不下。]
english_text: [It's okay, but sometimes when there are many cars, it feels like there's not enough space to park.]

chinese_text: [我就是没车，[laughing]就还好，但是我见的也多。]
english_text: [I just don't have a car, [laughing] so it's fine for me, but I've seen a lot of it.]

chinese_text: [就是见的也多什么什么两，两个车就为了抢一个车位啊。就是各种，嗯嗯不对付的那种，可多了。]
english_text: [I've seen a lot, like two cars fighting over one parking spot. All kinds of conflicts, you know, there are many of them.]

chinese_text: [就车多位子少。]
english_text: [It's just that there are many cars but few spots.]

chinese_text: [不是大哥您这有点强词夺理了，为啥你知道吗？因为你看我们这么多邻居是不是，我们楼上楼下这，这个旁旁旁边的邻居什么的，就您过来跟我说。]
english_text: [No, brother, you're being a bit unreasonable. Do you know why? Because look at all our neighbors here, upstairs, downstairs, and the neighbors next door, and you're the one who came to talk to me.]

chinese_text: [要不然就就不太行，大哥，行不行？咱们也互相理解一下好不好，我我赶赶工程。]
english_text: [Otherwise, it won't work, brother, okay? Can't we try to understand each other? I'm rushing to get this project done.]

chinese_text: [哎，我要是塞耳塞管用的话，我还过来敲你门吗？不是我说你要是这个样子的话，那我，我本来是本着一个跟你商量的态度过来跟你说的，你要是这样的话我这就报警了。]
english_text: [Hey, if earplugs worked, would I have come to knock on your door? I'm not saying... if you're going to be like this, then I originally came here to discuss this with you, but if you're going to act this way, I'm calling the police right now.]

chinese_text: [早上九点啊！]
english_text: [It's 9 AM!]

chinese_text: [现在9点钟的时候，我我想多休息一会儿怎么了错了吗？我要求不过分吧对吧，你要是做不到，我现在直接去报警好吧，警察过来跟你聊我就不跟你聊了，好不好。]
english_text: [At 9 o'clock now, I want to rest a bit longer, what's wrong with that? Is that a mistake? My request isn't unreasonable, right? If you can't accommodate that, I'll go call the police right now, okay? The police can talk to you, I won't talk to you anymore, alright?]

chinese_text: [反正报警警察这事也管好不好，因为你本身你就错了，你现在是周六周日你在装修对不对。]
english_text: [Anyway, the police will handle this matter, okay? Because you're in the wrong here. You're doing renovations on a Saturday or Sunday, right?]

chinese_text: [嗯，您上咱们那个网上去搜一下，咱们北京呢周六周日是全天，按理说是不能装修的。]
english_text: [Well, you can search online, but in Beijing, renovation is not allowed all day on Saturdays and Sundays, in principle.]

chinese_text: [咱都邻里邻居的，你说你装就装吧，咱能不能稍微晚一点再装？因为你看都是年轻人，我们周六周日好不容易休息想多睡会，好吧，咱们互相理解一下行不行？]
english_text: [We're neighbors, so if you must renovate, could you do it a bit later? You see, we're all young people, and we finally get to rest on weekends and want to sleep in a bit. Okay, can we try to understand each other?]

chinese_text: [啊，大哥能互相理解你也理解一下我好不好，因为我我这个赶装修呢，我必须得在下个月得得把房子给整出来。]
english_text: [Hey, brother, if we're going to understand each other, you need to understand me too. I'm rushing this renovation because I have to get the house ready by next month.]

chinese_text: [咱能不能稍微小点声，你看一下表现在是几点钟。]
english_text: [Can you please be a bit quieter? Look at what time it is now.]

chinese_text: [那是你的事。]
english_text: [That's your problem.]

chinese_text: [啊，影响别人的生活休息，对吧。]
english_text: [Ah, disturbing other people's lives and rest, right?]

chinese_text: [你这不废话嘛，你在我家脑袋顶上你在这铛铛铛铛，拿那铁锤搁那儿敲呢。]
english_text: [That's obvious. You're right above my apartment, banging away with a hammer.]

chinese_text: [你现在赶紧把这玩意儿停了，你要能停了这事咱们就拉倒就过，我觉得你也不差这天装修，对吧，你赶工期我可以理解，但是你晚一点行不行。]
english_text: [Stop this right now. If you can stop, we'll just let it go. I don't think you'll miss just one day of renovation, right? I understand you're on a tight schedule, but can you do it later?]

chinese_text: [我就不知道为什么别人都没有跟我来说，就您过来说。]
english_text: [I just don't understand why no one else has complained, only you.]

chinese_text: [好像我发现是您家在装修吗？]
english_text: [Am I the one who seems to be renovating here?]

chinese_text: [你赶工程咱也不差这一天对吧，我今天就这一天休息天，你就非得今天弄是吧？是这意思是吧。]
english_text: [You're rushing your project, but one day won't make a difference, right? Today is my only day off, and you absolutely have to do it today, is that it? Is that what you mean?]

chinese_text: [我跟你讲，说一千道一万是周六周日，你周六周日在装修，你这事是违法的你还听不明白啥意思吗？我跟你好好好商量不行，非得把这事给你挑明了说是吗？]
english_text: [Let me tell you, no matter how you look at it, it's Saturday and Sunday. Renovating on weekends is illegal, don't you understand? Can't we discuss this nicely? Do I have to spell it out for you explicitly?]

chinese_text: [但超时了怎么办，超时了这钱你你给我补啊，大哥。]
english_text: [But what if it goes overtime? If it goes overtime, will you compensate me for the money, brother?]

chinese_text: [不您要不您什么塞个耳塞啊，就戴个眼罩啊啥的就克服克服。]
english_text: [Why don't you just wear earplugs or an eye mask and just deal with it?]

chinese_text: [张朵朵。]
english_text: [Zhang Duoduo.]

chinese_text: [十八中？这不是重点中学吗？]
english_text: [No. 18 Middle School? Isn't that a key school?]

chinese_text: [对啊，我这，[laughing]怎么怎么怎么这就。]
english_text: [Yes, this... [laughing] how, how, how did this happen.]

chinese_text: [没事儿，你给捋捋呗。看哪些有用的，哪些没用的，整理整理就行。]
english_text: [It's okay, just sort through them. See which ones are useful and which aren't, just organize them.]

chinese_text: [不知道呢，这这放学还没回来。这没没想到给我们这么大一个惊喜这[laughing]。]
english_text: [I don't know, they haven't come back from school yet. We didn't expect such a big surprise [laughing].]

chinese_text: [哎，这，这怎么是个录取通知书啊？哎，你看看。]
english_text: [Hey, what, why is this an acceptance letter? Hey, take a look.]

chinese_text: [行行，必须的。]
english_text: [Okay, okay, absolutely.]

chinese_text: [好嘞好嘞。]
english_text: [Alright, alright.]

chinese_text: [哎，这这这咱家孩子录取什么书啊，你看看。]
english_text: [Hey, what, what, what book has our child been accepted to? Take a look.]

chinese_text: [哎，孩子上哪儿去了这是？]
english_text: [Hey, where did the child go?]

chinese_text: [哎，不是她她怎么也没跟咱说啊？这这这录取通知书儿，现在都都直接寄了吗都是？]
english_text: [Hey, why didn't she tell us? This acceptance letter, do they all just get mailed directly now?]

chinese_text: [这这不用看，我都知道，你看卖房的。]
english_text: [I don't even need to look, I already know. Just look at the real estate agents.]

chinese_text: [你别别别别别别弄少了啊，多弄点儿好吃的啊。]
english_text: [Don't, don't, don't make too little! Make more delicious food.]

chinese_text: [行吧，哎，你先做做做做做做几个好吃的菜，行不行？]
english_text: [Alright, hey, can you first cook a few delicious dishes, okay?]

chinese_text: [我现在去给给给咱爸咱妈打电话，啊。]
english_text: [I'm going to call our parents now.]

chinese_text: [这个，这这什么疏通下水管道，这有啥用啊？你这个这个老兵维修老兵汽。]
english_text: [This, this what, unclogging the sewer pipes, what's the use of this? This this Veteran Repair, Veteran Auto.]

chinese_text: [哎哟，我的妈呀，我真的给他们说说去。哎，这信封儿这是啥呀这个？你看这信封这是啥？它写的谁的名字？]
english_text: [Oh my god, I'm really going to give them a piece of my mind. Hey, what is this envelope? Look, what is this envelope? Whose name is written on it?]

chinese_text: [你看，我昨天还在这儿琢磨呢。我说这孩子到底这这这学校这事儿能不能落听啊，这事儿？]
english_text: [You see, I was here pondering just yesterday. I was wondering whether this school matter for the child could be finalized, this matter?]

chinese_text: [哎呀，我跟你说，这这过两天得跟物业说说。你看这这门口儿，这小广告儿全塞进来了，这乱七八糟一大堆。]
english_text: [Oh my, let me tell you, in a couple of days I need to talk to property management. Look at the entrance, all these small advertisements have been stuffed in, what a complete mess.]

chinese_text: [我真是太高兴了这是。]
english_text: [I'm just so happy about this.]

chinese_text: [你看，我就说这孩子行吧。你说她她这不吭不哈的给咱这么大一个惊喜。]
english_text: [You see, I told you this child is capable. Look at her, she didn't say a word but gave us such a big surprise.]

chinese_text: [我赶紧给老头儿老太太打电话啊。]
english_text: [I need to hurry and call the old folks (my parents).]

chinese_text: [完了，我一会儿问问孩子，看她几点回来，我我待会儿接着。别别别别她又跟那什么那那那那那那那那帮小朋友一块儿出去玩儿去了是吧？]
english_text: [Alright, I'll ask the child later what time she's coming back, I'll I'll continue then. Don't don't don't, she hasn't gone out with those those those those friends again, has she?]

chinese_text: [你你这样你这样，你去买点菜去哎。我给我给我给咱爸咱妈打个电话，我让他，我让老两口一会儿过来，咱一块儿吃个饭。]
english_text: [You you, you do this, go buy some vegetables. I'll I'll I'll call our parents, I'll have them, I'll have the old couple come over later, let's have a meal together.]

chinese_text: [我走的时候，我走的时候她就在门口就这么眼巴巴看着。]
english_text: [When I left, when I left, she was just standing at the door watching me so eagerly.]

chinese_text: [我不是好些年没回去了吗。]
english_text: [Haven't I not been back for many years?]

chinese_text: [我就觉得我特别不孝顺[Sobbing]。我啥好的东西都没给他们带过，他们也没出来溜达过，看一眼。]
english_text: [I just feel I'm particularly unfilial [Sobbing]. I've never brought them anything good, and they've never come out to stroll around and see things.]

chinese_text: [有机会还是多回去看看他们，真的，你也一样。]
english_text: [When there's a chance, you should go back to visit them more often, really, the same goes for you.]

chinese_text: [我回去时候啊，我就看老头儿啊，自己拄个拐杖搁儿那站着。两个手都在那边抖，想喝个茶吧，自己连茶杯都端不住。]
english_text: [When I went back, I saw the old man, standing there by himself with a cane. Both hands were trembling, when he wanted to drink tea, he couldn't even hold the teacup himself.]

chinese_text: [然后我就再看老太太，那头发全白。站在那儿，有的时候耳背，我说啥她也听不清。唉，想说话自己也说不明白。]
english_text: [Then I looked at the old lady, her hair was all white. Standing there, sometimes hard of hearing, she couldn't hear what I was saying. Alas, when she wanted to talk, she couldn't express herself clearly either.]

chinese_text: [那就不是多回去看两眼的事儿。]
english_text: [Then it's not just a matter of going back to visit more often.]

chinese_text: [我都不敢说我回头看一眼，我就怕我回头看一眼，我我今天就走不了。]
english_text: [I don't even dare to look back, I'm afraid if I look back even once, I I won't be able to leave today.]

chinese_text: [我有时候我想，我真想抽我自己两个嘴巴子。]
english_text: [Sometimes I think, I really want to slap myself across the face.]

chinese_text: [你也别太自责了。你家人也希望你好，也希望你开心，对不对。]
english_text: [Don't blame yourself too much either. Your family also wants you to do well and be happy, right?]

chinese_text: [我觉得，如果作为你家里人的话，也不想看到你现在这样子吧，对吧。那也希望你开开心心的。]
english_text: [I think, if they were your family members, they wouldn't want to see you like this now, right? They would also want you to be happy.]

chinese_text: [开心点儿。]
english_text: [Be a little happier.]

chinese_text: [行了，你以后多回去看看就行了，好吧。]
english_text: [Alright, just go back and visit more often from now on, okay?]

chinese_text: [怎么了？]
english_text: [What's wrong?]

chinese_text: [那要不这样吧，一会儿给家里人打个电话？]
english_text: [How about this, let's call your family in a bit?]

chinese_text: [诶，你别动你别动别动别动，你那什么开关你也别弄，打火机这东西全都别弄别弄。你等会我我去我在厨房看看再说，你看这味儿就是从厨房出来的呀。]
english_text: [Hey, don't move, don't move, don't move, don't touch any switches, and don't touch any lighters either. Just wait, I'll go check the kitchen. You see, this smell is coming from the kitchen.]

chinese_text: [哎呀我我慢点儿，我先把电断了。然后你你去那什么，你去拿那灭火器去，快点儿啊。]
english_text: [Oh, I'll be careful, let me cut off the power first. Then you, go get the fire extinguisher, hurry up!]

chinese_text: [是焦味儿吗？]
english_text: [Is it a burning smell?]

chinese_text: [暂时是没明火。]
english_text: [There's no open flame for now.]

chinese_text: [哎呦我的妈呀，你你赶紧赶紧赶紧拿个那什么拿个湿抹布给我，快快快快。]
english_text: [Oh my god, quickly, quickly, quickly get me a wet cloth, hurry, hurry, hurry, hurry!]

chinese_text: [哎呀不会，没事儿，没那么严重。它就是它就是短路了冒火星子，我把电断了就没事儿了。应该用不着灭火器了，只要没明火就行了嘛，是吧？你看。]
english_text: [Oh no, it's fine, it's not that serious. It just short-circuited and sparked, but it'll be fine now that I've cut the power. We probably don't need the fire extinguisher anymore, as long as there's no open flame, right? See?]

chinese_text: [那外面煮东西，啥味啊？]
english_text: [What's that smell from cooking outside?]

chinese_text: [我不动不动不动，你快去你快去，哎呦我天哪。]
english_text: [I won't move, I won't move, just go quickly, go quickly, oh my god.]

chinese_text: [诶，你闻着没这啥味啊？]
english_text: [Hey, do you smell this? What is that smell?]

chinese_text: [行行，你先别担心了，我打个电话，我先先先叫个叫个人过来看看。找个电工或者找个火警的过来看一下。]
english_text: [Okay, okay, don't worry first, I'll make a call, I'll call someone to come take a look. Find an electrician or call the fire department to come check.]

chinese_text: [你去。我我现在去把电断了去啊。]
english_text: [You go. I'm going to cut off the power now.]

chinese_text: [我刚把电断了，你看这火好像灭了，好像是？不响了吧？还能闻见味儿吗？]
english_text: [I just cut off the power, see, the fire seems to be out, right? It's not making noise anymore, is it? Can you still smell anything?]

chinese_text: [诶，你快快快快，你赶紧，那什么，你你下楼拿我车钥匙。车车车背后面有那什么，有那个干粉灭火器，快快快拿拿拿。]
english_text: [Hey, quickly, quickly, quickly, hurry up, you, go downstairs and get my car keys. There's, there's a dry powder fire extinguisher in the back of the car, quickly, quickly, get it, get it, get it.]

chinese_text: [我怎么闻着一股煤气味儿呢？]
english_text: [Why do I smell gas?]

chinese_text: [行行行，不是，你别乱动啊，等一下。]
english_text: [Okay, okay, okay, no, don't move around randomly, wait a moment.]

chinese_text: [怎么感觉像从厨房呢？]
english_text: [Why does it feel like it's coming from the kitchen?]

chinese_text: [别别别，你你小你小你小心点啊。]
english_text: [No, no, no, be careful, be careful.]

chinese_text: [行行行，哎呀我去，呐，给。]
english_text: [Okay, okay, okay, oh my, here, take it.]

chinese_text: [不是，这这能用湿抹布吗？]
english_text: [Wait, can you use a wet cloth for this?]

chinese_text: [现在这个劣劣质产品真可怕。]
english_text: [These low-quality products nowadays are really scary.]

chinese_text: [不是等等，这从哪儿哪儿冒出来的？]
english_text: [No, wait, where is this coming from?]

chinese_text: [还是有点儿感觉。]
english_text: [I still feel a bit uneasy.]

chinese_text: [这万一万一爆炸了怎么办呀？]
english_text: [What if it explodes? What should we do?]

chinese_text: [行行行，那我下嘛。]
english_text: [Okay, okay, okay, I'll do it then.]

chinese_text: [诶不是，你看那插销是不是在冒火星儿啊？]
english_text: [Hey, wait, look, isn't that plug sparking?]

chinese_text: [诶，不不不会是我昨天刚买的那个插线板儿，诶等等，我得去看看啊。]
english_text: [Hey, no, no, it can't be the power strip I just bought yesterday. Hey, wait, I need to go check.]

chinese_text: [感觉有点焦味儿啊！]
english_text: [I smell something burning!]

chinese_text: [但是你我都应该知道，我们医生有救人的优先选择权。我想要救这个孩子。]
english_text: [But both you and I should know that we doctors have the priority right to save lives. I want to save this child.]

chinese_text: [我知道在你心里，我就是没脑子。]
english_text: [I know that in your heart, you think I'm brainless.]

chinese_text: [可是我们就不能，可是我做不到眼睁睁地看着一个孩子，刚出生就承受这样的痛苦。]
english_text: [But can't we... but I can't just watch a newborn child endure such suffering.]

chinese_text: [你看，他还没有看过这片蓝天，就可能因为肺炎而离世。我们不应该去剥夺他生存的权利。]
english_text: [Look, he might die from pneumonia without ever having seen this blue sky. We shouldn't deprive him of his right to live.]

chinese_text: [就算我辞职，我也会坚持我自己的信仰。]
english_text: [Even if I resign, I will stick to my own beliefs.]

chinese_text: [庄大夫，我想听你说一句，如果你遇到这样的选择，你会怎么决定？]
english_text: [Doctor Zhuang, I want to hear you say, if you faced such a choice, how would you decide?]

chinese_text: [我以前很听傅老师的话，我觉得他的话就是信条。可是我现在不信他了，我信你说的话。]
english_text: [I used to listen to Teacher Fu very much, I thought his words were gospel. But now I don't believe him anymore, I believe what you say.]

chinese_text: [我明白你的难处，我也知道你心里面的难过。如果你一定要这样的话，我我觉得真的你只有辞职这一条路了。]
english_text: [I understand your difficulties, and I know the sadness in your heart. If you insist on doing this, I really think resignation is your only option.]

chinese_text: [我觉得还是再给她一点时间考虑吧？毕竟做这样的决定，对于任何人来说都不是一个简单的事情。]
english_text: [I think we should give her a bit more time to consider, right? After all, making such a decision is not a simple matter for anyone.]

chinese_text: [你如果一定要问我的话，我还是刚才那句话，我们再等一等。]
english_text: [If you must ask me, I'll repeat what I said earlier: let's wait a little longer.]

chinese_text: [这些东西不简简单单是教科书上面写的一句话，或者是给我们的一句规范。任何事情我们还是要，还是要根据情况去确定的你说对吗？]
english_text: [These things aren't just a sentence written in a textbook or a regulation given to us. For anything, we still need to determine based on the situation, don't you agree?]

chinese_text: [等孩子的父母等他的家属做一个决定，我们作为医生没有办法替他们做任何决定好吗？]
english_text: [We have to wait for the child's parents or family members to make a decision. As doctors, we can't make any decisions for them, okay?]

chinese_text: [对的，他能好一点儿。]
english_text: [Yes, he can get a little better.]

chinese_text: [然后我记得有有个新闻说，那个骑手去取外卖的时侯，他那个，呃，炒炒菜的台，就在那个马桶的旁边，哎呀。]
english_text: [And I remember there was a news report saying that when a delivery rider went to pick up food, their, uh, cooking station was right next to a toilet, ugh.]

chinese_text: [主要我平常比较懒比较懒，然后就是除了就是出去工作之外，我就就就基本上就点外卖会比较多。但是我现在点外卖的话，我也得得分，我基本上会点一些连锁品牌。]
english_text: [Mainly because I'm usually quite lazy, and besides going to work, I basically order takeout quite often. But when I order takeout now, I have to be selective; I basically order from chain brands.]

chinese_text: [所以说，经常吃外卖就可能会就是是拉拉肚子呀，就肠胃啊很不好，就卫生肯定是不过关的。]
english_text: [So, eating takeout frequently might cause diarrhea, and it's really bad for your digestive system. The hygiene standards definitely don't pass muster.]

chinese_text: [因为现在有很多的话，很多的东西的话，你根本就不知道，他那个外卖到底是在哪里做的，哪里做的？]
english_text: [Because now with so many things, you really have no idea where that takeout is actually made, where it's made?]

chinese_text: [然后油污，苍蝇，旁边就是臭抹布，抹抹锅的都在那扔着。然后老鼠这就别提了，这我自己都见过，特别特别不卫生。]
english_text: [And then there's grease, flies, and next to it, stinky rags used to wipe pans are just thrown there. And don't even mention the rats—I've seen them myself. It's extremely unhygienic.]

chinese_text: [怎么的也得，对对，怎么的也得三四十。你说我三四十，我买多少肉，你说买多少面，而且我自己做，我吃的也干净，吃的也放心。对，所以我还是一般都是自己做。]
english_text: [It costs at least, yes, yes, at least thirty or forty. With thirty or forty yuan, think about how much meat I could buy, how much noodles I could buy. And when I cook myself, I eat clean food and feel at ease. Right, so I usually just cook for myself.]

chinese_text: [他就是那种油油污时间长了，尤其锅底啊，特别恶心，就就就这边炒炒完，这边完了那边分装。]
english_text: [It's that kind of greasy buildup over time, especially at the bottom of the pot, which is particularly disgusting. They finish cooking on one side, and then over there they portion it out.]

chinese_text: [我一般都是自己在家做。]
english_text: [I usually make it myself at home.]

chinese_text: [真的有。就是，呃，大概三五平米的一个小屋，然后他就在里面炒菜，然后那个锅就是黑的，黑的就是上面感觉就是包了一层浆，但他肯定不是盘出来的。]
english_text: [There really are. It's like, uh, a small room of about three to five square meters, and he cooks inside it. The pot is black, it feels like it's coated with a layer of grime, but it definitely wasn't polished that way.]

chinese_text: [那连锁的还是稍微好一点儿。]
english_text: [The chain restaurants are slightly better.]

chinese_text: [因为我家旁边有特别大的菜市场，我是就喜欢上那去买。因为我感觉现在外面特别贵，你知道吗？就是，呃，因因为因为我山西人。]
english_text: [Because there's a very large wet market next to my home, I like to go there to buy things. Because I feel that eating out is particularly expensive now, you know? It's, uh, beca-because-because I'm from Shanxi.]

chinese_text: [对，我山西人，我有时候我吃面什么的。你看现在这些外卖，随随便点个面什么的。]
english_text: [Right, I'm from Shanxi, sometimes I eat noodles and stuff. Look at these takeout places now, ordering noodles casually costs so much.]

chinese_text: [啊，是是，我都见过这个。因为我有段时间闲的没事干，我就说我就跑两天外卖去，疫情的时候。实在闲的没事干，我说反正我也不接触别人。]
english_text: [Ah, yes, yes, I've seen this myself. Because I had a period of time when I was bored with nothing to do, I said I'd go deliver food for a couple of days during the pandemic. I was really bored with nothing to do, and I figured I wouldn't have contact with other people anyway.]

chinese_text: [我就把外卖往他本人一放就行了。我因为我每天在家天天待着，我都给我憋出病来了，我说我出去溜达溜达去，我说溜达溜达，那我就送个外卖吧，我去送去真的有。]
english_text: [I just need to place the takeout order in front of the person. Because I was staying at home every day, I was getting sick from being cooped up. I said I'd go out for a walk, and while walking, I might as well deliver some food. I went to deliver and it's true, there really are such places.]

chinese_text: [好像说是因为他们又又说猫肉其实是馊的。]
english_text: [It seems they say that cat meat is actually spoiled.]

chinese_text: [去弄个小小动物保护协会啥的。]
english_text: [Go start some small animal protection association or something.]

chinese_text: [我是，啧，我感觉咱养猫其实比养狗还稍微好点，不用遛啊啥的。我看我家楼底下老有就是那种流浪猫。]
english_text: [I, tsk, feel that raising cats is actually slightly better than raising dogs, no need to walk them or anything. I often see stray cats under my building.]

chinese_text: [嗯，抓这种野猫野狗，各种车各种逮逮它们。]
english_text: [Mhm, catching these stray cats and dogs, all kinds of vehicles going after them.]

chinese_text: [我看他们在那放的水放的水啊，放的水碗，放的屎碗屎盆啥的，可能有有时候我也过去放点猫粮啥的就是。]
english_text: [I see them putting out water bowls, food bowls, litter boxes and stuff, and sometimes I go over and put out some cat food or something.]

chinese_text: [中国其实也是，如果说这种流浪猫狗大家都保护起来，其实我觉得还是挺好的，没必要。]
english_text: [Actually, in China too, if everyone protected these stray cats and dogs, I think it would be quite good, there's no need not to.]

chinese_text: [也没做绝育啊，没啥的在底下有的时候叫啊闹啊。]
english_text: [They haven't been neutered either, so sometimes they make noise and cause disturbances down there.]

chinese_text: [其实我感觉我们那小区里面人还算比较好的，它不是有个那自行车不是有一个雨棚吗，充电棚那个。]
english_text: [Actually, I feel the people in our residential community are quite nice. You know, there's that shed for bicycles, the charging shed.]

chinese_text: [完了我前一阵就看老有人抓，我就上网上就看你们这干嘛呢？是查这东西呢还是干嘛呢？我后来发现说说说有人吃，说有人吃猫肉。]
english_text: [Then a while ago, I kept seeing people catching them, so I went online to see what they were doing. Were they checking on something or what? I later found out that people were eating them, that people were eating cat meat.]

chinese_text: [我家猫不吃了我就给人家放点儿，反正我看好像后来有一阵，他们就开始抓那些猫啊什么的，我说这是干嘛呢？]
english_text: [When my cat doesn't finish its food, I give it to them. Anyway, I saw that later for a while, they started catching those cats and stuff, and I wondered what they were doing?]

chinese_text: [哎是是，我是听过我是我是听我家里面老人说过，说是广东那边说吃猫肉猫肉可能是酸的，说有个菜叫什么。]
english_text: [Yeah, yes, I've heard it, I've heard the elders in my family say that in Guangdong, cat meat might be sour, and there's a dish called something.]

chinese_text: [龙龙虎斗啊对，说是一个盘子底下是猫，然后上面一个竹笼屉，然后一根竹签上面盘着蛇，这玩意叫龙。我说这东西哪能吃下去，你说人吃这个玩意儿。]
english_text: ['Dragon and Tiger Battle,' right. They say there's cat at the bottom of the plate, then a bamboo steamer basket on top, and a snake coiled around a bamboo stick, that thing is called the dragon. I said how could anyone eat this, you know, people eating this kind of thing.]

chinese_text: [完了我看还有好多网上人就说，说哎不要抓猫怎么怎么的，完了有有人就网友就说嘛，说哎你圣母心那你把猫都养了吧。]
english_text: [Then I saw many people online saying, 'Hey, don't catch the cats' and so on, and then some netizens would say, 'Oh, you're so sanctimonious, then why don't you raise all the cats yourself?']

chinese_text: [说你你你来负责它们，我觉得，哎呦，我是觉得这些人是挺啧挺没爱心的，你说它在咋地它也是个动物是吧，是个生命，你说你给它弄死了干嘛。]
english_text: [Saying 'You, you take responsibility for them.' I think, ugh, I feel these people are quite, tsk, unloving. No matter what, it's still an animal, right? It's a living being. Why would you kill it?]

chinese_text: [我觉得这啧他们那样也不对。]
english_text: [I think, tsk, what they're doing is also wrong.]

chinese_text: [从来不考虑别人感受，尤尤其你说家里边还有老人这种谁受了。中午要午休的，晚上要要休息的，早上想多睡会儿的年年轻人。]
english_text: [They never consider other people's feelings, especially when there are elderly people at home, who can bear it? Those who need to nap at noon, rest at night, or young people who want to sleep a bit longer in the morning.]

chinese_text: [从早上六点开始就彩排，就就放歌，我打电话我还问过我说你们干嘛呢，他说啊我们在彩排呢，嗯不好意思打扰你了，我说我你们小点声周六周日呢是吧。]
english_text: [They start rehearsing from 6 AM, playing music. I even called and asked what they were doing, and he said, 'Oh, we're rehearsing, sorry to disturb you.' I said, 'Can you be quieter? It's Saturday and Sunday, right?']

chinese_text: [然后你像那种，我估计他们也是那种全拖你知道把，有时候周六周日有家长加班他们也把孩子放那，放那也是吵，放歌唱歌。]
english_text: [And then, like that kind, I guess they're also those all-day care places, you know. Sometimes on Saturdays and Sundays when parents have to work, they drop their kids off there, and it's noisy there too, playing music and singing.]

chinese_text: [对，它就是那种承包商自己弄的那种。]
english_text: [Yes, it's the kind that the contractors set up themselves.]

chinese_text: [是吧，我觉得不好，不合适。]
english_text: [Right? I think it's not good, not appropriate.]

chinese_text: [我说你们彩排啥，我们六一，我说六一还早着呢，我说你干啥呀他就弄，那主持人，哎呀我的妈那主持人我也是头疼，我听他从早上六点一直叨叨叨叨晚上叨叨到下午六点。]
english_text: [I said, what are you rehearsing for? Our Children's Day. I said Children's Day is still far away, I said what are you doing and he just went ahead with it. That host, oh my god, that host gives me a headache too. I heard him chattering from 6 AM all the way to 6 PM.]

chinese_text: [他们是干嘛的，是你打比方说你六一完了前一个礼拜开始。你要说光是一帮孩子也算了，不知道从哪找了一帮演节目的，还找了一帮什么主持人，哎呀给我愁的。]
english_text: [What are they for? For example, they start a week before Children's Day. If it were just a bunch of kids, that would be fine, but they found some performers from who knows where, and also found some hosts, oh it worries me so much.]

chinese_text: [一到这个下午四五点钟接孩子放学把路也堵了，然后弄得也吵吵闹闹的，最可怕的是他们天天还办活动。]
english_text: [Every day around 4 or 5 PM when picking up kids from school, they block the roads and make a lot of noise. The most terrible thing is that they hold events every day.]

chinese_text: [按理说小区里面是不应该有这样的这这样的设施，和这个这个这个所谓的教培机构的啊，他他他们就有完了人还挺多的。]
english_text: [Logically, there shouldn't be such facilities and so-called educational training institutions in a residential area, but they have them and there are quite a lot of people.]

chinese_text: [有有春季运动会，夏季运动会，秋季运动会，冬季没有运动会，冬季有什么烂七八糟那些的活动。]
english_text: [There are spring sports meets, summer sports meets, fall sports meets, no winter sports meet, but in winter they have all sorts of messy activities.]

chinese_text: [我现在不是住的一个老小区里头吗，你说正常的话这个，咱们国家那种公立那种幼儿园，它不都是有正常的政府批的这些地规划的这些是吧。]
english_text: [I'm living in an old residential community now, right? Normally, in our country, those public kindergartens all have government-approved land and planning, don't they?]

chinese_text: [就那几句词来来回来去记不住你知道吗？记不住，没办法跟他们沟通好几次，就就一直都都都没用。]
english_text: [He just can't remember those few lines, you know? He can't remember them. I tried to communicate with them several times, but it was all useless.]

chinese_text: [啊，你要说人家庆个国庆这没毛病是吧，你过个六一也没毛病，但是你不能扰民呀！]
english_text: [Well, if they want to celebrate National Day, that's fine, right? Celebrating Children's Day is also fine, but you can't disturb the residents!]

chinese_text: [[Sobbing]他就这样没有了，我不孝。]
english_text: [[Sobbing] He just passed away like this, I'm unfilial.]

chinese_text: [我谁知道他早上刚起来人一下就栽那儿了，给我吓坏了。我赶紧就打电话，我就叫幺二零，给你们医院打电话。]
english_text: [Who would have known that he had just gotten up in the morning and suddenly collapsed there? It scared me to death. I immediately called 120 and called your hospital.]

chinese_text: [我说实在不行，因为，哎呀我实在是忙。我说实在不行，我说明天早上咱们再去看看去，咱直接去医院。]
english_text: [I said if it really doesn't work, because, well, I'm really busy. I said if it really doesn't work, let's go check again tomorrow morning, let's go directly to the hospital.]

chinese_text: [来了之后，这不就送进去抢救了吗就？]
english_text: [After we arrived, wasn't he sent in for emergency treatment?]

chinese_text: [从昨天晚上吃完晚饭，我爸就说他胸口不舒服，一直捂着胸口说难受难受。我就上网上去查，我就我就打电话去问。]
english_text: [Since finishing dinner last night, my dad has been saying his chest was uncomfortable, holding his chest and saying it hurts, it hurts. I went online to check, and I called to ask.]

chinese_text: [然后他在电话里边儿就跟我说，说让我赶紧按压胸口，我一直在那按一直在那按。我怎么喊他，他都没反应，人也不理我。]
english_text: [Then he told me on the phone to quickly press on his chest. I kept pressing and pressing. No matter how I shouted at him, he didn't respond, he just ignored me.]

chinese_text: [然后我，我真觉得我尽力了。我一直在那按，按的我整个人身上都没劲儿了，我都坐我摊那儿了，我不知道该怎么办了？然后你们医护人员就来了。]
english_text: [And then, I really feel I did my best. I kept pressing until I had no strength left in my whole body, I just slumped there. I didn't know what to do? And then your medical staff arrived.]

chinese_text: [我知道你现在，最想知道的应该是你父亲临终前到底是个什么情况，对吧？]
english_text: [I know that what you most want to know right now is what exactly happened before your father passed away, right?]

chinese_text: [[Sobbing]你别太难过了，其实你已经做到了你做儿子最大的职责了。]
english_text: [[Sobbing] Don't be too sad. Actually, you have already fulfilled your greatest duty as a son.]

chinese_text: [其实，这个就算是我们医护人员来，也是要轮流做的，你已经做得很棒了，所以不要太自责了。]
english_text: [Actually, even if our medical staff were here, we would have to take turns doing it. You've done a great job, so don't blame yourself too much.]

chinese_text: [做心肺复苏是很耗费体力的。而且你在发现这个状况的时候，第一时间给你父亲做了心肺复苏。]
english_text: [Performing CPR is very physically demanding. And when you discovered the situation, you performed CPR on your father immediately.]

chinese_text: [哎这样吧，[Sobbing]你先恢复一下情绪，我们好好的坐下来谈一谈。然后再了解一下你父亲当时病发的情况，好吗？]
english_text: [Well then, [Sobbing] calm down first, let's sit down and have a good talk. Then we can understand the situation when your father fell ill, okay?]

chinese_text: [[laughing]额那，那就一千？]
english_text: [[laughing] Um, well, then one thousand?]

chinese_text: [好，谢谢老板！]
english_text: [Okay, thank you, boss!]

chinese_text: [百分之三就是六万？]
english_text: [Three percent is sixty thousand?]

chinese_text: [嗯，不瞒你说，我就是想多挣点钱，以后好接孩子来城里。]
english_text: [Well, to be honest with you, I just want to earn more money so I can bring my child to the city in the future.]

chinese_text: [满意啊[laughing]！太满意了我这是！]
english_text: [Satisfied [laughing]! I'm more than satisfied!]

chinese_text: [不是，那平常？]
english_text: [No, what about normally?]

chinese_text: [噢好好，那？]
english_text: [Oh, okay, and?]

chinese_text: [那我这，该有点奖金吧？]
english_text: [So, I should get some bonus, right?]

chinese_text: [[laughing]还是太多是不是？]
english_text: [[laughing] Still too much, isn't it?]

chinese_text: [啊，该有啊！你想要多少钱？]
english_text: [Ah, yes, you should! How much do you want?]

chinese_text: [对对对对，然后再加上你刚才提的这些要求，我们还准备就是，每个月再给你涨五百块钱工资，你看怎么样？满意吗？]
english_text: [Yes, yes, yes, and in addition to the requirements you just mentioned, we're also prepared to give you a five hundred yuan salary increase each month. What do you think? Are you satisfied?]

chinese_text: [小刘啊，这次咱们这个项目能成功啊，你立了很大的功劳，啊，功劳有你一份儿！]
english_text: [Xiao Liu, our project's success this time is largely thanks to your great contribution. Ah, you deserve a share of the credit!]

chinese_text: [啊，咱们公司绝对不会亏待每一个，勤劳的，肯干的，踏实的人，好吧？]
english_text: [Ah, our company will absolutely not mistreat anyone who is hardworking, diligent, and down-to-earth, okay?]

chinese_text: [啊，应该的，应该的，你想要多少钱了，你说没关系啊。]
english_text: [Ah, it's deserved, it's deserved. How much do you want? Just say it, it's no problem.]

chinese_text: [对，所以你刚才[laughing]，所以你刚才跟我说两千的时候，我有点儿蒙，你知道吗[laughing]？你立的这个功劳比这大多了，这东西是是你应该得的，你明白吗？]
english_text: [Right, so when you just mentioned two thousand [laughing], I was a bit stunned, you know [laughing]? Your contribution is much greater than that. This is something you deserve, do you understand?]

chinese_text: [所以奖励这块儿，你放心，你知道吧？两万[laughing]，两千块钱，咱，咱可以展开你的想象，咱们公司给得起这个钱，好吧？]
english_text: [So regarding the reward, don't worry, you know? Twenty thousand [laughing], two thousand yuan, we, we can let your imagination run wild. Our company can afford this money, okay?]

chinese_text: [啊，对对，所以，所以我意思就是说，我说你听明白了吗？就是咱们公司现在呢准备给你百分之三。]
english_text: [Ah, yes, yes, so, so what I mean is, did you understand what I said? Our company is now prepared to give you three percent.]

chinese_text: [怎么还藏私房钱啦？]
english_text: [Why are you hiding secret savings?]

chinese_text: [你说现在这医院，怎么这么费钱啊？]
english_text: [Tell me, why are hospitals so expensive these days?]

chinese_text: [哎行了，单子事你别操心，操心它也少不了不是？这事儿我去解决去。行了，别哭了哭对身体不好了，你放心吧这事儿我来解决，啊。]
english_text: [Alright, stop worrying about the bill. Worrying about it won't reduce the cost, right? I'll take care of this. Stop crying, it's bad for your health. Don't worry, I'll handle this, ah.]
