chinese_text: [我就就就这一辆车，家里面两套房，我现在还正愁公证不出去呢，你帮我公证。来，公证完了之后，我现在就直接贷款，给他们发工资呗，对不对？]
english_text: [I only have this one car and two houses at home. I'm currently worried about not being able to get them notarized. You help me with the notarization. Once it's done, I can directly take out a loan and pay their wages, right?]

chinese_text: [那吓唬谁呢？你你实在不行了，你去你去法院告我吧，好不好？]
english_text: [Who are you trying to intimidate? If you really can't stand it, go ahead and sue me in court, okay?]

chinese_text: [什么意思啊？]
english_text: [What do you mean?]

chinese_text: [那公司不是说我一个人，我是领导，我今天给大家开钱，好咱就开。那银行也不是我家开的是不是，我就是去贷款我就去借，我也得去去去去去银行去去写申请，对不对？]
english_text: [The company doesn't consist of just me alone. I'm the leader. If I decide to pay everyone today, then we'll pay. But the bank isn't owned by my family, is it? Even if I go to get a loan, I still have to go to the bank to submit an application, right?]

chinese_text: [哪一个不是日晒雨淋哪，一个不是挣挣两个钱比比比比比干啥都难啊？]
english_text: [Who isn't working under the sun and rain? Isn't it difficult for everyone to earn a little money, harder than anything else?]

chinese_text: [你要是一个商量的态度，你能跟我说那么难听的话吗？啊什么叫抠抠搜搜，什么叫一拖再拖？]
english_text: [If you had a negotiating attitude, would you speak to me so harshly? What do you mean by 'stingy' and 'delaying again and again'?]

chinese_text: [啊你当都跟你一样啊，每天坐办公室里面敲敲电脑，你敲敲电脑打打键盘，我们就得跑断腿，对不对？]
english_text: [Do you think everyone is like you, sitting in an office tapping on a computer all day? You tap on your keyboard while we have to run ourselves ragged, right?]

chinese_text: [哎呀，是这样啊，我给大家先表个态啊。这个工资这个钱，我是一定会给到大家的，但是这不是说缓我几天时间嘛。]
english_text: [Well, it's like this. Let me first make my position clear to everyone. I will definitely give everyone this wage money, but can't you just give me a few more days?]

chinese_text: [你这样，你给我十五天好不好？]
english_text: [How about this, give me fifteen days, okay?]

chinese_text: [然后上面就有个桥，两段桥。每天早上打那过的时候，它车多，完人也多，呃就就特别挤。]
english_text: [Then there's a bridge above, a two-section bridge. Every morning when passing through it, there are many cars and also many people, so it's extremely crowded.]

chinese_text: [就是，两两它它还是两项车道，然后又不分这个机动车非机动车，然后还都得都得挤在那儿。那没办法，那那桥只能开那么大，那水库就那么大。]
english_text: [Exactly, it's still a two-lane road, and it doesn't separate motor vehicles from non-motor vehicles, so everyone has to squeeze in there. There's nothing that can be done, the bridge can only be so wide, and the reservoir is only so big.]

chinese_text: [赌的时候儿，你就甭管是骑自行车还是开车还是还是你骑电动车，都得下来推着往往过往外过。]
english_text: [During traffic jams, no matter if you're riding a bicycle, driving a car, or riding an electric scooter, you have to get off and push it across to get through.]

chinese_text: [燕郊，方便吗？]
english_text: [Yanjiao, is it convenient?]

chinese_text: [五百米的路能走出去七八分钟，就就一直那样儿。]
english_text: [A 500-meter distance can take seven or eight minutes to cross, it's always like that.]

chinese_text: [我是，哎呀好，我在那儿住挺长时间了。然后每回去地铁站的时候要过那个温榆河嘛，那河上面儿有个闸，它们叫什么二道闸是叫什么？]
english_text: [I, well, I've lived there for quite a long time. And every time I go to the subway station, I have to cross the Wenyu River, right? There's a gate on that river, what do they call it, the Second Gate or something?]

chinese_text: [你现在在北京是住住哪块儿？]
english_text: [Which part of Beijing are you living in now?]

chinese_text: [所以我基本上就是如果能不去坐地铁，不从不打那边儿走，我尽量不打那边儿走，基本上车挨着车人挨着人。那你在燕家时候儿，你交通什么方面吗？]
english_text: [So basically, if I can avoid taking the subway or going through that area, I try my best not to go that way. It's basically cars bumper to bumper and people packed together. So when you're in Yanjiao, how's your transportation situation?]

chinese_text: [那那摩托车的牌儿和那个电动车的牌儿，人家也也也打那儿过。哎呀每天从那过时候，可发愁了。]
english_text: [Those with motorcycle license plates and electric scooter license plates also have to pass through there. Oh, it's such a headache every day having to go through there.]

chinese_text: [它那个闸好像就那么大，只能那么建，就还挺为难的，唉呀可费劲每天。]
english_text: [That gate seems to be only that big, so it could only be built that way. It's quite a dilemma, oh what a struggle every day.]

chinese_text: [呃但但是没办法，你知道吧，那个桥它它也就确实只能修成那样了，也不是说不修。]
english_text: [Uh, but there's no way around it, you know. That bridge could really only be built that way, it's not like they didn't build it at all.]

chinese_text: [它也不是窄，就是人多，没办法人多。我我每天有时候骑电动车过，还看见好多人就是骑的那种呃河北的，可能就是燕郊的。]
english_text: [It's not that it's narrow, it's just that there are too many people, no helping that. Sometimes when I ride my electric scooter across, I see many people riding those, uh, Hebei-style ones, probably from Yanjiao.]

chinese_text: [啊对，尤其是尤其是你像他们好多人他开车也没素质，然后骑电动车也没素质，乱窜呀什么的。有的时候你说正常，其实它那个桥也没办法，它只能那样设计。]
english_text: [Ah right, especially especially like many of them, they have no manners when driving, and no manners when riding electric scooters, weaving around randomly and whatnot. Sometimes you think it's normal, but actually that bridge has no choice, it could only be designed that way.]

chinese_text: [啊，北关那面儿。]
english_text: [Ah, the Beiguan area.]

chinese_text: [我交通的话，我基本上都是要不就打个顺风车，要要不就提早一点坐公车，然后就再坐地铁这样。]
english_text: [As for my transportation, I basically either take a ride-sharing service or leave a bit earlier to take the bus, and then transfer to the subway.]

chinese_text: [因为没有直达的嘛，那那你那你肯定还是得经过一小段儿堵车的时间.堵车时间的话，那个太长的话，你想赶时间的话贼烦。]
english_text: [Because there's no direct route, you definitely still have to go through a period of traffic jam. If the traffic jam is too long, it's super annoying when you're trying to be on time.]

chinese_text: [住燕郊啊。]
english_text: [Living in Yanjiao, huh.]

chinese_text: [唉呀妈呀，我说你劳动什么了呀？还不得我在这做呀！啊？行了赶紧赶紧洗手洗手洗手吃饭。]
english_text: [Oh my goodness, what work have you done? I still have to do everything here! Huh? Enough, quickly wash your hands, wash your hands, wash your hands and eat.]

chinese_text: [行了行了行了，你看你好的这是事儿一点儿都没遗传上，你这贫嘴跟你妈一个样你看你，吃饭堵不上你嘴。]
english_text: [Alright, alright, alright. Look at you, you didn't inherit any of the good traits. Your smart mouth is just like your mother's, see? You can't stop talking even while eating.]

chinese_text: [哟！一听说吃炸酱面这就屁颠儿屁颠儿的跑回来了是吧？]
english_text: [Yo! The moment you heard we're having zhajiangmian, you came running back happily, didn't you?]

chinese_text: [我说你在你大伯家住了多长时间了？]
english_text: [I'm asking, how long have you been living at your uncle's house?]

chinese_text: [怎么样？他家房子好住吗？床比较软和，天天跟人家那住，挺自然挺得意是吧？]
english_text: [How is it? Is his house comfortable to live in? The bed is quite soft, living there every day, you feel quite at home and pleased, right?]

chinese_text: [哎，我可没说这话。]
english_text: [Hey, I never said that.]

chinese_text: [听你说这个合著好像还是我得了利了似的？]
english_text: [Listening to you, it sounds like I'm the one who's benefiting?]

chinese_text: [要不怎么说，嗯亲生的嘛对不对[laughing]？]
english_text: [Isn't that why they say, well, blood is thicker than water, right? [laughing]]

chinese_text: [您看哈，我现在已经是签约的主播了，等我粉丝破十的时候啊，什么房费水费啊什么的一起给您结算。]
english_text: [Look, I'm already a signed streamer now. When my followers exceed ten thousand, I'll settle everything with you, including rent, water fees, and all that.]

chinese_text: [然后我吃饭也不白吃您的，您做饭我洗碗行不行？给您做家务。]
english_text: [And I won't be eating your food for free. How about you cook and I'll wash the dishes? I'll do the housework for you.]

chinese_text: [怎么？你想让我回来住？]
english_text: [What? Do you want me to come back and live here?]

chinese_text: [你也多吃点儿[laughing]。]
english_text: [You should eat more too [laughing].]

chinese_text: [炸酱面这可是我的劳动所得啊！]
english_text: [This zhajiangmian (noodles with soybean paste) is the fruit of my labor!]

chinese_text: [那既然您想让我回来住呢，那我就遵命我就回来住。]
english_text: [Since you want me to come back and live here, then I'll obey and come back.]

chinese_text: [住了两三个月吧。]
english_text: [I lived here for about two or three months.]

chinese_text: [那我们是不是应该开除你十几回了，啊。如果不是我们同事，一次一次一次的原谅你的话，那你你是不是早就应该走出这个医院了？]
english_text: [Then shouldn't we have fired you more than a dozen times? If it weren't for our colleagues forgiving you again and again, wouldn't you have already been out of this hospital?]

chinese_text: [我不同意开除他。韩笑是我们的同事，我觉得开除他，这个惩罚太严重了。]
english_text: [I disagree with firing him. Han Xiao is our colleague, and I think firing him is too severe a punishment.]

chinese_text: [应该改。但是我觉得这个开除，这个太严重了。]
english_text: [He should change. But I think firing him is too severe.]

chinese_text: [行，那么换个方式说。如果说，你说要开除的话ok。那你那你在这个医院十几年来，你犯的错误有多少？]
english_text: [Fine, let's put it another way. If you say he should be fired, OK. Then how many mistakes have you made in this hospital over the past ten-plus years?]

chinese_text: [不是通知，我觉得我们应该本着友好的态度。你看啊，上次那个张予曦犯错误的时候，我们不是也一起，就是一起帮她，一起帮助她来渡过难关吗？]
english_text: [This isn't a notification; I think we should approach this with a friendly attitude. You see, when Zhang Yuxi made a mistake last time, didn't we all help her and support her through the difficulty?]

chinese_text: [对，他是有错的地方，对，批评指正也也很必要，但是我觉得也是需要分个程度的。那你那你不能说，他一犯错，我就开除他吧，我真是做不到。]
english_text: [Yes, he did make mistakes, and yes, criticism and correction are necessary, but I think we need to consider the degree. You can't just fire him every time he makes a mistake. I really can't do that.]

chinese_text: [所以主任你是直接来通知我的是吗？啊？]
english_text: [So Director, are you here directly to inform me? Huh?]

chinese_text: [我想问您一下啊，您是直接过来通知我呢？还是过来跟我征求意见的？]
english_text: [I'd like to ask you, are you here directly to inform me, or are you here to ask for my opinion?]

chinese_text: [我觉得你对这件事情的看法啊，有失偏颇。我为什么这么说呢？]
english_text: [I think your view on this matter is biased. Why do I say that?]

chinese_text: [做错的事情，你就得认啊。我还有我的工作，我就不想跟您多聊了，您自己看吧，好吧？]
english_text: [When you've done something wrong, you have to admit it. I have my work to do, so I don't want to talk with you any longer. You can decide for yourself, alright?]

chinese_text: [是这样啊，周组长。]
english_text: [I see, Team Leader Zhou.]

chinese_text: [您是组长，最终的决定权，还是在您手里。但是我觉得啊，做事情，咱们得一碗水端平。]
english_text: [You're the team leader, so the final decision is in your hands. But I think we need to be fair in how we handle things.]

chinese_text: [那所以，按您说的话的话，犯了错误之之后就不应该承担责任，犯了错误之后就不应该改是吗？是这意思是吗？]
english_text: [So according to what you're saying, after making a mistake, one shouldn't take responsibility, and after making a mistake, one shouldn't change? Is that what you mean?]

chinese_text: [是他犯下的错误，为什么现在还要让我去跟病人家属去解释啊？我应该去给他承担责任吗？]
english_text: [He's the one who made the mistake, why do I have to explain it to the patient's family now? Am I supposed to take responsibility for him?]

chinese_text: [啊，您跟我商量，好。如果您是征求我的意见，本着一个跟我商量的态度的话。那我给您的建议就是，他出现这样的问题，应该直接开除，好吧？]
english_text: [Oh, you're discussing it with me, fine. If you're asking for my opinion with an attitude of discussing it with me, then my suggestion is that for a problem like this, he should be fired immediately, alright?]

chinese_text: [嗯，外面下雨了，我想去接下孩子。]
english_text: [Hmm, it's raining outside, I want to go pick up my child.]

chinese_text: [不是，我没让孩子他爸去接孩子，要我不去的话孩子就没人接了。那，那如果您不同意的话，我就，那我就硬走了我！]
english_text: [No, I didn't have the child's father go pick up the child. If I don't go, there will be no one to pick up the child. So, if you don't agree, then I'll just leave anyway!]

chinese_text: [领导我，我我，我我说真的，我，我真，真的要去接孩子。那您，您要是真不同意。]
english_text: [Leader, I, I, I'm serious, I, I really need to go pick up my child. If you, if you really don't agree.]

chinese_text: [不是，我我，您看我。]
english_text: [No, I, I, look at me.]

chinese_text: [请什么假？]
english_text: [What kind of leave are you requesting?]

chinese_text: [啊，你早上来的时候你就迟到，啊，晚上你还想早退？你是想今天一天，把迟到和早退全给我占了是吗？]
english_text: [Oh, you were late when you came in this morning, and now you want to leave early? Are you trying to cover both being late and leaving early in one day?]

chinese_text: [我刚才把话已经给你放在那了，你今天敢去接孩子，走出公司这个门，明天你就别来。现在你给我出去，我瞅着你烦！]
english_text: [I've already made myself clear. If you dare to go pick up your child and walk out that company door today, don't bother coming back tomorrow. Get out now, you're annoying me!]

chinese_text: [你知道有句话叫，人越活越没个人样儿的吗？说了就你这号儿人，你今天给我走一个试试！你今天走出这个门儿，你明天就别来上班儿！]
english_text: [Do you know the saying that some people become less decent as they get older? That's exactly the type of person you are. Just try walking out on me today! If you walk out that door today, don't come to work tomorrow!]

chinese_text: [不是，我说你怎么回事啊？接孩子?]
english_text: [What's wrong with you? Picking up your child?]

chinese_text: [你什么你？你什么你？那孩子接的有那么重要吗？你不能让你老公去接下孩子吗？你当公司是哪儿啊？是你家开的呀！我都不能想迟到就迟到，想早退就早退的。]
english_text: [What do you mean 'what'? Is picking up that child so important? Can't you let your husband pick up the child? Do you think this company is your family business? Even I can't come in late or leave early whenever I want.]

chinese_text: [你知道你在干嘛吗？你在公司上班哎！]
english_text: [Do you know what you're doing? You're at work in a company!]

chinese_text: [你敢！你看看你现在这个样子，你看看人家吴安彤。那按辈分算，他是你徒弟，他都应该叫你一声师傅！你看看人家混的什么样儿？你再看看你这样儿！]
english_text: [How dare you! Look at yourself now, and look at Wu Antong. By seniority, he's your apprentice, he should even call you 'master'! Look how well he's doing, and then look at you!]

chinese_text: [咱就说，我前两天不是跟同事一块出去吃饭了吗。]
english_text: [Let me tell you, I went out to eat with my colleagues the other day.]

chinese_text: [可能就是北方这边儿城市，就是用劝酒文化，特别严重。尤其什么山东啊，东北啊这边儿。]
english_text: [Probably in the northern cities, the drinking culture is particularly severe. Especially in places like Shandong and the Northeast.]

chinese_text: [是，我觉得你这人也太不值钱了，不喝我就瞧不起你，不喝你就不是人。我这这[laughing]，我觉得挺有意思。]
english_text: [Yes, I think people like that are so worthless. 'If you don't drink, I'll look down on you,' 'If you don't drink, you're not a real person.' This... [laughing], I find it quite interesting.]

chinese_text: [反正基本上我就出去，基本上就是我，我胃溃疡。我我难受，我酒精过敏，啊你们要喝，嗯那我得去医院。]
english_text: [Anyway, whenever I go out, I basically just say I have a stomach ulcer. I feel sick, I'm allergic to alcohol. If you guys want to drink, well then I'll have to go to the hospital.]

chinese_text: [哎哟要要不就是什么，你喝完了必须得，哎呀，这这你要跟你要跟人碰，就必须得喝喝喝光喽。第一次见得喝三杯，完了还得打一圈儿。]
english_text: [Or else it's like, you must finish your drink. Oh, and if you toast someone, you have to drain your glass completely. First meeting requires three drinks, and then you have to go around the table.]

chinese_text: [就最可怕的是那种就是什么。]
english_text: [The most terrifying kind is like...]

chinese_text: [哎对，你不喝不是我兄弟，你不喝你就瞧不起我。]
english_text: [Yeah, right. 'If you don't drink, you're not my brother,' 'If you don't drink, you're looking down on me.']

chinese_text: [哎呀，我特别头疼这些事儿。我就觉得挺高兴一事儿，到最后弄得大家都特别，特别特别特别尴尬。就就你说我喝也不是，不喝也不是。]
english_text: [Ugh, I really hate these things. I think it's supposed to be a happy occasion, but in the end, it makes everyone extremely, extremely, extremely awkward. It's like, whether I drink or not, it's a problem.]

chinese_text: [就是这个中国的酒桌文化，我特别的不喜欢。嗯尤尤其是这老爷们一喝酒就，就就老是喜欢劝酒，我特别反感这事儿。]
english_text: [I really dislike China's drinking table culture. Especially when these men start drinking, they always like to pressure others to drink, and I really resent this.]

chinese_text: [就是还有什么额晚辈给长辈敬酒，什么初次见面什么喝三杯，什么主陪副陪。]
english_text: [And there's also things like younger people toasting elders, drinking three cups when meeting for the first time, main and secondary hosts, and so on.]

chinese_text: [还有那更过分的。那行，我给你叫叫叫救护叫那什么叫救护车，救护车旁边等着去。碰到这种，以后我觉得就别打交道了，实在是受不了，这种喝酒，劝酒的。]
english_text: [And then there are those who are even more excessive. Fine, I'll call an ambulance for you, you can wait next to the ambulance. When I encounter this kind of person, I think I just won't deal with them in the future. I really can't stand this kind of drinking and pressuring others to drink.]

chinese_text: [你要是不喝你就不是我兄弟。]
english_text: [If you don't drink, you're not my brother.]

chinese_text: [嗯，小酌怡情，大酒伤身嘛。]
english_text: [Well, a little drinking is pleasant, but excessive drinking harms the body.]

chinese_text: [商场新款[laughing]。]
english_text: [New arrival at the mall [laughing].]

chinese_text: [二十万！]
english_text: [Two hundred thousand!]

chinese_text: [不知道啊！]
english_text: [I don't know!]

chinese_text: [嗯可不吗，你哥给我买的！]
english_text: [Well, of course! Your brother bought it for me!]

chinese_text: [哎你看这衣服好看不？]
english_text: [Hey, do you think this dress looks good?]

chinese_text: [哎哎别别别！你你。]
english_text: [Hey, hey, no, no, no! You, you.]

chinese_text: [给你就给你两百万！]
english_text: [Fine, I'll give you two million!]

chinese_text: [嗯当老板了都。]
english_text: [Oh, so you've become a boss now.]

chinese_text: [对啊，本身你就说你海滩上扔垃圾。好多人做志愿者，专门打击什么，海洋垃圾啊然后这城市垃圾。]
english_text: [Right, just talking about littering on beaches. Many people volunteer specifically to combat marine garbage and urban waste.]

chinese_text: [哎，我都惊了，你知道吗？]
english_text: [Hey, I was shocked, you know?]

chinese_text: [随地吐痰是吧？]
english_text: [Spitting everywhere, right?]

chinese_text: [嗯，大爷大妈。对大爷大妈，对大爷大妈在公园儿，在喷泉这边儿洗脚，那边儿有大哥拿瓶子接水就喝。]
english_text: [Yeah, elderly men and women. Right, elderly men and women, washing their feet in the park by the fountain, while over there some guy is collecting water in a bottle to drink.]

chinese_text: [有一天也恶心到你自己。你说真的这素质差到让人令人发指。[laughing]哎呀。]
english_text: [One day it will disgust you too. I'm telling you, this lack of decency is outrageous. [laughing] Ugh.]

chinese_text: [我还有回是去哪儿，去潜江。]
english_text: [Another time I went somewhere, to Qianjiang.]

chinese_text: [上游游客在这边儿。]
english_text: [Upstream tourists are over here.]

chinese_text: [你说这事儿，你说你恶心别人。]
english_text: [You're talking about this matter, you're disgusting others.]

chinese_text: [你现在好多中，你像你像咱们国家，现在好多城市都创建文明城市呢。你你人都不文明，城市咋文明对不对？]
english_text: [Look at you now, just like in our country, many cities are trying to become civilized cities. If you're not civilized yourself, how can the city be civilized, right?]

chinese_text: [哎可多了，我还在见见那个公园里面洗脚的。]
english_text: [Oh, there are so many. I even saw people washing their feet in the park.]

chinese_text: [吃吃喝喝扔垃圾。我看到一孩子，一妈妈抱着孩子，孩子搁那儿撒尿。]
english_text: [Eating, drinking, and throwing trash everywhere. I saw a child, a mother holding her child, and the child was urinating right there.]

chinese_text: [不是，但是那六万块钱是签完协议之后的事儿。]
english_text: [No, but that 60,000 yuan was something that happened after the agreement was signed.]

chinese_text: [嗯，签了呀。]
english_text: [Yes, it was signed.]

chinese_text: [找了，但是传家哥跟我说，呃他说这个协议签完以后啊就是双方就都两清了。所以就后面的事他他管不了，让我再来找你。]
english_text: [I did, but Brother Chuanjia told me, uh, he said that after this agreement was signed, both parties were settled. So he can't handle matters that come after, and told me to come find you.]

chinese_text: [就是到后面补偿的那六万块钱呀！]
english_text: [It's about that 60,000 yuan in compensation that came later!]

chinese_text: [嗯，你今儿要是不给我说明白，什么保安？你要是不给我说法我就不走了我还。]
english_text: [Well, if you don't explain this to me clearly today, what security? If you don't give me an explanation, I'm not leaving.]

chinese_text: [不是，人家别人都给了呀。但是你没给我呀！]
english_text: [No, everyone else has received it. But you haven't given it to me!]

chinese_text: [哥，你看我们那个征地补偿的事儿，咋办呢？]
english_text: [Brother, look at our land acquisition compensation matter, what should we do?]

chinese_text: [但是人传家哥说这事不归他管，又让我来找你。你你们这推来推去，什么事都让我自己去办。我我一个大姑娘家我我干不了，你今儿就必须得给我个说法。]
english_text: [But Brother Chuanjia said this matter isn't under his jurisdiction and told me to find you again. You guys keep pushing me around, making me handle everything myself. I'm just a young woman, I can't do all this. You must give me an explanation today.]

chinese_text: [哎不是，你你不能这么说啊。我自己都去问人家了，人家说就是这个菜这个地，后来又给了六万块钱的补偿。]
english_text: [Hey, no, you can't say that. I went to ask them myself, and they said that for this vegetable land, there was an additional 60,000 yuan in compensation given later.]

chinese_text: [哥，哥你这样就不讲理了。我那么相信你，我问你你说让我找传家哥，我去找了呀。]
english_text: [Brother, brother, you're being unreasonable. I trusted you so much. I asked you, and you told me to find Brother Chuanjia, and I did go find him.]

chinese_text: [对，我就不走了！]
english_text: [Right, I'm not leaving!]

chinese_text: [什么六万块钱？]
english_text: [What 60,000 yuan?]

chinese_text: [你不走[over]是吧？你走不走[over]？]
english_text: [You're not leaving, are you? Are you leaving or not?]

chinese_text: [你们协议签了？]
english_text: [Did you sign the agreement?]

chinese_text: [那两清了还，后面还有什么事儿？]
english_text: [Then it's all settled, what other matters could there be?]

chinese_text: [我今儿给你个说法是吧？]
english_text: [I'll give you an explanation today, is that it?]

chinese_text: [我告诉你啊，你不要来我这儿闹。协议签完了，那就是定了的事儿知道吗？你要来我这儿要钱一分没有懂吗？]
english_text: [Let me tell you, don't come here making a scene. The agreement has been signed, that means it's finalized, understand? If you come here asking for money, you won't get a single cent, got it?]

chinese_text: [保安，保安！]
english_text: [Security, security!]

chinese_text: [哪儿又蹦出来个什么六万块钱呀？]
english_text: [Where did this 60,000 yuan suddenly come from?]

chinese_text: [上回不是让你去找那个什么传家吗？没找他？]
english_text: [Didn't I tell you to find that Chuanjia person last time? Didn't you find him?]

chinese_text: [你问的谁？[over]你过[over]来找我要钱，你问别人？你去跟他要钱好不好呀？]
english_text: [Who did you ask? You come here asking me for money, but you asked someone else? Why don't you go ask him for the money, how about that?]

chinese_text: [我真的服了，我没有见过这么邋遢的人。而且，你如果从他们家门口路过的话，你一定会闻到一种就是，酸臭酸臭的味儿。]
english_text: [I'm really at my wit's end, I've never seen such a messy person. And if you pass by their door, you'll definitely smell a sour, stinky odor.]

chinese_text: [没有用啊，就是他还还会那样我真的，我好想搬家，就好这个人太邋遢太腻歪了，真是受不了了我的妈呀。]
english_text: [It's useless, he still does the same thing, I really want to move out. This person is too messy and disgusting, I really can't stand it, oh my god.]

chinese_text: [物业管啊！物业管了也没有用啊。]
english_text: [The property management should handle it! But even if they do, it's useless.]

chinese_text: [而且你知道夏天，就是这种垃圾它会散发出很多味道，然后还会招出什么虫子啊，蚊子啊。我跟他说了无数遍，不好使，人家就是每天正照常，一到晚上哎做完饭了就把垃圾给你扔那儿了。]
english_text: [And you know, in summer, this kind of garbage gives off a lot of smells and attracts insects and mosquitoes. I've told him countless times, but it doesn't work. He just continues as usual every day, throwing the garbage there right after finishing cooking at night.]

chinese_text: [哎，人家下干什么呢？人家直接下次散开在楼道里。你见过这么，就是他他给你。]
english_text: [Well, what do they do? They just scatter it all over the hallway. Have you ever seen someone like this, he just...]
[Ah! Her.]

chinese_text: [天哪，这种人好烦啊！]
english_text: [Oh my god, people like this are so annoying!]

chinese_text: [每一天，都会把他的什么厨余垃圾呀，卫生间的垃圾呀，扔在门就是两个门儿的中间儿。你能想象我每天出门儿的时候我有多崩溃吗？]
english_text: [Every day, he throws his kitchen waste, bathroom trash, right in the space between our two doors. Can you imagine how upset I am every time I go out?]

chinese_text: [她还不承认是吗？]
english_text: [She still doesn't admit it, does she?]

chinese_text: [就是这个人，他不爱干净到了极限，所以他的垃圾我真的，我真的受不了了。然后好多次，我看到他那个垃圾在那儿，我就回去戴上一次性手套，我就给他抓到他门口去。]
english_text: [This person is extremely unhygienic, so I really can't stand his garbage. Many times, when I see his trash there, I go back, put on disposable gloves, and take it to his door.]

chinese_text: [我，给我气的，我直接上去。我我就说，我一开始先找他大人聊，然后说然后一开始，我刚第一次去敲门的时候，我还特意两边我都听了。]
english_text: [I was so angry, I went straight up. I said I would first talk to the adults, and then when I first knocked on the door, I特意 listened on both sides.]

chinese_text: [没有用？]
english_text: [It didn't work?]

chinese_text: [差不多十一十一点十二点才醒嘛。但那小孩儿呢，早上九点钟开始，开始就满家跑了。]
english_text: [They don't wake up until around eleven or twelve. But that kid starts running all over the house at nine in the morning.]

chinese_text: [嗯，别人家都没声儿，就他家有声儿。然后我敲门儿，她说不是，不是我家，]
english_text: [Hmm, all the other apartments are quiet, only theirs makes noise. Then I knocked on the door, and she said, 'No, it's not my home.']

chinese_text: [对，我说不是你家还能是谁家？两边都没人还能是谁家？然后我说你你管不管？你不管的话我告诉你啊，你以后，呃因为她老公是在外面上班，就就家里就一就一女人看孩子。]
english_text: [Right, I said if it's not your home, whose could it be? Both sides are empty, so whose else could it be? Then I asked if she would control it. If she didn't, I told her, because her husband works outside, there's just a woman watching the child at home.]

chinese_text: [不是，这事物业也不管吗？]
english_text: [Really? Doesn't the property management handle this either?]

chinese_text: [也，呃，应该有消消停了一个礼拜吧。又开始了，天天在那跑跑跑，他不光早上跑，他不光早上跑的，他六点钟也跑。]
english_text: [Well, uh, it was quiet for about a week. Then it started again, running around every day. Not only does he run in the morning, he also runs at six o'clock.]

chinese_text: [就是，就晚上六点钟的时候也跑，也搁那跑。]
english_text: [Yes, he also runs at six o'clock in the evening, just running around there.]

chinese_text: [我说你管不管？你不管的话我告诉你啊,我待会儿要是再被他吵吵着了，我觉得烦的话，我上来直接踹门啊。我不管，吓着小孩儿不算我的啊。然后，就这样消停了一段时间，然后过后，又开始了。]
english_text: [I asked if she would control it. If not, I told her, if I get disturbed by the noise again and feel annoyed, I'll come up and kick the door. I don't care, it's not my fault if the child gets scared. Then, it was quiet for a while, and then it started again.]

chinese_text: [嗯，刚学会走路，天天，在家里跑来跑去跑来跑去。就是我有的时候会呃，如果要睡得很晚的话。]
english_text: [Hmm, he just learned to walk and runs around the house every day. Sometimes, if I sleep very late...]

chinese_text: [我说，我说不是你家，还能是谁家？]
english_text: [I said, I said if it's not your home, whose could it be?]

chinese_text: [我大概听说了你的事儿，可以再讲讲吗？]
english_text: [I've generally heard about your situation, can you tell me more about it?]

chinese_text: [那你有什么想对他说的话吗？]
english_text: [So is there anything you want to say to him?]

chinese_text: [她就说，她说她不相信她的爸爸会这个样子，她不相信她的爸爸一辈子都会这样。]
english_text: [She said she couldn't believe her father would be like this, she couldn't believe her father would be like this for his whole life.]

chinese_text: [然后就，我们俩见到最后一面的时候，小秋她就拉着我的手，她怎么都不肯走。]
english_text: [Then, the last time we saw each other, Xiaoqiu held my hand and refused to leave no matter what.]

chinese_text: [所以我这次过来找他，就是想要见见他，想让他看一看，他爸爸跟以前不一样了。]
english_text: [So I came here this time to find him, I just want to see him, to let him see that his father is different from before.]

chinese_text: [唉，我一辈子，我一辈子也忘不了这件事。]
english_text: [Sigh, I'll never forget this for the rest of my life.]

chinese_text: [所以从那以后我就发誓，我要改头换面，我要重新做人，我就是为了她，我要做一个好爸爸。]
english_text: [So from then on, I swore that I would turn over a new leaf, I would start anew. It's all for her, I want to be a good father.]

chinese_text: [整天东躲西藏的。嗯，小秋跟她妈妈三天两头的也见不到我。然后她妈妈就，把她给带走了。]
english_text: [Hiding and dodging all day. Well, Xiaoqiu and her mother could barely see me. Then her mother took her away.]

chinese_text: [但是没想到，他现在好像不太想见我。]
english_text: [But unexpectedly, he doesn't seem to want to see me now.]

chinese_text: [你不要说什么想对他说的话啊。我其实我就我就远远地看他两眼就，我就就足够了我觉得。]
english_text: [Don't say anything you want to tell him. Actually, I think just looking at him from a distance would be enough for me.]

chinese_text: [嗯，我啊，年轻的时候犯浑。就听信了一些朋友说带我做生意，亏了一大笔钱。]
english_text: [Well, I was foolish when I was young. I believed some friends who said they would bring me into business, and I lost a lot of money.]

chinese_text: [这是我的房子，我买的。]
english_text: [This is my house, I bought it.]

chinese_text: [凭什么？]
english_text: [On what grounds?]

chinese_text: [[laughing]打拼？你所谓的打拼就是，跟你那些狐朋狗友，在外面吃饭喝酒打牌是吗？这就是打拼是吗？]
english_text: [Struggling? Your so-called struggling is just eating, drinking, and gambling with those worthless friends of yours, right? Is that what you call struggling?]

chinese_text: [在外面花钱？我妈生病住院的时候，是我，一个十几岁的小孩，去跟亲戚一家一家一家的借钱，那个时候你在哪啊？]
english_text: [Spending money outside? When my mom was sick and hospitalized, it was me, a teenager, who went to borrow money from relatives one by one. Where were you then?]

chinese_text: [我不想听你说了，走。]
english_text: [I don't want to listen to you anymore, leave.]

chinese_text: [走。哎，我没见过你这么无赖的人，你知不知道，你待在别人的家里是犯法的，我可以报警抓你。]
english_text: [Leave. Hey, I've never seen such a shameless person like you. Do you know that staying in someone else's home is illegal? I can call the police to arrest you.]

chinese_text: [你别再耍无赖了，行不行？]
english_text: [Stop being so shameless, will you?]

chinese_text: [离开我家。]
english_text: [Leave my home.]

chinese_text: [你是我爹，你现在知道你是我爹了，我跟我妈妈吃不饱饭的时候，你在哪？]
english_text: [You're my father? Now you know you're my father? When my mother and I couldn't eat enough, where were you?]

chinese_text: [你走不走？]
english_text: [Are you leaving or not?]

chinese_text: [你现在看到我工作了，我有能力了，我能养活我自己了，你跟我说，你是我爹？]
english_text: [Now you see I'm working, I'm capable, I can support myself, and you tell me you're my father?]

chinese_text: [不是吗？我除了跟你有血缘关系，从小到大你管过我什么？我上学你管过吗？我工作你管过吗？]
english_text: [Am I not? Besides having a blood relationship with you, what have you ever taken care of for me since I was young? Did you care about my education? Did you care about my job?]

chinese_text: [我走的，我妈走的时候，你在哪？我小时候被人欺负的时候，你在哪？]
english_text: [When my mom passed away, where were you? When I was bullied as a child, where were you?]

chinese_text: [我是你爹，我住你的房子，不是天经地义的吗？]
english_text: [I'm your father, isn't it natural that I live in your house?]

chinese_text: [那我赚钱的时候，你没看见而已，懂吗？]
english_text: [You just didn't see it when I was making money, understand?]

chinese_text: [我走去哪儿啊？]
english_text: [Where should I go?]

chinese_text: [钱，男人在外面不是要花钱的吗？]
english_text: [Money, don't men need to spend money when they're out?]

chinese_text: [这我家呀，凭什么？]
english_text: [This is my home, by what right?]

chinese_text: [我就算不管你，那我也是你爹，你呢？你可以报警啊。]
english_text: [Even if I don't care about you, I'm still your father, what about you? You can call the police if you want.]

chinese_text: [走不了。]
english_text: [Can't leave.]

chinese_text: [你是我亲生女儿，我待在你家叫别人家吗？]
english_text: [You're my biological daughter, would you call me a stranger when I'm staying at your house?]

chinese_text: [那我不是要去，男人嘛，去外边打拼吗？]
english_text: [Shouldn't I go out and make my way in the world? That's what men do.]

chinese_text: [来吧，你报警，让他们来抓我。]
english_text: [Go ahead, call the police, let them come and arrest me.]

chinese_text: [你今天就让呃警察过来，把你亲爹从你这个家里抬出去，让街坊四邻看看，你怎么做女儿的？]
english_text: [Today, you can have the police come and carry your own father out of your house, let all the neighbors see what kind of daughter you are.]

chinese_text: [哦，天啊！]
english_text: [Oh, my god!]

chinese_text: [不不是学生吗？]
english_text: [Isn't she a student?]

chinese_text: [啊？没来上班，为什么？]
english_text: [Huh? She didn't come to work, why?]

chinese_text: [妈呀!哎，怪不得咱们上次团建的时候，她还问我，她说想不想就是跳槽去一个更高薪的公司。天呐！我还好没答应。]
english_text: [Oh my! No wonder during our last team building, she asked me if I wanted to switch to a higher-paying company. Oh my god! I'm glad I didn't agree.]

chinese_text: [我天呐！还真看不出来。]
english_text: [Oh my god! I really couldn't tell.]

chinese_text: [妈呀！哎，那她来咱们公司不会是想。]
english_text: [Oh my! Wait, could it be that she came to our company to...]

chinese_text: [对啊，不然呢？]
english_text: [Exactly, what else?]

chinese_text: [电电电诈？]
english_text: [Telecommunications fraud?]

chinese_text: [就直接抓走了？]
english_text: [They just arrested her just like that?]

chinese_text: [我的天呐！哎，你怎么知道的？]
english_text: [Oh my god! How do you know?]

chinese_text: [啊，你敢信吗？]
english_text: [Ah, can you believe it?]

chinese_text: [戴着黑框眼镜，哇！你以为她刚大学毕业是吧？]
english_text: [Wearing black-rimmed glasses, wow! You'd think she just graduated from college, right?]

chinese_text: [你知道她以前干什么的？]
english_text: [Do you know what she used to do?]

chinese_text: [哼，我跟你说，今天她旁边的那个小黄跟我说。你知道吧，小李平时看上去老老实实一个人。]
english_text: [Hmph, let me tell you, that Xiao Huang next to her told me today. You know, Xiao Li usually seems like such an honest person.]

chinese_text: [人家在缅北搞电诈，你知道吗？]
english_text: [She was involved in telecom fraud in Northern Myanmar, did you know?]

chinese_text: [直接就不可能再回来了，就在那天天打电话了。]
english_text: [She won't be coming back at all, just making phone calls there every day.]

chinese_text: [工位不空着呢吗？]
english_text: [Isn't her workstation empty?]

chinese_text: [你没发现，小李今天没来上班吗？]
english_text: [Didn't you notice that Xiao Li didn't come to work today?]

chinese_text: [呃那个小王加班呢，然后小李也没走。突然来了警察，把她带走了。然后问了她好多关于在缅甸的事儿，就就当当场问的。然后确定了是她，把她带走的，小王在旁边听见了。]
english_text: [Well, Xiao Wang was working overtime, and Xiao Li hadn't left either. Suddenly the police came and took her away. They asked her many questions about things in Myanmar, right there on the spot. Then they confirmed it was her and took her away, Xiao Wang heard everything from nearby.]

chinese_text: [啊，她也问过我！]
english_text: [Ah, she asked me too!]

chinese_text: [就光在那打电话，你敢信吗？]
english_text: [Just making phone calls there, can you believe it?]

english_text: [Hey, that Sun, he just asked me.]

chinese_text: [顾佳，这些年除了钱，你有没有为，你有没有过一刻，为我的作品感到过不值过呀？有过吗？]
english_text: [Gu Jia, over these years besides money, have you ever, even for a moment, felt that my work wasn't worth it? Have you?]

chinese_text: [不是，如果他的资金不供应上的话，那我们公司下个月的资金链就完全断掉了。]
english_text: [No, if his funding doesn't come through, then our company's cash flow will be completely cut off next month.]

chinese_text: [你先消消气啊，是这样的，嗯，可能老万在相处的过程当中，并不是一个好的客户。但是你不得不否认，他是我们公司现在最大的客户。他给我们的订单，占我们每年利润的百分之五十。]
english_text: [Calm down first, it's like this, well, maybe Old Wan isn't a good client to deal with. But you have to admit, he's our company's biggest client right now. His orders account for fifty percent of our annual profit.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，他是觉得我们现在报的成本太高了吗？]
english_text: [Oh, does he think the costs we're quoting are too high?]

chinese_text: [怎么还和老万动手了？]
english_text: [Why did you get into a physical fight with Old Wan?]

chinese_text: [我不是那个意思，这样，你先消消气好吗？把后面的事情交给我处理，你相信我一次好吗？]
english_text: [That's not what I meant. Look, calm down first, okay? Let me handle what comes next, will you trust me just this once?]

chinese_text: [嗯，我也希望你能过得好。因为这么些年我在里边，咱妈、孩子你都照顾得这么好，我我真的我我亏欠你。]
english_text: [Yeah, I hope you can live well too. Because I've been inside all these years, and you've taken such good care of our mom and the kids, I really, I really owe you.]

chinese_text: [所以，其实你刚才跟我说，老林这个人听你这么一说，我觉得人挺好的。]
english_text: [So, actually, when you just told me about this person Old Lin, hearing you talk about him, I think he seems like a pretty good guy.]

chinese_text: [你不用在意我你不用管我，我我我都挺好的真的。你觉得你们俩什么时候合适要结婚的话，跟我说，我去喝你们喜酒。]
english_text: [You don't need to worry about me, you don't need to take care of me, I'm really doing fine, truly. If you think the two of you are ready to get married, let me know, I'll come drink to your wedding.]

chinese_text: [唉，你你别这么说，是我对不起你。你说当初要不是我进去了，是吧，事情也不会变成现在这个样子。]
english_text: [Sigh, don't say that, I'm the one who's sorry for you. You know, if it weren't for me being locked up back then, right, things wouldn't have turned out like this.]

chinese_text: [慢慢的我就觉得他好像变成了我的一个依靠。再然后呢，我们之间就有了爱，可是我还是觉得我挺对不起您的。]
english_text: [Gradually, I felt like he had become someone I could rely on. And then, love developed between us, but I still feel like I've let you down.]

chinese_text: [我我还是想和您解释一下。嗯，我那会跟老林吧，最开始只是朋友。]
english_text: [I still want to explain to you. Well, back then with Lao Lin, we were just friends at the beginning.]

chinese_text: [但听你这么说我就放心了，我希望我们都能过得很好。]
english_text: [But hearing you say that makes me feel relieved. I hope we can both live well.]

chinese_text: [我，[Sobbing]我没想到你能，就是这么宽容这么大方[Sobbing]。]
english_text: [I, [Sobbing] I didn't expect you to be so tolerant and generous [Sobbing].]

chinese_text: [没有啊，你当时也是为了保护别人嘛。但是，我啧我也不知道该怎么说，就是我很希望你能过得好。]
english_text: [No, you were trying to protect others at that time. But, well, I don't know how to say it, I just really hope you can live well.]

chinese_text: [但是后来呢，咱妈病了，他经常看我不容易又带着孩子又要照顾老妈，就过来帮忙。]
english_text: [But later, when our mom got sick, he often saw how hard it was for me, taking care of the child and looking after our mom, so he came over to help.]

chinese_text: [对呀。那么个小破四合院儿，一点五个亿呀？]
english_text: [Right. Such a small, shabby siheyuan, for 150 million?]

chinese_text: [切，那四合院儿，那多多少？]
english_text: [Tsk, that siheyuan, how much was it worth?]

chinese_text: [这，他们家那四合院儿拆了？不是，不是说那四合院儿，那个什么，国家重点保护。]
english_text: [What, their siheyuan was demolished? Didn't they say that siheyuan was, you know, under national key protection?]

chinese_text: [我那天加了呀，不是，这孙子不会给我删了吧？我看看。]
english_text: [I added him that day, no, did this bastard delete me? Let me check.]

chinese_text: [我猜四合院儿，怎么也得四千万？]
english_text: [I guess for the siheyuan, it must be at least 40 million?]

chinese_text: [朋友圈横杠了！给我删了！]
english_text: [I'm blocked on WeChat Moments! He deleted me!]

chinese_text: [我就，不是，他，他不爱喝酒，我我那天就给他灌酒来着嘛我。]
english_text: [I just, no, he, he doesn't like drinking, so I forced him to drink that day.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，那天那吃饭就应该让他买单啊我。]
english_text: [Oh, I should have let him pay for the meal that day.]

chinese_text: [不是，我前前段时间刚见过他，刚跟他吃过饭呢。]
english_text: [No, I just saw him recently, I just had a meal with him.]

chinese_text: [啥？一点五个亿？]
english_text: [What? 150 million?]

chinese_text: [你看看，你是不是得罪人家了？你吃饭的时候说啥了？]
english_text: [See, did you offend him? What did you say during the meal?]

chinese_text: [能想到吗？他们家，就是，你说大家小时候都住的一块儿，怎么就他们家拆了呢？]
english_text: [Can you believe it? Their family, I mean, we all lived together as kids, how come only their house was demolished?]

chinese_text: [那怪不得。]
english_text: [No wonder.]

chinese_text: [最近有个大新闻。]
english_text: [There's been some big news recently.]

chinese_text: [知道拆了多少钱吗？]
english_text: [Do you know how much they got for the demolition?]

chinese_text: [你还记得咱们小学那个刘星吗？]
english_text: [Do you remember Liu Xing from our elementary school?]

chinese_text: [亿！而且你知道吗？他们家本来那四合院就不算，其实不算太大。他们一家子住里面，也有点挤，对吧？]
english_text: [A hundred million! And did you know? Their siheyuan wasn't actually that big. The whole family living there was a bit crowded, right?]

chinese_text: [而且，我那天问他，我说哎，那你准备买个什么车？你知道人怎么说的吗？]
english_text: [And, I asked him that day, I said, 'So what car are you planning to buy?' Do you know what he said?]

chinese_text: [这还用选吗？喜欢哪个拿哪个啊。]
english_text: [Is there even a need to choose? Just take whichever one you like.]

chinese_text: [你看看。]
english_text: [See what I mean?]

chinese_text: [[laughing]一点五个亿！]
english_text: [150 million! Unbelievable!]

chinese_text: [人家拿到了这个赔偿款之后，扭头，二环买了套房。]
english_text: [After they received the compensation money, they immediately went and bought a house on the second ring road.]

chinese_text: [那一样的道理呀。你所谓的客户，我需要了解他具体是谁的客户吗？反正都是我们公司的客户喽。]
english_text: [It's the same logic. Do I need to know specifically whose client your so-called client is? After all, they're all clients of our company.]

chinese_text: [她自己想创立服装品牌的事情，你知道吗？]
english_text: [Do you know about her plan to start her own clothing brand?]

chinese_text: [哦，你的客户不跟你说啊？挺好的。还有啊，我之前做的一个报表，出现在了你的报告里面。]
english_text: [Oh, your client doesn't communicate with you? That's nice. By the way, a report I previously prepared appeared in your presentation.]

chinese_text: [那我问你啊，如果领导问下来的时候，数据从哪来，你怎么说呢？]
english_text: [So let me ask you, when management asks where the data came from, what will you say?]

chinese_text: [这上面的数据，我完全没有核对过。哎，如果出了错误，责任算你的还是我的？]
english_text: [I haven't verified any of the data on this at all. If there are errors, will the responsibility fall on you or me?]

chinese_text: [没有问题，太没有问题了。哎，那照你的意思就是，我们小组里的任何，你知道数据从哪来的吗？所有的数据，你今天想用他的就用他的，明天想用我的就用我的喽？]
english_text: [No problem, absolutely no problem. So according to your logic, does anyone in our team know where the data comes from? You can just use anyone's data whenever you want, his today and mine tomorrow?]

chinese_text: [我没有来得及呀！你是我的上司吗？你帮我核对？用得着你吗？]
english_text: [I didn't have time! Are you my supervisor? You want to help me verify? Do I really need your help?]

chinese_text: [哦行，那可以。行，那以后大家都一起互相抢客户吧。]
english_text: [Oh, fine, that's acceptable. Fine, then from now on, let's all just compete to steal each other's clients.]

chinese_text: [哎，我觉得我们是一个小组的。你的数据，你没有完成核对，那我来帮你核对，然后交上去。]
english_text: [Hey, I thought we were on the same team. Since you haven't finished verifying your data, I'll help you check it and then submit it.]

chinese_text: [这个责任在我吗？]
english_text: [Is this my responsibility?]

chinese_text: [我需要了解到这个数据，具体是谁做的吗？这个工作内容不是我的。]
english_text: [Do I need to know specifically who prepared this data? This isn't part of my job responsibilities.]

chinese_text: [今天这事我会记着。]
english_text: [I'll remember what happened today.]

chinese_text: [她没跟我说，我怎么知道？]
english_text: [She didn't tell me, so how would I know?]

chinese_text: [那你的报表，为什么不核对一下数据呢？我来帮你核对呀。]
english_text: [Then why don't you verify the data in your report? I can help you check it.]

chinese_text: [我只要说，这是我们小组研究下来的数据就可以了。我为什么要告诉他，具体是谁做的呢？]
english_text: [I just need to say this is the data researched by our team. Why should I tell him specifically who prepared it?]

chinese_text: [哎，我发现你真行啊。我今天才从市场部那边知道，我的客户，一直在跟进的客户，被你抢了，是吧？]
english_text: [Hey, I've discovered you're quite something. I only learned today from the marketing department that you stole my client—the one I've been actively pursuing, right?]

chinese_text: [有什么问题吗？]
english_text: [Is there a problem?]

chinese_text: [呃，对啊。]
english_text: [Uh, yes.]

chinese_text: [天呐天。]
english_text: [Oh my god, oh my god.]

chinese_text: [你这么一说，还真是哎，她请假了吗？]
english_text: [Now that you mention it, that's true. Did she take a day off?]

chinese_text: [一天挣四十万，这是什么概念？我想都不敢想。]
english_text: [Earning 400,000 in a day—what does that even mean? I wouldn't even dare to imagine it.]

chinese_text: [天哪！我还是没法接受。]
english_text: [Oh my god! I still can't accept it.]

chinese_text: [真的没想到哎，我平时看她，我觉得她特别老实，然后就是为人也挺好的。我以为他就是那种，就是按部就班，上完大学，就老老实实工作那种人。]
english_text: [I really didn't expect this. When I see her normally, I think she's particularly honest and has a good personality. I thought she was the type to just follow the conventional path—finish college and then work steadily.]

chinese_text: [我的妈呀！]
english_text: [Oh my god!]

chinese_text: [四十万？]
english_text: [Four hundred thousand?]

chinese_text: [为什么？]
english_text: [Why?]

chinese_text: [她她她是个诈骗犯！]
english_text: [She, she, she is a scammer!]

chinese_text: [我的妈呀！]
english_text: [Oh my god!]

chinese_text: [她要是早一点动手的话，赶上上次。她估计是没来多久，没敢在上次团建的时候，就下手。但是下一次说不定了，还好被带走了。]
english_text: [If she had acted earlier, she would have made it in time for last time. I guess she hadn't been here long and didn't dare to make a move during the last team-building event. But who knows about next time. Fortunately, she was taken away.]

chinese_text: [是啊，我也是以为这样儿的人呢，谁能想到她是这样儿的。]
english_text: [Yeah, I also thought she was that kind of person. Who could have imagined she was like this.]

chinese_text: [她这次过来就是来干嘛的，你知道吗？她来我们公司卧底。因为你知道，他们那边怎么把人弄过去？怎么把人骗过去？就是组织团建去国外旅游。]
english_text: [Do you know why she came here this time? She came to our company as an undercover agent. Because you know, how do they get people over there? How do they trick people? By organizing team-building trips to travel abroad.]

chinese_text: [你先别想这个啦，我是觉得我们真的好幸运啊。]
english_text: [Don't think about that for now. I feel like we are really lucky.]

chinese_text: [我可，哎，你看她平时是一个很老实的人，对吧。我戴个黑光眼镜，就像我大学里边儿，就是那种社团里最老实那种人，你知道吗？]
english_text: [Well, you see, she usually seems like a very honest person, right? With my black-rimmed glasses, I look like those most honest people in college clubs, you know?]

chinese_text: [哎，你没发现，今天小李没来上班儿吗？]
english_text: [Hey, didn't you notice that Xiao Li didn't come to work today?]

chinese_text: [我的天！我的腰子差点就没了。]
english_text: [Oh my god! My kidneys were almost gone.]

chinese_text: [她这次过来，就是来我们这边卧底的。就看我们我们这边的人，能不能给弄过去，你知道吗？]
english_text: [She came here this time as an undercover agent. She was checking if she could get people from our side to go over there, you know?]

chinese_text: [你知道她一天，她在那边一天的营业额有多少吗？四十万，四十万人民币。]
english_text: [Do you know how much revenue she makes in one day over there? Four hundred thousand, four hundred thousand Chinese yuan.]

chinese_text: [然后在飞机上，给大家就是发那些什么小小药片什么的，说说防晕机什么的。然后一睡到目的地之后，我们就已经出现在缅北了。]
english_text: [Then on the plane, they gave everyone those small pills, saying they were for motion sickness. Then after sleeping until the destination, we would find ourselves in Northern Myanmar.]

english_text: [Yesterday afternoon, when we got off work and everyone had left, the police came and took her away.]

chinese_text: [啊！而且她还不是什么小喽啰，她是个，她正经算是个小头目呢！]
english_text: [Ah! And she's not just some small fry, she's actually a proper minor leader!]

chinese_text: [她前几天刚跟我说，她说说希望能走在我前面。她说如果我也不在了的话，她不知道一个人怎么活[Sobbing]。]
english_text: [Just a few days ago, she told me she hoped she would die before me. She said if I were gone too, she wouldn't know how to live alone [Sobbing].]

chinese_text: [佳佳，也不瞒你说。晶晶走了之后吧，你小姨整个人呢，就跟变了一个人一样。]
english_text: [Jiajia, I won't hide it from you. After Jingjing left, your aunt became like a completely different person.]

chinese_text: [我我我真的不知道该怎么劝了，你你就当帮帮你姨夫，好不好？]
english_text: [I, I, I really don't know how to comfort her anymore. Won't you please help your uncle, okay?]

chinese_text: [嗯，突然之间这个晶晶没了，就觉得我跟你小姨我们两个人就在这个世界上就就没来过，就什么也没留下。]
english_text: [Hmm, suddenly with Jingjing gone, it feels like your aunt and I never existed in this world, like we've left nothing behind.]

chinese_text: [可是，你你知道这小孩对于做父母的来说，那就是心里边儿的一个念想,就就就就就觉得自己在这个世界上面还有有留下了一些什么。]
english_text: [But, you know, for parents, a child is something to hold onto in their hearts, it makes them feel like they've left something behind in this world.]

chinese_text: [我就是想看你，你能不能劝劝你小姨。真的你不知道，她一天天坐在那，她她一天饭吃不上几口，再这么下去人真的快没了。]
english_text: [I just want to see if you can persuade your aunt. Really, you don't know, she sits there all day, she can barely eat a few mouthfuls of food each day. If this continues, she'll really be gone soon.]

chinese_text: [她现在每天呢就，天天坐在窗口那儿往外看，就那么定定地看着，你也不知道她看什么。那一看就是大半天，谁跟她说话她也不搭理。]
english_text: [Now every day, she just sits by the window looking outside, just staring fixedly, and you don't know what she's looking at. She'll stare like that for most of the day, and she doesn't respond to anyone who talks to her.]

chinese_text: [嗯，你知道吧佳佳。[Sobbing]啧，我们做父母那生小孩，不是说要只是她给我们养老什么的，没没这个想法。]
english_text: [Hmm, you know, Jiajia. [Sobbing] Tsk, when we parents have children, it's not just so they can support us in our old age or anything like that. That's not, not what we think.]

chinese_text: [哎，我知道我知道。那说是这么说的，但是还是一码事归一码事，对吧。]
english_text: [Sigh, I know, I know. That's what people say, but still, one thing is one thing, right?]

chinese_text: [唉，[Sobbing]真的，您以后就把我当成亲闺女。]
english_text: [Sigh, [Sobbing] really, from now on you should treat me as your own daughter.]

chinese_text: [别这么说姨父，这不还有我呢吗，那舅舅家两个哥哥不也还在呢吗，我们都是你的孩子。]
english_text: [Don't say that, uncle. I'm still here, and aren't your two nephews from your brother's family still here too? We are all your children.]

chinese_text: [你别这么说，哎呦。]
english_text: [Don't say that, oh my.]

chinese_text: [我肯定我肯定会劝我小姨的，您放心吧。]
english_text: [I will, I will definitely persuade my aunt, don't you worry.]

chinese_text: [你你看你看你看。]
english_text: [You, you see, you see, you see.]

chinese_text: [哎，那我要是把它凑成一对儿的话，是不是会更贵啊？]
english_text: [Hey, if I were to make it a pair, would it be more expensive?]

chinese_text: [我我靠，那那那我我是不是马上发财了？]
english_text: [I, I damn, th-th-th-then am I going to get rich immediately?]

chinese_text: [多少？我天呐[laughing]！]
english_text: [How much? Oh my god [laughing]!]

chinese_text: [所以这是真的？]
english_text: [So this is real?]

chinese_text: [它它会不会是太像了？]
english_text: [Is, is it too similar?]

chinese_text: [哎，你看我最近淘回来的这个，好看不？]
english_text: [Hey, look at this one I recently dug up, isn't it beautiful?]

chinese_text: [哎，那你别你你你你放下放下放下放下，你别给我弄坏了。]
english_text: [Hey, then don't you, you, you, you put it down, put it down, put it down, don't break it for me.]

chinese_text: [那当然。]
english_text: [Of course.]

chinese_text: [不是。因为我很喜欢，但是真的太贵了，我实在是买不起。但是，我就觉得很好看嘛，所以我就买了。]
english_text: [No. Because I really like it, but it's really too expensive, I really can't afford it. But, I just think it's very beautiful, so I bought it.]

chinese_text: [呃，倒是这个道理，但是是不是会更贵？]
english_text: [Uh, that makes sense, but wouldn't it be more expensive?]

chinese_text: [二手市场能淘到这个成色的物件儿？]
english_text: [Can you really find something of this quality in a second-hand market?]

chinese_text: [不对劲儿，这真是你在二手市场淘的？]
english_text: [Something's not right, did you really dig this up from a second-hand market?]

chinese_text: [可以啊。]
english_text: [Not bad.]

chinese_text: [这东西，你知道仿制难度有多高吗？]
english_text: [This thing, do you know how difficult it is to replicate?]

chinese_text: [嗯，不现实不现实。你你还是就就就把它拍了得了，我跟你说，一点二亿落落钱包里。]
english_text: [Hmm, not realistic, not realistic. You should just, just, just sell it at auction, let me tell you, 120 million will fall into your wallet.]

chinese_text: [就现在的国内的技术，根本做不出一模一样儿的东西。]
english_text: [With the current domestic technology, it's impossible to make something exactly the same.]

chinese_text: [关键你怎么搞到另外一个呀？]
english_text: [The key is how did you get the other one?]

chinese_text: [哎，你也知道，我比较关注国内外的一些拍卖会啊。]
english_text: [Hey, as you know, I pay attention to some auctions at home and abroad.]

chinese_text: [我能看看吗？]
english_text: [Can I take a look?]

chinese_text: [你是不是忘了？之前是你告诉我，她在面前怎么说我，然后她在面前怎么说我，都是你告诉我的呀。你那个最大的狗头军师，叫什么什么什么狼儿。]
english_text: [Did you forget? It was you who told me how she talked about me in front of me, and then how she talked about me in front of me again. You told me all of it. Your biggest schemer, what's-her-name, Wolf or something.]

chinese_text: [你去你的呗，你为什么非得拽上我呢？]
english_text: [You can go by yourself, why do you have to drag me along?]

chinese_text: [对不起，那她们是你的朋友又不是我的朋友。]
english_text: [Sorry, but they're your friends, not mine.]

chinese_text: [每次咱们俩吵架的时候，就你那几个狗头军师，一直分分分分分的那是朋友？]
english_text: [Every time we argue, those schemers of yours keep instigating and taking sides. Are those really friends?]

chinese_text: [怎么说的？说我这个不行，那个不行，说我长得又矮，长得又黑，对吧。她，你告诉我的吧，这种人你的朋友，我去见她，我去见她干嘛！]
english_text: [What did they say? Saying I'm not good at this, not good at that, saying I'm short and dark-skinned, right? Her, you told me about her, right? With friends like that, why should I go see her? Why would I go see her!]

chinese_text: [你的朋友？你那是些什么朋友啊！]
english_text: [Your friends? What kind of friends are those!]

chinese_text: [我去见她们的意义是什么？见完了之后，让她们在你面前再吐槽我？]
english_text: [What's the point of me seeing them? So that after I meet them, they can complain about me to you again?]

chinese_text: [不想去。]
english_text: [I don't want to go.]

chinese_text: [怎么，什么我什么叫什么朋友啊？]
english_text: [What? What do you mean by 'my friends'?]

chinese_text: [那不是我在生气吗？我在生气，我的朋友当然为我着想啊。谁，我的朋友站你角度上去思考，你惹我生气。]
english_text: [Wasn't I the one who was angry? When I'm angry, of course my friends are going to think about what's best for me. Who, my friends should consider things from your perspective when you're the one who made me angry?]

chinese_text: [那我的朋友，你不得认识认识啊。]
english_text: [Then you have to get to know my friends.]

chinese_text: [那怎么了？]
english_text: [So what's wrong with that?]

chinese_text: [不想去，你给个理由行吗？]
english_text: [I don't want to go. Can you give me a reason?]

chinese_text: [为什么我跟我朋友的局，你永远不去呢？]
english_text: [Why do you never go to gatherings with my friends?]

chinese_text: [怎么就没有理由啊？约好的局，你每次都说不去，你答应过的，然后还不去。没有理由，怎么可能没有理由啊？]
english_text: [How can you say there's no reason? For planned gatherings, you always say you won't go, even after you've promised. No reason? How could there possibly be no reason?]

chinese_text: [那你这样说的话就没法过了。]
english_text: [If you're going to say that, then we can't go on like this.]

chinese_text: [你都没见过，怎么知道人家什么人啊？]
english_text: [You've never even met them, so how do you know what kind of people they are?]

chinese_text: [唉，我女儿要是活着的话，也二十二了。你是从国外回来的？]
english_text: [Sigh, if my daughter were still alive, she'd be twenty-two too. Did you come back from abroad?]

chinese_text: [但我现在想想，也没什么不好的嘛，去省外就去省外呗，你看你。]
english_text: [But thinking about it now, there's nothing bad about it. Going to study outside the province is just going to study outside the province. Look at you.]

chinese_text: [唉，哎不说这些。]
english_text: [Sigh, let's not talk about this.]

chinese_text: [所以啊，你说人活一辈子，想到什么，想做什么，就赶紧去做，是吧。]
english_text: [So, you know, in life, when you think of something you want to do, you should just go and do it, right?]

chinese_text: [她非得跟我说呀，要去省外读书。我那个时候儿吧，不太放心，就不同意。]
english_text: [She insisted on telling me she wanted to go study outside the province. At that time, I wasn't feeling comfortable about it, so I disagreed.]

chinese_text: [后来我就想明白了，不管去哪，只要她好好儿的就都挺好。]
english_text: [Later on, I came to understand that no matter where she goes, as long as she's doing well, everything is fine.]

chinese_text: [都去国外那么远，也没啥事儿。]
english_text: [She went as far as abroad, and nothing bad happened.]

chinese_text: [丁医生，你今年多大了？]
english_text: [Doctor Ding, how old are you this year?]

chinese_text: [她走那年，我记得是五月十二号。]
english_text: [The year she left, I remember it was May 12th.]

chinese_text: [就三百多分儿。]
english_text: [Just over 300 points.]

chinese_text: [对，所以他们就说说，你答题卡放地上踩一脚,你也不至于九分儿。]
english_text: [Right, so they say, even if you put your answer sheet on the ground and step on it, you wouldn't get just nine points.]

chinese_text: [你猜我高考多少分儿？]
english_text: [Guess how many points I got on the college entrance exam?]

chinese_text: [但是我其实也是够用的，不过像你。]
english_text: [But actually, mine was good enough too, just like yours.]

chinese_text: [你知道什么叫没好好学吗？]
english_text: [Do you know what it means to not study properly?]

chinese_text: [那有点儿太低了。]
english_text: [That's a bit too low.]

chinese_text: [四百多分儿叫差一点儿？]
english_text: [Over 400 points is considered 'almost'?]

chinese_text: [对，但是你四百多分儿，我身边，你你是第第三个第四个四百多分儿的。]
english_text: [Right, but with over 400 points, among people I know, you're only the third or fourth person with that score.]

chinese_text: [对对对，就是艺术类是够用的。]
english_text: [Right, right, right, it's good enough for art majors.]

chinese_text: [满分儿才七百吧？]
english_text: [The full score is only 700, right?]

chinese_text: [但是，你再猜我数学单科成绩有多少？]
english_text: [But, guess again what my math score alone was?]

chinese_text: [你从小学就是到大学学习成绩都很好吗？]
english_text: [Were your grades always good from elementary school through university?]

chinese_text: [不是算好的，算非常高了。]
english_text: [Not just good, it's considered very high.]

chinese_text: [你考六百多，妈这么。]
english_text: [You scored over 600, wow.]

chinese_text: [不算好，你你中考考多少分儿？]
english_text: [Not that good. How many points did you get on the high school entrance exam?]

chinese_text: [确实有点，艺术类还我还算好的。]
english_text: [It's true, for art majors, I'm actually considered quite good.]

chinese_text: [那确实是，你这九分有点太夸张了吧？你就随便abcd都选d。]
english_text: [That's true, your nine points is a bit too exaggerated, isn't it? You could have just randomly chosen D for all ABCD options.]

chinese_text: [挺差的，我都没好好学，四百多分的时候。]
english_text: [Pretty bad. I didn't even study properly when I got over 400 points.]

chinese_text: [[laughing]三百多？]
english_text: [[laughing] Over 300?]

chinese_text: [三百三十多也差不了多少，跟我四百多一点儿。]
english_text: [Over 330 isn't that different from my just over 400.]

chinese_text: [啧，还行吧，也不算很好。]
english_text: [Tsk, it's okay, not that great though.]

chinese_text: [真的吗？]
english_text: [Really?]

chinese_text: [对啊，因为比我分儿高的更多嘛。]
english_text: [Yeah, because there are more people with higher scores than me.]

chinese_text: [三百多多少呀？]
english_text: [How much over 300?]

chinese_text: [啥叫没好好学？]
english_text: [What do you mean I didn't study hard?]

chinese_text: [中考也就六百三十多分吧。]
english_text: [I only got a little over 630 on the high school entrance exam.]

chinese_text: [十分儿？八分儿？]
english_text: [Ten points? Eight points?]

chinese_text: [九分儿[laughing]？]
english_text: [Nine points [laughing]?]

chinese_text: [高考考的比较差一点，四百多分儿。]
english_text: [I did a bit poorly on the college entrance exam, just over 400 points.]

chinese_text: [差不多吧。]
english_text: [About right.]

chinese_text: [咳咳，两百多？]
english_text: [Ahem, over 200?]

chinese_text: [我不努力吗？]
english_text: [Don't I work hard?]

chinese_text: [我们两个都考上了。]
english_text: [Both of us were admitted.]

chinese_text: [我说了，我我可以我不花家里钱。]
english_text: [I said, I can, I can not spend the family's money.]

chinese_text: [我为什么不能去啊，为什么我不能上大学呢？]
english_text: [Why can't I go? Why can't I go to college?]

chinese_text: [我我可以去勤工俭学，我也可以拿奖学金，让我去吧，行吗？]
english_text: [I can work-study, I can also get scholarships, let me go, okay?]

chinese_text: [我从小到大，我什么事都能让着他，但这件事情，我不想再让着他了。你们要偏心，也得有个度吧。]
english_text: [Since I was young, I've let him have his way in everything, but on this matter, I don't want to give in to him anymore. If you're going to show favoritism, there should be a limit.]

chinese_text: [如果你的分数比你弟弟高，我可以让你去。现在是弟弟分数比你高，没有办法，我们家只能供得起一个人。]
english_text: [If your score was higher than your brother's, I could let you go. But now your brother's score is higher than yours, there's no way, our family can only afford to send one person.]

chinese_text: [但是你爸爸他现在[Sobbing]，现在已经没有办法工作了。]
english_text: [But your father now [Sobbing], he can't work anymore.]

chinese_text: [你知道你弟弟有多努力。]
english_text: [You know how hard your brother works.]

chinese_text: [不花家里钱，弟弟得花呀，我一个人供不起呀。没有办法呀，我也想让你上学。]
english_text: [Not spending family money, but your brother needs to spend it, I can't afford it alone. There's no way, I want you to go to school too.]

chinese_text: [怎么了？]
english_text: [What's wrong?]

chinese_text: [我知道这事儿，你难受，但是我们是基于分数来的，不是说偏心弟弟。]
english_text: [I know this matter makes you feel bad, but we're basing it on scores, not favoring your brother.]

chinese_text: [你知道吗？天天起早起早起早，我家已经一周没收拾过了。]
english_text: [You know? Getting up early every day, my home hasn't been cleaned for a week.]

chinese_text: [然后你说找保洁阿姨吧，天天这这，这点儿工资还不够自己花呢。]
english_text: [Then you say hire a cleaning lady, but with this little salary every day, it's not even enough for my own expenses.]

chinese_text: [我来这儿之后，就天天天气又冷现在。]
english_text: [After I came here, the weather has been cold every day now.]

chinese_text: [现在这房，房价什么样儿你知道吗？]
english_text: [Do you know what the housing prices are like now?]

chinese_text: [而且最近生病的还多你知道吗？我每天早上来这一路上咳咔咳咔咳咔，到处就是咳嗽的特别多。]
english_text: [And recently, many people are getting sick, you know? Every morning on my way here, cough, cough, cough, there are people coughing everywhere.]

chinese_text: [我真挺无语的，我要真换了房子离咱们单位近了。我每个月我不用干别的，我给房租交，交那个贷款去吧我。]
english_text: [I'm really speechless. If I really changed to a place closer to our workplace, I wouldn't need to do anything else each month, just pay the rent, pay that mortgage.]

chinese_text: [你说之前在那边儿好好儿的离着都近，那你说总不能为了单位搬走了我们也跟着搬家吧？]
english_text: [You said before that it was fine over there and everything was close. But you can't expect us to move just because the workplace relocated, right?]

chinese_text: [啊，天呐，你不知道乱成什么样。地上全是各种毛发，然后各种七七八八的，这儿一块儿那一块儿的。]
english_text: [Oh my god, you have no idea how messy it is. The floor is covered in all kinds of hair, and there's random stuff everywhere, in patches here and there.]

chinese_text: [哎哟喂，你说到换房子。]
english_text: [Oh dear, you're talking about moving to a new place.]

chinese_text: [啊，我有可能到点儿了，我真是有点儿困。]
english_text: [Ah, I think it's that time, I'm really a bit sleepy.]

chinese_text: [都远，谁不远呢？你知道早上五点钟起来，然后晚上九点钟到家就不错不错的了。这一天什么都干不了了。]
english_text: [Everything is far, what isn't far? You know, waking up at 5 AM and getting home by 9 PM is considered good. There's no time to do anything all day.]

chinese_text: [我真是挺无语的，关键咱们单位又远。]
english_text: [I'm really speechless, and the key thing is that our workplace is so far.]

chinese_text: [闷得慌。]
english_text: [I feel so suffocated/stifled.]

chinese_text: [我的天呐，那更要命了。]
english_text: [Oh my god, that's even worse.]

chinese_text: [这就，我就在想每天在干什么呀？起这么早然后就，真不懂我在干嘛。]
english_text: [This makes me wonder what I'm doing every day. Waking up so early, I really don't understand what I'm doing.]

chinese_text: [嗯，这没办法呀这。]
english_text: [Well, there's nothing we can do about it.]

chinese_text: [唉，我今天也是五点起的，主要我还养狗还得遛狗，你知道吗？]
english_text: [Sigh, I also woke up at 5 today, mainly because I have a dog that needs walking, you know?]

chinese_text: [现在冬天确实冷，太冷了，特别今天。]
english_text: [Winter is really cold now, too cold, especially today.]

chinese_text: [嗯，那没办法，这单位也搬不回去呀，就找换房子得了吧，真的是。]
english_text: [Well, there's no choice, the workplace can't be moved back. We'll just have to find a new place to live, really.]

chinese_text: [又咋了？]
english_text: [What's wrong now?]

chinese_text: [是啊，主要是今天怕那个堵车什么的，就提早提早来了，没想到还早到了！]
english_text: [Yeah, mainly because I was worried about traffic jams today, so I came extra early, and unexpectedly I arrived too early!]

chinese_text: [反正我觉得挺贵。]
english_text: [Anyway, I think it's quite expensive.]

chinese_text: [是啊，贼远。]
english_text: [Yeah, it's ridiculously far.]

chinese_text: [这么夸张？]
english_text: [That exaggerated?]

chinese_text: [哎，确实今天我也挺困的。我家从这挺远的，所以我今天，唉，一大早起来。]
english_text: [Sigh, I'm quite sleepy today too. My home is quite far from here, so today, well, I got up really early.]

chinese_text: [哎我哪天不是下班了就开拆它，那它那它白天搁家，我我出门的时候它放家门口我搬进来呀，那没办法呀没时间拆呀！]
english_text: [Hey, don't I start taking it apart right after work every day? It stays at home during the day, and when I leave, I put it at the doorstep and move it in. There's no other way, I don't have time to disassemble it!]

chinese_text: [哈你说自己挺好一人一样？]
english_text: [Ha, you're talking as if you're such a good person?]

chinese_text: [哼商量不商量不了。]
english_text: [Hmph, there's no room for discussion.]

chinese_text: [这现在就你占着呢。]
english_text: [Right now, you're occupying it.]

chinese_text: [我说你一天天的，啧就这冰箱就你占着我就不能用了是吧？全你的东西。]
english_text: [I'm saying, day after day, tsk, you occupy this refrigerator so I can't use it, right? It's all your stuff.]

chinese_text: [咱俩当时搬来是不是说好的呀！]
english_text: [Didn't we agree when we moved in together!]

chinese_text: [行行行，这事儿咱过了，那那个洗衣机能不能不要往里面扔袜子啊！]
english_text: [Fine, fine, fine, let's drop this matter, but can you please stop throwing socks into the washing machine!]

chinese_text: [这合租房，你怎么着都得给我留一半的空间。]
english_text: [In this shared apartment, you have to leave me half the space no matter what.]

chinese_text: [行，我之前跟你好好说你也没让啊。]
english_text: [Fine, but when I talked to you nicely before, you didn't make space either.]

chinese_text: [脏死啦！]
english_text: [That's disgusting!]

chinese_text: [我那快递不多嘛，我上班哪来得及拆拆呀！]
english_text: [I don't have that many packages, and I don't have time to open them when I go to work!]

chinese_text: [公共空间咱要商量着来。]
english_text: [We need to discuss how we use the common space.]

chinese_text: [我怎么不买了？]
english_text: [How am I not buying things?]

chinese_text: [怎么无理取闹呢。]
english_text: [Why are you being so unreasonable?]

chinese_text: [公用的洗衣机不要扔袜子行吗？]
english_text: [Can you please not throw socks in the shared washing machine?]

chinese_text: [那你好声好气儿说我是不是给你让出来了？你凶什么。]
english_text: [When I spoke to you nicely, didn't I make space for you? Why are you being so aggressive?]

chinese_text: [对不起商量不了。]
english_text: [Sorry, but there's nothing to discuss.]

chinese_text: [我怎么没让呢，我是不是说了我暂时放一下。]
english_text: [How did I not make space? Didn't I say I would put it there temporarily?]

chinese_text: [搬进来你真好意思说，哪次不是我给你整理的？]
english_text: [Since you moved in, you have the nerve to say that? When was it not me who organized your things?]

chinese_text: [我是一直占着吗？]
english_text: [Am I always occupying the space?]

chinese_text: [成天就你事儿多，你也不往家里头买东西啊！]
english_text: [You're the one who's always making trouble, and you don't even buy things for the home!]

chinese_text: [公用的你也知道是公用的。]
english_text: [So you know it's shared space.]

chinese_text: [你跟我提公共空间？你的快递天天堆在门口儿，我进来都我都得我得先拿脚扒了两下儿，我才能进门儿，你跟我商双商量公共空间，真好意思你。]
english_text: [You're bringing up shared space with me? Your packages are piled up at the door every day, and I have to push them aside with my foot just to get in. And you want to discuss shared space with me? You've got some nerve.]

chinese_text: [我不是吗？]
english_text: [Am I not?]

chinese_text: [谁规定的？]
english_text: [Who made that rule?]

chinese_text: [你买什么了，你要是买东西的话我能全占满吗？]
english_text: [What have you bought? If you were buying things, could I occupy all the space?]

chinese_text: [袜子不是衣物吗，为什么不能扔？]
english_text: [Aren't socks clothing? Why can't I throw them in?]

chinese_text: [多是理由吗？你这个时候你理直气壮了你。]
english_text: [Are those good excuses? You're being so self-righteous now.]

chinese_text: [谁规定呢？]
english_text: [Who made the rule?]

chinese_text: [那我就不能，我就扔怎么了？]
english_text: [So I can't? What if I just throw them in anyway?]

chinese_text: [你天天坐飞机，那，行啦，没事儿。好没事儿好，好。]
english_text: [You fly on planes every day, well, fine, never mind. Okay, never mind, okay, okay.]

chinese_text: [放放什么？]
english_text: [What are you putting down?]

chinese_text: [我这第一次坐，我有点，万一你说。]
english_text: [This is my first time, I'm a bit worried, just in case, you know.]

chinese_text: [汽车能和这比吗？我第一次坐飞机，我能不害怕吗？真没事儿呀哈？]
english_text: [How can you compare a car to this? It's my first time flying, how could I not be scared? Is it really okay?]

chinese_text: [不是，我这真害怕，我跟你说。你别。]
english_text: [No, I'm really scared, I'm telling you. Don't.]

chinese_text: [那我确实也听说过，但是这这颠簸的有点太厉害了吧，我感觉我这头也挺晕的。]
english_text: [Well, I have heard about that, but this turbulence is a bit too intense, isn't it? I feel quite dizzy.]

chinese_text: [我这还能吃得下饭呀？]
english_text: [How could I possibly eat now?]

chinese_text: [不是啊，大哥。这上去怎么那么恐怖啊，怎么还会，就是颠簸？]
english_text: [No, really, man. Why is it so terrifying when we go up? And why is there still turbulence?]

chinese_text: [靠窗难受点儿？]
english_text: [Is it more uncomfortable by the window?]

chinese_text: [哎这，咋咋咋咋咋咋有点颠簸呢啊？]
english_text: [Hey, why is it so bumpy all of a sudden?]

chinese_text: [正常吗这？]
english_text: [Is this normal?]

chinese_text: [不是啊，大哥，你能稍微关心一下我吗？你这太冷漠了。]
english_text: [Come on, man, can't you show a little concern for me? You're being so cold.]
