chinese_text: [你说你回来怎么不告诉我呀？还好我爸跟我说了。]
english_text: [Why didn't you tell me you were back? Luckily my dad told me.]

chinese_text: [行，那我这早饭你吃不吃了？]
english_text: [Fine, so are you going to eat this breakfast I prepared or not?]

chinese_text: [一会那唇膏买错了，那我就也不开心了。]
english_text: [If you buy the wrong lipstick later, then I'll be unhappy too.]

chinese_text: [那不行，你再带我去买两只，逛街去。]
english_text: [No, that won't do. Take me out to buy two more, let's go shopping.]

chinese_text: [就不高兴啊。]
english_text: [I'm just unhappy.]

chinese_text: [那我今天一大早给你，我还给你带早饭了。]
english_text: [I came to see you early this morning, and I even brought you breakfast.]

chinese_text: [什么礼物？]
english_text: [What gift?]

chinese_text: [真的假的？]
english_text: [Is that true or false?]

chinese_text: [倒时差也给我吃。]
english_text: [You're making me eat this even with the jet lag?]

chinese_text: [这个好。]
english_text: [This is good.]

chinese_text: [这么有劲儿？]
english_text: [So energetic?]

chinese_text: [那我哪儿知道啊？他们都买这个，我也没用过那个呀。]
english_text: [How would I know? They all buy this one, and I've never used that one.]

chinese_text: [买包，买包，买包。]
english_text: [Buy a bag, buy a bag, buy a bag.]

chinese_text: [呃，市中心吧。]
english_text: [Uh, downtown, I guess.]

chinese_text: [去那个，去哪儿？]
english_text: [Go to that... where are we going?]

chinese_text: [哎？那你要不高兴的话，我那个礼物就不送了啊？]
english_text: [Huh? If you're going to be unhappy, then I won't give you that gift, okay?]

chinese_text: [香菇白菜？]
english_text: [Mushrooms and cabbage?]

chinese_text: [你怎么不高兴啊？]
english_text: [Why are you unhappy?]

chinese_text: [那开了个商场，可大了！]
english_text: [They opened a new mall, and it's huge!]

chinese_text: [吃吃吃，那我吃完吧。]
english_text: [Eat, eat, eat. Fine then, I'll finish eating.]

chinese_text: [那多没劲呢？往走走走远一点儿。]
english_text: [How boring is that? Let's go farther, farther, farther away.]

chinese_text: [呃，哪个区域？百货大楼？]
english_text: [Uh, which area? The department store?]

chinese_text: [不行，实在太困了，你爸是不是也在家睡觉呢？]
english_text: [No, I'm too sleepy. Is your dad also sleeping at home?]

chinese_text: [这，这桌子能多少钱？定制的，那就得两百？]
english_text: [This, how much could this table cost? If it's custom-made, then it must be two hundred?]

chinese_text: [啥都行，只要能干活就行，啊，不挑，挑啥啊挑。]
english_text: [Anything is fine, as long as it can get the job done. I'm not picky, what's there to be picky about?]

chinese_text: [这，这个桌子两万，你买它干嘛呀？]
english_text: [This, this table is twenty thousand, why would you buy it?]

chinese_text: [这咋不合适了？就老，嫂子从老家给你带的特产。]
english_text: [What's wrong with this? It's just some local specialties that your sister-in-law brought from her hometown.]

chinese_text: [这还行呢？]
english_text: [Is this considered good enough?]

chinese_text: [他就，往那一躺啊，你就把他带身边儿，然后你看，给他啥职位都行。]
english_text: [He just lies around there, you can keep him by your side, and then, you see, you can give him any position.]

chinese_text: [两，两万？]
english_text: [Two, twenty thousand?]

chinese_text: [还行，那个，挺累的吧？]
english_text: [It's alright, that, quite tiring, right?]

chinese_text: [你给他安排个活干，他啥都能干。]
english_text: [If you assign him a task, he can do anything.]

chinese_text: [这还不大呀？]
english_text: [Isn't this big enough?]

chinese_text: [哦，就买它一个贵呀？]
english_text: [Oh, is it just expensive to buy one?]

chinese_text: [再扩一扩？]
english_text: [Expand it a bit more?]

chinese_text: [这看着挺好的。]
english_text: [This looks pretty good.]

chinese_text: [哎，没事儿，你就把他放放你身边。那你就没事儿，带带他就行啊。]
english_text: [Hey, it's nothing, just keep him by your side. Then you'll be fine, just guide him a bit.]

chinese_text: [哎，没啥不好意思的，拿着拿着啊，听嫂子的。]
english_text: [Hey, there's nothing to be embarrassed about, take it, take it, listen to your sister-in-law.]

chinese_text: [这真大！嘿。]
english_text: [This is really big! Hey.]

chinese_text: [行，那两万先，嗯，你看啊，你现在是不是，这生意做的挺大的哈？]
english_text: [Alright, then the twenty thousand first, um, you see, are you, is your business doing quite well now?]

chinese_text: [行啊，那开车也行啊，什么都行，他现在主要在家吧，他不干事儿。]
english_text: [Sure, driving is fine too, anything is fine, he's mostly at home now, right? He doesn't do anything.]

chinese_text: [嗯，你不，干，办不办那事儿，咱们先不说。这特产得拿着，又不是什么贵重的礼物。]
english_text: [Um, whether you do that thing or not, let's not talk about it for now. You have to take these local specialties, it's not some expensive gift.]

chinese_text: [质量也不错嘛。]
english_text: [The quality is quite good too.]

chinese_text: [我怕，安排的职位太低，他心里头，埋怨我。]
english_text: [I'm afraid if the position I arrange is too low, he'll resent me in his heart.]

chinese_text: [那我哥来，能干点儿什么呢？]
english_text: [So if my brother comes, what can he do?]

chinese_text: [啥都行？]
english_text: [Anything is fine?]

chinese_text: [也还行[laughing]。]
english_text: [It's alright too [laughing].]

chinese_text: [你猜猜？]
english_text: [Guess what?]

chinese_text: [嫂子，听我说，拿回去，拿回去啊。你这，这我坚决不能收，你这这这这，你放心，我，我大哥那事儿，我肯定给办了。]
english_text: [Sister-in-law, listen to me, take it back, take it back. This, I absolutely cannot accept this, this, this, this, don't worry, I, I will definitely take care of that matter for my big brother.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，这这这，嫂子你看，这这。]
english_text: [Oh my, this, this, this, sister-in-law, look, this, this.]

chinese_text: [[laughing]还行吧。]
english_text: [[laughing] It's alright, I guess.]

chinese_text: [是有点儿，是有点儿。]
english_text: [It is a little, it is a little.]

chinese_text: [怎么样，觉着我这儿？]
english_text: [So, what do you think of my place?]

chinese_text: [定制的。]
english_text: [Custom-made.]

chinese_text: [嗯，你看我这桌子。]
english_text: [Yeah, look at this table I have.]

chinese_text: [这，我就是不好意思，我有点儿。]
english_text: [Well, I'm a bit embarrassed about this.]

chinese_text: [这不合适，哪有这这，长辈给晚辈送的，送送，送不不合适。]
english_text: [This isn't appropriate. Since when do elders give gifts to their juniors? It's just not right.]

chinese_text: [嫂子，我跟你说，什么叫定制，定制就定的一个贵！]
english_text: [Sister-in-law, let me tell you what 'custom-made' means—it means it's expensive!]

chinese_text: [那，先从开车开始，行吗？]
english_text: [So, should we start with driving first, is that okay?]

chinese_text: [[laughing]那改天去帮帮他去。]
english_text: [[laughing] Well, let's go help him some other time then.]

chinese_text: [第三家了？]
english_text: [The third one already?]

chinese_text: [哦，以后嘴可不能这么快。]
english_text: [Oh, you can't be so quick with your words next time.]

chinese_text: [行，我知道了。就这嘴巴，老不过脑子说话。]
english_text: [Alright, I get it. My mouth just runs ahead of my brain sometimes.]

chinese_text: [也是哈，那，多去他家买水果？]
english_text: [That's true. So, should we buy more fruit from his shop then?]

chinese_text: [我这嘴，刚才太快了，你下次可得提醒我点儿。]
english_text: [My mouth was too quick just now. You'll have to remind me to be careful next time.]

chinese_text: [后悔了。]
english_text: [I regret it now.]

chinese_text: [也是哈，他俩都挺好的，人也不错。要不怎，怎么能跟我处呢，是吧？]
english_text: [That's true. They're both really good people, nice too. Otherwise, how could they be friends with me, right?]

chinese_text: [哦，谁开的？不会他开的吧？]
english_text: [Oh, who was driving? It wasn't him, was it?]

chinese_text: [没这茬？]
english_text: [That didn't happen?]

chinese_text: [能忙过来吗？第三家了。]
english_text: [Can you manage with all this work? It's already the third place.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，刚才嘴太快了，当人面说，他之前被辞退了。你说，他不会那个，硌得慌吧？]
english_text: [Oh, I spoke too quickly earlier, saying right in front of everyone that he was fired before. Do you think he's not feeling awkward about it?]

chinese_text: [他俩开的？]
english_text: [Are they both driving?]

chinese_text: [嗯，下次注意点儿，嗯。]
english_text: [Yeah, I'll be more careful next time.]

chinese_text: [没事儿，反正这事儿呢，他们嗯，应该是不在意的哈？]
english_text: [It's fine. Anyway, about this, they probably don't mind, right?]

chinese_text: [嗯，也是哈，就他那。]
english_text: [Yeah, that's true too, especially with him.]

chinese_text: [行，绝，绝绝对没问题。大家都相处这么多年了，你是什么样儿人，大家都知道。]
english_text: [Alright, absolutely, absolutely no problem. We've all known each other for so many years, everyone knows what kind of person you are.]

chinese_text: [对呀，现在他们一门心思，全在做生意上呢。能因为你，你这这这这不算事儿。]
english_text: [Yeah, right now they're completely focused on their business. They wouldn't make a big deal out of something like this just because of you.]

chinese_text: [第三家儿了。]
english_text: [That's the third one.]

chinese_text: [这事儿，就没这事儿。]
english_text: [This matter? It's a non-issue.]

chinese_text: [我来不及提醒呀！我这收不住啊，拦都拦不住啊。]
english_text: [I didn't have time to warn you! I couldn't hold back, there was no stopping it.]

chinese_text: [那当然了，你人其实也不错，就是这个嘴吧，比脑子快。]
english_text: [Of course, you're actually a decent person, it's just that your mouth is faster than your brain.]

chinese_text: [对，他不会当回事儿了。你看人家现在，格局大嘛，做做的也都挺好的。]
english_text: [Right, he won't take it seriously anymore. Look at him now, he's got a bigger perspective, and everything he's doing is going quite well.]

chinese_text: [[laughing]哎呀，不能，他们不是那样人。他们，以他那脾气，他要是真的，心里头不高兴，当场就给你翻脸了。还能等到你现在出来，跟我这儿嘀咕这些？]
english_text: [[laughing] Oh, no, they're not like that. With his temper, if he were really unhappy, he would have turned on you right then and there. Would he have waited until now for you to come out and whisper these things to me?]

chinese_text: [稍微过一下脑子。]
english_text: [Think it through a little.]

chinese_text: [这会儿后悔了吧？]
english_text: [Regretting it now, are you?]

chinese_text: [西街又新开了个水果店，你不知道吧？]
english_text: [A new fruit shop opened on West Street, you didn't know that, did you?]

chinese_text: [心里犯嘀咕了吧？]
english_text: [Having second thoughts, are you?]

chinese_text: [我跟你说，这也就是他们俩，换个人你试试。]
english_text: [Let me tell you, this only works with those two. Try it with someone else.]

chinese_text: [[laughing]你这会儿害怕啦？]
english_text: [[laughing] Are you scared now?]

chinese_text: [行，哎姐那这次就别客气了，咖啡我们我们来安排好不好？]
english_text: [Alright, hey sis, don't be polite this time. We'll handle the coffee, okay?]

chinese_text: [可以，完全没问题。而且我们那个后天啊，我们会带来几个样样本，已经做出来了。]
english_text: [Sure, no problem at all. And the day after tomorrow, we'll bring several samples that are already ready.]

chinese_text: [好的好的好的。]
english_text: [Okay, okay, okay.]

chinese_text: [哎呀没事儿没事儿，反正我我这下午吧就约了您，我就没有其他的事儿。]
english_text: [Oh, it's nothing, really. Anyway, since I scheduled this meeting with you for this afternoon, I don't have any other appointments.]

chinese_text: [可以可以，没问题。]
english_text: [Sure, sure, no problem.]

chinese_text: [您放心！我们是肯定不会让贵公司吃亏的。]
english_text: [Rest assured! We will definitely not let your company suffer any losses.]

chinese_text: [哎呦，丁姐好久不见呀。]
english_text: [Oh, Sister Ding, long time no see.]

chinese_text: [呃，十二点可以的没问题。]
english_text: [Uh, twelve o'clock is fine, no problem.]

chinese_text: [哦，可以可以没有问题！您看呃那明天的下午怎么样？]
english_text: [Oh, sure, sure, no problem! How about tomorrow afternoon, what do you think?]

chinese_text: [行，一会儿的话，我跟我的秘书商量一下这个事儿啊。]
english_text: [Alright, in a little while, I'll discuss this matter with my secretary.]

chinese_text: [行，那我们再约一个时间吧，因为我一会儿还有个会要开。]
english_text: [Alright, let's schedule another time then, because I have a meeting to attend shortly.]

chinese_text: [嗯，可以！没问题没问题，好。]
english_text: [Yeah, sure! No problem, no problem, good.]

chinese_text: [嗯，那这个还是ok的，嗯。]
english_text: [Well, this is still okay, yeah.]

chinese_text: [可以，可以可以。]
english_text: [Okay, okay, okay.]

chinese_text: [有看有看，我觉得整体的那个价格写的还不错。然后对这个，呃咱们这个合作这块也是比较满意的。]
english_text: [I've seen it, I've seen it. I think the overall price is quite good. And regarding this, uh, our cooperation is quite satisfactory.]

chinese_text: [哎呀好什么，你快别这么说，你那样说，我该不高兴了。]
english_text: [Oh, what 'good'? Please don't say that. If you say that, I'll be unhappy.]

chinese_text: [哎，你别跟我说了。你说完之后，我都害怕了，我这次要发挥不好的话，我妈又该说我了。]
english_text: [Hey, don't tell me anymore. After you said that, I'm scared. If I don't perform well this time, my mom will lecture me again.]

chinese_text: [你晚上回家还看书了？]
english_text: [Did you still study when you went home at night?]

chinese_text: [哎呀，我现在自己还没搞清楚呢！]
english_text: [Oh my, I haven't figured it out myself yet!]

chinese_text: [我没看呐，天呐！]
english_text: [I didn't study, oh my god!]

chinese_text: [你怎么努力的？]
english_text: [How did you study hard?]

chinese_text: [哎呀，你都不知道，这回我听说那个大题特别特别难。]
english_text: [Oh, you don't even know, I heard that the major questions this time are extremely difficult.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，怎么办呢怎么办呢？我现在我也不知道该怎么办了？哎以后你别问我题了，我现在我也泥菩萨过河呢，我自己都不知道怎么做呢，你别问我了啊，我不教你了啊。]
english_text: [Oh, what should I do, what should I do? I don't even know what to do now. Hey, don't ask me questions anymore. I'm like a clay idol crossing a river now, I don't even know how to do it myself. Don't ask me, I'm not teaching you anymore.]

chinese_text: [哎，你别说了，我这次成绩肯定要倒退了。我晚上回家，我就玩儿了，天怎么办呢？]
english_text: [Hey, don't say it, my grades are definitely going to drop this time. When I went home at night, I just played. Oh, what should I do?]

chinese_text: [我就是每天晚上都看书啊，然后我上课也认真听讲，然后积极回答老师问题，可是一到考试我就不行。]
english_text: [I study every night, and I listen carefully in class and actively answer the teacher's questions, but when it comes to exams, I just can't do well.]

chinese_text: [你别说了，你哪次发挥的差呀你这？还我就这成绩吧，就。]
english_text: [Don't say that, when have you ever performed poorly? And then you say 'this is just my grade'.]

chinese_text: [啊，你肯定也看吧。]
english_text: [Ah, you must have studied too.]

chinese_text: [不教我啊，我这，你这不教我，我更不会了呀。我这，你教我，我都不会呢。]
english_text: [Not teaching me? If you don't teach me, I'll be even more clueless. I mean, even when you teach me, I still don't get it.]

chinese_text: [这玩儿还考那么好，那么。]
english_text: [You still scored so well on this, huh.]

chinese_text: [啊特别难啊。]
english_text: [Ah, it's so difficult.]

chinese_text: [那每回回那个三十多嘛，嗨，我都害我都害怕我妈再打我。但是我明明很努力学习，你说怎么回事啊？]
english_text: [I always get in the thirties, sigh, I'm even afraid my mom will hit me again. But I clearly study very hard, what do you think is wrong?]

chinese_text: [哎，我跟你说，我这最近吧，老担心这考试。你说我上次那么努力学习，才考三十五分，哎这次咋办呀你说？]
english_text: [Hey, let me tell you, I've been worrying about this exam recently. I studied so hard last time and only got 35 points. What should I do this time, what do you think?]

chinese_text: [你不看书，你考那么好。]
english_text: [You don't study, yet you score so well.]

chinese_text: [你别这么说了，是不是我天生笨啊，怎么回事？我怎么考这么点儿？主要是我平时吧，我那题都会做。]
english_text: [Don't say that, am I just naturally stupid or what? How did I score so low? The main thing is that I can usually do all the problems.]

chinese_text: [但是我一考试，就感觉那个字就，就是在这，你懂吗，就是感觉跟那个。]
english_text: [But when I take an exam, I feel like the words are just... right there, you know? It's like that feeling...]

chinese_text: [咱们家三个卧室里的衣柜，两个半卧室都是你的衣服，还不够？]
english_text: [In our house with three bedrooms, the closets in two and a half bedrooms are filled with your clothes, and it's still not enough?]

chinese_text: [我不是心疼你买这些东西，是因为现在家庭的情况不一样。]
english_text: [It's not that I mind you buying these things, it's because our family's situation is different now.]

chinese_text: [下个月要给孩子交学费，知道吗？]
english_text: [We need to pay the child's tuition fee next month, you know?]

chinese_text: [你知道这个月信用卡刷爆了吗？]
english_text: [Do you know that the credit card was maxed out this month?]

chinese_text: [你要不考虑一下去专柜卖包呢？]
english_text: [Why don't you consider selling bags at the counter?]

chinese_text: [你是没衣服穿了吗？]
english_text: [Don't you have any clothes to wear?]

chinese_text: [哎呀，我就喜欢那个，那我下次少买点。]
english_text: [Oh, I just really like that one. I'll buy less next time then.]

chinese_text: [嗯，确实是。主要我这花钱，确实有点大手大脚的对吧？嗯，那我就喜欢嘛，嗯。]
english_text: [Yeah, that's true. I do tend to spend money recklessly, right? Well, I just like it, though.]

chinese_text: [嗯，主要没去翻。而且我最近不胖了点儿，穿不上了，没办法嘛。]
english_text: [Well, I haven't gone through them. And I've gained some weight recently, so they don't fit anymore. What can I do?]

chinese_text: [啊，卖包不适合我，我还适合买包。]
english_text: [Oh, selling bags isn't for me. I'm more suited to buying bags.]

chinese_text: [当然不只一个。因为我还买了另外一套衣服，那个包搭那个衣服好看，买了两个。]
english_text: [Of course, not just one. Because I also bought another outfit, and the bag looks great with that outfit, so I bought two.]

chinese_text: [真的，嗯，那别生气了啊，行不行，开心点。哼[laughing]，好。]
english_text: [Really, well, don't be angry, okay? Cheer up. Hmph [laughing], fine.]

chinese_text: [我朋友说，那个包适合，所以我就诶又买了一个包。]
english_text: [My friend said that bag suits me, so I went and bought another bag.]

chinese_text: [然后这包真的很好看，你知道吗？就搭那衣服贼好看，我搁那一站，那柜姐都夸好看。啧，所以就买了。]
english_text: [And this bag is really beautiful, you know? It looks amazing with that outfit. When I stood there, even the sales associate praised how good it looked. Tsk, so I bought it.]

chinese_text: [行，那我就好好照顾爸，你好好照顾自己啊。]
english_text: [Alright, then I'll take good care of Dad, and you take good care of yourself.]

chinese_text: [嗯，那看，听着也不错。]
english_text: [Hmm, well, that sounds pretty good too.]

chinese_text: [嗯好，等着你，工作顺顺利利的。]
english_text: [Okay, I'll wait for you. Hope everything goes smoothly with your work.]

chinese_text: [好好好，你这，工作可得好好注意，身体也得注意啊。]
english_text: [Okay, okay, okay. You need to be careful with your work and take care of your health too.]

chinese_text: [啊，就三万啊？]
english_text: [What, only thirty thousand?]

chinese_text: [行，当时也确实，也借了亲戚不少钱。那你那场，真的，最近挺好的是吧？]
english_text: [Alright, you did borrow a lot of money from relatives back then. So your business, it's been doing well recently, right?]

chinese_text: [也行也行。]
english_text: [That's fine, that's fine.]

chinese_text: [好好好。]
english_text: [Okay, okay, okay.]

chinese_text: [嗯，主要，咱爸最近生病了，就，我怕有点不够。]
english_text: [Well, mainly because Dad has been sick recently, and I'm worried it might not be enough.]

chinese_text: [我倒没什么，就怕爸那个。]
english_text: [I'm fine, I'm just worried about Dad.]

chinese_text: [至少就是能，能缓解很多问题嘛。现在我这边儿，一切都在往好的发展呢。]
english_text: [At least it can alleviate many problems. Now on my end, everything is developing for the better.]

chinese_text: [然后这边儿呢，你让他放宽心，就好好该治病治病，该干嘛干嘛。我这边儿都挺好的，我这么大人了，还照顾不好自己？对吧？]
english_text: [And over here, tell him not to worry. He should focus on getting treatment and doing what he needs to do. Everything is fine on my end. I'm a grown adult, can't I take care of myself? Right?]

chinese_text: [啊，就，我知道这可能，还不太够，但是。]
english_text: [Well, I know this might not be enough, but...]

chinese_text: [哎呀，没关系。你就跟他说，现在一切，都在往好的方向发展。]
english_text: [Oh, it's okay. Just tell him that everything is moving in a positive direction now.]

chinese_text: [回头再有多的，我就陆陆续续转给你。]
english_text: [When I have more later, I'll transfer it to you gradually.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，放心吧，放心吧。]
english_text: [Oh, don't worry, don't worry.]

chinese_text: [没事儿，都好着呢。]
english_text: [It's nothing, everything's fine.]

chinese_text: [没问题，放心吧。]
english_text: [No problem, don't worry.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，反正你放心吧。就，还有两个月差不多。]
english_text: [Oh, anyway, don't worry. There are still about two months left.]

chinese_text: [这不还有两个月呢吗？嗯，这，你先把之前的这个，拿这三万先给它堵上。后面儿的那个，我再想办法。]
english_text: [Aren't there still two months left? Well, you can use this thirty thousand to cover the previous expenses first. I'll figure out a way for the rest.]

chinese_text: [现在还行，我觉得挺，好着呢。而且，我最近认识一大姐，她带着我玩儿，带着我一块儿挣钱呢。]
english_text: [It's going pretty well now, I think it's quite good. Besides, I recently met an older woman who's been showing me the ropes and helping me make money.]

chinese_text: [我们现在，不光搞那个电缆，然后还有一些，就往小的说吧，就是那些什么呃，废铁啊，什么的，我，我们都要。]
english_text: [Right now, we're not just dealing with cables, but also other things, to put it simply, things like scrap iron and so on, we take all of that.]

chinese_text: [对吧？就现在，你也给他们那些，呃，亲戚说。我，我们这边儿，反正今年年底之前，就都能给他，给给，给他还上。]
english_text: [Right? So now, you can tell those relatives of ours. On our end, we'll be able to pay them all back by the end of this year.]

chinese_text: [你看就是我现在，就这，这边儿这个场子，然后还有那边儿那公司，做，我觉得做得都还行。就是再有个半年吧，我觉得就都能好起来。]
english_text: [Look, this business I have here now, and that company over there, I think they're both doing quite well. In another six months or so, I think everything will be much better.]

chinese_text: [我跟你说哈，啧，就我昨天过生日，我有好姐们儿。]
english_text: [Let me tell you, well, it was my birthday yesterday, and I have this good female friend.]

chinese_text: [就送我一支口红，平价。]
english_text: [She just gave me a lipstick, a cheap one.]

chinese_text: [你说她主要是她生日在前我先送的，她这往后往后她还给我送个几十块钱，我不求是大几千她好歹也得几百啊，上千吧至少得。]
english_text: [I mean, her birthday was before mine, and I gave her a gift first. Then she gives me something that's only worth a few dozen yuan. I'm not asking for thousands, but at least a few hundred, or even a thousand, right?]

chinese_text: [可真烦人。以后绝对不是朋友，你说我那好几千香水白送啊这是？]
english_text: [So annoying. We're definitely not friends anymore. Can you believe I just gave away that perfume worth thousands for nothing?]

chinese_text: [你知道她送我一什么吗？]
english_text: [Do you know what she gave me?]

chinese_text: [对啊！]
english_text: [Exactly!]

chinese_text: [平价啊很便宜几十块钱一只的，你知道我送她一什么吗？]
english_text: [It was cheap, just tens of yuan for one. Do you know what I gave her?]

chinese_text: [当时想着就是朋友嘛，当时我也看她挺喜欢的。嗯当时逛商场她挺喜欢的，我说她生日也快到了，问一下她说挺喜欢的买了。]
english_text: [I thought we were friends, and I saw she really liked it. When we were shopping at the mall, she seemed to really like it. Her birthday was coming up, so I asked her and she said she liked it, so I bought it.]

chinese_text: [不是了，我跟你说平日啊跟我姐妹相称，有什么事儿哎就找我，哎我平时给她发个消息什么的她就当没看见！]
english_text: [No, let me tell you, she usually calls me her 'sister', but whenever she needs something, she comes to me. But when I send her messages, she just ignores them!]

chinese_text: [我送她欸好几千的香水，她送一只口红还是几十块钱的啊，哼什么人啊这是！]
english_text: [I gave her perfume worth thousands, and she gave me a lipstick that only costs tens of yuan! What kind of person is that!]

chinese_text: [处不了，处不了处不了。]
english_text: [I can't deal with this, I just can't.]

chinese_text: [过生日送我几十块钱一只口红啊，谁要啊这是！]
english_text: [For my birthday, she gave me a lipstick that costs just tens of yuan! Who would want that!]

chinese_text: [哎认识也就三年吧。]
english_text: [Well, we've known each other for about three years.]

chinese_text: [我看她绝对没有把我当朋友。]
english_text: [I don't think she ever considered me a friend.]

chinese_text: [你们这以后估计也没有什么好了。]
english_text: [I guess there's no fixing your relationship now.]
[What?]

chinese_text: [那你们现在还是好朋友吗？]
english_text: [So are you still good friends now?]

chinese_text: [对啊不不然的话怎么会这样呢，就是关系已经失衡了。]
english_text: [Exactly, otherwise why would it be like this? The relationship is already unbalanced.]

chinese_text: [那你为什么要送她那么贵的？]
english_text: [Then why did you give her something so expensive?]

chinese_text: [她这也没把你当朋友吧。]
english_text: [She doesn't see you as a friend either, does she?]

chinese_text: [认认识多长时间啊？]
english_text: [How long have you known each other?]

chinese_text: [三年了！]
english_text: [Three years!]

chinese_text: [送个几十块钱的口红。]
english_text: [Gave a lipstick that costs just tens of yuan.]

chinese_text: [嗯，能像你这样，有这样就是想法乐于学习的啊，真的很少了。]
english_text: [Well, people like you who are eager to learn are really rare.]

chinese_text: [啊，这个总图纸呢那边还在研究，你是有什么呀？嗯？]
english_text: [Oh, the master plan is still being studied over there. Did you need something? Hmm?]

chinese_text: [哎，小张，怎么了？]
english_text: [Hey, Xiao Zhang, what's wrong?]

chinese_text: [嗯，这，这图纸画的还不错呀。]
english_text: [Hmm, this, this drawing is actually pretty good.]

chinese_text: [哎，我还是第一次看到啊。两个月，才两个月就能进步如此之快，还能画出这么专业的图纸。]
english_text: [Wow, I've never seen anything like this before. Just two months, only two months to improve so quickly and draw such professional diagrams.]

chinese_text: [不是工科出身怎么了？能画出这样的图纸是我，这么快能两个月能画出来，这很不错的啊。]
english_text: [So what if I'm not from an engineering background? I'm the one who drew these blueprints, and to complete them in just two months is quite impressive.]

chinese_text: [老化的问题啊？]
english_text: [Is it an aging issue?]

chinese_text: [这个问题还挺严重的，我这个一会儿找那个维修师傅，赶紧联系他们，让他们明天就过来修一下。]
english_text: [This problem is quite serious. I'll find the maintenance technician right away, contact them urgently, and have them come over tomorrow to fix it.]

chinese_text: [这个我画了一个图纸，您看看。]
english_text: [I've drawn a blueprint for this, please take a look.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，谢谢师父。]
english_text: [Oh, thank you, master.]

chinese_text: [谢谢师父。哎师父，咱们这个这么大个厂，为什么没有总图纸啊？]
english_text: [Thank you, master. Hey master, for such a large factory like ours, why don't we have a master blueprint?]

chinese_text: [嗯，那那倒也没有，我毕竟不像他们是工科出身，就进步空间还是挺大的。]
english_text: [Well, that's not entirely true. After all, unlike them, I don't have an engineering background, so there's still plenty of room for improvement.]

chinese_text: [咋了这么慌？]
english_text: [Why are you so panicked?]

chinese_text: [货没了，那，那货款能要回来吗？]
english_text: [The goods are gone, so, so can we get the payment back?]

chinese_text: [这，这，这等我，我这也我我现在也不知道怎么办呀这这这这？]
english_text: [This, this, this, wait, I, I right now I don't know what to do either, this, this, this, this?]

chinese_text: [跑了，跑了，跑了？]
english_text: [He ran away, ran away, ran away?]

chinese_text: [咱先找李大哥去，一会员工的事，一会再说行吗？啊咱找李大哥了解情况，好吧，啊？]
english_text: [Let's find Brother Li first. We can talk about the employee matter later, okay? Let's find Brother Li to understand the situation, alright?]

chinese_text: [我知道他跑了，但是我现在我不知道怎么办？这钱也没了，我我现在怎么办？我也不知道呀。]
english_text: [I know he ran away, but I don't know what to do now? The money is gone too, what should I do now? I really don't know.]

chinese_text: [王科呢，啊，找王科去啊啊。]
english_text: [What about Wang Ke? Ah, let's go find Wang Ke.]

chinese_text: [这这这这以前都是王科，王科弄这茬呀，找找。]
english_text: [This, this, this, this was always handled by Wang Ke, Wang Ke took care of these matters, let's look for him.]

chinese_text: [中间人，找找找找那个，李李李李大哥。他介绍的王哥，去找他去，走，找他去找他去。]
english_text: [The intermediary, look for, look for, look for, that, Li, Li, Li, Li Brother. He's the one who introduced Brother Wang, let's go find him, come on, let's go find him.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，那怎么办呀？有有有有没有有没有什么办法，啊？]
english_text: [Oh dear, what should we do? Is there, is there, is there any solution, ah?]

chinese_text: [仓库着火，货全没了。]
english_text: [The warehouse caught fire, all the goods are gone.]

chinese_text: [丁姐，怎么办呢？]
english_text: [Sister Ding, what should we do?]

chinese_text: [大家现在都很着急，没个主心骨，全都等你呢。]
english_text: [Everyone is very anxious now, without a leader, they're all waiting for you.]

chinese_text: [我实话告诉你，现在外头两千个员工，等着你呢。]
english_text: [To be honest with you, there are two thousand employees outside waiting for you now.]

chinese_text: [你没听明白吗，丁姐王科跑了，找不着人联系不上了。]
english_text: [Didn't you understand? Sister Ding, Wang Ke has run away, we can't find him or reach him.]

chinese_text: [现在我们能找的人只有你了。]
english_text: [Right now, you're the only person we can turn to.]

chinese_text: [你问我？]
english_text: [You're asking me?]

chinese_text: [你之前找到王儿这个叫越级。]
english_text: [Going directly to Wang-er before was considered bypassing the proper channels.]

chinese_text: [脑子笨都是借口，办法都是人想的好吧？咱们这儿有咱们这儿的规定。]
english_text: [Being slow-witted is just an excuse. Solutions are thought up by people, right? We have our own rules here.]

chinese_text: [你进单位不是一天两天了，你也不是刚毕业的实习生。这点儿人情世故你不懂吗？]
english_text: [You haven't been in this company for just a day or two, and you're not a fresh graduate intern. Don't you understand these basic social etiquette and workplace dynamics?]

chinese_text: [一个萝卜一个坑，专人专岗你不知道？你这边走了那好了，那我接下来我这边工作怎么进展呢？你告诉告诉我怎么进展呢？]
english_text: [Don't you know the principle of 'one person per position'? If you leave, then what about my work progress? Tell me, how am I supposed to proceed?]

chinese_text: [这个工作这个岗位招就是招你来做的，你现在给我顶替别人，那你是要做什么做人事的岗位？]
english_text: [You were hired for this specific job and position. Now you're asking to replace someone else? Are you trying to work in HR instead?]

chinese_text: [王儿跟我说了。]
english_text: [Wang told me.]

chinese_text: [该干什么干什么去吧。]
english_text: [Go do what you're supposed to do.]

chinese_text: [其实这个事儿啊，还是那句话可大可小。但是你这个操作下来，你现在让我也比较难办。]
english_text: [Actually, this matter could be big or small, as the saying goes. But with your actions, you've made it difficult for me.]

chinese_text: [你看明明是可以不调的嘛？]
english_text: [You see, it was clearly possible not to make this transfer, right?]

chinese_text: [丁儿不是我说你啊。]
english_text: [Ding, not to criticize you, but...]

chinese_text: [你现在管到我的头上来了？怎么安排人员？]
english_text: [Are you trying to tell me what to do now? About how to arrange personnel?]

chinese_text: [我只能说，什么规定你不知道？]
english_text: [All I can say is, what rules don't you know?]

chinese_text: [那主任往小了怎么办？]
english_text: [So what should the director do in a minor case?]

chinese_text: [嗯，主任我知道了。]
english_text: [Yes, Director, I understand.]

chinese_text: [嗯，主任，我有个事儿想求您一下。]
english_text: [Um, Director, there's something I'd like to ask you for.]

chinese_text: [嗯，我现在知道了，主任。]
english_text: [Yes, I know now, Director.]

chinese_text: [啊，你怎么知道主任？]
english_text: [Ah, how do you know the director?]

chinese_text: [没人告诉我呀。]
english_text: [No one told me.]

chinese_text: [嗯，主要我这人脑子笨，我也不知道怎。]
english_text: [Well, mainly I'm not very smart, so I don't know how...]

chinese_text: [[laughing]是，主任说的对。]
english_text: [[laughing] Yes, the director is right.]

chinese_text: [没有没，没有没有没有没有主任，我不调了行吧？]
english_text: [No, no, no, no, Director, I won't request the transfer, okay?]

chinese_text: [我是人事部经理，你不跟我说，随便开除人，算怎么回事儿？]
english_text: [I'm the HR manager. You fire people without consulting me, what's that all about?]

chinese_text: [那您为什么要开除她。]
english_text: [Then why did you fire her?]

chinese_text: [但是你开除人，必须经过我的同意。你在我不在的时候开除人，算怎么回事啊？]
english_text: [But you must get my approval before firing someone. What do you mean by firing people while I'm away?]

chinese_text: [我对你有什么意见啊？]
english_text: [What issue do I have with you?]

chinese_text: [我听说，你把我大表姐开除了。我不在的时候，你瞎开除人啊。]
english_text: [I heard you fired my older cousin. You're firing people indiscriminately while I'm away.]

chinese_text: [这事儿我不知道，没听说过。]
english_text: [I don't know about this matter, I've never heard of it.]

chinese_text: [职员去留的问题，还是归我管的。]
english_text: [The matter of staff retention and dismissal is still under my management.]

chinese_text: [你是不是因为觉得我大表姐文化水平低，所以才开除她呀。那我听说您这文化水平也不怎么高呀。]
english_text: [Did you fire her because you think my older cousin has a low education level? Well, I've heard that your education level isn't very high either.]

chinese_text: [你是不是瞧不起她，瞧不起她的文化水平。]
english_text: [Do you look down on her, look down on her education level?]

chinese_text: [您说也可能是瞎说。总之我不在的时候，不要随便开除人，这事儿必须得经过我的同意。]
english_text: [What you say might just be nonsense. In any case, don't fire people casually when I'm not here. This matter must have my approval.]

chinese_text: [我不是因为她是我大表姐，我只是觉得您对她有点意见。]
english_text: [It's not because she's my older cousin, I just feel that you have some issues with her.]

chinese_text: [怎么是因为亲戚才容忍呢？]
english_text: [How can it be that you tolerate her just because she's a relative?]

chinese_text: [我说过了，给公司造成了不小的损失，我开除她是有理有据的。]
english_text: [I've said it before, she caused significant losses to the company, and I have valid reasons for firing her.]

chinese_text: [我可以，他直接来找我对峙。]
english_text: [I can handle it, let him come directly to confront me.]

chinese_text: [对不起，整个销售部是归我管的。]
english_text: [I'm sorry, but the entire sales department is under my management.]

chinese_text: [您大表姐，三批货，三个厂家。她三批给我给我发了同一个厂家。公司损失很多。]
english_text: [Your older cousin, three batches of goods, three manufacturers. She sent me goods from the same manufacturer for all three batches. The company lost a lot.]

chinese_text: [如果她不是你大表姐的话，你还会这么生气吗？]
english_text: [If she weren't your older cousin, would you still be this angry?]

chinese_text: [不然呢，每次都是这样来干涉我的工作。]
english_text: [What else? Every time you interfere with my work like this.]

chinese_text: [您这儿有点强人所难了。]
english_text: [You're being a bit unreasonable here.]

chinese_text: [就像您对我有意见一样，对吧。]
english_text: [Just like you have issues with me, right?]

chinese_text: [那现在我说了，您总知道了吧。]
english_text: [Well, now that I've said it, you should know, right?]

chinese_text: [我们公司可以允许学历低，但是不能允许能力低。]
english_text: [Our company can tolerate low educational qualifications, but we cannot tolerate low abilities.]

chinese_text: [不能是因为亲戚，就一再的容忍吧。]
english_text: [You can't keep tolerating someone just because they're a relative, right?]

chinese_text: [好，你有什么需要？真的没事吗先生？]
english_text: [Okay, do you need anything? Are you really alright, sir?]

chinese_text: [您需要一杯水吗？]
english_text: [Do you need a glass of water?]

chinese_text: [马上了马上了。您是有什么不舒服的，有什么可以帮您的，需要一杯水吗？]
english_text: [Right away, right away. Are you feeling unwell? Is there anything I can help you with? Do you need a glass of water?]

chinese_text: [您调整呼吸，深呼吸，深吸一口气，对深吸一口气，好深吸一口气。没事啊，我们飞机非常安全非常安全，OK。]
english_text: [Please adjust your breathing, take deep breaths, take a deep breath, yes, take a deep breath, good, take a deep breath. It's okay, our aircraft is very, very safe, OK.]

chinese_text: [您不用紧张，我们飞机都是非常安全的。]
english_text: [You don't need to be nervous, our aircraft are all very safe.]

chinese_text: [没事儿，你深呼吸，缓缓，嗯好，好好好。]
english_text: [It's okay, take deep breaths, slowly, um, good, good, good.]

chinese_text: [飞机现在正在滑行，那个您的座椅前方有那个呕吐袋，您可以使用。]

english_text: [Sincere enough, right?]

chinese_text: [这杯就干了。]
english_text: [Let's finish this cup.]

chinese_text: [来，满上满上，这还不满上？]
english_text: [Come on, fill it up, fill it up. Why aren't you filling it up?]

chinese_text: [[laughing]什么王族啊，一边去，一边去。]
english_text: [What royalty? Get away, get away.]

english_text: [The split stays the same?]

chinese_text: [绝对翻篇啊！]
english_text: [We're definitely turning a new page!]

chinese_text: [那太有诚意了，哥！]
english_text: [That's so sincere, bro!]

english_text: [So interesting, so very.]

english_text: [You're a good guy, bro.]

chinese_text: [走一个，嗯。]
english_text: [Let's have a drink, yeah.]

chinese_text: [行啊，哥！]
english_text: [Alright, bro!]

chinese_text: [吃好喝好。]
english_text: [Eat well and drink well.]

chinese_text: [没问题啊，可没问题啊！]
english_text: [No problem, absolutely no problem!]

english_text: [Bottoms up, and let's wipe the slate clean.]

chinese_text: [翻篇，诶。]
english_text: [Let's move on, yeah.]

english_text: [Fill it up, fill it up.]

english_text: [Sounds good, bro.]

chinese_text: [哥，咱今天喝完这杯，就世纪大合解，以前的恩怨，诶，全全部一笔勾销。]
english_text: [Bro, after we finish this cup today, we'll have a grand reconciliation, all the past grievances will be completely wiped clean.]

chinese_text: [我刚不是，你知道你知道你知道是为什么？我刚才我一个人从那边我走过来，还没有看到你的时候。]
english_text: [No, I wasn't. Do you know, do you know, do you know why? Just now, when I was walking over here by myself, before I even saw you.]

chinese_text: [镜子里反光有一个人。]
english_text: [There's a person reflected in the mirror.]

chinese_text: [你你帮我去一下，咱们俩他们不知道，咱们小声说话，他们听不到。我害怕，就是。]
english_text: [Could you go for me? The two of us, they don't know, if we speak quietly, they can't hear us. I'm scared, that's why.]

chinese_text: [不是，我刚刚我。]
english_text: [No, I just... I...]

english_text: [He wants us to find the victim's severed finger. Where are we supposed to find it?]

chinese_text: [我也有点害怕。]
english_text: [I'm a little scared too.]

chinese_text: [就而且，不是，就而且你知道吗？我看到了什么？一排化妆间的镜子，就这个梳妆台。]
english_text: [And besides, no, and besides, do you know what I saw? A row of dressing room mirrors, just like this vanity.]

chinese_text: [不是不是，我我不知道，咱们现在在哪儿？不是。]
english_text: [No, no, I don't know. Where are we right now? No.]

chinese_text: [你要你要不然，你替我去行不行？我然后你不是你不是想买个包吗？我到时候我我我送你行不行？你帮我去做吧，我真的我，真的我。]
english_text: [How about, how about you go for me instead? And then, don't you want to buy a bag? I'll, I'll, I'll buy it for you later, okay? Please help me with this, I really, really mean it.]

chinese_text: [你别说了。]
english_text: [Don't say any more.]

chinese_text: [哎呀行了，够了，够吓人了，你。]
english_text: [Alright, that's enough. That's scary enough, you.]

chinese_text: [你你真的是有点大病你，赶紧找线索赶紧出去。我说我不玩儿不玩儿，你非得带我进来。]
english_text: [You really have some issues. Hurry up and find the clues so we can get out of here. I told you I didn't want to play, but you insisted on bringing me in.]

chinese_text: [不行不行不行不行不行，包包没这个重要。我跟你讲，你赶紧去，要不然，不是，哎咱不是还咱不是还有对讲机吗？要不然的话，咱那个，咱出去得。]

chinese_text: [我不，不可能。]
english_text: [No, impossible.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，你行了行了行了，不不不不想听不想听不想。你现在去找断指，然后我我我我我我我跟你后头，行吧你？]

chinese_text: [别别别别别，不行。不是。]
english_text: [No, no, no, no, no. That won't work. No.]

english_text: [You're scared, so why did you bring me here?]

chinese_text: [我怎么知道啊？你这不是，那。]
english_text: [How would I know? You're not... well...]

english_text: [What do you mean they can't hear? Are you going or not? If you're not going, I'm pressing the walkie-talkie.]

chinese_text: [怎么回事啊？怎么啦？]
english_text: [What happened? What's wrong?]

chinese_text: [摔了一跤，怎么摔的啊？人没事儿吧？医生怎么说？]
english_text: [You had a fall? How did it happen? Are you okay? What did the doctor say?]

chinese_text: [你别想那么多了，我先去医生那边儿问问什么情况，你好好休息。]
english_text: [Don't overthink it. I'll go ask the doctor what's happening, you just get some rest.]

chinese_text: [好好好，咱先不管孩子，你没事儿吧？人没事儿吧？]
english_text: [Okay, okay, let's not worry about the child right now. Are you okay? Are you really okay?]

chinese_text: [行，你别难受了。咱先不管孩子，你没事就好，行吗？]
english_text: [Alright, don't be upset. Let's not worry about the child for now. As long as you're okay, that's what matters, okay?]

chinese_text: [孩子没了？]
english_text: [The child is gone?]

chinese_text: [别难受了别难受了，孩子以后我们还会有的，好吗？好吗？]
english_text: [Don't be upset, don't be upset. We can have another child in the future, okay? Okay?]

chinese_text: [只要人没事儿就行，孩子我们以后还会有嘛。]
english_text: [As long as you're okay, that's all that matters. We can have another child in the future.]

chinese_text: [我，我下午上厕所的时候，摔了一跤。]
english_text: [I, I fell this afternoon when I went to the bathroom.]

chinese_text: [我有事儿。孩子没了，我能没事儿吗？]
english_text: [I'm not okay. The child is gone, how could I be fine?]

chinese_text: [等我醒过来的时候，大夫就跟我说，孩子没了。]
english_text: [When I woke up, the doctor told me the child was gone.]

chinese_text: [孩子没了。]
english_text: [The child is gone.]

chinese_text: [买啥呀？你瞅这排队。]
english_text: [Buy what? Look at this line.]

english_text: [Didn't you know the Summer Palace requires a reservation? Didn't you read the guide? How are you planning to get in today?]

english_text: [If we don't have tickets, are you going to take responsibility?]

chinese_text: [哎，等会儿，等会儿，你等会儿。]
english_text: [Hey, wait a minute, wait, just wait.]

english_text: [Are you crazy? You made plans with me but didn't buy tickets. Just look at the entrance, see how long the line is for people buying tickets.]

chinese_text: [我问你呢，你是不没买票？]
english_text: [I'm asking you, did you not buy tickets?]

chinese_text: [你现在怎么着什么意思？]
english_text: [What do you mean by that? What are you going to do now?]

chinese_text: [不是你是不没买票？]
english_text: [So you didn't buy tickets, right?]

english_text: [Reservations, reservations! Can't you understand? Forget about going out today. Just go home. I'm really angry.]

chinese_text: [那别逛了逛啥呀？]

chinese_text: [我等什么等啊？]
english_text: [What am I waiting for?]

chinese_text: [你先给我等一下，我捋一捋啊。]
english_text: [Wait a moment, let me sort things out.]

chinese_text: [你说什么？]
english_text: [What did you say?]

chinese_text: [你没买票是吧？]
english_text: [You didn't buy the tickets, right?]

chinese_text: [你先把票给我。]
english_text: [Give me the tickets first.]

chinese_text: [我去排队，哎呀。]
english_text: [I'll go queue up, ugh.]

chinese_text: [那那咱就现现在去买不一样啊。]
english_text: [Then, then we can just buy them now, it's not the same.]

chinese_text: [你跟我说了吗？]
english_text: [Did you tell me?]

chinese_text: [那是没买。]
english_text: [So you didn't buy them.]

chinese_text: [我记着呢，我就想着是是咱。]
english_text: [I remembered, I was thinking that we, we...]

chinese_text: [你在这等等我，我我去买行吗？]
english_text: [You wait here for me, I'll go buy them, okay?]

chinese_text: [嗯，是我负责我我的意思是咱们现在去买。]
english_text: [Yeah, it's my responsibility. I mean, let's go buy them now.]

chinese_text: [哦哦，我想我想起来了，你昨天晚上就是我打游戏的时候，你跟我说的是吧？噢。]

chinese_text: [我是怕咱们有变化。]

chinese_text: [不是，那。]
english_text: [No, but...]

english_text: [My bag is expensive! It's Dior. You don't recognize the brand, do you know how much this bag costs? What if it gets dirty if I put it on the ground? And besides, hey, there's a seat over there, right? Why don't you sit over there?]

chinese_text: [这再找一个呗，我告你在这儿不行这不行。]
english_text: [Just find another spot. I'm telling you, you can't sit here, this won't work.]

chinese_text: [哎后后边儿就有空座位，你坐那儿行不？还不包还不打扰你在这儿看信息好不好啊？]

chinese_text: [你没看到我放包了，告你坐不了。]
english_text: [Didn't you see I placed my bag here? I'm telling you, you can't sit here.]

chinese_text: [呃不好意思啊，我这个得放包儿，要不然你看看那边儿还有地儿，你去那边儿呗。]
english_text: [Uh, sorry, but I need to place my bag here. Otherwise, you can see if there's space over there, why don't you go over there?]

chinese_text: [不你找我事儿是不是？哎，那么多人呢，把包儿都放座上了，怎么的非得看上我这儿了？看我姑娘好欺负是不是啊？]

chinese_text: [不是，你放腿。]

english_text: [No, what's wrong with you?]

english_text: [There's no one here, so why don't you just put your bag on your lap?]

english_text: [I want to eat too.]

english_text: [I just don't know why he did it yesterday.]

chinese_text: [他就非得要就是刚上火。]
english_text: [He just had to get angry all of a sudden.]

chinese_text: [你还想吃烤肉吗？要不我把那哥们叫上？]

chinese_text: [我我我我没有办法理解，我不知道为什么。]

chinese_text: [然后我那会儿没看住，就从桌子上掉下来了。]
english_text: [Then I wasn't watching, and it fell off the table.]

chinese_text: [孩子自己在桌子上玩儿。然后我那会儿炒菜呢嘛，你不是给我就打电话说，你快到家了，我就想赶紧给你做饭。]
english_text: [The child was playing on the table by itself. Then I was cooking at that time, and you called me saying you were almost home, so I wanted to hurry up and make you food.]

chinese_text: [我想让他掉下来吗？我也不想让他掉下来嘛。]
english_text: [Did I want him to fall? I didn't want him to fall either.]

chinese_text: [非要在桌子上玩儿，我也不想啊他，我真的我。]
english_text: [He insisted on playing on the table, I didn't want him to either, I really, I...]

chinese_text: [你怎么看的孩子啊？]
english_text: [How were you watching the child?]

chinese_text: [现在就等孩子出来呗。是拉了个多大的口子啊？]
english_text: [Now we just wait for the child to come out. How big of a cut was it?]

chinese_text: [你怎么能把孩子放桌上呢？这是常识啊，你不能让他下面悬空啊，他怎么知道高低啊？]
english_text: [How could you put the child on the table? That's common sense. You can't let him have nothing underneath, how would he know about heights?]

chinese_text: [不是，你们在家到底发生了什么呀？怎么把孩子都送医院来了呀？]
english_text: [No, what actually happened at home? Why did you have to send the child to the hospital?]

chinese_text: [家里不是有围栏吗？那玩具区，你给它放在里面，你为什么给它放桌子上啊？]
english_text: [Isn't there a playpen at home? The play area, you could have put him in there, why did you put him on the table?]

chinese_text: [别提了，我本来找到一个，然后干了一个星期吧，辞职了。就跟。]
english_text: [Don't mention it, I found one, worked for about a week, then quit. Just like that.]

chinese_text: [就是我就，我一想想想，哎呀，我现在就，哎。]
english_text: [It's just that I, when I think about it, ugh, right now I just, sigh.]

chinese_text: [结果现在后来第二天又跟我说，说咱们可能现在需要赶赶进度，可能前半年就休不了了。]
english_text: [Then the next day, they told me that we might need to speed up the progress now, and probably won't be able to take time off in the first half of the year.]

chinese_text: [然后还有房贷，我现在又刚买了房。而且你说吧，这如果说碰到就合适的人一结婚，又是一笔开销。]
english_text: [And then there's the mortgage, I just bought a house recently. And you know, if I happen to meet the right person and get married, that's another expense.]

chinese_text: [说这个，你看就能不能周中咱们就休一天就得了。双休本来是周末双休，我现在变成了周中单休。]
english_text: [Speaking of this, do you think we could just take one day off during the week instead? The original two-day weekend has now become a single day off during the week for me.]

chinese_text: [没办法呀，现在工作多难找啊，大环境也不好。没办法，有个班儿上就不错了。哎，我现在我愁死我了。]
english_text: [There's nothing I can do, it's so hard to find a job these days, and the overall environment isn't good either. I have no choice, having any job is considered good. Ugh, I'm so worried now.]

chinese_text: [但是我就后来说，咱们这儿工作忙，说是看看就能不能把咱们周末双休就挪到周中。我一想那也行，反正是双休嘛，我也不在乎非要去周末休。]
english_text: [But later I said, since our work here is busy, I asked if we could move our weekend two-day off to the middle of the week. I thought that would be fine, since it's still two days off, and I don't mind not taking them on the weekend.]

chinese_text: [话是这么说。但是，你现在就是手头的一些事儿都解决不了。]
english_text: [That's true in theory. But right now, you can't even solve some of your immediate problems.]

chinese_text: [但是我又没办法。我一想吧，就以后你看看，我现在我这个车贷还没还清，一个月还有三千多的车贷。]
english_text: [But I have no other choice. When I think about it, looking ahead, I still have my car loan to pay off, which is over three thousand a month.]

chinese_text: [等于说我前半年六个月，我要连上六年六个月的班儿。然后我再一往墙上看，你猜怎么着？]
english_text: [That means for the first six months, I have to work continuously for six years and six months. And then when I looked at the wall, guess what?]

chinese_text: [算加班儿，但是不算加班儿费。说了只调休，没钱，想都别想。]
english_text: [It counts as overtime, but not paid overtime. They said we only get compensatory time off, no money, don't even think about it.]

chinese_text: [但是吧，刚上了几天班，他又跟我说。哎这个，那个小王啊，说咱们这个又工作可能前期比较艰苦一点儿。]
english_text: [But after just a few days of work, he told me again. 'Hey, Xiao Wang,' he said, 'this job might be a bit tough in the early stage.']

chinese_text: [因为给我的那工资跟我做的那些事儿，根本就不匹配，说是周末双休吧。]
english_text: [Because the salary they give me doesn't match at all with the work I do, and they said it would be a two-day weekend.]

chinese_text: [半年没有休过。]
english_text: [I haven't had a day off in six months.]

chinese_text: [我墙上看到店长，还有其他员工，都欠他们基本上最少的欠了三十五天假。]
english_text: [I saw on the wall that the store manager and other employees were all owed vacation days, with the minimum being thirty-five days owed.]

chinese_text: [那不对啊，那你们这，得给你们算加班啊，有加班费的。]
english_text: [That's not right, they should be calculating your overtime pay, you should get overtime compensation.]

chinese_text: [根本不合理？]
english_text: [Completely unreasonable?]

chinese_text: [为啥呀？]
english_text: [Why?]

chinese_text: [哎呦我的天。]
english_text: [Oh my goodness.]

chinese_text: [那你这也不应该那么辞职啊，你也知道现在工作不好找。]
english_text: [You shouldn't have resigned like that, you know how hard it is to find a job these days.]

chinese_text: [不应该呀！那一个礼拜前还我打视频的人，还好好乐呵了呢，怎么能自杀呢？]
english_text: [That doesn't make sense! The person who video-called me just a week ago was perfectly happy, how could they commit suicide?]

chinese_text: [怎么啦？你不是要跟我说件事吗？]
english_text: [What's wrong? Weren't you going to tell me something?]

chinese_text: [唉，我没想到事情这么严重。]
english_text: [Sigh, I didn't realize the situation was this serious.]

chinese_text: [他咋了？]
english_text: [What happened to him?]

chinese_text: [不是他，他得压力大成啥样才能去自杀呀！]
english_text: [Not him, how much pressure must he have been under to commit suicide!]

chinese_text: [不是你说呀！到底怎么了？]
english_text: [Just tell me! What exactly happened?]

chinese_text: [怎么了？他家里出事啦？]
english_text: [What happened? Did something happen to his family?]

chinese_text: [联系了呀！前两天他还给我打视频呢，一个礼拜前吧差不多。]
english_text: [I did contact him! He video-called me just a couple of days ago, about a week ago.]

chinese_text: [你也别太难过了，这个这个事谁也没有办法预料得到，对吧？]
english_text: [Don't be too sad. This was something no one could have predicted, right?]

chinese_text: [他自杀了？]
english_text: [Did he commit suicide?]

chinese_text: [不是谁跟你说的这个事啊。]
english_text: [It wasn't someone who told you about this matter.]

chinese_text: [他前天晚上跟我打电话的时候，跟我抱怨他家里的事，他不是一直单亲吗？]
english_text: [When he called me the night before last, he complained about his family matters. Hasn't he always been from a single-parent family?]

chinese_text: [我前天晚上他还给我打电话呢。]
english_text: [He even called me the night before last.]

chinese_text: [他妈不可能骗我，而且我给他打电话根本就没人接，我的妈呀！]
english_text: [His mom couldn't have lied to me, and when I call him, no one answers at all. Oh my god!]

chinese_text: [我前天晚上他跟我打电话的时候他情绪特别低落，然后我也不知道该怎么安慰他，我后来我心想着就没事了，我说我陪你喝点吧。]
english_text: [When he called me the night before last, he was particularly down, and I didn't know how to comfort him. Later I thought it would be fine, so I said I'd have a drink with him.]

chinese_text: [再加上实习的事，单位没有给他办下来。然后就自杀了，人没了。]
english_text: [On top of that, the internship matter, the company didn't get it sorted out for him. Then he committed suicide, and he's gone.]

chinese_text: [他出事了。]
english_text: [Something happened to him.]

chinese_text: [太讽刺了，你知道张帆吗？]
english_text: [How ironic. Do you know Zhang Fan?]

chinese_text: [他他他当时说他挺难受的，想自己待会儿。]
english_text: [He said he was feeling terrible at the time and wanted to be alone for a while.]

chinese_text: [我本来要去找他的，结果我当时我有事，我我就没去，然后。]
english_text: [I was going to see him, but I had something to do at the time, so I didn't go, and then...]

chinese_text: [哎然后，他家里面的事，然后他父母的事就整得他特别烦，再加上他最近谈对象然后也不太顺利。]
english_text: [Sigh, and then, his family matters, and his parents' issues made him particularly annoyed, plus his recent relationship wasn't going smoothly either.]

chinese_text: [你最近没跟他联系过？]
english_text: [Haven't you been in contact with him recently?]

chinese_text: [哎您看那个就是，这个大白菜，就今天的这个，呃什么冬瓜呀，小白菜都很新鲜，你要不要，你称点儿这个。]
english_text: [Hey, look at that, this Chinese cabbage, today's, uh, what's it called, winter melon, bok choy are all very fresh. Do you want some? Weigh some of this for you.]

chinese_text: [本来都熟了不要钱，行，老来，行，拿着一共十五块八。]
english_text: [Since we know each other, no charge. Alright, regular customer, alright, take it. That's fifteen eighty in total.]

chinese_text: [青椒那个三块五，就算你。我平时都三块九的，你今天就三块五吧。我看那个，你长得又好看，这个老来嗯好好。]
english_text: [The green peppers are three fifty for you. I usually charge three ninety, but for you today, it's three fifty. I see you're good-looking and a regular customer, yes, yes.]

chinese_text: [啊白菜现在四块六。]
english_text: [Ah, the cabbage is four sixty now.]

chinese_text: [嗯，哎我送你一把吧，行啊。]
english_text: [Hmm, hey, I'll give you a bunch for free, alright?]

chinese_text: [几根啊？四根好嘞，刚摘的特别新鲜。]
english_text: [How many stalks? Four stalks, alright. Just picked, especially fresh.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，我忘买香菜了。]
english_text: [Oh, I forgot to buy cilantro.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，谢谢。]
english_text: [Oh, thank you.]

chinese_text: [青椒啊，青椒怎么卖呀？]
english_text: [Green peppers, how much are the green peppers?]

chinese_text: [这么贵。]
english_text: [So expensive.]

chinese_text: [你便宜点嘛，老在你家买，啊。]
english_text: [Give me a discount, I always buy from your shop, ah.]

chinese_text: [谢谢啊。]
english_text: [Thanks.]

chinese_text: [呃行给我来，呃帮我挑四根，四根。]
english_text: [Um, okay, get them for me. Um, help me pick four, four.]

chinese_text: [[laughing]行，你给我装点吧，嗯。]
english_text: [[laughing] Okay, you pack some for me, yeah.]

chinese_text: [本来嘛，这么简单的事情复制粘贴这还需要问吗？呃ctrl加C，ctrl加V这么简单的。]
english_text: [I mean, for something this simple like copy and paste, do you really need to ask? Um, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, it's that simple.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，ctrl加V。]
english_text: [Oh, Ctrl+V.]

chinese_text: [那也行你得钱给我呗。]
english_text: [Well, that's fine, but you have to give me the money then.]

chinese_text: [你入职前的岗前培训呢？不是都培训过嘛你这些最基本的。]
english_text: [What about your pre-job training? Weren't you trained on all these basic things?]

chinese_text: [好好好好好，弄吧弄吧弄吧。]
english_text: [Fine, fine, fine, fine. Go ahead, go ahead, go ahead.]

chinese_text: [宋体啊，你什你什么的这个楷体啊，字号全在上边儿。]
english_text: [Song typeface, or whatever, Kai typeface, the font sizes are all up there.]

chinese_text: [那我你工作我都做了，你不得给点辛苦费啊？]
english_text: [Well, I've done all your work, so shouldn't you give me some compensation for my effort?]

chinese_text: [一点儿就没用心一看你就。]
english_text: [You clearly didn't put any heart into it at all.]

chinese_text: [不是我刚开始入职的时候，我怎么没有忘啊？这人跟人的差距咋这么大呀？]
english_text: [When I first started this job, how come I didn't forget these things? How can there be such a big difference between people?]

chinese_text: [你之前怎么学的呀？这么简单的事儿不知道。]
english_text: [How did you learn before? How do you not know such a simple thing?]

chinese_text: [不是，这个字体条不就在上边儿吗？你那个。]
english_text: [No, isn't the font toolbar right up there? You...]

chinese_text: [哎，那个复制键是ctrl加什么来着？]
english_text: [Hey, what's the copy key, Ctrl plus what again?]

chinese_text: [怎么就没用心了？你这人。]
english_text: [How did I not put effort into it? You're impossible.]

chinese_text: [噢，对对对对对，哎那个字体条在哪儿来着？]
english_text: [Oh, right, right, right, right, right. Hey, where's that font toolbar again?]

chinese_text: [噢，对对对，粘贴呢？]
english_text: [Oh, right, right. And what about paste?]

chinese_text: [我为什么把钱给你啊？]
english_text: [Why should I give you money?]

chinese_text: [那要不我把工作给你你做。]
english_text: [Well then, how about I give you my work to do?]

chinese_text: [不是我我这不还想起来一个ctrl嘛，我就忘了加哪个字母了嘛。]
english_text: [No, I did remember the Ctrl part, I just forgot which letter to add to it.]

chinese_text: [记得啊，这不又忘了嘛，这太长时间没用了。]
english_text: [I did remember, but I forgot again. It's been too long since I used it.]

chinese_text: [我这不是问你一下，确保我这不不浪费时间，你知道你告诉我一下怎么了？]
english_text: [I'm just asking you to make sure I don't waste time. What's wrong with you telling me if you know?]

chinese_text: [那不你闲我这不会那不会的嘛，我给你做嗯。]
english_text: [Well, you're the one who thinks I can't do this or that, so I'll let you do it, yeah.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，我这不刚入职嘛，这不熟悉正常啊。]
english_text: [Oh come on, I just started this job. It's normal that I'm not familiar with everything yet.]

chinese_text: [真的，真的，我真的是挺谢挺感谢你们的，唉。]
english_text: [Really, really, I'm truly, truly grateful to you all, sigh.]

chinese_text: [没事儿，不怪人家姑娘。是我自己麻烦太多，给你们添麻烦了。]
english_text: [It's nothing, don't blame the young lady. I'm the one with too many troubles, causing you all inconvenience.]

chinese_text: [唉，其实我也应该感谢你们，照顾我这么长时间。]
english_text: [Sigh, actually I should be thanking you too, for taking care of me for so long.]

chinese_text: [要不是我自己的身体这样，也不会麻烦你们了，其实也是我自己的问题，唉。]
english_text: [If it weren't for my own health condition, I wouldn't have troubled you all. Actually, it's my own problem, sigh.]

chinese_text: [月过十五，光阴少。人到暮年，万事休。]
english_text: [After the fifteenth day of the month, time grows short. When one reaches old age, all things come to rest.]

chinese_text: [您别这么说，照顾你们病人，是我们医生和护士该尽的职责。]
english_text: [Please don't say that. Taking care of you patients is the duty of us doctors and nurses.]

chinese_text: [李先生，您现在感觉怎么样？肚子还疼吗？]
english_text: [Mr. Li, how are you feeling now? Is your stomach still hurting?]

chinese_text: [实在是对不起，发生了这样的事情，是我们医院的错。]
english_text: [I'm truly sorry that this happened. It's our hospital's fault.]

chinese_text: [实在是不好意思啊。发生了这样的事情，我们谁也没想到。]
english_text: [I'm really embarrassed. Something like this happened, and none of us expected it.]

chinese_text: [咱家咱家中签儿了。]
english_text: [Our family, our family won the lottery.]

chinese_text: [就是，我的天这也太突然了。]
english_text: [Exactly, oh my god, this is so sudden.]

chinese_text: [哎呦，我的天！你现在这点，你去哪车管所都下班了，你只能明天去[laughing]。]
english_text: [Oh my, oh my god! At this time, wherever you go, the vehicle management office is already closed. You can only go tomorrow [laughing].]

chinese_text: [又去看车了。]
english_text: [Going car shopping again.]

chinese_text: [我刚收到呀，刚刚手机震动，我就拿下来一看，哎中签了。我的妈呀！摇了五年了，摇了五年了，我们终于中了。]
english_text: [I just received it, my phone just vibrated, I took it out and looked, hey, we won. Oh my god! We've been trying for five years, for five years, and we finally won.]

chinese_text: [你到时候，等牌儿下来了，估计车都换了好几代了。]
english_text: [By the time the license plate comes out, the car models will probably have changed several generations.]

chinese_text: [不是，你要想买车，你不行，咱租个京牌。]
english_text: [No, if you want to buy a car, you can't, we should rent a Beijing license plate.]

chinese_text: [不是，那有什么用啊？你到现在车牌还没摇到，你摇几年了，你看车也没有用啊。]
english_text: [No, what's the use of that? You haven't won the license plate lottery yet, how many years have you been trying? It's useless to look at cars.]

chinese_text: [你刚收到的吗？]
english_text: [Did you just receive it?]

chinese_text: [我去这[laughing]，太巧了吧这。]
english_text: [Wow this [laughing], what a coincidence.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，真的假的呀这是？]
english_text: [Oh my, is this real or fake?]

chinese_text: [你快掐我一下。]
english_text: [Quick, pinch me.]

chinese_text: [哎，这也没办法，咱们从这个，你看从这个。]
english_text: [Sigh, there's nothing we can do about it. Let's start from this, you see, from this.]

chinese_text: [哎我不是想着先看到那个就好车，我就想多看两眼。等到到时候有牌了，就就随时换了呗。]
english_text: [Hey, I was thinking I should see that nice car first, I want to look at it a few more times. When we get the license plate, we can just change it anytime then.]

chinese_text: [对啊，因为嗯最近不是有那个置换补贴嘛，有一万五。]
english_text: [Right, because recently there's that trade-in subsidy, right? Fifteen thousand.]

chinese_text: [然后你咱家这个条件也符合。但是一直是外地牌儿，就每个月一年只能办十二次进京证，而且特别麻烦。]
english_text: [And our family's conditions also qualify. But we've always had an out-of-town license plate, so we can only apply for the Beijing entry permit twelve times a year, and it's especially troublesome.]

chinese_text: [别明天了，车我都看好了，就一会儿吃完饭去吧。]
english_text: [Don't wait until tomorrow, I've already picked out the car. Let's go right after we finish eating.]

chinese_text: [租京牌太麻烦了。而且他们也扯皮，你知道吗？]
english_text: [Renting a Beijing license plate is too troublesome. And they also make excuses, you know?]

chinese_text: [三系从二一款，一直看到了现在二五款。二五款今年刚好有政策，知道这个如果是置换的话，还能便宜一万五。]
english_text: [I've been looking at the 3 Series since the 2021 model up to the current 2025 model. The 2025 model has a policy this year, and I know that if it's a trade-in, it can be 15,000 yuan cheaper.]

chinese_text: [不是，它，太假了吧这也，怎么突然就中了。]
english_text: [No, this is too fake. How did I suddenly win?]

chinese_text: [哎哎，你别找我呀，啊，我求你找我呀。我回家安安心心，我看电影好不好啊？我给你做工作，你给我加班儿费了吗？]
english_text: [Hey, hey, don't come to me. I'm begging you to come to me. I go home peacefully and watch a movie, okay? I did the work for you, did you pay me overtime?]

chinese_text: [你行，以后啥也别找我，好吧，离我远点儿。]
english_text: [Fine, don't ask me for anything in the future, okay? Stay away from me.]

chinese_text: [不是，大哥。]

chinese_text: [我凭什么自己去呀，你把我书拿走了。]
english_text: [Why should I go by myself? You're the one who took my book.]

chinese_text: [你这人真有意思。]
english_text: [You're really something else.]

chinese_text: [刚刚你在桌上，我放了几本书吧。]
english_text: [I placed a few books on the table just now, didn't I?]

chinese_text: [有书不就代表这有人吗？]
english_text: [Don't books represent that someone is sitting here?]

chinese_text: [我怎么知道在动了。]
english_text: [How would I know it was moved?]

chinese_text: [你自己去吧。]
english_text: [Go by yourself then.]

chinese_text: [我没动啊！我给你放那边去了呀。]
english_text: [I didn't touch it! I moved it over there for you.]

chinese_text: [你要是坐这我肯定是不会坐，你问题是这没人呀我才坐。]
english_text: [If you were sitting here, I definitely wouldn't have sat down. The problem is, no one was here, so I sat down.]

chinese_text: [反正我不去，我挺忙的一天，你没事找事呢。]
english_text: [Anyway, I'm not going. I've had a busy day, and you're just making trouble out of nothing.]

chinese_text: [哇！我放那边去了。]
english_text: [Wow! I moved it over there.]

chinese_text: [但是我来的时候它没人啊，它也没有写的这个座位是你规定就要让谁坐呀。]
english_text: [But when I came here, no one was here. There wasn't any sign saying this seat was reserved for someone.]

chinese_text: [这不可能，这都有图书馆都有摄像头啊，我书根本就没动，我所以就是我只是把你。]
english_text: [That's impossible. The library has surveillance cameras. My book wasn't moved at all, so I was just moving you.]

chinese_text: [对啊，我只是动了书，书都没有翻开过，都有摄像头的，都能看得清清楚楚。]
english_text: [Right, I just moved the book, I didn't even open it. There are cameras everywhere, they can see everything clearly.]

chinese_text: [你刚才你书放在这个地方啊，就但是没有人啊它只有书，我就挪过去了呀。因为我在这边，我看的这个书它它在这个地方啊。]
english_text: [You had your book here earlier, but there was no one, just the book, so I moved it. Because I'm over here, and the book I was reading was right here.]

chinese_text: [不是啊！我觉得就是，因为我平时我也坐这，我正好我看到没。]
english_text: [No! I think it's because I usually sit here, and I happened to see it, didn't I?]

chinese_text: [谁告诉你有书就有人的呀。]
english_text: [Who told you that a book means someone is there?]

chinese_text: [这事实啊。]
english_text: [That's a fact.]

chinese_text: [这个您放心。]
english_text: [You can rest assured about this.]

chinese_text: [哦是吗？]
english_text: [Oh, really?]

chinese_text: [你看就那十万块钱就能不能再缓两天？]
english_text: [You see, can that 100,000 yuan be delayed for another two days?]

chinese_text: [嗯，就这个钱你看，就我们这种情况是能申请的吗？]
english_text: [Um, about this money, you see, can we apply for it in our situation?]

chinese_text: [啊，太好了。]
english_text: [Ah, that's great.]

chinese_text: [哎，那个嗯就大夫是是是这样的，就是我们现在呃凑了呃，五万八千块钱。]
english_text: [Well, um, doctor, it's like this, we've managed to gather, um, 58,000 yuan.]

chinese_text: [是，那个嗯，就是，嗯是这样的，就是我听我朋友说，就是就咱们医院里面好像有一个十万块钱的住院补贴是吗？]
english_text: [Yes, um, well, it's like this, I heard from my friend that there seems to be a 100,000 yuan hospitalization subsidy in our hospital, is that right?]

chinese_text: [呃，医疗。嗯对呀，就还没走呢。]
english_text: [Uh, medical insurance. Yeah, that's right, we haven't processed it yet.]

chinese_text: [谢谢你谢谢你。]
english_text: [Thank you, thank you.]

chinese_text: [好好好，这个肯定没有问题。]
english_text: [Okay, okay, okay, this is definitely not a problem.]

chinese_text: [谢谢，谢谢谢谢大夫，那我们就额就前期先走这个呃，医疗保险。就然后就后期的话，就看您明天这个住院补贴十万块钱看能不能申请。]
english_text: [Thank you, thank you, thank you, doctor. Then we'll, um, first process the medical insurance. And then later, we'll see if we can apply for the 100,000 yuan hospitalization subsidy tomorrow.]

chinese_text: [是是是是是。]
english_text: [Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes.]

chinese_text: [没事都能理解都能理解。]
english_text: [It's okay, I can understand, I can understand.]

chinese_text: [嗯，住院补贴主要是需要住院十五天以上，你们这个才住了十二天。]
english_text: [Um, the hospitalization subsidy mainly requires hospitalization for more than fifteen days, and you've only been hospitalized for twelve days.]

chinese_text: [一天icu就得四五万，这个你现在是缓了，你过两天你这个加上来还有那么多。医院没有办法去处理这个事情的。]
english_text: [One day in the ICU costs 40,000 to 50,000 yuan. You've delayed it now, but in a couple of days, you'll still have that much to add up. The hospital can't handle this matter.]

chinese_text: [没事没事，然后还有一个就是，还有个医疗保险。]
english_text: [It's okay, it's okay. And there's also the medical insurance.]

chinese_text: [缓不了了，你现在你的家属还在icu，icu每天的造价你大概应该也是清楚的，对吧？你也不是第一次交钱了。]
english_text: [It can't be delayed anymore. Your family member is still in the ICU, and you should probably be aware of the daily cost of the ICU, right? This isn't your first time paying.]

chinese_text: [然后大概率应该是能申请下来的。但是前提是你目前这个三万多啊，今天还是要交的啊。]
english_text: [And there's a high probability that it can be approved. But the prerequisite is that you still need to pay this 30,000-plus yuan today.]

chinese_text: [嗯。然后这样你们压力不也能少一些吗？]
english_text: [Um. And this way, wouldn't your pressure be reduced?]

chinese_text: [我估计啊，我想你们这个病人啊，十五天之后也出不了院，因为现在还在icu里嘛。]
english_text: [I estimate that, I think your patient won't be able to be discharged after fifteen days either, because they're still in the ICU.]

chinese_text: [好吧？然后等三天之后，正好十五天了，你可以去申请一下这个。]
english_text: [Alright? Then after waiting three more days, it'll be exactly fifteen days, and you can go apply for this.]

chinese_text: [然后大概是，这样吧，这个钱你不行的话，我这边先跟医院说一声，先欠一下。]
english_text: [Then, how about this? If you can't handle the money, I'll talk to the hospital first and let them know we'll owe it for now.]

chinese_text: [放心吧。]
english_text: [Don't worry.]

chinese_text: [你们走了吗？应该还没走呢吧？]
english_text: [Have you guys left? You probably haven't left yet, right?]

chinese_text: [病人恢复的还挺快的，很快应该也能出院了。]
english_text: [The patient is recovering quite quickly and should probably be discharged soon.]

chinese_text: [嗯，我自己在这边。]
english_text: [Yeah, I'm here by myself.]

chinese_text: [黄阿姨啊，您放心以后我就是您儿子。]
english_text: [Auntie Huang, don't worry, from now on I'll be like your son.]

chinese_text: [呃我今年三十五。]
english_text: [Uh, I'm thirty-five this year.]

chinese_text: [他气冲冲的就走出了家门，再也没回来过。]
english_text: [He stormed out of the house and never came back.]

chinese_text: [我当时啊，就不同意他去，就跟他吵了一架。]
english_text: [At that time, I disagreed with him going, so we had an argument.]

chinese_text: [呃那怎么没回家呢？]
english_text: [Uh, then why didn't he come home?]

chinese_text: [去哪儿都一样，只要人活着，可惜了他现在听不到我说的这些话了。]
english_text: [It doesn't matter where you go, as long as you're alive. It's a pity he can't hear what I'm saying now.]

chinese_text: [小刘大夫今天不忙啊？]
english_text: [Dr. Liu, you're not busy today?]

chinese_text: [哎呀，如果能回到那个时候啊，我肯定跟他说，你去！不就是个省外嘛。就算是国外，咱也得去对吧？人活这辈子。]
english_text: [Oh, if I could go back to that time, I would definitely tell him, 'Go! It's just out of province, right?' Even if it were abroad, we would still have to go, right? That's how life is.]

chinese_text: [你说，我当时怎么就跟他吵架呢？]
english_text: [Tell me, why did I argue with him back then?]

chinese_text: [哎哟，我儿子要是活着的话，现在也应该跟你一边儿大了。]
english_text: [Oh, if my son were still alive, he would probably be about the same age as you now.]

chinese_text: [我到现在都还记得，我俩吃了最后一顿饭，他刚考上大学，省外的大学。]
english_text: [I still remember our last meal together. He had just been admitted to a university out of province.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，实在。]
english_text: [Oh, really.]

chinese_text: [不是，我刚才我给您打电话的时候，里边儿还有奶茶的。]
english_text: [No, when I called you just now, there was still milk tea inside.]

chinese_text: [嗯，直接就扫给你，行吗？]
english_text: [Yeah, I can just scan it for you directly, okay?]

chinese_text: [嗯，要要不然这样吧，就是您也不要走平台了。就是您别，呃别就是您别投诉我，然后我您奶茶的钱，我自己的钱赔给您，行吗？]
english_text: [Um, or how about this? You don't need to go through the platform. Just, uh, just don't file a complaint against me, and I'll compensate you for the milk tea with my own money, okay?]

chinese_text: [哎，不好意思不好意思。要不然那个，这样吧，就是您。]
english_text: [Ah, sorry, sorry. Or, um, how about this, you...]

chinese_text: [就是，您下单付多少钱。]
english_text: [It's just, however much you paid when you placed the order.]

chinese_text: [行，好的。]
english_text: [Okay, good.]

chinese_text: [哎，好的好的，谢谢谢谢。]
english_text: [Ah, okay, okay, thank you, thank you.]

chinese_text: [哎那个，嗯，就有一个情况，需要跟您说一下。就是我刚才送外卖的时候，可能那个路上就比较颠一点儿，然后这个就奶茶可能撒了一点儿。]
english_text: [Um, excuse me, there's something I need to tell you. When I was delivering your food order just now, the road was a bit bumpy, and some of the bubble tea might have spilled.]

chinese_text: [嗯，您您看这样行吗？就是我刚才我看了一下就是，您这个订单是十九块八，我赔你二十五块钱，行吗？]
english_text: [Um, would this be okay? I just checked, and your order was 19.8 yuan. How about I compensate you with 25 yuan, is that alright?]

chinese_text: [实在不好意思，你就是是这样的。其实我以前是学营养就是嗯，您知道你要是在减肥期间，其实不适合喝奶茶的，因为一杯奶茶，要六百大卡了。]
english_text: [I'm really sorry, but here's the thing. Actually, I used to study nutrition, and you know, if you're trying to lose weight, bubble tea isn't really suitable because one cup has about 600 calories.]

chinese_text: [啊，没事没事儿，能理解能理解。]
english_text: [Oh, it's fine, it's fine. I understand, I understand.]

chinese_text: [你刚刚跟我说奶茶少了，撒了一点儿，是吧？]
english_text: [You just told me that some bubble tea spilled, right?]

chinese_text: [那个那就这样儿吧，好吧？]
english_text: [Well, let's just leave it at that then, okay?]

chinese_text: [哎哎行吧行吧，就这样儿吧。]
english_text: [Alright, alright, fine. Let's just leave it at that.]

chinese_text: [你现在告诉我，怎么解决这个事情？我午餐没了，被你给撒没了。]
english_text: [Now tell me, how are you going to resolve this? My lunch is gone because you spilled it all.]

chinese_text: [我现在就等着喝杯奶茶，我就当减肥了。然后现在奶茶也没了，我也没时间再点了呀。]
english_text: [I was just waiting to drink this bubble tea and was considering it as part of my diet. But now the tea is gone, and I don't have time to order again.]

chinese_text: [我现在不光是奶茶的费用，你浪费我时间啊，我中午的饭都已经没吃。]
english_text: [It's not just about the cost of the bubble tea; you've wasted my time, and I haven't had my lunch because of this.]

chinese_text: [你现在一杯都没有了，全撒没了，就剩点儿芋圆儿了。]
english_text: [Now I don't have any drink left at all. It's all spilled, with only some tapioca pearls remaining.]

chinese_text: [不是，你这个有点儿过分了吧。你要是撒了一点儿，那可以，都无所谓，对吧？也知道你们服务行业不容易。]
english_text: [No, this is a bit too much, isn't it? If only a little had spilled, that would be fine, it wouldn't matter, right? I know it's not easy working in the service industry.]

chinese_text: [不是，咱看一下呢。我这个奶茶现在里面儿除了芋圆，一滴奶茶都没有吧，你这叫少了一点儿啊，朋友。]
english_text: [No, let's take a look. In this bubble tea now, besides the tapioca pearls, there's not a single drop of tea left, is there? And you call this 'a little spilled,' my friend?]

chinese_text: [不是，你就现在告我这事儿怎么解决吧？]
english_text: [No, just tell me right now how you're going to resolve this issue.]

chinese_text: [哎，你等会儿，你回来。]
english_text: [Hey, wait a minute, come back.]

chinese_text: [你别管我这些。]
english_text: [Don't worry about me.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，年轻人就让她玩呗。她们爬山，咱俩吃烤肉多好。]
english_text: [Oh, just let the young people have their fun. They're going hiking, while we can enjoy some barbecue together.]

chinese_text: [当然啊!]
english_text: [Of course!]

chinese_text: [你小心点那个，那个河你下河的时候小心点你这个。]
english_text: [Be careful with that river. Be careful when you get in the water.]

chinese_text: [啊对呀，我跟你说你看，看着河看着这个风景。闻到味儿了没有，烤的肉怎么样？香不香？]
english_text: [Oh yes, let me tell you, look at the river and this scenery. Can you smell it? How's the barbecue? Doesn't it smell delicious?]

chinese_text: [我怕你咬了鱼。]
english_text: [I'm afraid you'll bite the fish.]

chinese_text: [嗯，完美。]
english_text: [Hmm, perfect.]

chinese_text: [那当然了，常年烤肉，十几年的老厨师了。我跟你说就是什么锦州烧烤啊，什么齐齐哈尔烤肉啊，在我这儿都不行。]
english_text: [Of course, I've been grilling for years, I'm a veteran chef with over a decade of experience. Let me tell you, whether it's Jinzhou barbecue or Qiqihar grilled meat, none of them can compare to mine.]

chinese_text: [哦，她们俩都早爬山去了。]
english_text: [Oh, they both went hiking early.]

chinese_text: [当然了，我就说来这儿准没错吧？]
english_text: [Of course, didn't I tell you that coming here would definitely be the right choice?]

chinese_text: [行，当然啦。哎，你还吃什么那个啊，金针菇茄子豆角什么的吃吗？]
english_text: [Okay, of course. Hey, are you still eating those things? Like enoki mushrooms, eggplant, green beans and stuff?]

chinese_text: [我也没烤他们俩的[laughing]。]
english_text: [I didn't grill theirs either [laughing].]

chinese_text: [肯定得尝，多吃点儿啊。]
english_text: [You definitely have to try it, eat more.]

chinese_text: [可以，你这手艺一绝啊！]
english_text: [Nice, your cooking skills are amazing!]

chinese_text: [哎呀我的天呐，多大的瘾啊？还去爬山？]
english_text: [Oh my goodness, what's with this addiction? Still going hiking?]

chinese_text: [怎么着你怕我被鱼咬了啊[laughing]？]
english_text: [What, are you afraid I'll get bitten by a fish [laughing]?]

chinese_text: [啊，爬山去了？]
english_text: [Oh, you went hiking?]

chinese_text: [冰冰凉凉的，可好吃了。]
english_text: [It's icy and cool, so delicious.]

chinese_text: [我谢谢你。]
english_text: [Thank you.]

chinese_text: [哎一会儿这烤串儿啊不给她们，咱俩先吃啦。]
english_text: [Hey, let's not give them the skewers later, let's eat first.]

chinese_text: [我跟你讲，我刚刚下去看了一下那个河，那个水特别凉。]
english_text: [Let me tell you, I just went down to look at the river, the water is really cold.]

chinese_text: [这地儿找的真可以啊，这山清水秀的。]
english_text: [This place is really nice, with beautiful mountains and clear waters.]

chinese_text: [可以啊，你看着烤，我不挑食。哎，我们一会儿把那个西瓜往那个河里面一放，哎呦。]
english_text: [Sure, you handle the grilling, I'm not picky. Hey, we'll put that watermelon in the river for a bit later, oh yeah.]

chinese_text: [行，那一会儿高低得尝一尝。]
english_text: [Okay, then we must try it later.]

chinese_text: [哦，但是特别清。]
english_text: [Oh, but it's really clear.]

chinese_text: [哎呦，真的假的？这么厉害。]
english_text: [Wow, really? That's impressive.]

chinese_text: [行，一会儿让她俩下来自己吃，不管了，谁让她俩跑了的。]
english_text: [Fine, let them come down and eat by themselves later, I don't care anymore, it's their fault for running off.]

chinese_text: [哎呦，哎，你看那河清的，哎呦。]
english_text: [Wow, hey, look how clear that river is, wow.]

chinese_text: [医院昨天是不是给您发短信了，说体检之前一定要空腹连水都不能喝。]
english_text: [Didn't the hospital send you a text message yesterday saying you must fast before the check-up, not even water?]

chinese_text: [是，所以我让你说的，我说了让你明天来呀！你今天查不了。]
english_text: [Yes, that's what I told you, I said you should come tomorrow! You can't get checked today.]

chinese_text: [那你就后天来。]
english_text: [Then come the day after tomorrow.]

chinese_text: [你想抽血，抽血之前必须空腹，知道吗？你吃点东西，它对你那个血液是有是有影响的，我们怎么给你检查呀！]
english_text: [If you want a blood test, you must fast before it, understand? If you eat something, it affects your blood, how can we examine you!]

chinese_text: [不是你怎么。]
english_text: [What's wrong with you.]

chinese_text: [今天检不了了，明天再来吧。]
english_text: [You can't get checked today, come back tomorrow.]

chinese_text: [您啊也别跟我在这磨叽，我解决不了。我说的空腹检查，空腹检查你今天肯定是检查不上的，明白吧？你要是能哪个医院能给你检查，那你去别的医院，我们这个医院肯定不行。]
english_text: [Stop arguing with me, I can't solve this. I said it's a fasting check-up, you definitely can't get checked today, understand? If any other hospital can check you, then go to another hospital, our hospital definitely won't do it.]

chinese_text: [嗯，张春。]
english_text: [Hmm, Zhang Chun.]

chinese_text: [我后天也有事。]
english_text: [I also have something to do the day after tomorrow.]

chinese_text: [但是我吃那么早，现在早消化没了吧。]
english_text: [But I ate so early, it must have been digested by now, right?]

chinese_text: [我这个，您看能不能通融一下，就是随随便查查，因为我身体肯定很健康的，就也没什么，就老，我就想抽个血。]
english_text: [For my case, could you please make an exception? Just do a simple check-up, because I'm definitely very healthy, there's nothing wrong, I just want to have a blood test.]

chinese_text: [哎不是，哎大夫，我都已经排好久了，预约了特别久了。]
english_text: [No, doctor, I've been waiting in line for a long time, I made this appointment a long time ago.]

chinese_text: [不是我我都来了，我家挺远的我住通州，您在朝阳，我这我我我过来我得，我坐公交我坐四十分钟呢我。]
english_text: [I'm already here, and my home is quite far. I live in Tongzhou, and you're in Chaoyang. It took me forty minutes to get here by bus.]

chinese_text: [对呀，就是现在因为十一已经过了，就没有什么大节日，然后圣诞节又还没过，所以说这个中间机票就比较便宜。]
english_text: [Yes, that's right. Now that the National Day holiday is over, there are no major holidays, and Christmas hasn't come yet, so the air tickets are relatively cheap during this period.]

chinese_text: [呃你猜嘛，那我都说了，我要是我不能给范畴，我给范畴就就没意思了。]
english_text: [Well, guess. If I tell you the range, it wouldn't be fun anymore.]

chinese_text: [你猜现在北京飞三亚多少钱？]
english_text: [Guess how much it costs to fly from Beijing to Sanya now?]
