english_text: [Really, I have your birth certificate. I have your birth certificate, look.]

chinese_text: [你你还记得你小时候的事儿吗？]
english_text: [Do you remember things from your childhood?]

chinese_text: [对不起对不起佳佳。]
english_text: [I'm sorry, I'm sorry, Jiajia.]

chinese_text: [你妈妈在你走丢了之后就一直怪我。]
english_text: [Your mother has been blaming me ever since you got lost.]

chinese_text: [四岁之前事儿还记得吗？]
english_text: [Do you remember things from before you were four?]

chinese_text: [你所以就是四岁之前的事儿你都不记得了是不是？]
english_text: [So you don't remember anything from before you were four, right?]

chinese_text: [哎好[Sobbing]好。]
english_text: [Oh, okay [Sobbing] okay.]

chinese_text: [我[Sobbing]我待会给她打个电话说跟她说你找到了，你想见她对吗？]
english_text: [I [Sobbing] I'll call her later and tell her you've been found, you want to see her, right?]

chinese_text: [啊，佳佳。]
english_text: [Ah, Jiajia.]

chinese_text: [然后没两年她就她就改嫁了，不过我知道她现在在哪。]
english_text: [Then in less than two years, she remarried, but I know where she is now.]

chinese_text: [我一直在找你。]
english_text: [I've been looking for you all this time.]

chinese_text: [我是我是你爸爸。]
english_text: [I am, I am your father.]

chinese_text: [对不起你，爸爸爸爸没看好你，我对不起你。]
english_text: [I'm sorry, Dad, Dad didn't take good care of you, I'm sorry to you.]

chinese_text: [你看这是这是小时候的你。]
english_text: [Look, this is you when you were little.]

chinese_text: [我自从你走掉了之后，你的出生证明我一直每天都带在身上。]
english_text: [Ever since you were gone, I've carried your birth certificate with me every day.]

chinese_text: [对不起你。]
english_text: [I'm sorry to you.]

chinese_text: [去别别跟我说什么维权不维权。]
english_text: [Don't talk to me about rights protection or not.]

chinese_text: [哎呦，想来讹钱是不是啊？]
english_text: [Oh, trying to extort money, right?]

chinese_text: [怎么啦？出什么事儿了呀？]
english_text: [What's wrong? What happened?]

chinese_text: [是不是想讹钱？]
english_text: [Trying to extort money?]

chinese_text: [嗯，可以帮你重做，但退钱，别想了，啊。]
english_text: [Well, I can help you redo it, but a refund, forget it, ah.]

chinese_text: [你别跟我说什么医疗事故扯这些没用的。]
english_text: [Don't talk to me about medical malpractice and these useless things.]

chinese_text: [这跟我们没关系啊。这你是不是，跟你说术后几天不能碰水，你是不是洗澡了？]
english_text: [This has nothing to do with us. Didn't I tell you not to touch water for a few days after the surgery, did you shower?]

chinese_text: [是不是想讹钱？]
english_text: [Trying to extort money?]

chinese_text: [我们开美容院的，我需要懂法吗啊？来你就说，开个价吧，想想要多少啊？]
english_text: [We run a beauty salon, do I need to know the law? Come on, just name your price, how much do you want?]

chinese_text: [那我只能这么跟你说，我们就只能尽我们的能力，啊看给你弄到哪儿是是什么样是什么样。那至于你后边怎么样，那看你个人造化了是吧？]
english_text: [Then I can only tell you this, we can only do our best, ah, see what we can do for you and what it turns out to be. As for what happens to you afterward, that depends on your own fate, right?]

chinese_text: [你要不要做，你要做我今天就安排人给你做，做吗？做不做？]
english_text: [Do you want it done or not? If you do, I'll arrange for someone to do it for you today. Will you? Will you or not?]

chinese_text: [你这样人我看多了，就想讹钱嘛。]
english_text: [I've seen many people like you, just trying to extort money.]

chinese_text: [那我不能保证啊。谁能保证给你恢复到原来的样子，你要是原来的样子，你干嘛给我整容啊啊？]
english_text: [Well, I can't guarantee that. Who can guarantee to restore you to your original appearance? If you were satisfied with your original appearance, why would you come to me for plastic surgery, ah?]

chinese_text: [我今天也不是说来要钱的。你呢，要么把这个给我重做，给我恢复好了。]
english_text: [I didn't come here for money today. You either redo this for me and fix it properly.]

chinese_text: [我讹钱？]
english_text: [I'm extorting money?]

chinese_text: [我讹钱，你们是不是就不想管，就就想推辞这件事是吧？这是你们医院的问题。]
english_text: [If I'm extorting money, does that mean you don't want to take responsibility, you just want to shirk this matter, right? This is your hospital's problem.]

chinese_text: [你看看你们给我割的这双眼皮是啥？这啥？]
english_text: [Look at this double eyelid you gave me, what is this? What is this?]

chinese_text: [那你至少得给我弄好吧？我现在眼睛睁不开。]
english_text: [Then you should at least fix it for me, right? I can't open my eyes now.]

chinese_text: [我跟你说，我已经去医院查了，已经有证明的好吗？我把这个证明今天拍在这儿了，你自己看看检查结果，这就是你们造成的医疗事故。]
english_text: [Let me tell you, I've already been to the hospital for an examination, and I have proof, okay? I'm posting this proof here today, you can see the examination results yourself. This is a medical accident caused by you.]

chinese_text: [我我这个眼睛都睁不开，我现在就只能半睁着。]
english_text: [I can't even open this eye, I can only keep it half-open now.]

chinese_text: [你懂不懂法呀哥？]
english_text: [Do you understand the law, bro?]

chinese_text: [我这不叫讹钱，我这是维权。]
english_text: [This isn't extortion, this is me defending my rights.]

chinese_text: [那重做行呀，那你重做，你能保证给我恢复到原来的样子吗？]
english_text: [Then redoing it is fine, but if you redo it, can you guarantee to restore it to its original appearance?]

chinese_text: [不做啦。]
english_text: [I'm not doing it anymore.]

chinese_text: [这跟碰水有什么关系，碰水它只是留疤。我这个现在是眼睛睁不开，这属于医疗事故。]
english_text: [What does this have to do with water contact? Water contact would only leave scars. My problem now is that I can't open my eyes, this is a medical accident.]

chinese_text: [我讹钱，我要得是一个合理的解释。]
english_text: [Extorting money? What I want is a reasonable explanation.]

chinese_text: [那要么你就把我花的这个钱赔给我，外加我这个医药费和重新修复的费用，这合理吧？]
english_text: [Then either you refund me the money I spent, plus my medical expenses and the cost for corrective surgery, that's reasonable, right?]

chinese_text: [我卖的东西肯定没有问题，肯定是你用的方式不对。]
english_text: [The things I sell are definitely not problematic, it must be that you're using it incorrectly.]

chinese_text: [我给你的时候是干净的呀，那不然你为什么会拿走啊？]
english_text: [It was clean when I gave it to you, otherwise why would you have taken it?]

chinese_text: [啊，你说你没时间用，它就自己放在那儿自己坏了是吧？]
english_text: [Oh, so you're saying you didn't have time to use it, so it just sat there and broke by itself, is that it?]

chinese_text: [[laughing]你现在是你现在是是想干嘛？让，让我给你退是吗？]
english_text: [[laughing] What are you trying to do now? You want me to give you a refund, is that it?]

chinese_text: [我看，[laughing]CCD拍出来不就是这样儿的吗？]
english_text: [Let me see, [laughing] isn't this just how CCD cameras take pictures?]

chinese_text: [我告诉你，我们这边呢出的每一个相机，我都是质检了过后给你发过去的啊。你不要在那跟我说什么你收到手了，你用了几天了，啊，有问题了过来找我。]
english_text: [Let me tell you, every camera that comes from our side, I personally quality check it before sending it to you. Don't come to me telling me you received it, used it for a few days, and now there's a problem.]

chinese_text: [你已经用了一段时间了对吗？你想要一个新的，那很合理啊，而且还涨价了。]
english_text: [You've already used it for a while, right? You want a new one, that's very reasonable, and the price has gone up too.]

chinese_text: [你如果要发现有问题，你当时你就拒收，对不对？咱们要讲道理的。]
english_text: [If you had found a problem, you should have refused to accept it then, right? We need to be reasonable.]

chinese_text: [啊？光圈呢？调了没？]
english_text: [Huh? What about the aperture? Have you adjusted it?]

chinese_text: [可以赚钱，有利润空间啊！]
english_text: [You can make money, there's profit margin!]

chinese_text: [我卖给你，我卖给你的时候两千，现在已经涨到三千了！]
english_text: [When I sold it to you, it was two thousand, now it has gone up to three thousand!]

chinese_text: [那怎么啦？啊？]
english_text: [So what? Huh?]

chinese_text: [快门调了吗？]
english_text: [Has the shutter been adjusted?]

chinese_text: [你要我给你换一个新的？我怎么知道是不是到你手里以后你把它故意弄坏了，然后过来说，哎我再换一个新的。然后转手那么一，然后一千块钱赚到了。我怎么知道你是不是要这样儿？]
english_text: [You want me to exchange it for a new one? How would I know if you intentionally damaged it after getting it, then come to me saying 'hey, exchange it for a new one,' then resell it and make a thousand yuan. How would I know if that's what you're planning to do?]

chinese_text: [你会不会用它呢？啊？]
english_text: [Can you use it or not? Huh?]

chinese_text: [那你没有时间拍照，你这事情你上哪儿说去呢？咱走小法庭好不好呀啊？你收到货之后你没时间拍照？那你会有这种人吗？]
english_text: [So you don't have time to take photos? Where are you going to argue your case? Should we go to small claims court, huh? You didn't have time to take photos after receiving the item? Who does that?]

chinese_text: [哎，你知道！你给你换可以，你得加钱。]
english_text: [Hey, you know! I can exchange it for you, but you have to pay extra.]

chinese_text: [你给我的时候那是邮寄过来的，我怎么知道在你手上是不是干净的？]
english_text: [When you gave it to me, it was mailed. How would I know if it was clean when you had it?]

chinese_text: [这才几天呀？我才没用过几次。我这一直在出差没有时间用，我今天回来之后发现照片全都是这个样儿的，我才来找你的。]
english_text: [It's only been a few days! I've only used it a few times. I've been on business trips and haven't had time to use it. I only came back today and found all the photos look like this, that's why I'm contacting you.]

chinese_text: [我怎么不会用了？哎！我之前用别的相机拍怎么也不是这样啊？]
english_text: [How would I not know how to use it? Hey! When I used other cameras before, the photos never turned out like this!]

chinese_text: [它不是坏！这是你的镜头本来就有问题。]
english_text: [It's not broken! Your lens had problems to begin with.]

chinese_text: [这还没问题？你睁着眼睛说瞎话！]
english_text: [And this isn't a problem? You're lying with your eyes wide open!]

chinese_text: [你你这个CCD你看拍出来这是啥呀？]
english_text: [Look at this CCD of yours. See what kind of photos it takes?]

chinese_text: [我凭什么给你加钱呀？]
english_text: [Why should I pay you extra?]

chinese_text: [哎，它要是个好的，我再把它弄坏了，哎专门再过来换一个，我何必呀我？]
english_text: [Hey, if it was good to begin with, why would I break it and then specifically come here to exchange it? What would be the point?]

chinese_text: [它要是个好的我何必换它呢？]
english_text: [If it was good, why would I need to exchange it?]

chinese_text: [不是，人家那拍出来也不是这样儿啊，你给我卖的这是什么货啊？]
english_text: [No, other people's cameras don't take photos like this. What kind of product did you sell me?]

chinese_text: [我调了呀。]
english_text: [I did adjust it.]

chinese_text: [我都调了，你以为我是傻子呀？我不是跟你说你这个问题就是镜头有问题。你看你这镜头上还有灰有霉，你当时还跟我说镜头上干净什么都没有呢。]
english_text: [I've already adjusted everything. Do you think I'm stupid? Didn't I tell you the problem is with the lens? Look, there's dust and mold on your lens, yet you told me before that the lens was completely clean with nothing on it.]

chinese_text: [我当时收的时候没有时间拍照，我这不是拍了之后才发现的吗？]
english_text: [When I received it, I didn't have time to take photos. Isn't that why I only discovered the problem after taking pictures?]

chinese_text: [是是人，是真的人，还是看错了？]
english_text: [Was it a person, a real person, or did I see it wrong?]

chinese_text: [你爸站门口盯着你。]
english_text: [Your dad was standing at the door staring at you.]

chinese_text: [我都能看到门口有个人在那在那盯着我，我只能看到人影，我看不到他的脸。]
english_text: [I could see someone standing at the door staring at me. I could only see their silhouette, not their face.]

chinese_text: [我小时候嘛，就是七岁差不多那会儿，刚搬新家。在搬新家之前，我一直都是跟我爸妈一起睡。]
english_text: [When I was a child, around seven years old, we had just moved to a new home. Before moving to the new home, I always slept with my parents.]

chinese_text: [嗯，刚搬搬过去那段时间呢，我就每次晚上醒过来的时候，我能看见，在我的门口，有一个人影。]
english_text: [Well, during that period right after we moved, every time I woke up at night, I could see a figure at my door.]

chinese_text: [对，因为我爸就是怕我刚到新家睡不习惯嘛。]
english_text: [Right, because my dad was worried I wouldn't be able to sleep well in the new home.]

chinese_text: [我说爸好怕，我想我想还是回去跟你们一起睡吧。然后我爸就说，他说那个人就是他。]
english_text: [I said, 'Dad, I'm scared. I think I'd rather come sleep with you guys.' Then my dad said that person was him.]

chinese_text: [啥也不懂，也不知道，也甚至都不知道，什么鬼啊这些东西，我都不知道。我那会儿就，反正就害怕嘛。后来有一次，跟我爸说了这件事。]
english_text: [I didn't understand anything, didn't know anything, didn't even know about things like ghosts. I just felt scared back then. Later on, I told my dad about this incident.]

chinese_text: [我的房间门，我晚上睡觉的时候，房间的门几乎都是开着的，我不关。而而且自己睡的时候呢，也不会睡得那么死，晚上总是有的时候会莫名其妙地醒过来。]
english_text: [My bedroom door, when I sleep at night, is almost always left open. I don't close it. And when I sleep alone, I don't sleep too soundly. Sometimes at night, I just wake up for no apparent reason.]

chinese_text: [啊，我说我最近每天晚上睡觉睡到一半儿，然后起来的时候。]
english_text: [Oh, I was saying that recently every night when I sleep halfway through, and then when I get up.]

chinese_text: [所以他每天晚上起来上厕所之后，他就会站在门口，看我一会儿，看我睡得踏不踏实。]
english_text: [So every night after he gets up to use the bathroom, he would stand at the door and watch me for a while, to see if I'm sleeping soundly.]

chinese_text: [在那儿就定定地站在那儿，望着我。]
english_text: [He would just stand there motionless, staring at me.]

chinese_text: [是人是一个人影，是一个人影。就在那儿定定的看着我，然后我每次都特别害怕，然后呢，完了就再，然后又睡过去。]
english_text: [It's a person, it's a silhouette. Just standing there motionless and staring at me, and every time I would be so scared, and then, well, I would just fall back asleep.]

chinese_text: [嗯就是，哎反正这事挺吓人的。但是后来就解释完了之后，也没那么吓人了。]
english_text: [Well, anyway, this was quite scary. But after it was explained later, it wasn't so scary anymore.]

chinese_text: [我就威胁你。]
english_text: [I'm threatening you.]

chinese_text: [那不是我们安的啊，你别污蔑人！]
english_text: [We didn't install that, don't slander us!]

chinese_text: [那在我们民宿，就是我们安的呀？那说不定，是别人安到我们民宿，害我们呢？]
english_text: [So in our guesthouse, we were the ones who installed it? Or maybe, someone else installed it in our guesthouse to frame us?]

chinese_text: [哦，这是我的民宿，我就要连，连插头的插孔，我都要检查是吗？]
english_text: [Oh, this is my guesthouse, so I have to check even the plug sockets, is that it?]

chinese_text: [那你怎么说？]
english_text: [Then what do you say?]

chinese_text: [你有什么言论自由？你有言论自由，你生在，你生在这个地方，你有什么言论自由？你哪来言论自由？谁给你言论自由了？]
english_text: [What freedom of speech do you have? You have freedom of speech? You were born, you were born in this place, what freedom of speech do you have? Where did you get freedom of speech? Who gave you freedom of speech?]

chinese_text: [怎么没有可比性？]
english_text: [How are they not comparable?]

chinese_text: [关键是我怎么负责呀？这件事我没法负责呀！]
english_text: [The key is how can I be responsible? I can't be responsible for this matter!]

chinese_text: [你打扫卫生，会连插座插孔也看？会连空调也扒开来看？会连电视机我也要把它拆开来看里面有没有装摄像头，你会这么打扫家里卫生是吗？会吗？]
english_text: [When you clean, do you check even the plug sockets? Do you pry open the air conditioner to look? Do I have to disassemble the TV to see if there's a camera inside? Do you clean your home like this? Do you?]

chinese_text: [你会去检查你家插头插孔里面，有没有摄像头吗？如果有人趁你不在家的时候，在你摄像头，在你那个插座插孔里面安了摄像头，你能发现吗？你可能一辈子都发现不了，对吗？]
english_text: [Would you check the plug sockets in your home to see if there are cameras? If someone installed a camera in your socket while you weren't home, could you discover it? You might never discover it in your lifetime, right?]

chinese_text: [你，你不好意思啊。我们要开门做生意呢，啊！你要是曝光了影响我们生意了，这钱，赔了的钱你赔我呀？谁赔我呀？]
english_text: [You, you should be ashamed. We need to run our business here! If you expose this and it affects our business, this money, the compensation money, will you pay me? Who will pay me?]

chinese_text: [你既然每天都要打扫这个卫生，你就要每天要检查清楚。啊，这种事情，你你如果说你不管，那谁来管？]
english_text: [Since you clean every day, you should check thoroughly every day. For matters like this, if you say you won't take responsibility, then who will?]

chinese_text: [如果说，你今天能给我一个合理的解释，或者是一个态度好的道歉，这个事儿，我可能还能有缓的余地。你既然是这个态度的话，今天这个事儿我必须发到网上。]
english_text: [If you could give me a reasonable explanation today, or a sincere apology, there might be room for negotiation on this matter. But since you have this attitude, I must post this online today.]

chinese_text: [那不然呢？这是，这是。]
english_text: [What else would it be? This is, this is.]

chinese_text: [你这是开门做生意的，你就是让旅客来住的。啊，那我们住进来了，你不得为我们的安全负责呀？]
english_text: [You're running a business, you're here to accommodate guests. So when we stay here, shouldn't you be responsible for our safety?]

chinese_text: [那我不管，反正我住在你们民宿，那是你们没有把这个检查清楚。啊，那我现在住进去了，我发现有摄像头，那我不曝光这个事儿。那万一以后，后来还有人住进来呢？]
english_text: [I don't care, since I'm staying in your guesthouse, it's because you didn't check this properly. Now that I've checked in and found a camera, if I don't expose this matter, what if someone else stays here in the future?]

chinese_text: [你这个话有可比性吗我想问？我自，难道我家，我还要开门做生意，我让人家来住我家呀？]
english_text: [May I ask if your statement is comparable? Do I, in my own home, need to run a business and let people stay at my house?]

chinese_text: [我在网上，我想怎么发怎么发，你知道我用哪个号儿发呀？反正这个事儿，我肯定是要曝光的。既然你们这个态度，还是这个样子，那不好意思，我们不可能再谈下去。]
english_text: [Online, I can post however I want. Do you know which account I'll use to post it? Anyway, I will definitely expose this matter. Since you have this attitude and are still like this, I'm sorry, but we cannot continue this discussion.]

chinese_text: [哼，你威胁谁呢？]
english_text: [Hmph, who are you threatening?]

chinese_text: [你，你们民宿里，还安摄像头？]
english_text: [You, you still have cameras installed in your guesthouse?]

chinese_text: [不是，就在你们民宿，怎么就不是你们安的了？]

english_text: [She can make so many things, like Poyang Lake fish head, and then also our most delicious mixed rice noodles.]

chinese_text: [对呀！对，它又便宜又好吃，超级不错！]
english_text: [Yeah! That's right, it's both cheap and delicious, super great!]

chinese_text: [你要是不能吃辣的话，你可以不加辣嘛。它有加辣也可以不加辣，一般就是放在桌上你爱吃的话自己拿。]
english_text: [If you can't eat spicy food, you can just not add the spice. It can be made spicy or not spicy, and it's usually placed on the table so you can take it yourself if you like it.]

english_text: [I, I, I when I was in school, I had to eat it basically every morning and evening, I just had to eat it.]

english_text: [It's especially delicious. Don't think it looks simple, just mixed noodles with clay pot soup. I love the egg and meat patty soup the most. Just ordinary mixed noodles paired with egg and meat patty soup is especially delicious!]

chinese_text: [好啊特别好，我们那儿山多水多的。如果你喜欢爬山我可以带你去爬武功山，还有那个井冈山都可以爬。]
english_text: [Great, really great. We have lots of mountains and waters where I'm from. If you like mountain climbing, I can take you to climb Wugong Mountain, and you can also climb Jinggang Mountain.]

chinese_text: [藜蒿就是一种呃植物长在彭阳湖里。]
english_text: [Artemisia selengensis is a type of plant that grows in Poyang Lake.]

chinese_text: [怎么样，假期了有没有想好去哪里玩？]
english_text: [So, have you thought about where to go for fun during the holiday?]

chinese_text: [对对对对对！]
english_text: [Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!]

chinese_text: [腊肉也是我们那的特产。]
english_text: [Cured meat is also a specialty from my hometown.]

chinese_text: [真的吗？你要去我老家玩儿啊？]
english_text: [Really? You want to go visit my hometown?]

chinese_text: [我的话我早晚都吃。]
english_text: [As for me, I eat it both in the morning and evening.]

chinese_text: [诶，我可听说王阿姨那人家谁给钱多，她可就往好里夸呀，你还敢找王阿姨给你介绍。]
english_text: [Hey, I've heard that Auntie Wang praises whoever pays her more, and you still dare to ask Auntie Wang to introduce you to someone?]

chinese_text: [哎他是个老板吗？]
english_text: [Hey, is he a boss?]

chinese_text: [嗯，这是有点恶心。]
english_text: [Hmm, this is a bit disgusting.]

chinese_text: [王阿姨给你介绍的？]
english_text: [Introduced by Auntie Wang?]

chinese_text: [我觉得不至于吧，品品茶不是也挺好的吗？]
english_text: [I don't think it's that bad, isn't it nice to just taste some tea?]

chinese_text: [他以为他是在，[laughing]他以为他是在面试我吗？]
english_text: [He thought he was, [laughing] did he think he was interviewing me?]

chinese_text: [嗯，什么西湖龙井，信阳毛尖，跟我开始扯什么商朝。我说，先生咱不是在相亲吗？]
english_text: [Hmm, talking about West Lake Longjing, Xinyang Maojian, and then started rambling on about the Shang Dynasty with me. I said, sir, aren't we here on a blind date?]

chinese_text: [品，不是，不是你怎么也不懂呢？]
english_text: [Tasting tea, no, no, how come you don't understand?]

chinese_text: [你说到这个我就来气，你知道我今天遇到了什么人吗？]
english_text: [When you mention this, it makes me angry. Do you know what kind of person I met today?]

chinese_text: [啊，我知道了我知道了，那真的是有点恶心了。]
english_text: [Ah, I get it, I get it. That really is a bit disgusting.]

chinese_text: [他是在以上位者的姿态在俯视我，他在审视我，很恶心。]
english_text: [He was looking down on me with a superior attitude, he was examining me, it's disgusting.]

chinese_text: [一坐下，他就开始品品品茶吧，我说品茶？品什么茶？]
english_text: [As soon as we sat down, he started tasting, tasting, tasting tea. I said, tasting tea? What tea are we tasting?]

chinese_text: [真的很惹人烦，我真的，烦得我有点恶心。]
english_text: [It's really annoying, I'm so annoyed that I feel a bit disgusted.]

chinese_text: [相亲是为了什么，我们为了互相了解看能不能先进一步发展，他给我讲茶。我说哥咱先别讲茶了，他跟我来一句，行那你自我介绍吧，自我介绍。]
english_text: [What's the purpose of a blind date? We're supposed to get to know each other and see if we can develop further, but he's giving me a lecture on tea. I said, brother, let's not talk about tea for now, and he comes back with, fine then, introduce yourself, introduce yourself.]

chinese_text: [反正派头是很足的。]
english_text: [Anyway, he has a really impressive style.]

chinese_text: [我很我很烦，我真的很烦。我没有见过这样的，其实是就是王阿姨跟我介绍的时候，他不是这样的，他跟我说那个那个孩子，他说是一个很温和很体贴的一个孩子。]
english_text: [I'm so annoyed, I'm really so annoyed. I've never seen anything like this. Actually, when Auntie Wang introduced him, he wasn't like this. She told me about that boy, she said he was a very gentle and considerate person.]

chinese_text: [对，那怎么怎么是个这样的呢!我都怀疑我今天是不是看错了，就是我是不是碰到了其他的人。]
english_text: [Right, how could he be like this! I even wonder if I saw things wrong today, like if I met someone else by mistake.]

chinese_text: [品茶？我们是在相亲，为什么他上来就一副，他上来就是一副他很高，我很低的那样子。]
english_text: [Tea tasting? We're on a blind date, why did he start with such an attitude, acting as if he's superior and I'm inferior.]

chinese_text: [啊，你你你太敏感了吧。]
english_text: [Oh, you're being too sensitive.]

chinese_text: [那还能是什么原因呢？我看你们之前其实相处得挺好的呀。]
english_text: [What other reason could there be? I thought you two were getting along quite well before.]

chinese_text: [你咋了？你状态不对呀。]
english_text: [What's wrong with you? You're not yourself today.]

chinese_text: [哎，是不是因为上次开会，老板，你们组就表扬了你一个人，没有表扬表扬其他人的原因？]
english_text: [Hey, is it because at the last meeting, the boss praised only you from your team and didn't praise the others?]

chinese_text: [这有病吧她。]
english_text: [She must be crazy.]

chinese_text: [哎，我觉得，我觉得这不是你的问题，是他们的问题。]
english_text: [Hey, I think, I think this isn't your problem, it's their problem.]

chinese_text: [被造谣了！什么谣啊？]
english_text: [Rumors were spread about me! What kind of rumors?]

chinese_text: [你解释也没用，你怎么解释，人家也不相信。你就做好你自己自己得了，别管他们。]
english_text: [It's useless to explain, no matter how you explain it, they won't believe you. Just be yourself and don't worry about them.]

chinese_text: [真的很奇怪。]
english_text: [It's really strange.]

chinese_text: [昨天我爸送我来上班。]
english_text: [Yesterday, my dad gave me a ride to work.]

chinese_text: [所有人都不说话了。一开始他们都在聊天，我一进门，他们就不说话了。]
english_text: [Everyone stopped talking. At first, they were all chatting, but as soon as I entered, they all went silent.]

chinese_text: [差不多有一个礼拜了，每一个人，我都感觉有意无意的不跟我说话。只要我从洗手间或者是从大门口，我一进来。]
english_text: [It's been about a week now. Every person, I feel they're intentionally or unintentionally not talking to me. Whenever I come in from the restroom or from the main entrance.]

chinese_text: [那个我问了，我问了是不是这个。但是我要这么说的话，不会有人去正面回答我的。]
english_text: [I asked, I asked if it was about this. But if I say it like that, no one will give me a direct answer.]

chinese_text: [或者我走到哪儿，他们都会回避我的眼神。等我走过去之后，又有回头看我。]
english_text: [Or wherever I go, they avoid eye contact with me. After I walk past, they turn back to look at me.]

chinese_text: [他后面才告诉我，哎，是因为，是因为被造谣了。]
english_text: [He later told me, hey, it's because, because rumors were spread about me.]

chinese_text: [不是，不是敏感。我跟你说，我我也跟其他朋友聊过嘛。]
english_text: [No, it's not being sensitive. Let me tell you, I've also talked about this with other friends.]

chinese_text: [多离谱。我觉得这种事情，居然是可以造得起谣的吗？还是说造谣真的没有代价呀？而且她这一说，所有的人都信了，为什么？]
english_text: [How ridiculous. I think, for something like this, can rumors actually be spread? Or is there really no consequence for spreading rumors? And yet, as soon as she said it, everyone believed her, why?]

chinese_text: [她到公司说，我每天从不同的男人车上下来。]
english_text: [She told people at the company that I get out of different men's cars every day.]

chinese_text: [我最近不知道怎么回事？我公司里那些同事，莫名其妙的全都不理我了，全都不跟我说话。]
english_text: [I don't know what's been going on recently? All my colleagues at the company are suddenly ignoring me for no reason, none of them will talk to me.]

chinese_text: [我问他，你是不是有什么事情瞒着我？有没有什么事情，是我不知道的或者是怎么样？我缠了他整整一个下午。]
english_text: [I asked him, are you hiding something from me? Is there anything I don't know about or what's going on? I pestered him for an entire afternoon.]

chinese_text: [其他朋友也都也有问过我，是不是太敏感了。没有啊，我之前之前，我们不都不都处得好好的嘛。]
english_text: [Other friends have also asked me if I'm being too sensitive. No, before this, weren't we all getting along just fine?]

chinese_text: [难道我要问他，啊是因为他们，呃上次只表扬了我一个，所以你们不理我吗？不可能会有人这么回答我，对不对？]
english_text: [Am I supposed to ask him, 'Oh, is it because they only praised me last time, so you're ignoring me?' No one would actually answer me like that, right?]

chinese_text: [我要我要怎么去解释呢？]
english_text: [How am I supposed to explain this?]

chinese_text: [不是，我怎么觉得今天这个话题，这么沉沉重呢？嗯，话里有话。]
english_text: [No, why do I feel like today's topic is so heavy? Hmm, there's more to what's being said.]

chinese_text: [后悔是吧？]
english_text: [You regret it, don't you?]

chinese_text: [怎么想着约这儿啊，这不是我们小时候常来的地方吗？]
english_text: [Why did you think of meeting here? Isn't this the place we used to come to often when we were kids?]

chinese_text: [你早干嘛去了？早两年你不说呢？我等了你八年，你早干嘛去了？]
english_text: [Where were you all this time? Why didn't you say something two years earlier? I waited for you for eight years, where were you?]

chinese_text: [[laughing]后悔没有早带我来。]
english_text: [[laughing] I regret not bringing you here sooner.]

chinese_text: [太沉重了有点儿，有点儿太沉重了。我要结婚了。]
english_text: [This is a bit too heavy, a little too heavy. I'm getting married.]

chinese_text: [我今天来是想跟你说这个的。]
english_text: [I came here today to tell you this.]

chinese_text: [我现在都老后悔了。那时候老说，我太忙了，或者我要我要我要这样我要那样，就是，都没好好听过你说这个话。]
english_text: [I really regret it now. Back then, I always said I was too busy, or I wanted this or that, but I never really listened to what you were saying.]

chinese_text: [但现在我觉得，其实你挺好的。我感觉我可能错过了生命中很珍贵的一段感情。]
english_text: [But now I think you're actually a great person. I feel like I might have missed out on a very precious relationship in my life.]

chinese_text: [对啊，那个时候，我记得你老跟我说你喜欢这儿。老让我带你到这儿来，拍拍照，然后看看落叶什么的。]
english_text: [Yeah, back then, I remember you always told me you liked this place. You always asked me to bring you here to take pictures and look at the falling leaves and things like that.]

chinese_text: [你要结婚了？]
english_text: [You're getting married?]

chinese_text: [我懂了。那，祝你幸福。]
english_text: [I understand. Well, I wish you happiness.]

chinese_text: [后悔没有，没有发现你，你这么重要。]
english_text: [I regret not realizing how important you were to me.]

chinese_text: [我现在是想问，我还有弥补的机会吗？]
english_text: [What I want to ask now is, do I still have a chance to make it up to you?]

chinese_text: [没事，我我不希望给你压力啊，你是，我会尊重你的想法。只是我觉得如果我不把这个说出来，我可能会遗憾一辈子。]
english_text: [It's okay, I don't want to pressure you. I will respect your feelings. It's just that I feel if I don't say this, I might regret it for the rest of my life.]

chinese_text: [说是在五天之后，呃，要开始清理楼道内的这个个人物品，说楼道是公共区域。]
english_text: [They said that after five days, they would start removing personal items from the hallway, stating that the hallway is a public area.]

chinese_text: [然后，这么第六天晚上，那天我加班回家的时候。哎，我门口没有了，就那个鞋垫到鞋柜全都没有了。]
english_text: [Then, on the evening of the sixth day, when I came home from working overtime, everything by my door was gone - from the doormat to the shoe cabinet, it was all gone.]

chinese_text: [结果我过几天回家的时候啊，那天晚上回去，门上给我贴了个条儿。]
english_text: [Then when I came home a few days later, that night, there was a notice posted on my door.]

chinese_text: [那个物业太奇葩了。你知道吗？就是我刚搬进去，其实还好，没觉得有什么不一样，就正常那个什么吧。物业费也没有说是特别高或怎么着。]
english_text: [That property management is so ridiculous. You know, when I first moved in, it was actually fine, I didn't notice anything different, just normal stuff. The property management fees weren't particularly high or anything.]

chinese_text: [哎，我想就这，我就没也没在门口放什么。我就放一个鞋垫，再放放一个鞋柜子，柜子上就一双鞋。]
english_text: [Well, because of this, I didn't put much by my door. I just had a doormat and a shoe cabinet with only one pair of shoes on it.]

chinese_text: [哦，你们小区也这样。]
english_text: [Oh, your residential community is like that too?]

chinese_text: [哎，我那个邻居啊，那个大鞋柜放在那儿一动不动。我这边，那个两袋麻袋土豆放门口，他也没收。他就收我的，你猜怎么着？]
english_text: [Hey, let me tell you. My neighbor, they have a large shoe cabinet sitting there that never moves. On my side, they didn't remove two sacks of potatoes by the door. But they took my stuff, guess why?]

chinese_text: [哎，我跟你说。我前几天啊，我就听说隔壁有一小区，他们这小区就是，狗不栓绳，然后咬咬孩子。]
english_text: [Hey, let me tell you. A few days ago, I heard about a community nearby where dogs aren't leashed and then they bite children.]

chinese_text: [它，人家收走了。]
english_text: [It was taken away by them.]

chinese_text: [结果找物业，物业说我不赔，那你去找业主。业主说，你去找物业，就就就这么打架，可烦了。你，你得注意点儿。]
english_text: [So I went to the property management, and they said they wouldn't compensate me and told me to find the owner. The owner told me to go to the property management. They just kept passing the buck, which was so annoying. You need to be more careful.]

chinese_text: [哎哟，我跟你说我最近啊，我搬那个小区啊，我现在老后悔了。]
english_text: [Oh my, let me tell you, I recently moved to that residential complex, and I regret it so much now.]

chinese_text: [哎，收走了，也不说问一下。然后我寻我寻思那，那你它规定贴在那，我以为是假的，那那就还行吧，起码那个人人家提前告知。]
english_text: [They just took it away without even asking. Then I thought, well, the regulation was posted there, but I thought it was fake. But that would have been fine, at least they would have informed people in advance.]

chinese_text: [就这样放一放，也没没关系对吧？我看别人家也没收，我就没管。]
english_text: [I just left it there, thinking it would be fine, right? I saw others weren't being taken away, so I didn't bother.]

chinese_text: [那你们那物业也是不管事儿。]
english_text: [Your property management is really useless too.]

chinese_text: [结果一转头，你猜怎么着？]
english_text: [Then I turned around, and guess what happened?]

chinese_text: [那鞋呢？]
english_text: [What about the shoes?]

chinese_text: [人家根本就不管。就是说哎呀，人家嗯，认识很多年了，这个狗狗从小看到大的，说不会。但是我看到它，它就是嗷嗷乱叫的呀。]
english_text: [They don't care at all. They're like, 'Oh, we've known each other for many years, we've watched this dog grow up since it was a puppy, it won't do anything.' But when I see it, it's barking aggressively.]

chinese_text: [嗷嗷乱叫的那种大狗，不栓绳儿。]
english_text: [That kind of big dog that barks aggressively, not on a leash.]

chinese_text: [物业不管，那大妈可厉害了。]
english_text: [The property management doesn't do anything, but that lady is really something else.]

chinese_text: [她过来骂我一顿。说呃，你家孩子呀，关你什么事儿啊？]
english_text: [She came over and yelled at me, saying, 'What's it to you about my child?']

chinese_text: [我跟物业报告。物业说，哎呀，邻里邻邻里乡亲的，大家互相的体谅体谅吧。我说，我体谅她，谁来体谅我呀？]
english_text: [I reported it to the property management. They said, 'Oh, we're all neighbors here, everyone should be considerate of each other.' I said, 'If I'm considerate of her, who will be considerate of me?']

chinese_text: [就是，就是我我跟物业反馈啊。]
english_text: [Yes, that's right, I gave feedback to the property management.]

chinese_text: [直接被那狗吓哭了，直接吓哭了。我就说，我说你好，能把那狗栓下绳吗？把孩子吓哭了。]
english_text: [My child was scared to tears by that dog, literally scared to tears. I said, 'Excuse me, could you please leash your dog? It's scaring my child.']

chinese_text: [现在那些物业真的是不该管的瞎管，该管的他不管。我们小区里面有人遛狗不拴绳儿，遛狗，大狗。]
english_text: [Nowadays, property management really meddles in things they shouldn't and ignores things they should handle. In our residential complex, there are people walking big dogs without leashes.]

chinese_text: [鞋也跟你走了？]
english_text: [Did they take the shoes too?]

chinese_text: [嗯，真的。]
english_text: [Yeah, really.]

chinese_text: [你现在呀，你你你现在胆子就太小了，你和那个陈鼎天一样。我们得把步子迈大一点点，好不好？]
english_text: [You're being too timid now, just like Chen Dingtian. We need to be a bit bolder, okay?]

chinese_text: [你就相信我，好吧？我以前投资有出现过问题吗？没有吧？哎，咱们现在三个人，搞了这个企业。我现在只能跟你说这些了，陈鼎天他就说不通，我只能拉拢你了。]
english_text: [Just trust me, alright? Have my investments ever had problems before? No, right? Look, the three of us have started this business. This is all I can tell you now. Chen Dingtian just won't listen to reason, so I can only win you over.]

chinese_text: [那拿下之后，我们可以去做，做那个什么综合呃，各种贸易，还有做什么零售贸易，这个都ok的。]
english_text: [After we secure it, we can engage in comprehensive trade, various types of commerce, and retail trade. All of that is fine.]

chinese_text: [你要是不同意我，那就没没法做了。]
english_text: [If you don't agree with me, then it won't be possible to proceed.]

chinese_text: [我好好再给你说说，我这个项目。这个项目真的是好，适合我们公司。]
english_text: [Let me explain my project to you again properly. This project is really good and suitable for our company.]

chinese_text: [而且我这个算比较保守的了，他那个更吓人。你就选择吧，你到底要选哪一个？]
english_text: [Besides, my plan is actually quite conservative compared to his, which is even more outrageous. You just need to choose, which one are you going to pick?]

chinese_text: [没有时间了，大姐，商机不等人。]
english_text: [There's no time left, my friend. Business opportunities don't wait.]

chinese_text: [所以我们来来来来弄，现在是最适合的方式就这个。步子迈大了以后，真的你说不准的。]
english_text: [So let's do this, this is the most suitable way right now. Once you take too big a step, you really can't predict what will happen.]

english_text: [Sure, where are you going to hang out?]

chinese_text: [行，然后到时候。哎，你帮我买条买条裤子吧，最近天气凉了，我想买条新的裤子。但是我现，我的眼光不行，得你来帮我挑。]
english_text: [Okay, and then when the time comes. Hey, can you help me buy a pair of pants? The weather has gotten colder recently, and I want to buy a new pair. But my taste isn't good, so I need you to help me choose.]

chinese_text: [那家有一家万州烤鱼，特别好吃。]
english_text: [There's a Wanzhou grilled fish place that's especially delicious.]

chinese_text: [我好久没有吃烤鱼了。]
english_text: [I haven't had grilled fish in a long time.]

chinese_text: [最近有个喜剧片上了，你看评分还挺高的，去看这个电影。]
english_text: [A comedy movie was released recently. I saw the ratings are quite high, let's go watch that movie.]

chinese_text: [嗯，烤鱼旁边好像就有一家新开的商业街，我觉得可以去那儿逛。]
english_text: [Hmm, it seems there's a newly opened shopping street next to the grilled fish place. I think we can hang out there.]

chinese_text: [那吃完的话，我还想去逛街。]
english_text: [After eating, I still want to go shopping.]

chinese_text: [真的吗？]
english_text: [Really?]

chinese_text: [那，那明天我们去哪儿玩？]
english_text: [So, where are we going to hang out tomorrow?]

chinese_text: [哎呀，你明天能不能不加班儿啊？你陪陪我嘛。]
english_text: [Oh, can you not work overtime tomorrow? Please spend time with me.]

chinese_text: [好，[laughing]你好久都没有陪我了。]
english_text: [Okay, [laughing] you haven't spent time with me for a long time.]

chinese_text: [诶，我好像知道诶。对对对对对，可以，那我们可以去吃那个。]
english_text: [Hey, I think I know. Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, okay, then we can go eat that.]

chinese_text: [交给我。那这样的话，明天呢，我们就嗯中午先去吃烤鱼，然后下午去逛街，对吗？那晚上我们去干什么呀？]
english_text: [Leave it to me. In that case, tomorrow, we'll... um... first go eat grilled fish at noon, then go shopping in the afternoon, right? Then what are we going to do in the evening?]

chinese_text: [啊这个事我可以解释，我我我虽然是做了这个套现这个事儿，但是我发誓这些钱没有一分进到我的口袋里。]
english_text: [Ah, I can explain this matter. Although I did do this cash-out thing, I swear that not a single cent of this money went into my pocket.]

chinese_text: [不是，这个事儿我真的可以解释。我们我们先不要停止这个合作这个事儿，好吗？]
english_text: [No, I really can explain this matter. Let's not stop this cooperation, okay?]

chinese_text: [我不知道。]
english_text: [I don't know.]

chinese_text: [我会尽快把套走的钱补齐，但是您需要给我一些时间，我目前没有办法。]
english_text: [I will replenish the cashed-out money as soon as possible, but you need to give me some time. I currently have no way to do it immediately.]

chinese_text: [一个月。]
english_text: [One month.]

chinese_text: [签字吧！]
english_text: [Sign it!]

chinese_text: [你要同意的话，你就在这个意向书上签个字。你要不同意的话，那找你谈话的就不再是我了，你明白这个意思吧。]
english_text: [If you agree, you just sign this letter of intent. If you don't agree, then it won't be me talking to you anymore, do you understand what I mean?]

chinese_text: [一个月不行太久了，只有十五天的时间，十五天你要是补不回来，那我只能法庭上见了。]
english_text: [One month is too long. You only have fifteen days. If you can't repay it in fifteen days, then I can only see you in court.]

chinese_text: [我不需要你的解释，法律上也不看解释，我现在需要你的解决方案，你给我一个方案现在。]
english_text: [I don't need your explanation, and the law doesn't look at explanations either. What I need now is your solution. Give me a plan now.]

chinese_text: [你多久时间可以把资金补回来？]
english_text: [How long will it take you to replenish the funds?]

chinese_text: [我现在呢对你的这个举动是非常失望的。你没有经过我们的事先的同意，自己去做了这样的事情。]
english_text: [I am very disappointed with your actions now. You did this without our prior consent.]

chinese_text: [所以现在进一步对你的要求就是，你把你自己套现的资金补回来。第二点就是我考虑我的团队是不会再跟你合作，及时止损。]
english_text: [So the further requirement for you now is to replenish the cashed-out funds. Second, I am considering that my team will no longer cooperate with you, to cut our losses in time.]

chinese_text: [我们查账的时候发现，你把账目上那些应该是对公的账目拿去套现了，也就是进到你私人的口袋里了。]
english_text: [When we were auditing the accounts, we discovered that you took the corporate funds that should have been for the company and cashed them out, which means they went into your private pocket.]

chinese_text: [这个事情我需要得到你现在的一个解决方案和态度。]
english_text: [Regarding this matter, I need to get your solution and attitude right now.]

chinese_text: [钱有没有进你的口袋，那是你和我们审计部门的事情，我在这里就不想再多说了。]
english_text: [Whether the money went into your pocket or not is a matter between you and our audit department. I don't want to say more about it here.]

chinese_text: [今天为什么找你来，你知道吧？]
english_text: [You know why I asked you to come today, right?]

chinese_text: [今天我我找你来只是通知你这个事情，没有任何商量的余地。]
english_text: [Today I asked you to come just to inform you about this matter. There is no room for negotiation.]

chinese_text: [大姐，我觉得是这样的啊，你看你这天天开个车，车也挺漂亮的是吧？人也挺漂亮的，怎么净干这不漂亮的事呢？这车位是你买的吗？]
english_text: [Ma'am, I think it's like this, you see, you drive a car every day, the car is quite beautiful, right? And you're quite beautiful too, so why do you keep doing such unattractive things? Did you buy this parking spot?]

chinese_text: [哎大姐咱们这样商量啊，我要不用的时候你想怎么停怎么停，就当我白给你的了，好吧？但是我要用的时候，麻烦你给我让一下，行吗？]
english_text: [Hey ma'am, let's discuss it this way. When I'm not using it, you can park however you want, consider it a free gift from me, okay? But when I need to use it, could you please make way for me, alright?]

chinese_text: [来你现在给我挪来。]
english_text: [Come on, move it for me now.]

chinese_text: [是这样啊，就是如果说呢我可以停楼上的话，我就停楼上了。但是这个车位它不是我买的吗？大姐咱讲讲理行不行？]
english_text: [It's like this, if I could park upstairs, I would park upstairs. But didn't I buy this parking spot? Ma'am, can we be reasonable?]

chinese_text: [大姐，你的一会儿是，从晚上的九点停到第二天早上七点上班是吧？]
english_text: [Ma'am, you park from 9 PM to 7 AM the next morning when you go to work, right?]

chinese_text: [是，你平时我不用的时候你用一下就行了对吧？你不能天天用吧？你用完了你看我这每天骑着骑骑我这胯子我都没地方往往里放了对不对？你搁这我买的车位，你搁这我把车放哪啊？]
english_text: [Yes, you can use it when I'm not using it normally, right? But you can't use it every day, right? After you're done using it, look, I have nowhere to put my bike every day, right? This is the parking spot I bought, where am I supposed to park my car?]

chinese_text: [车位是我买的，我想停哪停哪对不对？现在是这个车位你没付款，你现在占着我的车位我跟你，想要用我的车位我还得跟你商量是吧？]
english_text: [I bought the parking spot, so I can park wherever I want, right? The thing is, you didn't pay for this spot, and now you're occupying my spot. When I want to use my own parking spot, I have to negotiate with you, is that right?]

chinese_text: [我让呀你给我打个电话，我就下来挪车呗。这有什么可吵的呀？我又不是说诚心就占你的车位不走啦。]
english_text: [I'll move it if you give me a call, and I'll come down to move the car. What's there to argue about? I'm not intentionally occupying your spot and refusing to leave.]

chinese_text: [挪就挪。]
english_text: [Fine, I'll move it then.]

chinese_text: [这不也没多久嘛，你本来早上有时候你出门有时候又不出门的，我怎么摸得准你什么时候停车呀？那我就偶尔就这样放一下呗。]
english_text: [It's not like it's been there for long. Sometimes you go out in the morning, sometimes you don't, how can I possibly predict when you'll be parking? So I occasionally just leave it there for a bit.]

chinese_text: [不是你这个停这，楼下都多方便，你直接停楼上呗。]
english_text: [No, if you're going to park here, it's so much more convenient downstairs. Why don't you just park upstairs?]

chinese_text: [不是你这空着你也不放车呀，我这放一下怎么啦？]
english_text: [But you're not even using this empty space for your car, so what's wrong with me parking here for a moment?]

chinese_text: [我不是说你跟我商量，我这不是就每天就停这么一会儿，我又没停多久，你说的好像我成天一天到晚就占这不走了似的。]
english_text: [I'm not saying you need to consult me, but I only park here for a little while each day. I don't park for long, yet you talk as if I'm occupying this space all day long and never leaving.]

chinese_text: [有什么没法儿说的，你跟我还不能说呀！]
english_text: [What's there that can't be said? You can tell me anything!]

chinese_text: [你又不一定一定要干这个，你别难过呀哥。]
english_text: [You don't necessarily have to do this, so don't be sad, brother.]

chinese_text: [你有什么平时压在心里的话，你不敢跟嫂子说的你跟我说。]
english_text: [If there's anything you've been holding back in your heart, anything you don't dare tell your wife, you can tell me.]

chinese_text: [哥我是你妹妹，除了父母咱俩是这个世界上最亲的人，你有什么不能跟我说的？]
english_text: [Brother, I'm your sister. Besides our parents, we're the closest people in this world to each other. What could you possibly not be able to tell me?]

chinese_text: [哥，昨天听嫂子说你失业了？]
english_text: [Brother, I heard from your wife yesterday that you lost your job?]

chinese_text: [哎呀，没事儿多大事呀！现在工作这么好找是不是？你又这么努力，这么优秀的不愁找不着工作。]
english_text: [Oh, it's nothing, it's not a big deal! Jobs are easy to find these days, right? With how hardworking and outstanding you are, you won't have trouble finding a job.]

chinese_text: [四十五怎么了？多少人都是四五十岁才发家呢。]
english_text: [What's wrong with being forty-five? Plenty of people make their fortune in their forties or fifties.]

chinese_text: [咱们俩有什么不能说的呀！]
english_text: [What could there be that we can't talk about!]

chinese_text: [你哥我都四十五啦！好找工作吗？]
english_text: [Your brother is already forty-five! How easy is it to find a job at this age?]

chinese_text: [我没法儿跟你说。]
english_text: [I can't tell you.]

chinese_text: [唉，你嫂子也是跟你说这干啥？]
english_text: [Sigh, why did your wife tell you about this anyway?]

chinese_text: [我没法儿说[Sobbing]。]
english_text: [I can't say [Sobbing].]

chinese_text: [我跟你也没法说，我跟你嫂子也没法说。]
english_text: [I can't talk to you, and I can't talk to your wife either.]

chinese_text: [你自己在公司不也做的是hr吗？你们公司会找像哥这样四十五岁的人啊？]
english_text: [Don't you work in HR at your company? Would your company hire someone like your brother who's forty-five?]

chinese_text: [这再说一千道一万不也得挣钱也得活嘛，是不是？[laughing][Sobbing]你说这挺挺老大不小的整这出儿[laughing]。]
english_text: [When all is said and done, you still need to earn money to live, right? [laughing][Sobbing] Here you are, at such an age, pulling this stunt [laughing].]

chinese_text: [[Sobbing]就那样儿吧，没啥说的，有啥可说的呀。]
english_text: [[Sobbing] It is what it is, nothing to say, what is there to say.]

chinese_text: [你不要跟我说尽量。能做，咱们就做，不能做，咱就趁早辞职，好吧，就这样。]
english_text: [Don't tell me you'll 'try your best.' If you can do it, then we do it. If you can't, then quit early, okay? That's it.]

chinese_text: [那你跟我说，不是客观原因是什么原因？主观原因，我的原因。我花钱过来还让你，雇着花钱过来，让你教训我来了，是吧？]
english_text: [Then tell me, if it's not objective reasons, what reasons are there? Subjective reasons, my reasons? I'm paying you, I hired you with my money, did I pay you to come lecture me, is that it?]

chinese_text: [哎，我花钱雇你来，不是说让你来给我玩儿尽力的。你跟我玩什么呢？玩尽力局呢，啊？]
english_text: [Hey, I didn't pay you to come here and just 'do your best.' What are you playing at with me? Playing the 'do your best' game, huh?]

chinese_text: [不是，我就奇了怪了，你们现在这些年轻人，怎么这么喜欢去找其他原因啊。你先不要说别人问题，他的问题，一会我会说他。咱现在说的是，你的问题。]
english_text: [No, I just find it strange, you young people these days, why do you always like to find other reasons? Don't talk about other people's problems, his problems, I'll deal with him later. What we're talking about now is your problem.]

chinese_text: [这就是你给我的理由啊？]
english_text: [Is this the reason you're giving me?]

chinese_text: [你觉得，你还有下次吗？啊？]
english_text: [Do you think there will be a next time for you? Huh?]

chinese_text: [有多难搞？你是老板我是老板？啊，我花钱雇你来，就是让你来解决问题来了。]
english_text: [How difficult is it? Are you the boss or am I the boss? Huh, I pay you to come here to solve problems.]

chinese_text: [咱是一个公司，这项目做成了，咱是要挣钱的。做不成了，一堆人张着嘴，管我要钱要吃饭。你给我解决问题，啊？]
english_text: [We are one company. If this project succeeds, we make money. If it fails, a bunch of people will come to me with their mouths open asking for money and food. You solve the problem for me, got it?]

chinese_text: [讲道理是吧？我给你发工资了没有？按时按月发了没有？]
english_text: [You want to reason, right? Did I pay you or not? Did I pay you on time every month?]

chinese_text: [不是说是花钱雇你来，让你给我找问题来了，对不对？]
english_text: [I didn't pay you to find problems for me, did I?]

chinese_text: [你你不知道这次这个客户，有多难搞。]
english_text: [You don't know how difficult this client is.]

chinese_text: [我不是教训你，我是在跟你讲道理。这这事情明摆着是这样，那你。]
english_text: [I'm not lecturing you, I'm reasoning with you. This situation is obviously like this, so you...]

chinese_text: [那同组的那个谁，他不也没搞定吗？]
english_text: [That guy from the same group, he didn't get it done either, did he?]

chinese_text: [可是我也想，我也想完成这个单子。但是问题是，这些都是客观原因呀，也不是我的问题呀。]
english_text: [But I want to complete this order too. But the problem is, these are all objective reasons, not my fault.]

chinese_text: [嗯，对不起老板。我知道这次我真的没做好，但我下回一定努力。]
english_text: [Well, sorry boss. I know I really didn't do well this time, but I'll definitely work harder next time.]

chinese_text: [我已经尽力了。]
english_text: [I've already tried my best.]

chinese_text: [那那我那我再去试试，我尽量把他拿下。]
english_text: [Then, then, then I'll try again, I'll do my best to get him.]

chinese_text: [那肯定是我做的呀，那不可能一个人做出两个菜的味儿啊。]
english_text: [Of course I made it. It's impossible for one person to make two dishes with different tastes.]

chinese_text: [啊？这菜咋了？这不是已经做第二遍了吗？]
english_text: [Huh? What's wrong with this dish? Isn't this already the second time I've made it?]

chinese_text: [找事呢吧？这道菜的做法，咱们咱们店从来没变过呀！]
english_text: [Looking for trouble, aren't you? The way this dish is prepared has never changed in our restaurant!]

chinese_text: [味儿不对？]
english_text: [The taste is wrong?]

chinese_text: [我觉得吧，他甭管是怎么样，但别跟客户起冲突，是吧？]
english_text: [I think, no matter what, you shouldn't conflict with customers, right?]

chinese_text: [一直都是按照菜谱上面就做的呀，怎么会有味道呢？]
english_text: [It's always been made according to the recipe, how could there be a problem with the taste?]

chinese_text: [哎呀就这样吧，我觉得他压根儿就没吃过这道菜，他根本就不懂。你何必跟他争执呢？是吧？]
english_text: [Oh, just let it go. I think he's never even eaten this dish before, he doesn't understand it at all. Why bother arguing with him? Right?]

chinese_text: [这味儿对啊？这味有什么问题啊？]
english_text: [The taste is right, isn't it? What's wrong with the taste?]

chinese_text: [嗯给他换道菜，呃再给他这个赠送一盘甜点，行不行？]
english_text: [Well, change his dish, and, uh, give him a complimentary dessert, okay?]

chinese_text: [你这样啊，你不行呢，你推荐他换一道菜，不行就别上这道菜，好不好？]
english_text: [Here's what you do: if it's not working, recommend he change to a different dish. If that doesn't work, just don't serve this dish, alright?]

chinese_text: [一上来就说这菜味味儿不对，但我觉得吧，他就找找茬儿。他今天啊来的时候，我看他就鬼鬼祟祟的，他的面相就感觉很奇怪。]
english_text: [Right from the start, he said the taste of this dish is wrong, but I think he's just looking for trouble. When he came in today, I saw him acting suspiciously, his facial expression seemed very strange.]

chinese_text: [厨师长这菜又被退回来了。]
english_text: [Head chef, this dish has been sent back again.]

chinese_text: [这人你说哪有来餐厅鬼鬼祟祟，人家大大方方来吃饭。他一进门儿他就在那东张西望的，我就感觉这人不对。]
english_text: [You see, who comes to a restaurant acting all sneaky? Normal people come to eat openly. The moment he walked in, he started looking around everywhere, and I felt something was off with this guy.]

chinese_text: [我刚还去了，他说他上次来的时候，不是这个味儿。我说你上次啥时候来的？他说上次就是上周，那上周不也是你做的吗！]
english_text: [I just went there, and he said it didn't taste the same as last time. I asked him when he came last time, and he said it was last week. But didn't you make it last week too!]

chinese_text: [这种人多了去了，但是，咱咱就这么处理吧啊！]
english_text: [There are plenty of people like that, but, well, let's just handle it this way!]

chinese_text: [不知道玩啊，那顾客说味儿不对啊。]
english_text: [What's there to understand? The customer said the taste was off.]

chinese_text: [你说他是不找事啊？]
english_text: [Would you say he's not looking for trouble?]

chinese_text: [你这还让他捞着便宜了还。]
english_text: [You even let him get away with it.]

chinese_text: [那万一就是想吃霸王餐找事儿呢？]
english_text: [What if he's just trying to get a free meal by causing trouble?]

chinese_text: [行行行吧。]
english_text: [Alright, alright, alright.]

chinese_text: [呃，我我，我老婆又是在家自己全职带孩子，孩子孩子要上学，你都不知道现在这孩子上学多贵。]
english_text: [Uh, my wife is a full-time stay-at-home mom, and the kids need to go to school. You have no idea how expensive schooling is for kids these days.]

chinese_text: [你随便报个班儿，你说别的别的这家长都给孩子报这班儿，你说咱报不报？不报，人家明明年开学的时候，老师们就不讲这一部分，没办法儿这钱都是免不了的。]
english_text: [You sign up for any class, and you see other parents enrolling their kids in these classes. Do we enroll or not? If we don't, the teachers won't even cover that part when school starts. There's no way around it; this money is unavoidable.]

chinese_text: [咋了？出啥事了？]
english_text: [What's wrong? What happened?]

chinese_text: [你你你最近过得咋样？我怎么感觉你好像垂头丧气的呢？]
english_text: [How have you been lately? Why do I feel like you're so downcast?]

chinese_text: [上礼拜刚去医院查的，腰肌老损不说，完了这个颈椎现在还有点问题。我现在基本上就是，一直对着电脑我这么看着，我隔个几分钟我就得起来，我得活动活动这脖子。]
english_text: [I just went to the hospital for a check-up last week. Not to mention the chronic lumbar muscle strain, but now my cervical spine is also having some issues. Basically, now I'm constantly staring at the computer, and every few minutes, I have to get up and move my neck around.]

chinese_text: [这个工作，这个就业环境，这个情况，咱能不被开除就不错了，对不对？唉，都攒不下钱，都是勉强糊口。]
english_text: [With this job, this employment environment, this situation, it's already good enough that we're not getting fired, right? Sigh, we can't even save money, just barely making ends meet.]

chinese_text: [你心里面儿别太自责了，我觉得有些东西它是不可避免的对吧？你像这种天灾人祸的事儿。]
english_text: [Don't blame yourself too much. I think some things are unavoidable, right? Like these natural disasters and accidents.]

chinese_text: [因为啥呀？]
english_text: [Why?]

chinese_text: [哎呀，我其实我挺能理解你的心情的。]
english_text: [Ah, I can actually understand how you're feeling.]

chinese_text: [我听你男朋友说不是，那狗不是当当下儿，就就没了吗？它也没遭受啥痛苦，我觉得可能对于它来说也算是比较好的一个，一个归宿吧。]
english_text: [I heard from your boyfriend that the dog passed away suddenly, right? It didn't suffer much pain. I think for it, this might have been a relatively good ending.]

chinese_text: [嗯，这这事这这种事儿看看看怎么说，看你怎么想，我觉得其实。]
english_text: [Well, this kind of thing depends on how you look at it, how you think about it. I actually think...]

chinese_text: [哎呦喂这，也没办法的事儿，你说这这。]
english_text: [Oh dear, this is something that can't be helped. What can you say about this?]

chinese_text: [因为车祸。]
english_text: [Because of a car accident.]

chinese_text: [你说它但凡是安乐死的，如果它是寿终正寝我都没有这么难过，我觉得它是幸福的。]
english_text: [If it had been euthanized or died of old age, I wouldn't be this sad. I would feel that it had a happy ending.]

chinese_text: [但是这种意外发生，我就会很自责，我觉得是我没有照顾好它。]
english_text: [But when this kind of accident happens, I feel very guilty. I feel like I didn't take good care of it.]

chinese_text: [它是被车撞的，它一定很疼啊。]
english_text: [It was hit by a car, it must have been in so much pain.]

chinese_text: [我跟它相处了这么多年了，嗯，我就感觉把它当家人一样。它现在这样离开我了，我真的很难过。]
english_text: [I've spent so many years with it, and I feel like it's family to me. Now that it's left me like this, I'm really sad.]

chinese_text: [我没不让你说呀，你现在不就在说吗？我也没堵你嘴啊，你要说说呗。我不是给你道歉了吗？我说对不起嘛不是？]
english_text: [I'm not stopping you from talking, are you? You're talking right now. I didn't cover your mouth. If you want to talk, then talk. Didn't I apologize to you? I said I'm sorry, didn't I?]

chinese_text: [那这半半个小时也也也还行，你看今天这天儿。]
english_text: [Well, half an hour isn't too bad, considering the weather today.]

chinese_text: [咱咱咱不说以前的，咱别老翻旧账行不行？就咱就说这回我我我错了，我给你道个歉，对不起，好不好？]
english_text: [Let's not talk about the past, can we stop bringing up old issues? Let's just focus on this time. I was wrong, I apologize to you, I'm sorry, okay?]

chinese_text: [我我我错了行不行？]
english_text: [I was wrong, okay?]

chinese_text: [行，我我我错了，我真不是故意的。]
english_text: [Fine, I was wrong, I really didn't do it on purpose.]

chinese_text: [那咱就说今天的事儿呗，说昨天，说说说上几次的事干啥？那不是翻旧账是啥嘛？]
english_text: [Then let's just talk about today's matter. Why bring up yesterday or the previous times? What is that if not bringing up old issues?]

chinese_text: [你你先别急，你听我说啊，我确实提前出门儿了，但是你没想到这燕郊进京那块儿又有个岗哨在那儿卡着。我又没拿身份证，我这不又开车回去拿了一下身份证，这不就晚了？]
english_text: [Don't be anxious, listen to me. I did leave early, but you didn't expect there to be another checkpoint at the Yanjiao to Beijing area, did you? I didn't bring my ID, so I had to drive back to get it, which made me late.]

chinese_text: [我这我这我这路上堵车呢。]
english_text: [I was stuck in traffic on my way here.]

chinese_text: [不是我不是翻旧账，你一次又一次的迟到，你还不让我说了？那我当你这是第一次迟到吗？如果你这是第一次迟到，我有这么生气吗？]
english_text: [I'm not bringing up old issues. You've been late time and time again, and you won't even let me talk about it? Should I pretend this is the first time you've been late? If this were the first time, would I be this angry?]

chinese_text: [我不说上几次的事儿，那那你觉得如果说第一次我有这么生气吗？第一次我会这样生气吗？你记不记得你第一次迟到的时候？]
english_text: [If I don't mention the previous times, do you think I would be this angry if it were the first time? Would I be this angry the first time? Do you remember the first time you were late?]

chinese_text: [你要是能提前够时间出门儿的话，你就算堵这么久，也不会迟到这么久呀。我都等你多长时间了？我在这儿坐了半个小时了已经。]
english_text: [If you had left early enough, even with this much traffic, you wouldn't have been this late. How long have I been waiting for you? I've already been sitting here for half an hour.]

chinese_text: [这是理由吗？路上堵车你不知道提提前出门儿啊？]
english_text: [Is that an excuse? You didn't know you should leave earlier because of traffic?]

chinese_text: [半个小时也还行？你听听你说的话！]
english_text: [Half an hour is acceptable? Listen to what you're saying!]

chinese_text: [你这是第几次迟到了？]
english_text: [How many times have you been late now?]

chinese_text: [不是，那你说我翻旧账，我只是在跟你陈述事实好吗？]
english_text: [No, you say I'm bringing up old issues, but I'm just stating the facts to you, okay?]

chinese_text: [说好的一点整到，你这迟到多久了？]
english_text: [We agreed to meet at 1 o'clock sharp, how late are you now?]

chinese_text: [不是，我不买房子，我还是个学生，我买不起房子，你们从哪知道的我的电话呀？]
english_text: [No, I'm not buying a house. I'm still a student and can't afford a house. Where did you get my phone number from?]

chinese_text: [哎，我都已经跟你们说过多少次了，不要再给我打电话了，为什么还要一直给我打电话，这不是骚扰是什么？]
english_text: [Sigh, how many times have I told you not to call me anymore? Why do you keep calling me? If this isn't harassment, what is?]

chinese_text: [哎呀，你赶紧挂了吧，再也不要给我打过来了！]
english_text: [Oh my, just hang up already, and never call me again!]

chinese_text: [随机拨打，那你们从哪儿找着我的电话号码的？]
english_text: [Random dialing? Then where did you find my phone number?]

chinese_text: [哎呀，不需要不需要不需要！]
english_text: [Oh my, no, no, no! I don't need it!]

chinese_text: [怎么又是你呀，你给我打多少遍电话啦？]
english_text: [How is it you again? How many times have you called me?]

chinese_text: [我我是挺幸运的，哎，但是呢，哎，你天天这样骚扰我，你是不是已经构成骚扰了，我是不是可以打电话报警啦！]
english_text: [I-I guess I'm lucky, but, well, you harassing me like this every day, haven't you already committed harassment? Can't I call the police!]

chinese_text: [那我都说了不需要了。]
english_text: [But I already said I don't need it.]

chinese_text: [我都说了不需要啦！]
english_text: [I already told you I don't need it!]

chinese_text: [你那边是机器人是吗？]
english_text: [Are you a robot?]

chinese_text: [以后不要再给我打电话了，听到了吗？]
english_text: [Don't call me again in the future, do you hear me?]

chinese_text: [啊，是这样的女士，我们是正常的宣传我们的房地产业务的，不涉及到骚扰这个层面的。]
english_text: [Ah, well, ma'am, we're just promoting our real estate business normally, which doesn't constitute harassment.]

chinese_text: [哎，好嘞，谢谢再见。]
english_text: [Sigh, alright then, thank you, goodbye.]

chinese_text: [啊，我们这边都是随机拨打的号码的。]
english_text: [Ah, we randomly dial numbers here.]

chinese_text: [海景房山景房，您都可以了解一下，您花时间的话，可以到这边来看一下，我可以安排这边车，直接到我们这边来看。]
english_text: [Sea-view houses, mountain-view houses, you can learn about them. If you have time, you can come here to see them. I can arrange a car to bring you directly here.]

chinese_text: [啊，女士您不要生气，我们这边只是给您推荐一下比较匹配您的房型，觉得您这边还是对这些比较有。]
english_text: [Ah, ma'am, please don't be angry. We're just recommending housing types that match you well, and we think you're quite interested in these.]

chinese_text: [啊，不是的女士，我们这边是直接跟您沟通的。]
english_text: [Ah, no, ma'am, we're communicating with you directly.]

chinese_text: [啊，女士是这样的啊，我们这边秦皇岛阿那亚黄金海滩豪华别墅您了解一下吗？]
english_text: [Ah, ma'am, well, would you be interested in our luxury villas at Aranya Gold Beach in Qinhuangdao?]

chinese_text: [啊，我们这边有我们自己的途径是网络拨号，随机拨号，呃，拨到您的，啊，您这边也是挺幸运的呢!]
english_text: [Ah, we have our own methods, which is network dialing, random dialing, uh, we dialed you, ah, you're quite lucky then!]

chinese_text: [啊，先生是这样的，我也很想帮你，但是我现在也无能为力是吧？]
english_text: [Ah, sir, it's like this, I'd really like to help you, but I'm powerless right now, right?]

chinese_text: [嗯，我知道我能理解你的心情，但是那我也没办法呀。这是这是客观因素，也不是我想不给你取钱的啊。]
english_text: [Hmm, I know, I can understand your feelings, but there's nothing I can do. This is an objective factor, it's not that I don't want to let you withdraw money.]

chinese_text: [那那您去隔壁的商店借一下呢？您如果这么着急的话。]
english_text: [Then, then could you borrow from the shop next door? If you're in such a hurry.]

chinese_text: [那我们这个坏了我也不会修，我是不是得等技术人员过来修了，再给您做呢？]
english_text: [Well, I can't fix this if it's broken, don't I have to wait for a technician to come and fix it before I can serve you?]

chinese_text: [先生我跟您说了今天这里取不了！]
english_text: [Sir, I told you, you can't withdraw money here today!]

chinese_text: [啊，取钱啊？今天办不了。]
english_text: [Ah, withdraw money? Can't do it today.]

chinese_text: [哎我知道先生，我能理解你，我现在也是非常着急的心情，但是。]
english_text: [I know, sir, I understand you, and I'm also very anxious right now, but...]

chinese_text: [啊，今天我们这个柜台这边有点问题需要处理一下。]
english_text: [Ah, there's an issue at our counter today that needs to be resolved.]

chinese_text: [啊行，我去叫经理。]
english_text: [Alright, I'll go get the manager.]

chinese_text: [嗯，您着急用钱可以去隔壁的银行看看嘛。]
english_text: [Well, if you need money urgently, you could check the bank next door.]

chinese_text: [那我现在着急用咋办？对不对？]
english_text: [So what should I do if I need it urgently now? Right?]

chinese_text: [啊是是这么道理，但是我现在要着急用这个钱。我现在立马立刻马上我要取这个钱，你有没有什么其他的办法？]
english_text: [Yes, that makes sense, but I need this money urgently. I need to withdraw this money right now, immediately. Do you have any other solutions?]

chinese_text: [取不了取不了是吗？来取不了你叫你们经理吧，我不跟你说了。]
english_text: [Can't withdraw, can't withdraw, is that it? Fine, if it can't be withdrawn, call your manager. I'm not talking to you anymore.]

chinese_text: [你们这个银行对吧？你们得有这种应急预案是不是？你我不是说我现在来了你跟我说一句，说哎我现在不能取就不取了。]
english_text: [This is your bank, right? You should have emergency plans for situations like this, don't you? I'm not saying that I came here and you just tell me you can't withdraw and that's it.]

chinese_text: [呃不不不这样这样这样，你不要跟我车轱辘话哈，一直跟我说理解我理解我。你你要能理解我你就帮我把钱取了，我来这是来解决问题的，不是说是需要你理解我的好不好？]
english_text: [No, no, no, stop going in circles with me, constantly saying you understand me. If you really understood me, you would help me withdraw my money. I came here to solve problems, not to need your understanding, okay?]

chinese_text: [啊，不是你这样行行行，我不需要你理解我的心情，我需要你帮我解决问题。我得把这个钱取出来，我今天着急用你能听明白吗？]
english_text: [No, alright, alright, I don't need you to understand my feelings, I need you to help me solve my problem. I need to get this money out, I need it urgently today, do you understand?]

chinese_text: [不是那我现在着急用钱，我我我取一下不行吗？你看能不能通融一下？]
english_text: [But I need the money urgently now, can't I just make a withdrawal? Can't you make an exception for me?]

chinese_text: [啊，你是在跟我开玩笑是不是？我到隔壁商店去借一下？我要取的是大额存款，我今天需要用这笔钱，你听不明白是咋回事儿？]
english_text: [Are you kidding me? Go borrow from the shop next door? I'm trying to withdraw a large sum of money, I need this money today, don't you understand what's going on?]

chinese_text: [你好，我取一下钱。]
english_text: [Hello, I'd like to withdraw some money.]

chinese_text: [为啥办不了啊？]
english_text: [Why can't it be done?]

chinese_text: [不是我只有这一个卡，我要是能我要是能去别的银行，我不就不上你们这儿来了吗？]
english_text: [This is my only card. If I could go to another bank, I wouldn't have come here, would I?]

chinese_text: [你再问问你再问问你，你你哥那边儿还能不能借点儿钱？]
english_text: [Ask again, ask again, can your brother lend us some money?]

chinese_text: [这咋弄？我现在都不知道该咋弄了，我跟我爸我妈他们都张过嘴了，这老头老太太已经给给已经垫了一部分了，他还找他们去垫呀？]
english_text: [What should we do? I don't even know what to do now. I've already asked my dad and mom, and the old folks have already covered part of it. Should I ask them to cover more?]

chinese_text: [我求了没用啊，我跟他说了有用我还在这儿愁啥呀？你关键是马上这这这咱就要下地，要下地要种要弄。]
english_text: [Begging is useless. If talking to him worked, why would I still be worrying here? The key point is that we need to get to the fields soon, to plant and work the land.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，你说这可咋弄啊？这眼瞅着这马上就要春耕了你说这，你说咱这水渠这事儿还没着落呢？我上哪儿弄那么多钱去呀？]
english_text: [Oh my, what should we do? Spring plowing is just around the corner, and our irrigation channel issue is still unresolved. Where am I supposed to get that much money?]

chinese_text: [哎上学是肯定得上学嘛，那我去借也也得让孩子上这个学呀。你关键是，哎呀这不能让这地荒着呀，这这咋弄？]
english_text: [Well, of course the child has to go to school. I'll borrow money if I have to, but the child must get an education. The key point is, we can't let the land lie fallow. What should we do?]

chinese_text: [那水引不进去你光种了有啥用啊？咱不能说天天那么大果园儿，那那几十亩果园儿咱俩不能这天天提着水桶上去弄吧。]
english_text: [What's the use of just planting if we can't get water in? We can't be carrying water buckets every day for such a large orchard, for dozens of acres of orchard, can we?]

chinese_text: [关键垫他们也没有啊，你说这这玩意儿救急，他也他确实没有咋救这个急呀？]
english_text: [The key is they don't have money to cover it either. You say this is for emergency relief, but if they really don't have it, how can they provide emergency relief?]

chinese_text: [我说我能不能分期给你，我说我先给你一部分。我说等这边儿果子收了，咱这边果子落地卖了钱我再给你，他不行嘛他。]
english_text: [I asked if I could pay in installments, that I could give him part of it first. I said after we harvest the fruits here, after the fruits are picked and sold, I would give him the rest, but he wouldn't agree.]

chinese_text: [你关键我跟那李老板商量了半天，他跟我说了说他直接把机器弄上来，弄上来给咱挖这个渠。你关键挖这个渠他现在张嘴管我要二十万，我上哪儿弄这些钱就给他二十万去？]
english_text: [The key is, I discussed with Boss Li for a long time, and he told me he would bring up the machinery directly to dig the channel for us. But now he's asking me for 200,000 yuan to dig the channel. Where am I supposed to get that much money to give him 200,000 yuan?]

chinese_text: [那能怎么办呢？那不能就这样眼瞅着它这样儿吧？]
english_text: [So what can be done? We can't just watch it go on like this, can we?]

chinese_text: [我都问过了，我所有人都问遍了，唉他们最近也不好。]
english_text: [I've already asked everyone, I've asked them all, but they're not doing well recently either.]

chinese_text: [你不行你去求求人家呢？]
english_text: [If you can't, why don't you go and beg them?]

chinese_text: [你说这怎么办呀？这没钱了明年孩子学费怎么交呀？那他小小年纪不能不上学了吧？]
english_text: [What do you think we should do? We're out of money, how will we pay for the child's tuition next year? He can't just drop out of school at such a young age, right?]

chinese_text: [啊，对对对对对，我看的就是那个。]
english_text: [Ah, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, that's the one I watched.]

chinese_text: [哎呦哇，他也太帅了。]
english_text: [Wow, he's so handsome.]

chinese_text: [哎哎，我知道他，他我知道。]
english_text: [Hey, hey, I know him, I know him.]

chinese_text: [哎，没事，下回我指定能见上的。]
english_text: [Ah, it's okay, I'll definitely get to meet him next time.]

chinese_text: [我以为你见着他呢？]
english_text: [I thought you had met him?]

chinese_text: [听着也不好看呀!]
english_text: [It doesn't sound good either!]

chinese_text: [你见着他啦？]
english_text: [Did you meet him?]

chinese_text: [满足一下他们精神需求，就专门有一帮人就开车帮毒贩运送这些物资，然后挣这个钱，讲这么个事儿的。]
english_text: [To satisfy their spiritual needs, there's a group of people who specifically drive to help drug dealers transport these supplies and earn money, that's what the story is about.]

chinese_text: [然后他们就是有一些生活上的必需品，他们有钱花不出去，他不挣很多钱吗？]
english_text: [And they have some daily necessities, they have money they can't spend, don't they earn a lot of money?]

chinese_text: [我这我这，我跟他又不熟是吧？]
english_text: [Well, well, I'm not familiar with him, right?]

chinese_text: [上音乐节，你不知道吗？]
english_text: [At the music festival, didn't you know?]

chinese_text: [我没见着他，但是他在那个片儿里面演戏了，演的特别好我觉得。]
english_text: [I didn't meet him, but he acted in that movie, and I think he performed really well.]

chinese_text: [呃，那那那片叫啥名，我忘了，反正他他不是在那边演哑巴吗？]
english_text: [Uh, what's the name of that movie, I forgot, but wasn't he playing a mute person in it?]

chinese_text: [好看！我觉得里面尤尤尤尤其是啊，尤其是那个那谁，蒋琪明演的特别好，蒋蒋蒋琪明你知道吗？]
english_text: [Great! I think especially, especially that guy, Jiang Qiming acted really well, Jiang, Jiang, Jiang Qiming, do you know him?]

chinese_text: [行，那你见上你给我引荐引荐啊。]
english_text: [Okay, then when you meet him, introduce me to him.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，我跟你说，这片儿名字叫啥，叫边水往事，它讲得是个啥事儿啊。]
english_text: [Oh, let me tell you, what's the name of this movie, it's called 'Border Water Past Events', what's it about?]

chinese_text: [我，好多小姑娘都喜欢他。]
english_text: [I, many young girls like him.]

chinese_text: [你也喜欢是吧，前两天我刚才上音乐节了，你知道吗？]
english_text: [You like him too, right? I just went to the music festival the other day, did you know?]

chinese_text: [他上音乐节唱歌，唱歌唱得确实也挺好。]
english_text: [He sang at the music festival, and he really sings well too.]

chinese_text: [我跟你说啊，前两天我看了一个电视剧特别好看。]
english_text: [Let me tell you, I watched a TV series the other day that was especially good.]

chinese_text: [那你那你说下道菜我学什么呀？]
english_text: [Then what do you say I should learn for the next dish?]

chinese_text: [香吧？香吧？[laughing]你想不想尝一口？]
english_text: [Fragrant, isn't it? Fragrant, isn't it? [laughing] Do you want to have a taste?]

chinese_text: [行，以后家里的饭，我包了。]
