chinese_text: [敲门我说咋了？他说那个你交一下物业费呗？我说我租房子的，我说你要不你问问房东。]
english_text: [They knocked on the door, I asked what's wrong? He said, 'Could you pay the property management fee?' I said I'm renting the place, I told him to ask the landlord instead.]

chinese_text: [他儿子好像在国外，他好像也在国外，他就不怎么管。然后那个物业天天每天早上，六点多钟就敲我门。]
english_text: [His son seems to be abroad, and he seems to be abroad too, so he doesn't really manage things. Then the property management knocks on my door every morning, a little after six o'clock.]

chinese_text: [哎你得交物业费呀，我说你交物业费谁买的房子你就问谁呗对吧？你问我干嘛呀？跟我有啥关系呀？就这种就就各种不讲理。]
english_text: [Hey, you need to pay the property management fee. I said, for the property management fee, you should ask whoever bought the property, right? Why are you asking me? What does it have to do with me? This kind of thing is just so unreasonable.]

chinese_text: [啊你要不你要你要不转告的话，我们就那啥我们就给你停水停电。我说我说你讲不讲理对不对?我说我又不是没交水费没交电费，你给我停这些玩意儿。]
english_text: [If you don't pass on the message, then we'll, you know, cut off your water and electricity. I said, are you being reasonable or not? I said I've paid my water and electricity bills, why would you cut these off for me?]

chinese_text: [啊，我们打房东电话打不通。]
english_text: [Ah, we can't get through to the landlord's phone.]

chinese_text: [我说你打不通你接着打呀，你老给我打啥电话对不对？你不要老给我打电话，我说这这物业费我说我也不应该我交。我说你们也有房东的信息，有他的电话我说你们给他打电话不就行了吗？]
english_text: [I said, if you can't get through, then keep trying. Why do you keep calling me? Don't keep calling me, I said this property management fee isn't something I should be paying anyway. I said you have the landlord's information, you have his phone number, can't you just call him?]

chinese_text: [物业他们是干嘛呀？他们不是每年收那些物业费啥的吗，我当时租这个房子，嗯，房东他也不老来。]
english_text: [What do property management people do anyway? Don't they collect property management fees every year? When I rented this house, the landlord didn't come around often.]

chinese_text: [哎那啥你不住这房子吗？我说我住啊，他说那你帮我转告一下，我说那不是你的工作吗？我还得帮你完成你的工作呗。]
english_text: [Hey, don't you live in this house? I said I do. He said then could you help me pass on the message? I said isn't that your job? Do I have to help you complete your work?]

chinese_text: [啊，嗯他们不接我电话，你给他转房租啥的他理你吗？我说那当然理我呀，我说他要收钱的呀。]
english_text: [Ah, well they don't answer my calls. When you transfer the rent to him, does he respond to you? I said of course he responds to me, I said he wants to collect the money.]

chinese_text: [啊他跟我说啊，那麻烦你转告他一下，让他交一下物业费，我说我转告不了。]
english_text: [Ah, he said to me, 'Could you please tell him to pay the property management fee?' I said I can't pass that message.]

chinese_text: [啊，说查消防呢，我说行，我说那我今天晚上就把电动车推到楼上面去充电，我说要充爆了给楼炸了我说你们就负责。哎呀，我都服了就就这物业就贼离谱嘛。]
english_text: [Ah, they said they're checking for fire safety. I said fine, I said then I'll push my electric scooter upstairs to charge tonight. I said if it explodes and blows up the building, you'll be responsible. Oh my god, I'm speechless, this property management is just ridiculously absurd.]

chinese_text: [是呀，这还威胁上你啦？]
english_text: [Really? They're threatening you now?]

chinese_text: [那咋地，都搬回家啊？]
english_text: [So what, are you all moving back home?]

chinese_text: [哎它就是那样儿，然后啥也看不见，就是亮着那么一个小小的光源。哎我天天都烦死了也没有人说这事儿，真的是！]
english_text: [Ugh, it's just like that, and you can't see anything, just a tiny light source is on. I'm so annoyed by it every day, and nobody says anything about this issue, really!]

chinese_text: [保安太烦人了！]
english_text: [The security guards are so annoying!]

chinese_text: [我跟你说，你们小区还行，还有保安。我们小区连保安都没有，连连个路灯都不带开的，也不知道省什么钱天天的。]
english_text: [Let me tell you, your residential community is decent, you even have security guards. Our community doesn't even have security guards, they don't even turn on the street lights. I don't know what money they're saving every day.]

chinese_text: [我天啊！]
english_text: [Oh my god!]

chinese_text: [哎，我一进小区晚上伸手不见五指，啥也看不见。什么破小区，还说什么啊附附近那个呃什么物业最好的，这这这人都没有管的！]
english_text: [Sigh, as soon as I enter the residential complex at night, it's pitch black, I can't see anything. What a terrible complex, and they still claim to have the best property management in the area, but there's no one in charge!]

chinese_text: [啥小区电费那么贵啊？]
english_text: [What kind of residential complex has such expensive electricity fees?]

chinese_text: [它那路灯，就在那儿建的好儿好儿的那路灯，哎就亮亮那么一点点光。也不知道它在那干啥，还半大半夜的还挺晃眼的，啥也看不见啥也照不亮。]
english_text: [Their street lights, those nicely built street lights there, well, they only emit a tiny bit of light. I don't know what they're even there for, and in the middle of the night, they're quite glaring, yet they don't illuminate anything.]

chinese_text: [他就听不懂，他说啊你挪呗。]
english_text: [He just doesn't understand, he says, 'Just move it yourself.']

chinese_text: [基础这些东西全没有？]
english_text: [Are all these basic amenities completely missing?]

chinese_text: [对啊我就说很恶心，然后我就没办法，那就多开多多开开窗户呗。开窗户然后就下雨，然后那个电动车嗡儿嗡儿响，我就没法儿睡觉。]
english_text: [Right, I said it's disgusting, but I had no choice, so I just opened the windows more. But when I open the windows, it rains, and then that electric scooter makes a buzzing sound, so I can't sleep.]

chinese_text: [小区物业全那样儿真招人烦。]
english_text: [All residential complex property managements are like that, really annoying.]

chinese_text: [开空调你说他又是那种上水上电的那屋，我朋友开空调你知道一个月能花多少钱？能花三千块钱，都是保守估计啊！]
english_text: [Using air conditioning, and you know it's one of those places with separate water and electricity meters. Do you know how much my friend spends on air conditioning in a month? It can cost three thousand yuan, and that's a conservative estimate!]

chinese_text: [不我跟我朋友开车进去，我俩就住里面，哎不让停。]
english_text: [No, my friend and I drove in, we both live there, but they wouldn't let us park.]

chinese_text: [收物业费完了没保安？]
english_text: [They collect property management fees, but there are no security guards?]

chinese_text: [还有就是啥，我跟我朋友开车进这个小区，小区里面其实就没有就规划停车位，也没说要收车费。就是你你要收，收就收对吧？你不收就不收。]
english_text: [Also, when my friend and I drive into this residential complex, there are actually no designated parking spaces planned, and they never mentioned charging parking fees. I mean, if you want to charge, then charge, right? If you don't want to charge, then don't.]

chinese_text: [完了没路灯？]
english_text: [And there are no street lights?]

chinese_text: [管你们收物业费吗？]
english_text: [Do they even collect property management fees from you?]

chinese_text: [我就找保安去，两点多钟，我说师傅，我说那个电动车不知道是谁的。我说也没人管，我说你要不给我挪一下。]
english_text: [So I went to find the security guard, around two o'clock, I said, 'Sir, that electric scooter there, I don't know whose it is. I said no one is managing it, so could you please move it for me?']

chinese_text: [我说你说我说你管啊，我说要不你看呢？我说你见证一下，我说别到时候我把人家车挪到别的地儿去了，我说人家找不见来找我麻烦。说我弄弄人家车了咋地咋地，他就听不懂。]
english_text: [I said, 'I'm telling you to handle it,' or I said, 'Why don't you watch?' I said, 'Be a witness, so that when I move someone's car to another place, they can't find it and come to trouble me. Saying I damaged their car or whatever.' But he just doesn't understand.]

chinese_text: [我又住二楼然后夏天又热，我就必须得开窗户睡，要不就开空调。]
english_text: [I live on the second floor, and it gets hot in the summer, so I have to sleep with the windows open, or else use the air conditioner.]

chinese_text: [你那个声儿吧，你甭管是一秒钟还是十分钟，它都影响了，别人正常的休息和睡眠了，是不是？]
english_text: [That noise of yours, whether it's for one second or ten minutes, it affects other people's normal rest and sleep, doesn't it?]

chinese_text: [你说我正睡的香，你哐，突突突突一脚，你直接给我干醒了，你说我能不难受吗？对不对？]
english_text: [I mean, I'm sleeping soundly, and then you come with a bang, vroom vroom, and wake me up directly. Do you think I wouldn't be upset? Right?]

chinese_text: [我帮你推摩托车？]
english_text: [Should I help you push your motorcycle?]

chinese_text: [白小姐，那楼底下摩托车是你的呀？]
english_text: [Miss Bai, is that motorcycle downstairs yours?]

chinese_text: [那我跟你说了，咱咱这个是不是互相体谅一下，对吧？这这晚上要休息，那你要不，你找个正经工作，你别每天半夜下班儿，也行啊。]
english_text: [Then let me tell you, shouldn't we be considerate of each other? Right? People need to rest at night, so why don't you find a proper job, one where you don't get off work in the middle of the night every day, that would work too.]

chinese_text: [你说完了吗？你跟我好好说话，我跟你好好说话，你不好好说，咱就别好好说话。]
english_text: [Are you done talking? If you speak to me properly, I'll speak to you properly. If you don't speak properly, then we won't speak properly.]

chinese_text: [是这样儿啊。就是不管说几米的路，对吧？你回来的时候很晚，我意思就是您不行，您推着进来都行，对不对？]
english_text: [It's like this. No matter how short the distance is, right? When you come back very late, I mean, couldn't you just push it in? Right?]

chinese_text: [我没侮辱人。]
english_text: [I'm not insulting anyone.]

chinese_text: [对，我没说，我没说您正常不能下班儿回家。我意思说，你那个声儿太大了，影响咱们邻里邻居的休息了，你能明白我的意思不？]
english_text: [Right, I didn't say, I didn't say you can't normally come home after work. What I mean is, your noise is too loud and affects the rest of us neighbors. Can you understand what I mean?]

chinese_text: [我发现你小姑娘，你人挺有意思的啊。你你这么大个人了，你怎么说话怎么不讲道理呢？怎么呢？]
english_text: [I find you quite interesting, young lady. You're a grown-up, how can you be so unreasonable when you speak? What's wrong with you?]

chinese_text: [啥工作加班儿，天天半夜回来呢？啊，谁家好人，半夜出去上班儿呢？你不是保安就是保姆吧？]
english_text: [What kind of job requires you to work overtime and come back in the middle of the night every day? What decent person goes to work in the middle of the night? You must be either a security guard or a nanny, right?]

chinese_text: [是，这个摩托车没办法，这摩托车是死的，但咱人是活的吧。咱能不能变通一点儿，对吧？都是邻里邻居的，咱们是不是互相的理解一下，对吧？]
english_text: [Yes, there's nothing we can do about the motorcycle itself, it's just an object, but we humans are flexible, right? Can't we be a bit more accommodating? We're neighbors, so shouldn't we try to understand each other, right?]

chinese_text: [我体谅你每天上班儿辛苦，但是你回来的时候，你也别吵着这老人小孩儿，是不是？]
english_text: [I understand that you work hard every day, but when you come back, you shouldn't disturb the elderly and children, okay?]

chinese_text: [我觉得就是咱就进小区里面，就别骑着你那个摩托，在小区里面儿炸街了，行不行？大家邻里邻居的也需要休息，好不好？]
english_text: [I think once you're inside the residential complex, you shouldn't ride your motorcycle around making loud noises, okay? We're all neighbors and we need to rest too, alright?]

chinese_text: [你这么着，我跟你商量个事儿啊。我发现你每天回家的时候特别晚，啊，回来的时候，我家孩子也好，老人也好都睡觉了。]
english_text: [Listen, I want to discuss something with you. I've noticed that you come home very late every day, and by the time you return, both my children and the elderly in my home are already asleep.]

chinese_text: [那你是什么正经人儿啊，这么大晚上不睡觉？]
english_text: [Then what kind of decent person are you, not sleeping so late at night?]

chinese_text: [不是，我总共从小区门口，骑进来几分钟，几多少米的路呀，就把你吵醒了？]
english_text: [Come on, it only takes me a few minutes to ride from the complex entrance, just a few dozen meters, and that wakes you up?]

chinese_text: [不是，谁不讲道理呀？]
english_text: [No, who's being unreasonable here?]

chinese_text: [你这话说的就有意思了，我怎么不是正经工作了？你你说我做什么的呀？哎，我上班儿在公司加个班儿，就成不正经工作了？你这个人才有意思呢。]
english_text: [That's an interesting thing to say. How is my job not proper? What do you think I do for a living? Hey, I work overtime at the office, and suddenly it's not a proper job? You're the one who's interesting.]

chinese_text: [不是，下班儿晚，也不是我能决定的事情，对吧？那摩托车它的声儿就那么大，我也没说给它改造一个什么跟拖拉机似的，突突突突专门吵你啊？]
english_text: [Look, getting off work late isn't something I can control, right? The motorcycle is just that loud, I didn't modify it to sound like a tractor specifically to annoy you, did I?]

chinese_text: [不是，不是什么我炸街。我我正常下班儿回家，不行啊？]
english_text: [No, it's not like I'm deliberately making noise. I'm just coming home from work normally, is that not allowed?]

chinese_text: [不是，我想吵吗？我也不想吵呀，那我没办法呀。你让我推进来，那么大摩托车，我推得动吗我？啊，那要不您这样吧，下次我下班儿回来，你出来帮我推摩托车，好吧？]
english_text: [No, do you think I want to make noise? I don't want to either, but I have no choice. You want me to push it in? It's such a big motorcycle, do you think I can push it by myself? Hey, how about this: next time I get off work, you come out and help me push the motorcycle, okay?]

chinese_text: [我上正经的班儿，我加个班儿，就成不正经的工作了？]
english_text: [I have a proper job, and just because I work overtime, it becomes an improper job?]

chinese_text: [大哥，你真有点儿侮辱人了吧？]
english_text: [Brother, aren't you being a bit insulting?]

chinese_text: [不是，那你总给我个解决办法吧。你让我推着进来，我。]
english_text: [Well, then at least give me a solution. You want me to push it in, I...]

chinese_text: [不是备点儿吃的，我这，哎呀我这还没备吃的呢，那我不得赶紧出去买去呀。]
english_text: [No, I need to stock up on food. Oh, I haven't prepared any food yet, so I need to hurry out and buy some.]

chinese_text: [抓抓紧时间赶紧去买米去。]
english_text: [Hurry up and go buy some rice.]

chinese_text: [行行行行行行。]
english_text: [Alright, alright, alright, alright, alright.]

chinese_text: [啊那，这咋整的呀？]
english_text: [Oh, so what should we do about this?]

chinese_text: [你这话说的，窗户吹掉，那我们我们在房子里那不冻死了。]
english_text: [What you're saying, if the windows get blown off, wouldn't we freeze to death inside the house?]

chinese_text: [水吃的什么方便食品都得都得囤点啊。]
english_text: [We need to stock up on water, food, and any kind of convenience foods.]

chinese_text: [哎呀那那等我回去看看吧，等会不行找个师傅让他上门上门儿给检查一下，给封一下呢？]
english_text: [Oh well, let me go back and check. If that doesn't work, maybe I can find a technician to come over and inspect and seal it?]

chinese_text: [台风，又来台风啦？]
english_text: [A typhoon, is there another typhoon coming?]

chinese_text: [主要是水，吃的其实我觉得家里面儿还还不少呢。]
english_text: [Mainly water, and for food, I actually think we still have quite a bit at home.]

chinese_text: [赶紧去买点儿吧。哎，我想想办法把把把家里面儿那个窗户再再加固一下，我总觉得咱家那个那那个那个那个那个那阳台就不行。]
english_text: [Hurry up and go buy some stuff. Hey, let me think of a way to reinforce the windows at home again. I always feel that our balcony is not good enough.]

chinese_text: [那那咋整呀？那那咱把咱那阳台好好封一下等会儿。]
english_text: [So what should we do? Let's properly seal our balcony for a while.]

chinese_text: [完了我去去问问，看他们能不能把那个窗户加固一下，好吧？]
english_text: [Alright, I'll go ask and see if they can reinforce the windows, okay?]

chinese_text: [备点吃的呗，那就不出门儿了呗。]
english_text: [Stock up on some food, so we don't have to go out then.]

chinese_text: [是吗就说，明后天连续连续一个礼拜，都是蓝色预警。]
english_text: [Really? So starting from tomorrow and the day after, for a whole week, it's all blue alerts.]

chinese_text: [玻璃全吹飞了，把阳台上放的洗衣机，然后晾衣架全弄飞了。]
english_text: [All the glass was blown away, and the washing machine and drying rack on the balcony were all blown away too.]

chinese_text: [你不行再买两根儿蜡烛。万一要停电了呢？]
english_text: [Why don't you buy a couple more candles? Just in case there's a power outage?]

chinese_text: [它不是它它阳台上的窗户无所谓吧，是吧。]
english_text: [It's not that the windows on the balcony don't matter, right?]

chinese_text: [你这样你这样，你去超市买点什么水啊，完了[over]吃的这些东西[over]，主要主要是水啊。]
english_text: [Here's what you do: go to the supermarket and buy some water and then some food. Mainly water, though.]

chinese_text: [我觉得我觉得我一会儿回去，我直接把那啥吧，直接把把把洗衣机抬进去，把值钱东西抬进去，窗户要真吹掉就吹掉吧。咱咱把门儿关好。]
english_text: [I think when I go back later, I'll just move the washing machine inside, and bring the valuable things in. If the windows really get blown away, then so be it. Let's just make sure to close our doors properly.]

chinese_text: [哎，我看这天气预报怎么这还台风预警了，蓝色警报？]
english_text: [Hey, I'm looking at the weather forecast, why is there a typhoon warning now? A blue alert?]

chinese_text: [咱再抓紧时间。]
english_text: [Let's hurry up then.]

chinese_text: [那别人不投诉呀，就光你投投诉啊？]
english_text: [So other people don't complain, only you do?]

chinese_text: [那不扰民啦？]
english_text: [Isn't that disturbing the peace?]

chinese_text: [卖狗？就那种小狗。]
english_text: [Selling dogs? Like those small puppies.]

chinese_text: [他不是那底上不是开门儿，就放楼门口，然后他那个楼门口正好对着我窗户。]
english_text: [He doesn't open the store on the ground floor; he just puts them at the building entrance, and that entrance is right opposite my window.]

chinese_text: [每天早上七八点钟的时候。你像咱咱做这种工作，也不可能说天天就出去嘛，有的时候就是工作日咱也可能在家。]
english_text: [Every morning around seven or eight o'clock. With our kind of work, it's not like we can go out every day. Sometimes we might be at home on weekdays too.]

chinese_text: [每天早上就五六点钟那个狗狗市儿就拉回来小狗，然后就放他们店里面，然后他就不往店里放，他就放在那个，他就放他家楼门口。]
english_text: [Every morning at five or six o'clock, they bring back puppies from the dog market, and then they're supposed to put them in their store, but they don't put them in the store; they put them at their building entrance.]

chinese_text: [从早上七八点一直彩排到晚上六七点，天黑了结束。]
english_text: [They rehearse from seven or eight in the morning until six or seven in the evening, ending when it gets dark.]

chinese_text: [每天早上准时爸爸的爸爸叫什么，要不就叫]
english_text: [Every morning on time, 'what do you call grandpa?' or else they just call...]

chinese_text: [他怎么这么有钱呐？]
english_text: [How does he have so much money?]

chinese_text: [戏都没资质？]
english_text: [The play doesn't even have proper qualifications?]

chinese_text: [毕竟，他没有资质，他怎么能开这个呀？]
english_text: [After all, he doesn't have the qualifications, how could he open this?]

chinese_text: [为啥啊？他不是挣那么多吗？]
english_text: [Why? Doesn't he earn so much?]

chinese_text: [不是，哎，他被限制出行，然后他上老赖名单儿，他还能开这么多分场？]
english_text: [No, sigh, he's restricted from traveling, and he's on the debtor's list, yet he can still open so many branches?]

chinese_text: [哇，他还真的很会资源利用诶。]
english_text: [Wow, he's really good at utilizing resources.]

chinese_text: [而且这城地方非常好啊。]
english_text: [And this venue is really excellent.]

chinese_text: [他是个天才[laughing]。]
english_text: [He's a genius [laughing].]

chinese_text: [你怎么可能让你白天当剧场晚上开酒吧，你疯了你呀？]
english_text: [How could you use it as a theater during the day and a bar at night? Are you crazy?]

chinese_text: [他贷款呐，他为什么上的老赖名单儿？他贷款贷的。]
english_text: [He took out loans, that's why he's on the debtor's list. He got loans.]

chinese_text: [你们贷款贷的？]
english_text: [You all took out loans?]

chinese_text: [然后就是咱们舍得花那大几百去看话剧。]
english_text: [And then we're willing to spend hundreds to see a play.]

chinese_text: [啊，贷款贷的，他不还钱。]
english_text: [Oh, he got loans but doesn't repay the money.]

chinese_text: [那酒吧怎么开的，我跟你说啊。这个场地白天演话剧，晚上开酒吧，神不神？我就问你这样的人神不神？]
english_text: [So how did he open the bar, let me tell you. This venue is used for plays during the day and as a bar at night, isn't that amazing? I'm asking you, isn't a person like that amazing?]

chinese_text: [但是他那酒吧没开多长时间被被人封了。]
english_text: [But his bar didn't stay open for long before it was shut down.]

chinese_text: [六个，六个城市，六个城市全他自己掏钱，他哪儿有那么多钱啊？]
english_text: [Six, six cities, all six cities he paid for himself, where would he get so much money?]

chinese_text: [他雍和宫不是有有有有一片地嘛？他三里屯儿还有一个剧场。]
english_text: [Doesn't he have a piece of land in Yonghegong? He also has a theater in Sanlitun.]

chinese_text: [他不是资源利用，我跟你说他是偷摸儿干。因为首先消防那边儿，你都过不了。]
english_text: [He's not utilizing resources, let me tell you he's doing it secretly. Because first of all, you can't even pass the fire safety inspection.]

chinese_text: [他贷款啊，他现在已经上老赖名单儿了，他被，他被限限限，限制出行了。]
english_text: [He took out loans, he's already on the deadbeat list now, he's been, he's been restricted from traveling.]

chinese_text: [他就偷摸儿干啊，你就，你像，首先咱们先考虑，就看话剧的群体，咱们年轻人居多。]
english_text: [He just does it secretly, you, you see, first let's consider, the audience for watching dramas is mostly young people like us.]

chinese_text: [对，就舍得喝酒啊，他看完话剧，我给你个晚上代金券儿你来不来？你来吧。]
english_text: [Right, they're willing to spend on drinks, after watching the drama, if I give you an evening voucher, will you come? Of course you'll come.]

chinese_text: [啊，对呀，我跟你说卖，你卖票他肯定得挑好地方来啊。]
english_text: [Ah, yes, let me tell you about selling tickets, he definitely has to pick good locations to sell them.]

chinese_text: [你是不是在我面前排？你是不是插了我的队啊？凭什么呀？]
english_text: [Are you lining up in front of me? Did you just cut in line? On what grounds?]

chinese_text: [你就算是老年人，你也不能这样。]
english_text: [Even if you're elderly, you can't act like this.]

chinese_text: [老年旅游团儿，老年旅游团儿不是不是不是人还是怎么的？我也在排队，我排了俩小时了。]
english_text: [Senior tour group, senior tour group, are they not human or what? I'm also in line, I've been waiting for two hours.]

chinese_text: [那你为什么不早点儿来呢？你早点儿来，你排队你在这来。]
english_text: [Then why didn't you come earlier? If you came earlier, you could queue up here.]

chinese_text: [你干这个的，那我打电话报警啊？你就是干这个的呀？]
english_text: [Is this what you do for a living? Then should I call the police? Is this your job or what?]

chinese_text: [我尊重老人，所以说我没有跟他们吵，我再跟您沟通对不对？我先来的，我在这儿排着队，你带着一帮人插在我面前，你什么意思呢？]
english_text: [I respect the elderly, so I didn't argue with them, I'm communicating with you, right? I came first, I've been waiting in line here, and you bring a bunch of people to cut in front of me, what's your intention?]

chinese_text: [不是，大哥，你这什么意思呀？你带这么帮人，插我前面什么意思？我在这儿排了很久了。]
english_text: [Hey, brother, what do you mean by this? Bringing so many people to cut in front of me, what's that about? I've been waiting here for a long time.]

chinese_text: [怎么的，你要讹人是吗？你还碰瓷啊？]
english_text: [What, are you trying to extort me? Are you playing the victim now?]

chinese_text: [哎，让路归让路，可是我现在是在排队，你们也得排队吧？是不是都是在法治社会啊？你得尊重这些啊。]
english_text: [Look, giving way is one thing, but I'm in line right now, you all need to queue too, right? Aren't we in a society under the rule of law? You have to respect these rules.]

chinese_text: [可是你哎，你后面你不看这一串儿有多少个人？]
english_text: [But hey, don't you see how many people are behind you?]

chinese_text: [我跟你说，今天能发到网上，你就是犯法的。我现在把这些话发上去，你就是就是犯法的。]
english_text: [Let me tell you, if this gets posted online today, you're breaking the law. If I post these words now, you're committing a crime.]

chinese_text: [你一个两个，我也就算了，我就忍了。你这后面多少个？十几个人你插我前面，你在我后面？]
english_text: [If it were just one or two of you, I would let it go, I would tolerate it. But how many are behind you? Over a dozen people cutting in front of me when you were behind me?]

chinese_text: [哎，我可没说我要讹人啊，我可没说啊。]
english_text: [Hey, I never said I was going to extort anyone, I never said that.]

chinese_text: [不是你听我的，姐们儿你快报，啊你快报。我跟你说，我这里边儿身体不好的有的是，你要把他们吓着了。]
english_text: [No, listen to me, sister, hurry up and report it, come on, hurry up. Let me tell you, there are people here with health conditions, you might scare them.]

chinese_text: [不是，你给老人让个路儿，怎么啦？]
english_text: [What's wrong with giving way to the elderly?]

chinese_text: [我早点儿来了呀！]
english_text: [I did come early!]

chinese_text: [那我就干这个的，我我我不那啥？]
english_text: [Then this is what I do, I, I, I don't... what?]

chinese_text: [这帮老人能都能当你爷爷奶奶了，你知道吗？]
english_text: [These elderly people could be your grandparents, you know?]

chinese_text: [我没排队吗？我排了呀。]
english_text: [Didn't I queue? I did queue up.]

chinese_text: [我就告你，身体不好啊。]
english_text: [I'm telling you, my health is not good.]

chinese_text: [你没看见吗？老年旅游团儿。]
english_text: [Can't you see? It's a senior tourist group.]

chinese_text: [不是，你这小丫头说话，怎么那么呛人呢？什么叫不是人啊怎么着？尊重老人你不懂吗？]
english_text: [Hey, little girl, why are you so confrontational? What do you mean 'not human'? Don't you understand respecting the elderly?]

chinese_text: [我是，不是我就问你，我是不是来的比你早？然后我站你前边儿，是不是理所应当？我站的队，我让这帮老老爷爷老奶奶站在我身后，是不是很合理？]
english_text: [Let me ask you, didn't I arrive earlier than you? So isn't it natural that I stand in front of you? I was in the queue, and I let these elderly grandpas and grandmas stand behind me, isn't that reasonable?]

chinese_text: [哎哟嘿，还给你能的还犯法，哎你报你报你报，我看那个法律敢管这事儿？来你报。]
english_text: [Oh, so you think this is illegal? Go ahead, report it, report it. Let's see if the law dares to handle this matter? Go on, report it.]

chinese_text: [你报呗，哎呀哎，你你呀你报你报，你快报。]
english_text: [Go ahead and report it. Oh, you, you go report it, hurry up and report it.]

chinese_text: [那老人腿脚儿不好，我过来先占个地儿，让老人站我后边儿，那是插你队吗？]
english_text: [The elderly have trouble with their legs, so I came to hold a spot and let them stand behind me. Is that cutting in line?]

chinese_text: [凭什么给你看呢？你是什么人呢？]
english_text: [Why should I show you? Who are you anyway?]

chinese_text: [我该收的这些钱，这块儿地是我家的，这块停车位也都是我们弄的，线都是我画的，这些东西都是我该收的钱。所以这二十块钱你赶紧扫，别在这儿掰扯了，二十块钱，对你来说不是什么事儿，赶紧吧。]
english_text: [This money I'm collecting is what I'm owed. This land is my family's, we made these parking spaces, I painted the lines myself. This is money I'm entitled to collect. So scan this twenty yuan quickly, stop arguing here. Twenty yuan is nothing to you, hurry up.]

chinese_text: [你要是没啥事你在这待着，我不急。反正我成天在这个停车场待着啊，没关系。]
english_text: [If you have nothing better to do, you can stay here. I'm not in a hurry. Anyway, I stay in this parking lot all day, so it doesn't matter.]

chinese_text: [你管它小牌儿大牌儿，你能看着吧？上面是不是有字？我是不是写的很清楚啊？那是你的问题。]
english_text: [Never mind if it's a small sign or a big one, can you see it? Aren't there words on it? Didn't I write it clearly? That's your problem.]

chinese_text: [停这儿的停车费啊！这是收费的停车场。]
english_text: [Parking fee for parking here! This is a paid parking lot.]

chinese_text: [你跑得出去吗？你看看外面，你跑得出去吗？外面都是我们的车，你怎么跑啊？咱后外面一堵你出得去吗？]
english_text: [Can you run out? Look outside, can you escape? Outside are all our cars, how would you run away? If we block the exit outside, can you get out?]

chinese_text: [哎，小伙子你过来把钱交一下，停车费还没交呢，二十块钱。]
english_text: [Hey, young man, come over and pay the money. You haven't paid the parking fee yet, twenty yuan.]

chinese_text: [咋没写啊？所有人都交钱，所有人都交，就你不交呀？那不是写着吗！你看外面那个地方，写了个小牌儿，说停车收费。]
english_text: [How is it not written? Everyone pays money, everyone pays, only you won't pay? Isn't it written there! Look outside that place, there's a small sign that says parking fee required.]

chinese_text: [上面写清楚了啊，在这儿停车要收费。我是这儿的管理员，[over]好吗[over]？]
english_text: [It's clearly written above that parking here requires a fee. I'm the administrator here, okay?]

chinese_text: [那咋不是钱的事儿呢？赶紧，二十块，我怎么不讲理了？写的清清楚楚，然后这个地界也是我们家地。]
english_text: [How is this not about money? Hurry up, twenty yuan. How am I being unreasonable? It's clearly written, and this land belongs to my family.]

chinese_text: [那你别走了，你别走了，在这儿待着吧啊。]
english_text: [Then don't leave, just stay here then.]

chinese_text: [我就找无赖怎么着了？你这二十块钱你得给，这是停车费，我该收的。]
english_text: [So what if I'm being unreasonable? You have to pay this twenty yuan, this is the parking fee I'm entitled to collect.]

chinese_text: [荒郊野外，你荒郊野外你，我这儿不管，你这车被别人刮了蹭了咋整？啊，那就不是二十块钱的事儿了。]
english_text: [Out here in the wilderness, if I don't keep an eye on things, what happens if your car gets scratched or damaged by someone else? Ah, then it won't be just a twenty yuan matter.]

chinese_text: [哎哟，那你是眼睛是真不好，那你确实该去看看眼睛。但是问题是啊，不好意思，这是我们家的地儿，我们家的停车位，您给我交二十块钱，好吧？你要是不交就别走。]
english_text: [Oh, so your eyesight is really bad, then you should indeed get your eyes checked. But the problem is, excuse me, this is our family's land, our family's parking space, so please pay me twenty yuan, okay? If you don't pay, then don't leave.]

chinese_text: [你是谁啊？我都说了，这块停车场是我们家的，赶紧的。]
english_text: [Who are you? I already told you, this parking lot belongs to our family, hurry up.]

chinese_text: [我咋没管呢？我要是没管，你这车我跟你说，在这撞了不知道多少次了。你也说了这荒郊野外，也没有监控啊，对不对？没有人管。]
english_text: [How have I not been managing? If I weren't managing, let me tell you, your car would have been hit many times here already. You also said this is out in the wilderness, there are no surveillance cameras, right? No one is watching.]

chinese_text: [你管啥了？我就问你管啥了？]
english_text: [What have you been managing? I'm asking you, what have you been managing?]

chinese_text: [不是等会，什么叫扫这儿？什么停车费？]
english_text: [What do you mean 'wait'? What do you mean 'scan here'? What parking fee?]

chinese_text: [不是，来来来你这样，来这样。]
english_text: [No, come here, do it like this, like this.]

chinese_text: [我没看见！我。]
english_text: [I didn't see! Me.]

chinese_text: [你这也没写哪儿收费啊！]
english_text: [You didn't even write where fees are charged!]

chinese_text: [那你是什么人？你凭什么管我要钱呢？]
english_text: [Then who are you? On what grounds are you asking me for money?]

chinese_text: [那你就耍无赖呗？]
english_text: [So you're just going to be unreasonable, then?]

chinese_text: [哎，你自己说，那没监控我直接跑不就得了吗！我还给你交，给你交钱？]
english_text: [Hey, you said it yourself, if there's no surveillance, I could just run away, right? Why would I still pay you, give you money?]

chinese_text: [主要你不讲理，你知道吗？]
english_text: [The main thing is you're being unreasonable, you know?]

chinese_text: [不是，耍无赖耍得这么光明正大吗？现在？]
english_text: [No, are you really being so shameless so openly? Now?]

chinese_text: [什么停车费？什么停车费？]
english_text: [What parking fee? What parking fee?]

chinese_text: [你自己都说是小牌儿了，你瞅瞅你能看见它？]
english_text: [You yourself said it's a small sign, just look, can you even see it?]

chinese_text: [我给你，来你说说这这块地是你家的是不是？]
english_text: [Let me tell you, come on, say it, is this piece of land yours or not?]

chinese_text: [你把，你把房产证儿给我拿给我看看！]
english_text: [You, you bring me the property deed to show me!]

chinese_text: [行，那就耗着。]
english_text: [Fine, then we'll just wait it out.]

chinese_text: [你说是你的，那我还说是我家的。你给我二十块钱。]
english_text: [You say it's yours, well I say it's mine. You give me twenty bucks.]

chinese_text: [这荒郊野外的，你给我上哪儿收费去？]
english_text: [This is in the middle of nowhere, where do you get off charging fees here?]

chinese_text: [这不是，这不是钱的事儿。]
english_text: [This isn't, this isn't about the money.]

chinese_text: [就那小牌儿，还没你眼睛大呢！你能瞅着？]
english_text: [That small sign, it's not even as big as your eyes! Can you even see it?]

chinese_text: [他自己没手吗？]
english_text: [Doesn't he have hands of his own?]

chinese_text: [你弟，我问你，这钱是不是都是我挣的啊？你整天搁家，你啥活儿不干，这钱是不是全是我挣的？]
english_text: [Your brother, let me ask you, isn't all this money earned by me? You stay at home all day, you don't do any work, isn't all this money earned by me?]

chinese_text: [不是，那我的钱是大风刮来的吗？]
english_text: [No, did my money just blow in with the wind?]

chinese_text: [来来，你又开始啊，胡搅蛮缠。你每次都这套，咱俩能不能说道理，能不能说道理？]
english_text: [Here we go, you're starting again, being unreasonable. You pull this every time, can we please be reasonable, can we please talk logically?]

chinese_text: [给你弟弟的还不够，给的还不够多，是不是？房子谁买的？那车，车没。]
english_text: [What I've given your brother isn't enough, it's not enough, is it? Who bought the house? The car, there's no car.]

chinese_text: [他是你亲弟没错，但他不是废物，他自己没手没脚嘛，不会自己干吗？]
english_text: [He's your biological brother, that's true, but he's not useless. Doesn't he have hands and feet? Can't he do things himself?]

chinese_text: [不是给了呀，不是咱给的不少了呀。]
english_text: [But I did give, haven't we given quite a lot already.]

chinese_text: [我刚才怎么看小康怎么又从我卡里面儿拿了四千块钱？]
english_text: [How did I just see that Xiaokang took another 4,000 yuan from my card?]

chinese_text: [咱俩也是将吧够，你月月这么接济，啥时候儿是个头儿？]
english_text: [We're just barely getting by ourselves, with you giving them financial support every month, when will this end?]

chinese_text: [管孩子是理由儿吗？]
english_text: [Is taking care of the children even a valid excuse?]

chinese_text: [一分钱不给，房子收回来，我卖了。]
english_text: [Not a single penny, take back the house, I'll sell it.]

chinese_text: [挣的钱呢？钱呢？]
english_text: [What about the money they earned? Where's the money?]

chinese_text: [不是，那小康他媳妇儿，这两口子是一点儿钱不挣吗？我就好奇了。]
english_text: [No, seriously, Xiaokang and his wife, do these two not earn any money at all? I'm just curious.]

chinese_text: [那挣多少是够？]
english_text: [Then how much earned money would be enough?]

chinese_text: [咱俩是没孩子吗？咱俩的孩，咱俩的孩子怎么办？]
english_text: [Don't we have children? What about our children, what will happen to them?]

chinese_text: [你弟弟跟你弟妹俩大活人养不活自己吗？穷有穷过法儿，富有富过法儿。]
english_text: [Can't your brother and sister-in-law, two grown adults, support themselves? There are ways to live when you're poor, and ways to live when you're rich.]

chinese_text: [我弟弟一家人。]
english_text: [My brother's whole family.]

chinese_text: [怎么就不是理由了？好，现在就因为他不是你亲弟，你就这样子是吧？他要是你亲弟，你是不是随便都给，你是不是百分之八十都可以给他？]
english_text: [How is that not a reason? Fine, so just because he's not your biological brother, you're acting like this, right? If he were your biological brother, would you give him whatever he wants? Would you even give him eighty percent?]

chinese_text: [没钱了嘛，我弟弟没钱了，让他拿取一点儿，要不然这这这个月咋过啊？]
english_text: [They're out of money, my brother has no money, let him take some, otherwise how will they get through this month?]

chinese_text: [我也没有说不把钱都给他们吧。我只是给了他们一点儿，咱们只是给了他们三三分之一而已，让他买一个房子，买一个。]
english_text: [I never said not to give them all the money. I just gave them a little, we only gave them one-third, just enough to let them buy a house, buy one.]

chinese_text: [我怎么胡搅蛮缠，我说就是道理，他是我弟弟我亲弟，也是你弟。]
english_text: [How am I being unreasonable? What I'm saying makes sense. He's my brother, my biological brother, and also your brother.]

chinese_text: [我作为姐姐，是不是该做这个，你作为姐夫是不是应该给他们买？]
english_text: [As his sister, shouldn't I do this? As his brother-in-law, shouldn't you help them buy it?]

chinese_text: [那我又不是没有考虑过，我弟弟，那我家怎么办？我弟弟好了，也可以接济我们的。]
english_text: [It's not like I haven't considered it, my brother, but what about our family? When my brother's situation improves, he can help us out too.]

chinese_text: [他们自己花了呀，给我弟弟点儿钱怎么了？]
english_text: [They spent their own money, what's wrong with giving my brother some money?]

chinese_text: [我不用管孩子吗？啊，我给我弟弟钱怎么，都是一家人。]
english_text: [Don't I need to take care of the children? What's wrong with me giving my brother money? We're all family.]

english_text: [That was just the right moment.]

english_text: [He really had this reaction, like 'what, what, what?'?]

english_text: [Right! He was originally handling himself, but it has a sound effect.]

chinese_text: [我说，犯罪嫌疑人不是在那儿吗？我给他指了控台的位置，他一看那孩子不在那。我说犯罪嫌疑人不是在那吗？你看一眼。]
english_text: [I said, isn't the suspect right there? I pointed to the console's position, he looked and saw that the kid wasn't there. I said isn't the suspect right there? Take a look.]

chinese_text: [我自己跑下去关呗！咋整啊？]
english_text: [I'll just run down and turn it off myself! What else can I do?]

chinese_text: [就贼神。]

chinese_text: [就就来了，你有什么招？]

chinese_text: [我就，我真的，就就就傻呵呵的，你知道吗？就就颠儿颠儿颠儿颠儿，啪一关。然后下场再起。]

chinese_text: [然后我就跟那儿。我说丁律师，我是不是可以把犯罪嫌疑人带上来了。懵了，当时丁律师懵了。]

chinese_text: [我不管，那是你自己的事儿。]
english_text: [I'm not taking care of him, that's your own business.]

chinese_text: [你不是他儿子呀？小的时候他没给你钱呐？]

chinese_text: [咱爸妈送过去挺好的，没有什么不该的。]
english_text: [It's quite good that our parents sent him over, there's nothing inappropriate about it.]

chinese_text: [我不要钱，你把他接过去管。这两这一段时间，爸妈在我这儿，我已经够累了。我还得管孩子，还得管爸妈，还得上班儿，你管管吧。]
english_text: [I don't want money, you take them and take care of them. Our parents have been staying with me for a while now, and I'm already exhausted. I have to take care of the kids, take care of our parents, and still go to work. You take care of them for a while.]

chinese_text: [我家房子也不大，半年了，我家管不了了。我现在有自己的工作，有事儿。]

chinese_text: [那你什么意思啊？是不是该到你了？之前说好的半年，每个人管半年，是不是该到你了？]
english_text: [Then what do you mean? Isn't it your turn now? We agreed before that each of us would take care of them for six months. Isn't it your turn now?]

chinese_text: [雇个保姆，我这不是一样的，管管得挺好的吗？]
english_text: [Hire a nanny. Isn't it the same? I've been taking care of them quite well, haven't I?]

chinese_text: [你是掏了，我没管吗？我是不是在这儿天天管爸妈？然后我你你掏钱，我出力，是不是都说好了的？]
english_text: [You paid the money, but didn't I take care of them? Haven't I been taking care of our parents every day here? And then you pay the money, I provide the labor. Didn't we already agree on this?]

chinese_text: [爸妈明儿接你那儿去住啊？住上半年，然后再送我这儿行吗？]
english_text: [Should I have Mom and Dad go stay at your place tomorrow? Stay there for half a year, and then send them back to me. Is that okay?]

chinese_text: [不是你，哎呀姐，你不能这么算。那那前阵子，那爸妈那那住院钱，不还我自己掏的吗？]
english_text: [No, hey sister, you can't calculate it like that. The hospitalization fees for our parents a while ago, didn't I pay for those myself?]

chinese_text: [那这么着，那这么着这么着，行咱俩别吵也别争啊。每个月，我以后给你两千块钱。]
english_text: [Alright then, alright then, okay, let's not argue or fight. I'll give you two thousand yuan every month from now on.]

chinese_text: [管不了一点儿。]
english_text: [I can't take care of them at all.]

chinese_text: [不，干啥啊？]
english_text: [No, what for?]

chinese_text: [咱爸妈住我这，不开。]
english_text: [Our parents staying with me won't work.]

chinese_text: [主要是，哎呀，那谁你又不是不知道。她事儿还多，我我主要是怕咱爸妈。]
english_text: [Mainly, well, you know who I'm talking about. She's so demanding. I'm mainly worried about our parents.]

chinese_text: [那我不累吗？]
english_text: [Then don't I get tired?]

chinese_text: [我给你钱还不行吗？]
english_text: [Would it be okay if I give you money?]

chinese_text: [不是不是，你你你听我说啊，就首先我家那房子也不大，是吧？]
english_text: [No, no, listen to me. First of all, my house isn't big either, right?]

chinese_text: [他俩不开心，放不开。]
english_text: [They won't be happy and won't feel comfortable.]

chinese_text: [我管呐！]
english_text: [I'll take care of them!]

chinese_text: [我是，但你能不能体谅体谅？我家孩子小。]
english_text: [I am, but can't you be understanding? My child is young.]

chinese_text: [不可能，绝对不可能啊！爸妈不可能接我这儿来住。]

chinese_text: [我家孩子这么小，如果现在把爸妈接过来的话，我还得雇一个保姆，你明白这个理儿不？]
english_text: [My child is so young. If I take our parents in now, I'll have to hire a nanny. Do you understand this logic?]

chinese_text: [什么什么关系？]
english_text: [What? What relationship?]

chinese_text: [那我就在你身边，那阿姨也知道咱俩的事儿，你就跟我说呗。]
english_text: [I'm right here with you, and that aunt knows about our situation, so just tell me.]

chinese_text: [不，我真不知道。]
english_text: [No, I really don't know.]

chinese_text: [不是不是，你你你先冷静一下我。]
english_text: [No, no, you calm down first.]

english_text: [I only asked you because I saw you didn't go to class. Because you weren't there for those few classes, I skipped too, so I wasn't there either!]

chinese_text: [不是。我的意思是说，你有啥事儿你，你跟我说呗。]
english_text: [No. What I mean is, if you have something going on, you can just tell me.]

chinese_text: [哦哦，阿姨姨，阿姨也来了哈。]

english_text: [You said you could accompany me, and now you're asking me why I came back? Why did my mom come over? But where were you at that time?]

chinese_text: [我当时一直在等你过来，我一直在等你联系我，你知道我回家之前的那段时间，我一直在干嘛吗？]
english_text: [I was waiting for you to come, I was waiting for you to contact me. Do you know what I was doing all the time before I went home?]

chinese_text: [我每，咱们两个都是共同的课对吧，没有没有一天我去上课。]
english_text: [Every day, we both had the same classes, right? There wasn't a single day that I went to class.]

chinese_text: [我怎么跟你说？我怎么跟你开口去说这句话呀？]
english_text: [How should I tell you? How could I bring myself to say this to you?]

chinese_text: [我那每一天，我都把我自己关在宿舍里面。我每一天我不敢出门，我也不敢去接触任何别的人。可是你问过我吗？你问过我一句话吗？]
english_text: [Every single day, I locked myself in the dorm. Every day I didn't dare to go out, nor did I dare to interact with anyone else. But did you ask me? Did you ask me even once?]

chinese_text: [你问过我吗？那些公共课大课，我都不敢去上，你问过我吗？]
english_text: [Did you ask me? I didn't even dare to attend those large public lectures, did you ask me?]

chinese_text: [你在我身边儿，咱们俩当时是什么关系啊？]
english_text: [When you were by my side, what was our relationship at that time?]

chinese_text: [怎么能不来呀？]
english_text: [How could I not come?]

chinese_text: [他把我关到那个厕所里。咱们俩所谓共同的好朋友，把我关到厕所里的时候，你在哪儿？你在干什么啊？]
english_text: [He locked me in that bathroom. When our so-called mutual friend locked me in the bathroom, where were you? What were you doing?]

chinese_text: [你真不知道，你问过我吗？[Sobbing]我回去了，你知道吗？你知道，你为什么不打电话问问我呢？]
english_text: [You really don't know, did you ask me? [Sobbing] I went back, did you know? You knew, so why didn't you call to ask me?]

chinese_text: [他把所有人都就是全部都给说了一遍，然后完了之后，意思就是说他最牛。]
english_text: [He criticized everyone one by one, and after that, the implication was that he was the best.]

chinese_text: [我们这些演员都是都是什么垃圾玩意儿，然后呢如果没有他这部戏一点儿都成不了，然后大家演的都很烂什么什么什么的。]

chinese_text: [我之前拍了一个戏，那导演特离谱。]
english_text: [I filmed a play before, and that director was outrageous.]

chinese_text: [然后完了之后呢，他每天嘴特别毒老骂人家，骂完人家又说人家演的不好怎么怎么样。然后我们又不知道，因为我们是分开排练的，大家的时间都错开的。]

english_text: [And then, for example, he would tell me that he had criticized all of them, and then tell another actor that he had criticized all of us.]

chinese_text: [然后说自己这部戏导的多么很不容易怎么怎么样，然后说这个嗯这部戏排起来不好，全靠他一个人自己撑的什么什么的。]

english_text: [And then when we went, he just kept telling us how poorly this girl performed, how her acting wasn't good, how she had no professional qualities, no class, just, uh, none of the qualities of an actor, nothing at all.]

chinese_text: [然后结果到后来这你知道吗，这姑娘回去问她导师说，那个我你让我去她那儿排戏，我好弄好了怎么怎么的，然后她导师来了句，啊他谁呀？]
english_text: [And then later, you know, this girl went back to ask her advisor, saying, 'You told me to go to her place to rehearse the play, and I've got everything ready how and how,' and then her advisor said, 'Ah, who is he?']

chinese_text: [然后呢他说，那是他的导师求求他，让他把这个师妹塞进来的，他一直是跟我们这么说的。然后完了之后。]
english_text: [And then he said that it was his advisor who begged him to let this junior sister in, that's what he had been telling us all along. And then after that.]

chinese_text: [就是他根本就不认识这个导演，这导演就是瞎编的。]

chinese_text: [嗯，我们当时把我们所有人到最后，就是那个戏排完了有一年了吧，我们是不是还时不时还聚在一起骂他，真的很离谱。]
english_text: [Yeah, all of us at that time, even a year after the play was finished, we would still get together from time to time to curse him out, it was truly outrageous.]

chinese_text: [他一开始致辞我们所有人都走了，然后就他一个人自己在那开始在哪卖惨，把我们给气的这是什么人呢，然后呢，你自己能力又不行，然后完了你做人还不行。]
english_text: [When he started his speech, all of us left, and then he was there all by himself trying to act pitiful, which made us so angry, what kind of person is this? And then, not only are you incompetent, but your character is also terrible.]

chinese_text: [然后他就是在装你知道吗？就装的是每个人的就是那种感觉，然后完了之后有一个姑娘是她的学妹。]
english_text: [And then he was just pretending, you know? Pretending to have that kind of connection with everyone, and then there was this girl who was his junior sister.]

english_text: [His professional skills are not good, and then he doesn't do what he's supposed to do, and then he says, 'Oh, I only had her come because I was doing it out of respect for her advisor.']

chinese_text: [然后然后以至于我们那段时间就会觉得这姑娘，因为她确实耽误了我们所有人排练进度我们会觉得说她有问题。]

chinese_text: [嗯嗯嗯，装的。]

english_text: [Just for the sake of pretending.]

chinese_text: [能力不行，人品不行。]
english_text: [Incompetent and bad character.]

chinese_text: [而且那个桌子现在也高级，它好几层的那种，非常方便，又有抽屉又有什么的，特方便。咱不像咱们现在的那个桌子，就是一桌面儿。]
english_text: [And the desks are now more high-end, they have multiple layers, very convenient, with drawers and everything. Unlike our current desks which are just a tabletop.]

chinese_text: [就方便多了这样儿，那太好了！]
english_text: [It's much more convenient this way, that's great!]

chinese_text: [好，变成了从不知道哪儿淘来的这种两层印花的。我跟你说真的，说的夸张一点，你上厕所不多叠几层就，就你你懂的。]
english_text: [Well, it's been replaced with this two-layer printed toilet paper from who knows where. Let me tell you, to put it exaggeratedly, if you don't fold it several layers when you go to the bathroom, you know what I mean.]

chinese_text: [就白跑，对啊，他他要扣我全勤，算我迟到，然后旷工什么。真的好变态，而且就说一个特别，尴尬的事情。]
english_text: [So it was a wasted trip, right? He wants to deduct my perfect attendance bonus, count me as late, and then mark it as absence or something. It's really perverted, and then there's this particularly embarrassing thing.]

chinese_text: [对，然后每天要求你，你上班必须得打卡。你说咱们做就跑外面的，我每天见客户之前，我还得提前去公司把卡打了。]
english_text: [Right, and they require you to clock in every day. I mean, we work outside, so before meeting clients every day, I have to go to the company early just to punch my card.]

chinese_text: [啊天，我真的快受不了了，怎么能这样啊？你说我天天给公司打工啊，我自己在倒贴着钱，那我何必，我不如自己当老板去了。]
english_text: [Oh my god, I really can't stand this anymore, how can it be like this? I'm working for the company every day, and I'm actually losing my own money. Why should I? I might as well be my own boss.]

chinese_text: [自己买啊，你说多搞笑吧？然后签合同的笔，你得自己准备，然后夹子自己准备。哎，我不知道公司要干嘛？我这样还，]
english_text: [Buy it yourself, how ridiculous is that? And for signing contracts, you have to prepare your own pen, and your own clips. I don't know what the company is trying to do? I'm still,]

chinese_text: [对，很离谱，就是莫名其妙。然后桶装水，咱们工作不用喝水吗？]
english_text: [Right, it's outrageous, just inexplicable. And then the bottled water, don't we need to drink water at work?]

chinese_text: [饮水机撤了，桶装水撤了，没有了。我现在每天要是去公司的话，我还得在家里烧好了开水带过去。]
english_text: [The water dispenser is gone, the bottled water is gone, nothing left. Now if I go to the company every day, I have to boil water at home and bring it with me.]

chinese_text: [哎，之前咱们就是那个，水台那里。那个挂耳就不咋好喝，现在，连挂耳都没有了，给你换速溶了。]
english_text: [Sigh, before we had that water station. The drip coffee wasn't that good, but now, even the drip coffee is gone, they've replaced it with instant coffee.]

chinese_text: [原来卫生纸，三层印花的对吧？然后现在说，我们要节省，我们不能那个浪费。]
english_text: [The toilet paper used to be three-layer printed, right? And now they say we need to save, we can't waste.]

chinese_text: [跟你说，最近公司要疯了。]
english_text: [Let me tell you, the company has gone crazy recently.]

chinese_text: [连水都取消啦？]
english_text: [They even canceled the water?]

chinese_text: [哦就，等于我出来之后就全变了？]
english_text: [Oh, so everything changed after I left?]

chinese_text: [怎么了？]
english_text: [What happened?]

chinese_text: [就等于，你不到公司，然后今天出去跑的这个客户，你跑了一趟，等于白跑。]
english_text: [It means if you don't come to the company, and you go out to meet a client today, the trip is basically wasted.]

chinese_text: [那得亏我是出来得早。]
english_text: [Fortunately, I left early.]

chinese_text: [就，就那离谱？]
english_text: [Is it really that outrageous?]

chinese_text: [那就等于所有我为公司付出的这些东西。公司该给我的什么都没有，还得我自己掏？]
english_text: [So that's equivalent to all the things I've sacrificed for the company. The company gives me nothing in return, and I have to pay for things myself?]

chinese_text: [自己带过去？那带对少了，不够喝就渴着？]
english_text: [Bring it myself? What if I bring too little and don't have enough to drink? Just go thirsty?]

chinese_text: [哎哟，这都都不知道他们是怎么想的。]
english_text: [Oh my, I really don't know what they're thinking.]

chinese_text: [你别这样。]
english_text: [Don't be like this.]

chinese_text: [你没事儿吧，哥？]
english_text: [Are you okay, bro?]

chinese_text: [我给你煮面。]
english_text: [I'll cook some noodles for you.]

chinese_text: [你要是不舒服，你就哭出来，现在就咱俩。]
english_text: [If you're not feeling well, just cry it out. It's just the two of us here now.]

chinese_text: [我们没有爸爸了。]
english_text: [We don't have a dad anymore.]

chinese_text: [可是你这样我更害怕。]
english_text: [But when you're like this, I'm even more scared.]

chinese_text: [你饿吗？哥，一天都没吃饭了。]
english_text: [Are you hungry? Bro, you haven't eaten all day.]

chinese_text: [我去给你煮点儿面吧，冰箱里还有爸留下的炸酱呢。]
english_text: [Let me go cook some noodles for you. There's still the zhajiang (fermented soybean paste) Dad left in the fridge.]

chinese_text: [咱爸肯定也不希望咱俩天天啥也不干，搂在一起哭吧[laughing]。]
english_text: [Dad definitely wouldn't want us to just do nothing and hug each other crying all day [laughing].]

chinese_text: [你都替我哭完了[laughing]。]
english_text: [You've already done all the crying for me [laughing].]

chinese_text: [都会，都会好的。]
english_text: [Everything will be alright, everything will get better.]

chinese_text: [都会好的。]
english_text: [Everything will get better.]

chinese_text: [他们就觉得，你为这个工作应该付出你的全部，然后你还应该不求回报。那我是为什么？我为爱发电吗？]
english_text: [They think you should give your all to this job and not expect anything in return. Then what am I doing it for? Am I supposed to generate electricity from love?]

chinese_text: [我们也从来都没给过，但我们是哪种加班儿，我们跟你们这还不一样。]
english_text: [We've never received it either, but our kind of overtime is different from yours.]

chinese_text: [对，就是这种。有一天晚上的时候，十一点钟了，给我打电话,让我把这个东西马上发给他做出来。我上哪儿去做呀？我用的那个电脑根本就不行，我还得跑到单位，跟你一样，哎呦真服了！]
english_text: [Right, exactly that kind. One night at 11 o'clock, they called me and told me to immediately send this thing to them to get it done. Where was I supposed to do it? The computer I use isn't capable enough, so I had to run to the office, just like you. Oh my god, I can't even!]

chinese_text: [我们是晚上正常六点下班儿。但是到了六点没人敢走，全都九点以后才走。谁要是走了，他就批评。]
english_text: [We're supposed to get off work at 6 PM normally. But when 6 PM comes, no one dares to leave; everyone stays until after 9 PM. If anyone leaves, he criticizes them.]

chinese_text: [哎呦，真的是没法说。]
english_text: [Oh my, it's really speechless.]

chinese_text: [哪是提前下班儿？人家是正点儿走，但是他就不是。他就说哎你就应该九点下班儿，你看有人动吗？那是谁敢动啊？]
english_text: [How is that leaving early? They're leaving right on time, but he doesn't see it that way. He says you should leave at 9 PM. Look, is anyone moving? Who would dare to move?]

chinese_text: [怎么了？]
english_text: [What's wrong?]

chinese_text: [那就等于是占这两天的时间，让你去做。]
english_text: [That's equivalent to taking up these two days to make you do it.]

chinese_text: [那这些是不是都是我工作之外，我本职工作之外的事儿？那是不是应该给我补贴？]
english_text: [So aren't these all things outside of my job, beyond my regular duties? Shouldn't I get compensation for them?]

chinese_text: [每天一大堆的事儿，然后老是临时丢过来这事儿，临时丢过来那事儿。把这个完成，那个完成。我哪有那么多时间去完成这个？]
english_text: [Every day there's a pile of things, and they're always throwing last-minute tasks at me, this and that. Finish this, finish that. Where do I find so much time to complete all this?]

chinese_text: [哎，我跟你说我好气呀。]
english_text: [Ugh, let me tell you, I'm so angry.]

chinese_text: [然后我跟他讲，我说可是周末我们休息。他说对啊，所以让你礼拜一给我，那我请问我加班儿，那我的休息在哪儿呢？]
english_text: [Then I told him, I said but we rest on weekends. He said yes, that's why I asked you to give it to me on Monday. But then I ask, if I work overtime, when do I get my rest?]

chinese_text: [对啊，而且他们还经常就是，在公司的时候从来不跟你说。每次我，好多次，我每次就是回家之后，哎洗漱完吃完饭了要睡觉了。一个电话过来说，今天那个什么什么什么东西你还没给我。]
english_text: [Exactly, and they often, when they're at the company, never tell you anything. Many times, every time I get home after washing up, eating dinner, and about to sleep, they call saying you haven't given me that such-and-such thing today.]

chinese_text: [我说要下班儿了，他说嗯，你礼拜一给我。可是周末是休息呀，是我自己的时间呀。]
english_text: [I said it's time to get off work, he said hmm, give it to me on Monday. But weekends are for rest, that's my personal time.]

chinese_text: [不是这。]
english_text: [No, that's not it.]

chinese_text: [不给呀。]
english_text: [I'm not giving it.]

chinese_text: [天哪！哎而且他们就是，我他们难道不理解吗？就是我在工作之余的时间，都叫加班儿。难道他们以为这是我们应该的吗？]
english_text: [Oh my god! And they just, don't they understand? Any time I spend beyond work hours is called overtime. Do they really think this is something we should be doing?]

chinese_text: [我心想你为什么不在公司给我要呢？然后我有那么几次，就是我要专门跑到公司去，把这个东西拷下来，再发给他。]
english_text: [I'm thinking why didn't you ask me for this at the company? Then there were several times when I had to specifically run to the office to copy this thing and then send it to him.]

chinese_text: [哎呦我不想干了。]
english_text: [Ugh, I don't want to do this anymore.]

chinese_text: [我每天我的天哪，哎早晨开会，下午开会，晚上临下班还要开会。天天开会咱们上哪去工完成工作呢？]
english_text: [Every day, oh my god, meetings in the morning, meetings in the afternoon, and another meeting right before getting off work. With meetings every day, when are we supposed to get our work done?]

chinese_text: [你知道我们老板，我不知道他犯什么莫名其妙的神经。哎！礼拜五，马上要下班儿了，给我一个表说，你赶紧做啊。]
english_text: [You know our boss, I don't know what weird idea got into him. Ugh! On Friday, right when I'm about to get off work, he gives me a form and says, hurry up and do this.]

chinese_text: [从来没有。]
english_text: [Never.]

chinese_text: [而且,就是他还经常说什么，那为什么别人能完成，你完不成呢？]
english_text: [And also, he often says things like, why can others complete it, but you can't?]

chinese_text: [板儿上钉钉的事儿了，就已经。]
english_text: [It's already a done deal.]

chinese_text: [说的什么呀？]
english_text: [What are you talking about?]

chinese_text: [可以在，嘶，我的想法啊，把所有的道具啊，景儿啊，我们可以加入一点儿预算。]
english_text: [We could, um, my idea is that for all the props, scenery, we could add a little to the budget.]

chinese_text: [我们就先演小剧场，然后小剧场打下一定基础之后，然后我们再去演大剧场。]
english_text: [Let's first perform in small theaters, and after building a certain foundation with small theater performances, then we can move on to big theaters.]

chinese_text: [没问题，先别想这么多了，咱们先好好准备。]
english_text: [No problem, let's not think too much about it now, let's just prepare well first.]

chinese_text: [但是这么说，还不一定，但是我觉得咱们这个戏，还是挺有希望的。]
english_text: [But having said that, it's not certain, but I think our play has quite a lot of potential.]

chinese_text: [出结果了啊？通过了。]
english_text: [The results are out? It passed.]

chinese_text: [有这个机会。]
english_text: [We have this opportunity.]

chinese_text: [十一月，那咱们还得准备准备，还得再排一排。有一些问题，我觉得可以再解决一下，如果能解决了，我觉得要比之前那个版本要好得多呢。]
english_text: [November, so we still need to prepare and rehearse more. There are some issues I think we can resolve, and if we can, I think it will be much better than the previous version.]

chinese_text: [哎，而且我听说，这次如果能拿到最优秀的那个奖，可能咱们俩都能被评优秀演员。]
english_text: [Hey, and I heard that if we get the most outstanding award this time, both of us might be named outstanding actors.]

chinese_text: [那有这个的话，那咱们都可以投入商演啦。]
english_text: [With that, we can both get into commercial performances.]

chinese_text: [啊啊，我记得。]
english_text: [Ah, I remember.]

chinese_text: [然后把整体再往起提一提，然后包括咱们的表演什么的。]
english_text: [Then let's elevate the overall quality, including our performance and everything.]

chinese_text: [多少钱？十个？]
english_text: [How much? Ten?]

chinese_text: [对，而且我们还可以把道具啊，我们的景啊，重新都设计一下，争取让它更完美。]
english_text: [Yes, and we can also redesign the props, our scenery, and everything, striving to make it more perfect.]

chinese_text: [我们通过了。]
english_text: [We passed.]

chinese_text: [哦，天哪，那太好了。]
english_text: [Oh, my god, that's great.]

chinese_text: [十万块。十万块。]
english_text: [One hundred thousand yuan. One hundred thousand yuan.]

chinese_text: [我今天接到了一个电话。]
english_text: [I received a phone call today.]

chinese_text: [对，哦，天哪！想想都好开心呀，所以我们这次一定要好好搞。]
english_text: [Yes, oh my god! I get happy just thinking about it, so we must do a great job this time.]

chinese_text: [通过了。]
english_text: [Passed.]

chinese_text: [咱们四月份投的那个戏剧节，你还记得吗？]
english_text: [Do you remember that theater festival we submitted to in April?]

chinese_text: [是的，我们在十一月份，就要去参演了。]
english_text: [Yes, we're going to perform in it in November.]

chinese_text: [对啊。而且我看他们上面有那个评奖的，那个准则嘛。然后，如果说评到了戏剧金奖的话，你知道奖金有多少钱吗？]
english_text: [Right. And I saw they have the criteria for awards. And if we win the Gold Drama Award, do you know how much the prize money is?]

chinese_text: [对啊，如果说，我们能顺利的拿到这个奖金的话，那后面我们完全可以去让我们这个戏，比如说在剧院呀，在各种地方都可以去演了。]
english_text: [Right, if we can successfully get this prize money, then afterward we can definitely take our play to perform in theaters and various other places.]

chinese_text: [真的吗？]
english_text: [Really?]

chinese_text: [哎，是这儿吗？]
english_text: [Hey, is this the place?]

chinese_text: [多贵啊？]
english_text: [How expensive is it?]

chinese_text: [那会不会有我最喜欢的那个歌手啊？]
english_text: [Will my favorite singer be there?]

chinese_text: [天呐！那我还。]
english_text: [Oh my god! Then I still...]

chinese_text: [这是咱们公司办的？]
english_text: [Is this organized by our company?]

chinese_text: [一千多一捧？]
english_text: [Over a thousand per bouquet?]

chinese_text: [哎，这个是香槟吗？]
english_text: [Hey, is this champagne?]

chinese_text: [嗯，我觉得差不多哎。]
english_text: [Hmm, I think it's about right.]

chinese_text: [我的妈呀！哎，那公司今年是挣了多少钱呀？]
english_text: [Oh my god! Hey, how much money did the company make this year?]

chinese_text: [天呐！这也太好看啦！]
english_text: [Oh my god! This is so beautiful!]

chinese_text: [[laughing]天呐，太棒了！哎那你说，今天晚会会有就是比如说明星啊什么的？你有听说吗？]
english_text: [Oh my god, that's great! Hey, do you think there will be celebrities or something at tonight's party? Have you heard anything?]

chinese_text: [一百多块钱一块儿？]
english_text: [Over 100 yuan for one piece?]

chinese_text: [天呐，那也太棒了！]
english_text: [Oh my god, that's amazing!]

chinese_text: [我这次年终奖，我觉得按我的贡献，我是不是能发这个数儿？]
english_text: [For my year-end bonus this time, considering my contribution, do you think I could get this amount?]

chinese_text: [那个好像我在商场见过，好像都一百多块钱一个呢。]
english_text: [I think I've seen that in the mall, they were over 100 yuan each.]

chinese_text: [咱们今天真是来着了，今年来这个公司，看来赚的不少。]
english_text: [We really lucked out today. It seems we've earned quite a bit by joining this company this year.]

chinese_text: [你看见那花儿没有？]
english_text: [Did you see those flowers?]

chinese_text: [那花儿你知道多贵吗？]
english_text: [Do you know how expensive those flowers are?]

chinese_text: [我觉得不一定来谁，但是来的肯定是知名的。咱们期待一下儿吧。]
english_text: [I'm not sure who will come, but whoever comes will definitely be famous. Let's look forward to it.]

chinese_text: [能吧，你看这儿摆了一溜。哎，那点心是不是挺高级的？]
english_text: [Probably. Look, they're lined up here. Hey, isn't that pastry quite high-end?]

chinese_text: [那一千多就那么一捧。]
english_text: [That's over 1,000 for just that small bunch.]

chinese_text: [我觉得你也行[laughing]。]
english_text: [I think you can do it too [laughing].]

chinese_text: [一千多，就那么一捧。]
english_text: [Over 1,000 for just that small bunch.]

chinese_text: [这个好像是，我也不太懂，这。]
english_text: [This seems to be... I don't really understand this.]

chinese_text: [哎哎哎哎。]
english_text: [Hey hey hey hey.]

chinese_text: [不知道啊，那我们这个，是不是年终奖也能多发点儿？]
english_text: [I don't know. Do you think our year-end bonuses could be a bit more generous too?]

chinese_text: [然后关键问题，你拿着这个弄儿开的螃蟹，你去找他。人家说，你怎么证明这是我这的？]
english_text: [And here's the key problem: you take that opened crab to him, and he asks, how can you prove this is from my place?]

chinese_text: [我说我就下来了，怎么就不是，你调这个监控。他说我凭什么给你调监控？啊。我真是无话可说了。]
english_text: [I said I just came down from here, how could it not be? Check the surveillance. He says, why should I check the surveillance for you? Ah. I was truly speechless.]

chinese_text: [他给你掺水有多严重了吗？而且这而且这都不是什么，那个形容的掺水。]
english_text: [How severely did they water it down for you? And this... this isn't even the kind of watering down you can describe.]

chinese_text: [这这没法沟通，我说我这刚买回去，你就不认识我了。我我不知道，你这不是跟我这买的。]
english_text: [This is impossible to communicate. I said I just bought this and came back, and you don't recognize me. I don't know, you didn't buy this from me.]

chinese_text: [一打开全是水，你那螃蟹放多久了？你那去年的螃蟹吧。]
english_text: [When you open it, it's all water. How long have you kept those crabs? Those are from last year, aren't they?]

chinese_text: [你至少它得有黄嘛，母螃蟹呀！]
english_text: [At least it should have roe, it's a female crab!]

chinese_text: [对，他说是你自己弄的，而且你凭什么说是在我这买的，你怎么证明了，你没法证明。哎呀，我跟你讲就以后买东西，就还是得去正规的超市买，没法去市场。]
english_text: [Right, he says you did it yourself, and on what basis do you say you bought it from me? How can you prove it? You can't prove it. Ugh, let me tell you, from now on, we should still buy things from proper supermarkets, not from markets.]

chinese_text: [我知道你说了，就是他把里子全都给冻实了，这样他那个重量，能卖你卖的更多。]
english_text: [I know what you're saying, he froze the insides solid, so that the weight is heavier, and he can sell you more.]

english_text: [Right, I think since they have this idea, then there's definitely a possibility. As long as we do our preparation work well, and we can introduce our ideas and things in sufficient detail, they will definitely be interested.]

chinese_text: [那，庆祝庆祝？]
english_text: [So, should we celebrate?]

chinese_text: [突然就感觉我们好像站起来了！]
english_text: [Suddenly I feel like we've stood up!]

chinese_text: [哦，真没想到，我们居然真的做到了。]
english_text: [Oh, I really didn't expect that we actually did it.]

chinese_text: [可以啊。]
english_text: [That's great.]

chinese_text: [卖光啦？]
english_text: [Sold out?]

chinese_text: [哎，那我们能不能去比如说像重庆啊，成都啊，这种我很喜欢的城市？]
english_text: [Hey, can we go to cities that I really like, such as Chongqing, Chengdu, and so on?]

chinese_text: [对呀，而且我们有第一轮儿的这个铺垫，后面一定很好。]
english_text: [Yes, and with the foundation we've built in this first round, the future will definitely be great.]

chinese_text: [啊，想想都开心。]
english_text: [Ah, it makes me happy just thinking about it.]

chinese_text: [对对对。]
english_text: [Yes, yes, yes.]

chinese_text: [对啊，而且如果我们，反馈很好的话，那我们到时候可以把它再继续投入，继续去做成更好的剧目。]
english_text: [Right, and if we get very good feedback, then we can continue to invest in it and make it into an even better play.]

chinese_text: [那我去准备。]
english_text: [Then I'll go prepare.]

chinese_text: [已经卖光了。]
english_text: [It's already sold out.]

chinese_text: [哪怕上座率不像这个这么高但是，我觉得应该也没什么太大问题，跟这个应该大差不差。]
english_text: [Even if the attendance rate isn't as high as this, I think there shouldn't be too big of a problem. It should be about the same.]

chinese_text: [我觉得效果应该越来越好，票应该卖的也是越来越好。]
english_text: [I think the results should get better and better, and ticket sales should also get better and better.]

chinese_text: [没问题/over]。]
english_text: [No problem.]

chinese_text: [啊，南京咱们都去。然后，把这一轮儿演出结束之后，咱们就可以想想投入大剧院的事儿了，因为咱们现在是小剧场嘛，如果上座率这么好的情况下，我觉得可以，再找投资人商量商量。]
english_text: [Ah, we'll all go to Nanjing. Then, after this round of performances is over, we can think about moving into the grand theater, since we're currently in a small theater. With such good attendance rates, I think we can discuss it with investors again.]

chinese_text: [而且这四轮儿演下来，所有人都已经磨合的差不多了。]
english_text: [And after these four rounds of performances, everyone has pretty much gotten in sync with each other.]

chinese_text: [咱们当时想的是百分之六十的上座率，咱们就已经相当厉害了。]
english_text: [We initially thought that a 60% attendance rate would already be quite impressive.]

chinese_text: [哎你知道咱们商演的那个戏，首轮儿的票。]
english_text: [Hey, you know about the tickets for the first round of our commercial performance.]

chinese_text: [一共四场，场场爆满。]
english_text: [There were four shows in total, and every single one was sold out.]

chinese_text: [那我我先去找投资人聊聊大剧场的事儿？]
english_text: [So should I go talk to the investors about the grand theater first?]

chinese_text: [结果这四场全都卖爆，诶我是这么想的，后边儿咱们现在原本就寻四个城市，咱们要不加到，七个城市。]
english_text: [As it turns out, all four shows completely sold out. Here's what I'm thinking: we originally planned for four cities, but why don't we expand to seven cities?]

chinese_text: [就这个口碑打下来了之后，那其实咱们团的名气就打出来了。]
english_text: [Once we've established this reputation, our troupe's fame will really take off.]

chinese_text: [我想的也是，成都咱们去。]
english_text: [I think so too, let's go to Chengdu.]

chinese_text: [呃，还可以去上海。]
english_text: [Uh, we can also go to Shanghai.]

chinese_text: [行，好嘞。]
english_text: [Okay, great.]

chinese_text: [哦，行没事没事，那就回头。]
english_text: [Oh, okay, no problem, we'll talk later then.]

chinese_text: [哦呦，不错当老板啦！[laughing]那你就定居在这了是吗？]
english_text: [Oh wow, becoming a boss now! [laughing] Does that mean you've settled down here?]

chinese_text: [对，就回去也凑不到一块儿，真没想到这缘分。]
english_text: [Yeah, we couldn't get together even when I went back. I really didn't expect this fate.]

chinese_text: [哎，你说咱小时候啊，天天在一块儿，这上学放学都跟那分不开似的。好家伙这一过这么多年，还真挺恍惚的。]
english_text: [Hey, you know when we were kids, we were together every day, going to and from school as if we were inseparable. Wow, after so many years, it all feels quite surreal.]

chinese_text: [啊？怎么是你呀？]
english_text: [Huh? How is it you?]

chinese_text: [做医美方向。]
english_text: [I'm in the medical aesthetics field.]

chinese_text: [哎呦！真不错哎。哎这这么多年没见，你这没变样，还这么帅。]
english_text: [Oh wow! That's really great. Hey, after not seeing each other for so many years, you haven't changed a bit, still so handsome.]

chinese_text: [啧，还行吧，凑合活呗，哎你在这干啥？]
english_text: [Well, it's alright, just getting by. Hey, what are you doing here?]

chinese_text: [好嘞。那咱常联系啊。]
english_text: [Great. Let's keep in touch then.]

chinese_text: [嗨，我出差嘛。]
english_text: [Hey, I'm here on a business trip.]

chinese_text: [是呢，其实从毕业之后，咱们俩就好像就很少见了哈？因为老家那边也。]
english_text: [Yeah, actually, we've rarely seen each other since graduation, right? Because of our hometown situation too.]

chinese_text: [好嘞，好嘞。]
english_text: [Great, great.]

chinese_text: [你这不也挺好吗？你小老板[laughing]，那怎么着晚上有事吗？]
english_text: [You're doing pretty well yourself too, little boss [laughing]. So, got any plans for tonight?]

chinese_text: [你怎么跑上海来了？]
english_text: [How did you end up in Shanghai?]

chinese_text: [也有事儿。]
english_text: [I've got things to do too.]

chinese_text: [还帅什么呀？我就还还是那样，嘴贫[laughing]。]
english_text: [What's so handsome about me? I'm still the same, just running my mouth [laughing].]

chinese_text: [哎我这挺想你的，我这也没想到在这能见着你啊！]
english_text: [Hey, I've been missing you. I didn't expect to run into you here!]

chinese_text: [哎？你怎么在这呢？]
english_text: [Huh? What are you doing here?]

chinese_text: [[laughing]小老板小老板，我现在基本就小房子住着呗，租人住着[laughing]。]
english_text: [[laughing] Little boss, little boss, I'm basically just living in a small place now, renting from someone [laughing].]

chinese_text: [哎，行行，没问题没问题。]
english_text: [Alright, alright, no problem, no problem.]

chinese_text: [好嘞，常常联系常联系好，先走了啊！]
english_text: [Alright, let's keep in touch, let's keep in touch. I'm heading off now!]

chinese_text: [瞎忙呗[laughing]。]
english_text: [Just busy with random stuff [laughing].]

chinese_text: [哪有你这样的人？]
english_text: [What kind of person are you?]

chinese_text: [我求求你了大姐，每天早上你起的早我还得睡觉呢，你那洗漱叮当五四，那动静能不能小一点儿呀。]
english_text: [I'm begging you, ma'am. You wake up early every morning while I still need to sleep. Could you please make less noise when you're washing up?]

chinese_text: [哎，你别转移话题行不行？]
english_text: [Hey, can you not change the subject?]

chinese_text: [我又不是不收，我收了，只是我收的晚了，你没听懂吗？]
english_text: [It's not that I don't take it in, I do take it in, I just take it in late. Didn't you understand?]

chinese_text: [你管我呢，我愿意，我看着舒服，我就看那垃圾我舒服。]
english_text: [It's none of your business. I want to, it makes me feel comfortable. I feel comfortable looking at that garbage.]

chinese_text: [哎，那我的上班时间不是那个，你影响到我了，我跟你说一下这件事这件事我有错吗？]
english_text: [Well, my work schedule isn't like that. You're affecting me, and I'm telling you about this. Am I wrong?]

chinese_text: [那我们能不能互相理解一下，你能不能理解一下我呢？]
english_text: [Can we try to understand each other? Can you try to understand me?]

chinese_text: [哎，你刚才自己也说了，我每天的工作，我回来需要就是这么晚。]
english_text: [Hey, you just said it yourself - with my daily job, I need to come back this late.]

chinese_text: [不是应该，但我的工作他不允许啊，他不是我的工作呀！]
english_text: [I know it's not ideal, but my job doesn't allow it, it's not my job!]

chinese_text: [那照你这样，我把垃圾我再堆多两天。]
english_text: [Well, according to your logic, I'll just let the garbage pile up for a couple more days.]

chinese_text: [哎，那你上班儿，我那个时候不上班。我需要休息我要睡眠你懂吗？]
english_text: [Well, you go to work, but I don't work at that time. I need rest, I need sleep, do you understand?]

chinese_text: [那你要是这样，我每天晚上回来的时候，我也叮当五四，我就吵你，你觉也别睡！]
english_text: [If you're going to be like that, then when I come back every night, I'll make a lot of noise too, I'll disturb you, and you won't get any sleep either!]

chinese_text: [那好，你这么说，那垃圾以后我一直不收，我就那么摆。]
english_text: [Fine, if that's what you're saying, then I'll never take in the garbage from now on, I'll just leave it there.]

chinese_text: [我有在收，只不过我就是收的晚了一点而已呀。]
english_text: [I do take it in, it's just that I take it in a little late, that's all.]

chinese_text: [我说的是你每天早上你影响我睡眠的事儿。]
english_text: [I'm talking about you affecting my sleep every morning.]

chinese_text: [到底是谁不讲理啊！明明你退一步，你理解一下就行了。]
english_text: [Who's really being unreasonable here! All you need to do is take a step back and try to understand.]

chinese_text: [你凭什么不收啊？这是公共区域。]
english_text: [On what grounds are you not taking it in? This is a public area.]

chinese_text: [那你为什么不能及时收了呢？]
english_text: [Then why can't you pick it up in time?]

chinese_text: [那照你这样，我在早起半个小时呗！]
english_text: [Then according to you, I should just wake up half an hour earlier!]

chinese_text: [哪有你这样的人呀！那照你。]
english_text: [Who's like you! According to you.]

chinese_text: [好好好，我不想跟你说了，好吧，我现在要去工作了。]
english_text: [Fine, fine, I don't want to talk to you anymore, okay, I need to go to work now.]

chinese_text: [不是，哎，早睡早起不应该是吗？]
english_text: [No, hey, isn't going to bed early and waking up early the right thing to do?]

chinese_text: [我转移什么话题？]
english_text: [What topic am I changing?]

chinese_text: [我为什么要理解你呢？你真好笑。]
english_text: [Why should I understand you? You're ridiculous.]

chinese_text: [不是，你怎么这么不讲理呢？]
english_text: [No, why are you so unreasonable?]

chinese_text: [那可是我的工作，就要求我这个点必须得起来呀!]
english_text: [That's my job, which requires me to get up at this time!]

chinese_text: [我要上班儿啊。]
english_text: [I have to go to work.]

chinese_text: [行，你堆你堆吧，反正我看到垃圾我就扔你卧室门口，我管你这。]
english_text: [Fine, you pile it up then. Anyway, whenever I see trash, I'll just throw it at your bedroom door. I don't care about your stuff.]

chinese_text: [那那你早点儿睡不就好了吗？]
english_text: [Then wouldn't it be better if you just went to bed earlier?]

chinese_text: [你就不能完事儿之后，收拾好了放在门口吗？你非得让我第二天早晨一起来看到。]
english_text: [Can't you just clean up and put it by the door after you're done? Do you have to make me see it the moment I wake up the next morning?]

chinese_text: [我怎么了？我我哎我按时起来上班我有错是吗？]
english_text: [What's wrong with me? I... I... I get up on time for work, is that wrong?]

chinese_text: [那你早点儿睡啊！哎，下次能不能麻烦你不要带带别人来家里，并且把你在客厅公共区域制造的垃圾收好，好吗？]
english_text: [Then go to bed earlier! Hey, could you please not bring other people home next time, and clean up the trash you make in the living room and other common areas, okay?]

chinese_text: [哎，那你旁边没跟人吗？]
english_text: [Hey, wasn't there anyone with you?]

chinese_text: [对，而且你也不知道他们有没有带武器什么的。]
english_text: [Right, and you don't know if they're carrying weapons or anything.]

chinese_text: [啊，咋了？]
english_text: [Huh, what's wrong?]

chinese_text: [我听你说的，我都好害怕。]
english_text: [Hearing what you said, I'm really scared.]

chinese_text: [我当时是自己出去上厕所的，就没有任何人，然后我也不敢喊，我就看着他走。因为我喊了，我怕被他们在聚拢过来，再发生点儿什么。]
english_text: [At that time, I went out to use the restroom by myself, there was no one else, and I didn't dare to shout. I just watched him leave. Because if I shouted, I was afraid they would gather around and something else might happen.]

chinese_text: [晚上我们在酒吧，那间酒吧，它的卫生间在外面。我们想上卫生间，必须要从酒吧的门口出来。]
english_text: [At night we were at a bar, and that bar's restroom was outside. If we wanted to use the restroom, we had to go out through the bar's entrance.]

chinese_text: [对，真的很害怕。然后我就赶紧去完卫生间，出来。出来的时候，我恨不得我在他们面前，我相对镇定。但是在他们看不见我的地方，我恨不得我是跑着跑回去的。]
english_text: [Right, I was really scared. Then I quickly finished using the restroom and came out. When I came out, I tried to appear relatively calm in front of them. But where they couldn't see me, I wished I could have run back.]

chinese_text: [太吓人了就那个状态。]
english_text: [That situation was terrifying.]

chinese_text: [出到外面之后，你就看见那些流浪汉，然后包括，有的人，他就往那一站，就这样看着你。]
english_text: [After going outside, you would see those homeless people, and including some people who would just stand there, staring at you like that.]

chinese_text: [从我手里，把我带的一个手包，就直接就给抢走了。]
english_text: [A handbag I was carrying was snatched directly from my hand.]

chinese_text: [然后但是你知道在国外那个环境，我又不敢说什么，而且旁边全是那样看着我的人。就所有人都在那样，就目光呆滞的看着你。]
english_text: [But you know, in that foreign environment, I didn't dare to say anything, and everyone around me was looking at me like that. Everyone was just staring blankly at you.]

chinese_text: [有一天晚上我们去酒吧，我现在想起来，我真的庆幸，没再发生什么更严重的事儿。]
english_text: [One night we went to a bar, and now that I think about it, I'm really grateful that nothing more serious happened.]

chinese_text: [哎呀就你，我根本就不敢想象，当时我要是多待一会儿，会发生什么。]
english_text: [Oh my god, I can't even imagine what would have happened if I had stayed any longer.]

chinese_text: [你知道我这趟出国，我们不是旅游吗，本来高高兴兴的。]
english_text: [You know, this trip abroad, we were supposed to be traveling, originally so happy.]

chinese_text: [但是就在这个时候，突然从我身后就冲出了一个黑影儿。我根本就看不见那个人长什么样儿，就冲出了一个黑影，比我还高，比我还壮。]
english_text: [But just at that moment, a dark figure suddenly rushed out from behind me. I couldn't see what the person looked like at all, just a dark figure rushed out, taller and stronger than me.]

chinese_text: [就这么看着你，然后你得走过这些人。你知道当他们看着我的时候，整个人我都发毛，我就怕发生点什么。]
english_text: [They just stare at you like that, and then you have to walk past these people. You know, when they looked at me, I got goosebumps all over, I was afraid something might happen.]

chinese_text: [你知道那天晚上，因为国外的晚上，跟咱们这边晚上不一样，他们那边晚上不安全。]
english_text: [You know that night, because nights abroad are different from our nights here, it's not safe over there at night.]

chinese_text: [嗯，超级舒服。而且你看，我们楼底下小区绿化老好了。]
english_text: [Hmm, super comfortable. And look, the green landscaping in our residential complex downstairs is really nice.]

chinese_text: [对吧？而且我喜欢什么颜色，喜欢什么家具，我都可以自己选择呀。]
english_text: [Right? And I can choose whatever colors and furniture I like myself.]

chinese_text: [买的呀。]
english_text: [I bought it.]

chinese_text: [哎，你来这儿。看，噔噔，江景房。]
english_text: [Hey, come here. Look, ta-da, a river-view apartment.]

chinese_text: [全款我哪付得起啊？我就首付自己掏了点儿，跟爸妈要了点儿，就。]
english_text: [How could I afford to pay in full? I just paid the down payment with some of my own money and asked my parents for a bit.]

chinese_text: [不，我跟你说，我这个非常的幸运。就刚好拿到的那个点，跟我，其实我算下来跟我之前租房子差不多。可是你看这样的话，我就拥有了一套自己的小房子，多好啊。]
english_text: [No, let me tell you, I was very lucky. The timing when I got it, actually, when I calculated, it's about the same as what I used to pay for rent. But look, this way, I own my own little house, how great is that.]

chinese_text: [对，你还得跟房东商量，还得就怕人家。]
english_text: [Right, and you have to negotiate with the landlord, and you're afraid of them too.]

chinese_text: [都是我自己亲自选的。]
english_text: [I chose everything myself personally.]

chinese_text: [就挺好。]
english_text: [It's pretty good.]

chinese_text: [哎呀，每天站在这儿，心情都贼好。]
english_text: [Oh my, standing here every day puts me in such a great mood.]
